docs.title: Abstracts
Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
docs.text:
2610.12445v1 by Oskar J. Hollinsworth, Alex F. Spies, Tigist Diriba, Adam Gleave, Chris Cundy

Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.

摘要：最近的事件突顯了監控 LLM 代理的挑戰以及模型欺騙人類的危險。我們顯示通過探針的白盒欺騙檢測可以擴展到前沿監控設置，方法是收集迄今為止最大的欺騙數據集來訓練探針，並引入一種新穎的探針架構，可以在多層和多個標記之間聚合信息。我們的探針在 SHADE-Arena 中達到了 98.8% 的 AUC，超越了 Opus 5.5 的文本監控基準，並顯示出隨著基礎模型的擴展，效能有所改善。為了將我們的探針推向極限，我們在幾個情況下進行測試，在這些情況下，僅從上下文無法確定欺騙。在這些情況中，我們稱之為內省欺騙，真實情況只能通過仔細引導或對模型訓練數據的透徹了解來確定。在其中一次評估中，我們顯示探針可以區分包含模型真正隱藏目標的轉錄本與其他目標，AUC 高達 99.7%。我們的探針還能輕易檢測出在政治敏感話題上撒謊的顯著開放權重模型，以及在壓力下對其信念的表述。我們發布了名為 FIBS 的訓練數據集，以幫助推動有效探針的前沿部署，並鼓勵社群以更多的欺騙和破壞例子來擴展這一數據集。

docs.title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
docs.text:
2610.12337v1 by Jialei He, Enhe Liu, Sifan Song, Pengfei Jin, Jionglong Su, Hongbin Wang, Zhixiang Lu, Yanhao Huang, Anteng Cai, Zhengyong Jiang, Jiaman Ding, S. Kevin Zhou, Jinfeng Wang

Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.

摘要：解剖連續性為醫學影像重建提供了補充信息，但其使用需要考慮局部解剖結構和切片取樣的變異。我們介紹了ContiLNN，它通過雙向封閉形式的連續時間（Bi-CfC）模塊增強了二維重建骨幹，以進行切片間建模，同時保留平面內特徵提取。切片索引間隔調節由局部特徵和隱藏狀態決定的閘門，使得傳播能夠響應取樣變異，而無需數值ODE整合。參考引導的一致性將第一和第二階切片強度差異對齊，以保留解剖變異，同時從凍結的骨幹中進行蒸餾有助於保持平面內的真實性。在五個訓練種子中，ContiLNN在CT去噪、MRI超解析度和減少計數的PET重建方面，分別提高了平均PSNR 0.1907、1.0176和1.2482 dB，且在所有三個任務中RMSE均較低。CT結果對於一名保留的患者具有描述性。PET消融支持超出額外點狀容量的有序傳播。在連續訓練下，Bi-CfC在所有測試的取樣條件下實現了比擁有相似參數數量和算術成本的Bi-GRU更高的真實性。匹配的七切片分析顯示其延遲低52.8%和峰值GPU內存使用低57.0%相比Bi-GRU。混合間隙訓練改善了兩個運算元的稀疏和不規則上下文性能，但在指標和上下文中並未形成統一的排名。對於較少的訓練患者和第二個骨幹的實驗進一步支持了數據效率和骨幹兼容性。

docs.title: OA-MAP: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Multimodal Framework for Interpretable Knee Osteoarthritis Progression
docs.text:
2610.12134v1 by Sixu Chen, Mingrui Yang, Qiang Guan, Xiaojuan Li

Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) progression prediction can support patient monitoring, requiring the integration of multimodal data and multidomain expertise. Moreover, isolated risk estimates provide limited insight underlying a prediction. To automate the progression assessment workflow and reduce manual effort while providing interpretable findings and supporting evidence, we present OA-MAP, an autonomous multi-agent framework for evidence-grounded assessment of structural and pain progression in KOA. The system incorporates modality-specific agents including MRI, X-ray, and clinical agents, together with a coordinator agent. This framework can autonomously recruit specialist agents, select tools for prediction and analysis, and retrieve literature as external evidence based on user request and available patient information. An uncertainty-informed human-in-the-loop mechanism enables clinicians to review and correct intermediate findings, triggering recomputation of affected results. We evaluate the prediction models using 600 participants from the FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium cohort. On the test set of 100 participants, the fusion models achieve AUROCs of 0.80 for structural progression and 0.68 for pain progression. A case study illustrates how OA-MAP combines risk estimates with intermediate findings, cross-modal conflicts, literature support, and uncertainty indicators to support interactive review.

摘要：膝關節骨關節炎（KOA）進展預測可以支持患者監測，這需要整合多模態數據和多領域專業知識。此外，孤立的風險估計對於預測的基本洞察提供有限的幫助。為了自動化進展評估工作流程並減少手動工作，同時提供可解釋的發現和支持證據，我們提出了OA-MAP，這是一個自動化的多代理框架，用於基於證據的KOA結構和疼痛進展評估。該系統包含特定模態的代理，包括MRI、X光和臨床代理，以及一個協調代理。這個框架可以自主招募專家代理，選擇預測和分析工具，並根據用戶請求和可用的患者信息檢索文獻作為外部證據。一個不確定性知情的人工介入機制使臨床醫生能夠審查和修正中間發現，觸發受影響結果的重新計算。我們使用來自FNIH骨關節炎生物標誌物聯盟隊列的600名參與者來評估預測模型。在100名參與者的測試集上，融合模型在結構進展方面達到0.80的AUROC，在疼痛進展方面達到0.68的AUROC。一個案例研究說明了OA-MAP如何將風險估計與中間發現、跨模態衝突、文獻支持和不確定性指標結合，以支持互動審查。

docs.title: Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction for Effective Subgroup Reliability
docs.text:
2610.11957v1 by Meihui Zhong, Wenxin Tai, Ting Zhong, Fan Zhou

Conformal prediction offers a distribution-free coverage guarantee, making it especially attractive for clinical applications. Standard conformal prediction, however, provides such guarantees only at the population level, and its prediction sets can exhibit coverage disparities across clinically important subgroups. A natural remedy is to calibrate within predefined groups. However, this can require access to sensitive subgroup attributes and is prone to a worst-group bottleneck: protecting the most difficult subgroup can inflate prediction sets for all, increasing cognitive burden on decision makers. To this end, we propose Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction (SGCP), a conformal framework for subgroup-reliable uncertainty quantification. It learns a stochastic grouping map that allows each sample to draw calibration information from others with similar calibration behavior, yielding a local score law that boosts reliability across subpopulations. We prove that SGCP retains the standard coverage guarantee. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that it consistently reduces subgroup coverage gaps while achieving smaller or comparable prediction set sizes relative to existing baselines.

摘要：符合預測提供了一種無分佈的覆蓋保證，使其在臨床應用中特別具吸引力。然後，標準的符合預測僅在整體層面提供這樣的保證，其預測集可能在臨床上重要的子群體之間顯示出覆蓋差異。一個自然的解決方案是在預定義的群體內進行校準。然而，這可能需要訪問敏感的子群體屬性，並且容易出現最差群體的瓶頸：保護最困難的子群體可能會膨脹所有人的預測集，增加決策者的認知負擔。為此，我們提出了隨機分組符合預測（SGCP），這是一種針對子群體可靠的不確定性量化的符合框架。它學習一個隨機分組映射，允許每個樣本從具有相似校準行為的其他樣本中獲取校準信息，產生一種局部得分法則，增強子群體之間的可靠性。我們證明SGCP保留了標準的覆蓋保證。在合成和現實世界基準上的實驗顯示，它始終減少子群體覆蓋差距，同時相對於現有基準達到更小或可比較的預測集大小。

docs.title: Intervention anchors and scientific verification in synthetic vascular predictive representations
docs.text:
2610.11704v1 by Lingsen You, Yujun Guo, Xinyu Zhong, Zisu Peng, Wentong Wang, Li Shen, Junbo Ge

Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates do not by themselves bind a latent direction to a named intervention. We present a mathematical and synthetic audit motivated by vascular device-vessel suitcordance. Capacity-matched least-squares predictors were exactly equivalent under complete fixed output transforms, whereas an anchor-only observer recovered interpretations only within the span of known perturbation signatures. Six three-dimensional configurations across 64 seeds gave a maximum paired prediction discrepancy of 6.7e-15 but a median untransported edit error of 1.513. Coordinate transport removed that error. Noisy and weak anchors constrained calibration stability, and changing the representation basis required recalibration or verified transport. Across 256 additional fits in dimensions 3-24, prediction equivalence persisted within 4.0e-15. We then evaluated nine deliberate runnable fault classes across 64 seeds. All 576 faulty executions completed, but each violated at least one reconstruction, prediction, delivered-edit or scope contract; all 320 valid control records passed. Repeating a faulty implementation gave exact self-agreement despite error against the separately computed simulator expectation. For one omitted-direction defect, probe coverage followed its analytic law, and rank-aware abstention protected unsupported interpretations. Scalar-noise experiments exposed both missed weak faults and excessive rejection under narrow relative tolerances. These controls provide an executable separation of prediction, semantic support and scientific acceptance. They are synthetic numerical audits, not clinical validation, neural JEPA-Anything replication, agent learning or patient treatment-effect estimation.

摘要：完整的正交預測坐標本身並不將潛在方向與命名的干預綁定。我們提出了一個數學和合成的審計，這是由血管裝置與血管的適配性所驅動。容量匹配的最小二乘預測器在完全固定輸出變換下是完全等價的，而僅依賴錨點的觀察者僅在已知擾動特徵的範圍內恢復解釋。六個三維配置在64個種子中給出了最大配對預測差異為6.7e-15，但中位數未傳輸編輯錯誤為1.513。坐標傳輸消除了該錯誤。嘈雜和弱錨點限制了校準穩定性，並且改變表示基礎需要重新校準或驗證傳輸。在3-24維的256個額外擬合中，預測等價性在4.0e-15內持續存在。我們然後評估了九個故意可執行的故障類別，涵蓋64個種子。所有576個故障執行均已完成，但每個都違反了至少一個重建、預測、交付編輯或範圍合同；所有320個有效控制記錄均通過。重複故障實現給出了精確的自我一致性，即使與單獨計算的模擬器期望存在錯誤。對於一個省略方向的缺陷，探測覆蓋遵循其分析法則，而考慮排名的棄權保護了不支持的解釋。標量噪聲實驗暴露了錯過的弱故障和在狹窄相對容忍度下的過度拒絕。這些控制提供了預測、語義支持和科學接受之間的可執行分離。它們是合成的數值審計，而不是臨床驗證、神經JEPA-任何複製、代理學習或患者治療效果估計。

docs.title: Beyond Report Imitation: Clinically Aware Multi-Image Ultrasound Report Generation from Visible Evidence
docs.text:
2610.11610v1 by Yuchen Yang, Xin Wang, Lufan Wang, Yinghong Pan, Yujuan Feng, Yuqing Yang

Generating ultrasound reports from multiple images requires aggregating clinical evidence across views, yet archived key frames capture only part of the dynamic examination. Raw-report imitation is therefore misaligned with visual supervision: content that is clinically valid for the full examination may be unverifiable from the images available to a model. This gap creates a clinical behavior alignment problem. A model must preserve visible findings, avoid diagnostic reversals and unsupported completion, and not collapse into conservative templates. We propose CAMEO, a Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration framework for ultrasound report generation. Stage I learns ultrasound visual-language primitives; Stage II performs Cross-View Evidence Grounding by distilling trusted visible report points into multi-image QA and report-style supervision; and Stage III performs Clinically Aware Preference Alignment using clinical-error-oriented preference pairs. From USReport, we construct USReport-Distilled with 17,670 evidence-grounded paired-image training instances and USReport-Pref with 21,869 preference pairs; we additionally use 25,631 PubMedVision-US ultrasound instruction samples for domain adaptation and multi-image instruction tuning. On the primary USReport-Distilled benchmark, CAMEO improves over EchoVLM from 0.25 to 0.40 BLEU-1, 0.28 to 0.45 ROUGE-1, and 0.27 to 0.43 METEOR, while raising ClinicalScore from 55.02 to 74.20. These results underscore the value of evidence-grounded supervision, clinically aware alignment, and clinically structured evaluation for reliable ultrasound report generation.

摘要：生成超聲報告需要從多個影像中聚合臨床證據，然而存檔的關鍵幀僅捕捉到動態檢查的一部分。原始報告的模仿因此與視覺監督不一致：對於完整檢查而言，臨床有效的內容可能無法從模型可用的影像中驗證。這一差距造成了臨床行為對齊問題。模型必須保留可見的發現，避免診斷逆轉和不支持的完成，並且不能陷入保守的模板。我們提出了 CAMEO，一個臨床意識的多影像證據為基礎的協調框架，用於超聲報告生成。第一階段學習超聲視覺語言基本元素；第二階段通過將可信的可見報告點提煉為多影像 QA 和報告風格監督來執行跨視圖證據對接；第三階段使用以臨床錯誤為導向的偏好對進行臨床意識的偏好對齊。從 USReport，我們構建了 USReport-Distilled，擁有 17,670 個基於證據的配對影像訓練實例，以及 USReport-Pref，擁有 21,869 個偏好對；我們還使用了 25,631 個 PubMedVision-US 超聲指令樣本進行領域適應和多影像指令調整。在主要的 USReport-Distilled 基準上，CAMEO 將 EchoVLM 的 BLEU-1 從 0.25 提升至 0.40，ROUGE-1 從 0.28 提升至 0.45，METEOR 從 0.27 提升至 0.43，同時將 ClinicalScore 從 55.02 提升至 74.20。這些結果突顯了基於證據的監督、臨床意識對齊和臨床結構化評估在可靠的超聲報告生成中的價值。

docs.title: Sera: Semantic Representation Aggregation for Reliable and Interpretable Battery Health Forecasting
docs.text:
2610.11567v1 by Jiawei Li, Fang Liu, Wei Zhang, Zuming Liu, Man-Fai Ng, Zhi Wei Seh

Battery state of health (SoH) forecasting is important for battery management, but remains challenging due to nonlinear degradation and heterogeneity across batteries. Existing data-driven approaches primarily use temporal models to learn from numerical battery time series, and higher-level degradation characteristics are often not explicitly represented. These characteristics, however, can provide degradation guidance to support reliable forecasting and make the influence of degradation more interpretable. In this paper, we propose \textsc{Sera}, a \underline{se}mantic \underline{r}epresentation \underline{a}ggregation framework that complements temporal modelling with degradation semantics. Guided by battery domain expertise, \textsc{Sera} extracts degradation semantics from time series and constructs two complementary representations using rule-based knowledge and LLM-based interpretation. The representations are independently encoded and integrated with the representation learned by temporal models through gated aggregations. Experiments on the mainstream benchmark across multiple prediction horizons and different temporal models show that \textsc{Sera} consistently improves forecasting performance, achieving up to a 37.3\% reduction in prediction error over the temporal baseline and enhanced generalizability. Counterfactual analysis examines how forecasts respond to changes in degradation semantics to assess interpretability. The results show that prediction responses are consistent with the meanings of key degradation descriptors across tested horizons. Together, these findings demonstrate that structured degradation semantics and effective aggregation can improve forecasting accuracy and support reliable and interpretable battery health forecasting for advanced battery management.

摘要：電池健康狀態（SoH）預測對於電池管理非常重要，但由於電池之間的非線性劣化和異質性，這仍然是一個挑戰。現有的數據驅動方法主要使用時間模型從數值電池時間序列中學習，而較高層次的劣化特徵往往未被明確表示。然而，這些特徵可以提供劣化指導，以支持可靠的預測並使劣化的影響更具可解釋性。在本文中，我們提出了\textsc{Sera}，一個\underline{se}mantic \underline{r}epresentation \underline{a}ggregation框架，該框架通過劣化語義補充時間建模。受到電池領域專業知識的指導，\textsc{Sera}從時間序列中提取劣化語義，並使用基於規則的知識和基於LLM的解釋構建兩個互補的表示。這些表示獨立編碼，並通過門控聚合與時間模型學習的表示進行整合。在多個預測時間範圍和不同時間模型的主流基準上的實驗顯示，\textsc{Sera}持續改善預測性能，預測誤差相比時間基準最多減少37.3\%，並增強了泛化能力。反事實分析檢查預測如何對劣化語義的變化做出反應，以評估可解釋性。結果顯示，預測反應與測試範圍內關鍵劣化描述符的含義一致。總體而言，這些發現表明，結構化的劣化語義和有效的聚合可以提高預測準確性，並支持可靠且可解釋的電池健康預測，以促進先進的電池管理。

docs.title: Learning to Orchestrate Evolutionary Search: Progression-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic DE-CMA-ES Coordination in Optimization and Structural Model Updating
docs.text:
2610.11546v1 by Lechen Li, Rongye Shi, Wanhuan Zhou

Solving high-dimensional structural model updating problems requires an algorithm capable of navigating complex, non-convex landscapes with correlated parameters. Existing hybrid evolutionary algorithms typically rely on static architectures or fixed switching rules, resulting in disjointed search phases. To address this, this study proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning-governed dynamic DE-CMAES Orchestration (DRL-DCO) algorithm, in which a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)-based actor-critic agent continuously governs the evolutionary process as a single, unified system rather than a mechanical concatenation of algorithms. Guided by a progression-aware state representation and a diversity-informed reward, the agent fluidly reallocates computational resources between the differencevector-based exploration of Differential Evolution (DE) and the covariance-guided exploitation of CMA-ES, while jointly regulating population size, elite preservation, and a restart mechanism to escape local optima. This allows DRL-DCO to autonomously transition between exploration-dominant, exploitation-dominant, and mixed-strategy regimes across generations. Beyond the training phase, the trained actor can operate in a supervision-free inference mode, where the internalized policy autonomously orchestrates DE and CMA-ES control from observed search states through forward inference alone, without critic evaluation or weight updates, enabling faster deployment while retaining full effectiveness. Validated on high-dimensional single-objective optimization benchmarks and the IASC-ASCE structural health monitoring benchmark, DRL-DCO achieves superior convergence accuracy and robustness compared to state-of-the-art adaptive and hybrid evolutionary algorithms, as well as single-operator DRL-governed baselines.

摘要：解決高維結構模型更新問題需要一種能夠在具有相關參數的複雜非凸地形中導航的算法。現有的混合進化算法通常依賴於靜態架構或固定的切換規則，導致搜索階段不連貫。為了解決這個問題，本研究提出了一種由深度強化學習主導的動態DE-CMAES協調算法（DRL-DCO），其中基於深度確定性策略梯度（DDPG）的演員-評論者代理持續主導進化過程，作為一個單一的統一系統，而不是算法的機械串聯。代理在進度感知的狀態表示和多樣性知情的獎勵指導下，靈活地在基於差異向量的差分進化（DE）探索和協方差引導的CMA-ES利用之間重新分配計算資源，同時共同調節種群大小、精英保留和重啟機制，以逃避局部最優。這使得DRL-DCO能夠在世代之間自主轉換探索主導、利用主導和混合策略的模式。在訓練階段之後，訓練過的演員可以在無需監督的推斷模式下運行，其中內部化的策略自主協調DE和CMA-ES控制，僅通過前向推斷從觀察到的搜索狀態進行，而無需評論評估或權重更新，從而實現更快的部署，同時保持完全的有效性。在高維單目標優化基準和IASC-ASCE結構健康監測基準上進行驗證，DRL-DCO在收斂準確性和穩健性方面超越了最先進的自適應和混合進化算法，以及單一運營商的DRL主導基準。

docs.title: Missing Modality-Aware Calibration for Trustworthy Brain Tumor Segmentation
docs.text:
2610.11419v1 by Sol Lee, Hyunji Kim, Sungrae Hong, Donghee Han, Mun Yi

Multimodal brain tumor segmentation typically leverages multiple MRI modalities, yet incomplete modality acquisition is common in clinical practice due to protocol heterogeneity and scan failures. Although recent methods maintain segmentation accuracy under missing modality conditions, they frequently overlook prediction reliability, leading to miscalibrated confidence estimates that hinder clinical adoption. Existing calibration techniques are largely modality-agnostic or assume that prediction difficulty decreases monotonically as additional modalities become available. However, in brain tumor segmentation, prediction difficulty depends primarily on which modalities are absent rather than how many, leading to combination-specific and spatially heterogeneous calibration errors. To address this, we propose Missing Modality-Aware Local Temperature Scaling (MMA-LTS), a post-hoc voxel-wise confidence calibration method. It estimates a spatially adaptive temperature field conditioned on a modality-availability learnable token and a voxel-wise difficulty score. Experiments on BraTS 2020 and FeTS 2024 show that MMA-LTS improves calibration while preserving the segmentation accuracy of state-of-the-art models across diverse missing-modality scenarios, thereby enhancing trustworthiness toward clinical deployment.

摘要：多模態腦腫瘤分割通常利用多種MRI模態，但由於協議異質性和掃描失敗，臨床實踐中常見模態獲取不完整。儘管最近的方法在缺失模態條件下保持了分割準確性，但它們經常忽視預測的可靠性，導致錯誤校準的信心估計，妨礙臨床應用。現有的校準技術在很大程度上是模態無關的，或假設預測難度隨著額外模態的可用性單調減少。然而，在腦腫瘤分割中，預測難度主要取決於缺失的模態，而不是缺失的數量，這導致特定組合和空間異質的校準誤差。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了缺失模態感知的局部溫度縮放（MMA-LTS），這是一種後處理的體素級信心校準方法。它根據模態可用性可學習標記和體素級難度分數估計一個空間自適應的溫度場。在BraTS 2020和FeTS 2024上的實驗顯示，MMA-LTS在保留最先進模型的分割準確性的同時改善了校準，從而增強了對臨床部署的信任度。

docs.title: MedBenchAgent: Towards Systematic Automation of Medical VLM Benchmark Construction
docs.text:
2610.11312v1 by Yulin Fu, Junren Wang, Guangjing Yang, Zhangyuan Yu, Wanran Sun, Jiabao Zhou, Jin Yin, Qicheng Lao

Large-scale construction of medical vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks is increasingly feasible with richly annotated imaging datasets and large language models (LLMs), yet existing automation largely focuses on generating evaluation items within predefined benchmark specifications. We study the broader problem of automatically deriving the specification itself: what to evaluate, which annotations support each task, and how to translate this evidence into reliable evaluation items. We formulate benchmark construction as constrained compilation, in which the benchmark specification is progressively derived from evaluation requirements, heterogeneous annotations, and medical knowledge. Based on this formulation, we introduce MedBenchAgent, a multi-agent framework with a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) that encodes task definitions, evidence mappings, evaluation protocols, and item specifications across construction stages. MedBenchAgent separates planning, which derives and verifies the specification, from instantiation, which constructs and audits items under the locked specification. MedBenchAgent achieves a Task-Space F1 of 90.9%, outperforming direct task induction (79.2-80.0%) and prior-guided induction (85.1%); 994 of 1,000 sampled items from correctly identified tasks pass human audit. We further demonstrate portability to a specialized medical domain and evaluate twelve VLMs, revealing task- and setting-specific variation obscured by aggregate scores. These results establish constrained compilation as a scalable and auditable framework for medical VLM benchmark construction beyond question generation.

摘要：大型醫療視覺-語言模型（VLM）基準的建設隨著豐富註釋的影像數據集和大型語言模型（LLMs）變得越來越可行，但現有的自動化主要集中在生成預定基準規範內的評估項目。我們研究自動推導規範本身的更廣泛問題：評估什麼、哪些註釋支持每個任務，以及如何將這些證據轉化為可靠的評估項目。我們將基準建設公式化為受限編譯，其中基準規範是根據評估要求、異質註釋和醫學知識逐步推導的。基於這一公式，我們介紹了MedBenchAgent，一個多代理框架，具有基準中介表示（BIR），該表示編碼了任務定義、證據映射、評估協議和建設階段的項目規範。MedBenchAgent將規劃（推導和驗證規範）與實例化（在鎖定的規範下構建和審核項目）分開。MedBenchAgent實現了90.9%的任務空間F1，超越了直接任務誘導（79.2-80.0%）和先前引導的誘導（85.1%）；從正確識別的任務中抽樣的1,000個項目中，有994個通過了人工審核。我們進一步展示了在專門醫療領域的可移植性，並評估了十二個VLM，揭示了被總體分數掩蓋的任務和設置特定的變異。這些結果確立了受限編譯作為醫療VLM基準建設的一個可擴展和可審核的框架，超越了問題生成。

docs.title: How to post-train on a surrogate: Envelope sampling mitigates reward hacking
docs.text:
2610.11281v1 by Sanjit Dandapanthula, Shuvom Sadhuka, Samir Khan, Michael Oberst, Aaditya Ramdas, Alexandra Chouldechova

Large language models (LLMs) are commonly post-trained against LLM judges and other cheap surrogates because the true reward, such as human preference, is too expensive to query at scale. This practice often leads to reward hacking, where reinforcement learning against a miscalibrated surrogate leads to undesirable side effects. In this work, we study a setting in which a small number $n$ of model outputs are annotated with ground-truth labels (e.g., from expert review) and used to recalibrate the LLM judge before optimizing against it. Prior approaches to judge recalibration are costly or heuristic, and it is known that on-policy sampling fails when the surrogate is miscalibrated on a rare set of outputs. In this work, we propose envelope sampling, a theoretically-grounded method for judge recalibration that seeks to minimize an upper bound on the regret of the post-trained model under the assumption that the human reward and re-calibrated reward lie in an $L^2$ ball around the judge. We give practical algorithms to sample from the envelope by rejection or by fine-tuning against a modified reward, and experiments on clinical note generation and on a controlled sycophancy task show that recalibrating on envelope samples mitigates reward hacking where recalibrating on base-model samples does not.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）通常會針對LLM評估者和其他廉價替代品進行後訓練，因為真實的獎勵，例如人類偏好，無法大規模查詢。這種做法經常導致獎勵黑客行為，當對一個錯誤校準的替代品進行強化學習時，會產生不良的副作用。在本研究中，我們研究了一種情境，其中少量$n$的模型輸出被標註為真實標籤（例如，來自專家評審），並用於在對其進行優化之前重新校準LLM評估者。先前的評估者重新校準方法成本高昂或是啟發式的，並且已知當替代品在一組稀有輸出上錯誤校準時，基於策略的抽樣會失敗。在本研究中，我們提出了包絡抽樣，這是一種理論基礎的評估者重新校準方法，旨在最小化在假設人類獎勵和重新校準獎勵位於評估者周圍的$L^2$球內的情況下，後訓練模型的後悔上界。我們提供了實用的算法，通過拒絕抽樣或對修改後的獎勵進行微調來從包絡中抽樣，並且在臨床筆記生成和受控的諂媚任務上的實驗顯示，基於包絡樣本的重新校準能夠減輕獎勵黑客行為，而基於基礎模型樣本的重新校準則無法做到這一點。

docs.title: CARE: Constrained Attention Refinement for Fine-Grained Visual Classification via Teacher-Student Distillation
docs.text:
2610.11153v1 by Ruibo Wen, Hang Shao, Yiming Lei

Fine-grained visual classification requires models to recognize subtle local traits while exposing the visual evidence behind their predictions. Class-specific attention pathways provide a natural basis for interpretable recognition, but their constrained prediction structure limits discriminative capacity and underuses intermediate representations from strong pretrained backbones. To address this problem, we propose CARE, a constrained attention refinement framework for interpretable fine-grained recognition via teacher-student distillation. CARE keeps the final prediction and explanation within a class-specific attention student, while introducing a training-only auxiliary query teacher that reads selected intermediate DINOv2 layers with learnable queries. The teacher fuses multi-level representations and transfers logit-standardized class-discriminative knowledge to the student. To further refine the explanation pathway, we design diversity and sparsity terms to regularize student attention heads, reducing redundancy and encouraging compact trait localization. Experiments on CUB, Oxford-IIIT Pet, Stanford Dogs, and Stanford Cars show that CARE achieves strong classification performance under an interpretable frozen-backbone setting, reaching 78.5% Top-1 accuracy on CUB. Faithfulness analysis with insertion and deletion metrics further indicates that the top-ranked attention regions retain class-relevant evidence for explanation.

摘要：細粒度視覺分類要求模型識別細微的局部特徵，同時揭示其預測背後的視覺證據。特定類別的注意力路徑為可解釋的識別提供了自然的基礎，但其受限的預測結構限制了判別能力，並未充分利用來自強大預訓練骨幹的中間表示。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了CARE，一個通過教師-學生蒸餾的可解釋細粒度識別的受限注意力精煉框架。CARE將最終預測和解釋保持在特定類別的注意力學生內，同時引入一個僅用於訓練的輔助查詢教師，該教師使用可學習的查詢讀取選定的中間DINOv2層。教師融合多層次的表示，並將對數標準化的類別判別知識轉移給學生。為了進一步精煉解釋路徑，我們設計了多樣性和稀疏性項來正則化學生的注意力頭，減少冗餘並鼓勵緊湊的特徵定位。在CUB、Oxford-IIIT Pet、Stanford Dogs和Stanford Cars上的實驗顯示，CARE在可解釋的凍結骨幹設置下達到了強大的分類性能，在CUB上達到78.5%的Top-1準確率。使用插入和刪除指標的忠實度分析進一步表明，排名最高的注意力區域保留了與類別相關的解釋證據。

docs.title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
docs.text:
2610.11140v1 by Weiwei Ma, Xiaobing Yu, Peijie Qiu, Jin Yang, Zhaoqi An, Xuanzhao Dong, Xiaoqi Zhao, Xiaofeng Liu

Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.

摘要：臨床診斷本質上是順序性的：臨床醫生只有在預期額外證據能解決診斷不確定性時，才會從便宜的檢測升級到昂貴的檢測。我們提出了 ActiveMedAgent，一個將這種成本意識的順序邏輯引入多模態醫療 AI 的框架。在一個凍結的、可通過 API 訪問的視覺-語言模型下，ActiveMedAgent 追蹤候選診斷的概率分佈，並根據每一步的診斷效用減去成本來評分每次獲取。然後，一個輕量級的 MLP 控制器在這些評分的軌跡上離線訓練，學習何時請求額外證據以及何時做出承諾。在三個常用基準上，基於軌跡的策略學習始終優於無指導獲取和全模態基準。值得注意的是，我們識別出一種信息過載效應。在 175 個案例中，代理在較少的通道下產生了正確的診斷，而全模態基準失敗，顯示出學習省略哪些信息與學習獲取哪些信息同樣重要。

docs.title: Budgeted Multi-Source Counterfactual Annotation for Off-Policy Evaluation
docs.text:
2610.10974v1 by Biao Xiang, Ali Eshragh, Yuexing Li, Kai Wang

Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value of a target policy from logged data, but limited behavior-policy coverage can force high-variance reweighting or reward-model extrapolation. Counterfactual annotations can add evidence about unobserved actions, yet practical sources, including domain experts and large language models (LLMs), may be costly, biased, or noisy. We study budgeted acquisition of such annotations for contextual-bandit OPE. Given source-specific costs and error profiles, we formulate an integer allocation problem over context-action pairs and annotation sources to minimize the component of estimator variance that depends on the annotation plan. We characterize when annotations are valuable through a first-annotation threshold and local annotation-value regimes. For the coupled multi-source problem, we develop a majorization-minimization algorithm with dynamic-programming subroutines that monotonically improves the objective. Experiments in synthetic clinical and LLM-annotated education bandits show that our allocation method reduces fixed-profile mean squared error (MSE) by 20.58% and 10.77%, respectively, relative to no annotation.

摘要：Off-policy 評估 (OPE) 從登錄數據中估算目標策略的價值，但有限的行為策略覆蓋可能迫使高方差的重加權或獎勵模型外推。反事實註解可以增加關於未觀察行為的證據，然而實際來源，包括領域專家和大型語言模型 (LLMs)，可能成本高昂、有偏或噪聲。 我們研究了這些註解在上下文強盜 OPE 中的預算獲取。考慮到特定來源的成本和錯誤特徵，我們將一個整數分配問題公式化，針對上下文-行動對和註解來源，以最小化依賴於註解計劃的估計器方差組件。我們通過首次註解閾值和局部註解價值範疇來描述註解何時有價值。對於耦合的多來源問題，我們開發了一種主化最小化算法，並配合動態規劃子程序，單調地改善目標。在合成臨床和 LLM 註解的教育強盜中的實驗顯示，我們的分配方法相對於無註解情況下，分別減少了固定配置的均方誤差 (MSE) 20.58% 和 10.77%。

docs.title: TRACE: A Governance Framework for Measuring Explainability Debt in Production AI Systems
docs.text:
2610.10957v1 by Harish Kant Pathak

Production AI systems deployed in high-stakes domains accumulate a governance liability that existing monitoring frameworks fail to detect: the progressive inability to explain individual decisions when regulators, auditors, or affected individuals demand accountability. We introduce TRACE (Transparency, Risk, Accountability, Compliance, and Explainability), a seven-instrument governance framework for measuring, tracking, and remediating Explainability Debt in production AI systems. The foundational instrument, the Explainability Debt Score (EDS), quantifies the proportion of production decisions falling below a governance-defined explainability confidence threshold at any point in time. Complementary instruments include DART (Debt Accumulation Rate Tracker for breach forecasting), SHIV (Scenario Health and Integrity Validator for daily governance), FDE (Feature Drift Evaluator for causal attribution), HVE (Human Validation Engine), AIDE (Audit Intervention Decision Engine), and ZERO (Zero Explainability Risk Optimiser for remediation). Through a twelve-month longitudinal case study of a production fraud detection system processing 50,000 daily financial transactions, achieving 98.46% accuracy and ROC-AUC of 0.9990, we demonstrate that an EDS of 0.23 on audit day was statistically predictable six months in advance using DART trajectory analysis (beta = 0.008/week, R-squared = 0.94, 95% CI: [0.006, 0.010]), and that 78% of Explainability Debt was concentrated in the highest-regulatory-risk decision category (transactions above $10,000), a risk asymmetry completely invisible to system-level metrics. TRACE provides the first quantitative operational architecture for EU AI Act Article 13 compliance in production AI deployment, establishing a new subdiscipline of explanation governance distinct from explanation generation.

摘要：生產 AI 系統在高風險領域的部署積累了一種治理負債，現有的監控框架無法檢測到：當監管機構、審計師或受影響的個體要求問責時，逐漸無法解釋個別決策。我們介紹 TRACE（透明度、風險、問責、合規性和可解釋性），這是一個七項工具的治理框架，用於衡量、跟踪和修復生產 AI 系統中的可解釋性負債。基礎工具，即可解釋性負債分數（EDS），量化在任何時刻低於治理定義的可解釋性信心閾值的生產決策所佔的比例。補充工具包括 DART（違規預測的負債累積率跟踪器）、SHIV（每日治理的情境健康和完整性驗證器）、FDE（因果歸因的特徵漂移評估器）、HVE（人類驗證引擎）、AIDE（審計干預決策引擎）和 ZERO（零可解釋性風險優化器）。通過對一個處理每日 50,000 筆金融交易的生產欺詐檢測系統進行為期十二個月的縱向案例研究，該系統達到了 98.46% 的準確率和 0.9990 的 ROC-AUC，我們展示了在審計日的 EDS 為 0.23 是可以通過 DART 軌跡分析在六個月前進行統計預測的（beta = 0.008/週，R-squared = 0.94，95% CI: [0.006, 0.010]），並且 78% 的可解釋性負債集中在最高監管風險決策類別（交易金額超過 $10,000），這種風險不對稱在系統層級的指標中完全不可見。TRACE 為生產 AI 部署中的 EU AI Act 第 13 條合規性提供了首個定量運營架構，建立了一個與解釋生成不同的解釋治理新子學科。

docs.title: AI-Mediated Self: How HCI Defines and Relates to the Self
docs.text:
2610.10770v1 by Jenny Xiyu Fu, Qian Yang, Malte Jung

How might AI alter how we understand and experience the self? This scoping review analyzes 102 papers to examine how the self is defined in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI), how AI-self relationships are conceptualized, and what risks emerge when AI becomes entangled with selfhood. Our synthesis makes three contributions. First, we define AI-mediated self as a conceptual umbrella that connects dispersed work across education, workplace, health, and creative practices. Second, we consolidate six framings of the self with four domains of ethical risk-agency/autonomy, identity/authorship, relational capacity, and meaning-making-into a conceptual map that provides a reusable vocabulary across contexts. Third, we introduce the Inclusion of AI-Self framework, which situates AI-self relationships along a spectrum of proximity. Together, these contributions position selfhood as a central design space in HCI.

摘要：AI 如何改變我們理解和體驗自我的方式？這篇範疇回顧分析了 102 篇論文，以檢視自我在人體與計算機互動 (HCI) 領域中的定義，AI 與自我之間的關係如何被概念化，以及當 AI 與自我糾纏時出現的風險。我們的綜合分析有三個貢獻。首先，我們將 AI 媒介的自我定義為一個概念性傘，將教育、工作場所、健康和創意實踐等不同領域的研究聯繫起來。其次，我們將自我的六種框架與四個倫理風險領域——代理性/自主性、身份/創作、關係能力和意義建構——整合成一個概念地圖，提供可在不同情境中重複使用的詞彙。第三，我們引入了 AI-自我納入框架，該框架將 AI-自我關係置於一個接近度的光譜上。這些貢獻共同將自我定位為 HCI 中一個核心的設計空間。

docs.title: Before They Can Solve: Predicting Post-Training Coding-Agent Performance from Base Models
docs.text:
2610.10478v1 by Tan Yu, Alexander Bukharin, Khushi Bhardwaj, Jennifer Williams, Zirui Liu, Jonathan Lingjie Li, Soumye Singhal, Joseph Jennings, Sanjeev Satheesh, Yash Jain, Ashish Vaswani, Venkat Krishna Srinivasan, Matthew Papakipos, Hyunwoo Kim, Jian Zhang, Oleksii Kuchaiev, Markus Kliegl, Mostofa Patwary, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bryan Catanzaro, Jonathan Cohen, Jiantao Jiao

How can we predict which base checkpoint is worth an expensive round of agentic post-training? End-to-end pass@$K$ tests whether successful behavior already appears in a base model's distribution, but it is a poor fit for agentic coding: many base checkpoints cannot reliably produce the well-formed tool invocation required to complete a task end-to-end. Single-shot or short-horizon tasks avoid these tool-calling failures by collapsing a multi-step interaction into a fixed prompt and a single patch, but they sidestep the core capability we care about: maintaining coherent state over many tool-using steps as the repository evolves. To bridge this gap, we treat successful post-trained agent trajectories as a lookahead signal of base-model potential. Replaying each trajectory and rerunning tests after every code-changing step identifies the decisive step: the first step whose cumulative patch flips the repository from failing to passing, certifying that the recorded action solves the task given the prior context. Motivated by a coverage principle for agentic traces, we build three screens at this step that do not require a base checkpoint to drive the harness from a cold start: (i) Decisive-Action BPB (bits per byte) measures the probability mass on the certified action, (ii) Patch MCQ tests the checkpoint's choice between that action and alternatives rejected by the same verifier, and (iii) prefix-conditioned pass@$K$ evaluates support for functionally-correct generations and credits any continuation that the tests accept. Across ten pairs of public base and post-trained models, all three screens rank the cohort in close agreement with post-trained SWE-bench Verified pass@$1$. As our methods need only a benchmark's successful trajectories and its verifier, they can be applied to turn future agentic coding benchmarks into base-model evaluations.

摘要：如何預測哪個基礎檢查點值得進行昂貴的後訓練代理性回合？端到端的 pass@$K$ 測試是否成功行為已經出現在基礎模型的分佈中，但它對於代理性編碼來說並不適合：許多基礎檢查點無法可靠地產生完成任務所需的良好工具調用。單次或短期任務通過將多步互動簡化為固定提示和單一補丁來避免這些工具調用失敗，但它們迴避了我們所關心的核心能力：在多個使用工具的步驟中隨著資料庫的演變保持一致的狀態。為了彌補這一差距，我們將成功的後訓練代理軌跡視為基礎模型潛力的前瞻信號。在每個軌跡上重播並在每次代碼更改步驟後重新運行測試，以確定關鍵步驟：第一步的累積補丁使資料庫從失敗轉變為通過，證明所記錄的行動在先前的上下文中解決了任務。受到代理性痕跡的覆蓋原則的激勵，我們在這一步構建了三個篩選器，這些篩選器不需要基礎檢查點來從冷啟動驅動裝置：(i) 關鍵行動 BPB（每字節位數）測量經過認證的行動的概率質量，(ii) 補丁 MCQ 測試檢查點在該行動和同一驗證者拒絕的替代方案之間的選擇，以及 (iii) 前綴條件 pass@$K$ 評估對功能正確生成的支持，並對測試接受的任何延續給予信用。在十對公共基礎和後訓練模型中，所有三個篩選器在與後訓練 SWE-bench 驗證的 pass@$1$ 之間緊密一致地對該群體進行排名。由於我們的方法僅需要基準的成功軌跡及其驗證者，因此可以應用於將未來的代理性編碼基準轉化為基礎模型評估。

docs.title: LLM Persuasion Is in the Eye of the Evaluation
docs.text:
2610.10232v1 by Kamile Dementaviciute, Julija Vaitonyte, Tijl De Bie

Large language models (LLMs) have already been shown to match or exceed human experts in persuasion. While their persuasive capabilities hold promise for beneficial uses such as education and health communication, they can also be used to manipulate and misinform, making their evaluation a growing priority for developers and regulators. That evaluation, however, remains fragmented: studies differ in what they treat as persuasion, and broad claims often rest on narrow, situation-specific assessments. Automated methods, often modelled on human studies, offer a way to compare such assessments directly, as they can be run on the same models at scale and can include high-risk forms of persuasion that would be difficult or unethical to test on people. In this study, we adapt nine published automated methods to a shared setup, run them on the same fifteen LLMs, and ask whether their rankings agree and why. We find that the methods agree only weakly (mean Spearman $ρ= 0.25$). Our analyses point to two contributing factors. Models that refuse some tasks but not others, directly or indirectly, lower agreement by about a quarter, and these refusals fall mostly on manipulation tasks. General capability also plays a part: most rational persuasion (non-manipulative) methods track it, whereas most manipulation methods do not. Together, these findings suggest that agreement depends more on the task a method sets than on how it scores persuasion, although this pattern is only indicative given the eight methods available for analysis. More broadly, our results suggest that persuasion scores combine a model's ability to persuade with its willingness to do so. A single score is therefore informative about its own setting, but says little about a model's persuasiveness across tasks.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）已經被證明在說服力方面可以與人類專家匹敵或超越。雖然它們的說服能力對於教育和健康溝通等有益用途充滿希望，但它們也可以被用來操控和誤導，這使得對它們的評估成為開發者和監管者日益重要的優先事項。然而，這種評估仍然是片段化的：研究在將什麼視為說服上存在差異，而廣泛的主張往往基於狹窄的、情境特定的評估。自動化方法，通常以人類研究為模型，提供了一種直接比較這些評估的方法，因為它們可以在相同的模型上大規模運行，並且可以包括那些在對人進行測試時會很困難或不道德的高風險說服形式。在這項研究中，我們將九種已發表的自動化方法適應於共享設置，並在同樣的十五個LLMs上運行它們，並詢問它們的排名是否一致以及原因。我們發現這些方法的共識僅為微弱（平均斯皮爾曼 $ρ= 0.25$）。我們的分析指出了兩個促成因素。拒絕某些任務而不是其他任務的模型，無論是直接還是間接，將協議降低了約四分之一，而這些拒絕主要集中在操控任務上。一般能力也起著作用：大多數理性說服（非操控性）方法跟蹤它，而大多數操控方法則不然。綜合這些發現，表明協議更多依賴於方法設定的任務，而不是它如何評分說服，儘管這一模式僅在可用於分析的八種方法中具有指示性。更廣泛地說，我們的結果表明，說服分數結合了模型的說服能力和其願意這樣做的程度。因此，單一分數對其自身設置是有信息量的，但對於模型在不同任務中的說服力卻幾乎沒有指導意義。

docs.title: Coverage-Aware Reasoning with Medical Tokens for Diagnosis Prediction
docs.text:
2610.10641v1 by Kaisong Zhang, Haotian Fang, Junmeng Zhou, Hang Lv, Yulan Pan, Yanchao Tan

Large language models (LLMs) offer promising potential for next-visit diagnosis prediction, owing to their ability to integrate longitudinal clinical evidence and reason over it in natural language. However, reinforcement learning for LLM reasoning commonly rewards each trajectory according to the correctness of its final answer. In next-visit diagnosis prediction, multiple diagnoses can be simultaneously valid, but independently rewarding one diagnosis per trajectory does not distinguish repeated hits from coverage of different diagnoses. The policy can therefore concentrate on a few correct diagnoses, leaving others uncovered. Meanwhile, LLM tokenizers can split ICD codes into several generic tokens with limited clinical meaning, requiring multiple decoding steps to predict each diagnosis and hindering reasoning over a large disease vocabulary. To address both challenges, we propose CARing, a framework that represents diagnoses with compositional Semantic IDs (SIDs) and optimizes reasoning trajectories for multi-label coverage. Concretely, we first encode ontology-enriched disease semantics into compact SIDs through residual quantization, and ground the resulting SID tokens in natural language and longitudinal EHR contexts through multi-task alignment and reasoning-enriched training to unlock transferable LLM reasoning. CARing further improves unordered multi-label prediction through a coverage reward for reinforcement learning and multi-positive supervision. At inference time, the model supports both efficient direct constrained decoding and multi-chain reasoning with rank fusion. On MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, CARing exceeds all EHR-trained baselines in weighted F1 and attains the highest top-k recall at every reported cutoff, including R@30 of 46.04% and 46.52% in reasoning mode. Our codes and logs are available at https://github.com/zmlxzyh/CARing-Codes-Logs.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）在下一次就診診斷預測方面展現出有希望的潛力，因為它們能夠整合縱向臨床證據並用自然語言進行推理。然而，對於LLM推理的強化學習通常根據最終答案的正確性來獎勵每個軌跡。在下一次就診診斷預測中，可能同時存在多個有效的診斷，但獨立地對每個軌跡獎勵一個診斷並不能區分重複的命中和不同診斷的覆蓋。因此，策略可能會集中在少數正確的診斷上，而忽略其他診斷。同時，LLM分詞器可以將ICD代碼拆分為幾個具有有限臨床意義的通用標記，這需要多個解碼步驟來預測每個診斷，並妨礙對大型疾病詞彙的推理。為了解決這兩個挑戰，我們提出了CARing，一個用組合語義ID（SIDs）表示診斷的框架，並優化多標籤覆蓋的推理軌跡。具體而言，我們首先通過殘差量化將豐富本體的疾病語義編碼為緊湊的SIDs，並通過多任務對齊和增強推理訓練將生成的SID標記與自然語言和縱向EHR上下文進行對接，以解鎖可轉移的LLM推理。CARing進一步通過強化學習的覆蓋獎勵和多正監督來改善無序多標籤預測。在推理時，模型支持高效的直接約束解碼和帶有排名融合的多鏈推理。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，CARing在加權F1上超過了所有EHR訓練的基準，並在每個報告的截止點上達到最高的top-k召回率，包括推理模式下的R@30為46.04%和46.52%。我們的代碼和日誌可在https://github.com/zmlxzyh/CARing-Codes-Logs獲得。

docs.title: From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving
docs.text:
2610.09769v1 by Adrián Zámečník, Matěj Kripner, Martin Koutecký, Martin Balko, Jan Grebík, Pavel Hubáček, Robert Šámal, Václav Rozhoň

Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems extracted from four sets of papers, solving about 200 open problems. One experiment used papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science. There, we answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by their authors.

摘要：大型語言模型在數學研究中越來越發揮作用，而進展往往依賴於高效的證明搜尋、漸進的改進和仔細的驗證。我們描述了Bolzano，一個多代理的開源系統，它使用並行證明代理和驗證代理，並維持一個人類可讀的研究狀態。在專家選擇的問題上進行的初步手動使用產生了8個結果，其證明已由領域專家檢查。受到這些案例研究的激勵，我們在沒有問題特定人類指導的情況下運行了Bolzano，處理了約3,800個從四組論文中提取的開放問題，解決了約200個開放問題。一個實驗使用了被STOC 2026接受的論文，這是一個在理論計算機科學領域的頂級會議。在那裡，我們回答了論文中提出的四個問題，這得到了其作者的確認。

docs.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
docs.text:
2610.09643v1 by Gabriel Ocana-Santero, Marko Tvrdic

Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

摘要：藥物發現對於神經疾病傳統上集中於疾病所改變的分子。但導致病理的分子不一定是逆轉病理的最佳切入點。在此，我們探討哪些未被改變的分子控制點可以被利用來恢復病理神經迴路至功能狀態。我們提出了CircuitATLAS，一個基於來源的系統神經科學知識圖譜和目標發現的代理框架，專注於迴路病。它結構化了跨疾病、表型、電生理學、迴路、大腦區域、細胞類型和分子效應者的文獻衍生關係，同時故意排除直接的疾病-基因和疾病-蛋白質邊緣，以減少捷徑推理。該圖譜包含383萬個節點和766萬條邊，包括531萬個LLM提取的關係，並整合了結構化數據集，如人類細胞圖譜和新的多模態體內測量。我們接著介紹了一個代理工作流程，從可測量的疾病表型推理到它們的迴路和細胞基質，再到分子干預、治療可行性和臨床限制。最後，我們介紹了一個由人類主導的體內實驗室循環，將假設生成與實驗迭代聯繫起來。在這個框架內，一個代理提名ATP1A3，即神經元alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase，作為皮層興奮性的控制點；ATP1A3的抑制性神經元特異性表達在體內消除了對局部4-氨基吡啶挑戰的β和γ波反應，然後將經過驗證的目標帶入結構引導的小分子篩選，最終在一個定義的測定中解決調節的方向。因此，CircuitATLAS提供了一個發現治療藥物的框架，不僅基於疾病中分子上所受到的干擾，還基於可以控制以恢復迴路功能的內容。

docs.title: Dual- versus Single-Suggestion AI Support for Radiographic Interpretation in Residents: Randomized Multireader Study
docs.text:
2610.09589v1 by Lin Wu, Zhe Xu, Hongyi Wang, Feifei Zhou, Wei Deng, Chunlong Zhang, Yuting Zhu, Kaixiao Chen, Xiao Liang, Chen Yang, Yeyuan Chen, Hao Chen, Fuqing Zhou

Purpose: To compare dual- and single-suggestion AI support for radiographic interpretation by residents, particularly when the shared AI suggestion was incorrect. Materials and Methods: This prospective, multicenter, randomized three-arm reader study was conducted at three hospitals in China from July to September 2026 (ChiCTR2600129243). After specialty stratification, 132 residents with fewer than 3 years of clinical experience were randomized 1:1:1 to GPT-5.4 alone (group A), GPT-5.4 plus Kimi-K2.6 (group B), or GPT-5.4 plus Gemini-3.6 Flash (group C); 123 were analyzed. Participants interpreted 60 radiographs before and after AI support. The primary outcome was accuracy change. Welch ANOVA and Holm-adjusted t tests compared support conditions; HC3 linear models assessed specialty interaction. Results: Among 123 residents (mean age, 24.1 years +/- 1.4; 65 women), radiology residents showed greater accuracy improvement with dual- than single-suggestion support (B-A, 6.69 percentage points [95% CI, 0.97-12.40]; C-A, 7.87 percentage points [95% CI, 1.64-14.11]; Holm-adjusted P = .030 for both), whereas accuracy change did not differ in non-radiology residents (P = .20). When GPT-5.4 was incorrect, AI-assisted accuracy was higher with dual- than single-suggestion support in radiology residents (40.1% and 40.4% vs 20.0%) and non-radiology residents (31.3% and 31.0% vs 12.1%) (all Holm-adjusted P < .001). The dual-suggestion effect differed by specialty (interaction difference, 10.44 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.36-16.52; P < .001). Conclusion: Dual-suggestion support may mitigate the influence of erroneous AI suggestions, with greater accuracy improvement observed in radiology but not non-radiology residents.

摘要：目的：比較雙重和單一建議的人工智慧支持對住院醫師的放射影像解讀的影響，特別是在共享的人工智慧建議不正確的情況下。材料與方法：這項前瞻性、多中心、隨機三組讀者研究於2026年7月至9月在中國的三家醫院進行（ChiCTR2600129243）。在專業分層後，132名臨床經驗少於3年的住院醫師以1:1:1的比例隨機分配至僅使用GPT-5.4（A組）、GPT-5.4加Kimi-K2.6（B組）或GPT-5.4加Gemini-3.6 Flash（C組）；分析了123名參與者。參與者在人工智慧支持前後解讀60幅放射影像。主要結果是準確度的變化。使用Welch ANOVA和Holm調整的t檢驗比較支持條件；HC3線性模型評估專業互動。結果：在123名住院醫師中（平均年齡24.1歲 +/- 1.4；65名女性），放射科住院醫師在雙重建議支持下的準確度改善大於單一建議支持（B-A，6.69個百分點[95% CI，0.97-12.40]；C-A，7.87個百分點[95% CI，1.64-14.11]；Holm調整P = .030，兩者均如此），而非放射科住院醫師的準確度變化則無顯著差異（P = .20）。當GPT-5.4不正確時，放射科住院醫師在雙重建議支持下的人工智慧輔助準確度高於單一建議支持（40.1%和40.4%對20.0%），非放射科住院醫師則為（31.3%和31.0%對12.1%）（所有Holm調整P < .001）。雙重建議效果因專業而異（互動差異，10.44個百分點；95% CI，4.36-16.52；P < .001）。結論：雙重建議支持可能減輕錯誤人工智慧建議的影響，在放射科住院醫師中觀察到更大的準確度改善，但在非放射科住院醫師中則未見此情況。

docs.title: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
docs.text:
2610.09558v1 by Samuel Margolis, Paul Schmiedmayer, Alan Huang, Ethan Chen, Ishan Bhattacharjee, Atman Shah, Ben Viggiano, Fang Cao, Shriya Reddy, Roger Xia, Jack O'Sullivan, Daniel Katz, Matthew Wheeler, Euan Ashley, Bruna Gomes

Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets. Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.

摘要：藥物靶點發現需要區分那些因果驅動疾病的分子與那些僅僅與之相關的分子。訓練和評估 AI 代理人以端到端執行此工作流程是困難的，因為現實世界的生物銀行缺乏已知的因果真相，且參與者層級的數據受到訪問控制。我們介紹了 DrugTargetWorld，一個程序生成模擬生物銀行或“世界”的框架，具有已知但隱藏的因果結構。每個世界包含 54,000 名參與者的基因型、蛋白質、健康記錄、結果和合成的磁共振成像 (MRI)。代理人必須構建疾病表型，識別因果驅動蛋白，推斷調節的有益方向，並可選擇進行虛擬的“濕實驗室”實驗。我們在 20 個心血管世界和三個實驗預算中評估了九個代理人，共 540 集。Opus 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 獲得了最高的平均綜合得分，分別為 39.98 和 35.38（滿分 100），並且平均恢復了 64% 的因果驅動因子。然而，沒有任何代理人能可靠地區分誤導性的非因果蛋白，且性能仍然受到連接表型構建、因果證據和干預決策所需的綜合判斷的限制。通過使每個世界的因果結構對評估者已知但對代理人隱藏，DrugTargetWorld 將端到端的藥物靶點發現轉變為一個可擴展的訓練和評估問題，並具有可驗證的獎勵。

docs.title: SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models
docs.text:
2610.09498v1 by Md Kawsher Mahbub, Milon Biswas, Mirza Niaz Morshed, Wei Yu

Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce \textbf{SpatialUQ}, a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches $0.784$ failure-detection AUC versus $0.664$ for MC-Dropout ($p{<}10^{-6}$) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ vs.\ $0.127$ for $\ell_1$), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and $\ell_1$ reaches $0.832$, outperforming a five-member ensemble ($0.813$). MUS scales with model quality, reaching $0.899$ with BiomedCLIP ($ρ= 0.846$), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ($ρ= 0.523$) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ.

摘要：臨床視覺模型通常作為凍結的黑箱部署，無法在推理時訪問內部、重新訓練或獲取真實標籤。我們介紹了 \textbf{SpatialUQ}，這是一種僅使用輸出概率的事後不確定性方法。它測量全局預測與六次確定性前向傳遞中五個固定空間裁剪的均值之間的詹森-香農散度。前提很簡單，值得信賴的預測在空間上是一致的。在 NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$) 上，我們的多裁剪不確定性分數 (MUS) 達到 $0.784$ 的失敗檢測 AUC，而 MC-Dropout 則為 $0.664$ ($p{<}10^{-6}$)，計算量僅為其五分之一，並且原生校準 ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ 對比 $\ell_1$ 的 $0.127$)，在 AUC 超過 0.78 的方法中，校準效果最佳。將 MUS 與熵、置信度和 $\ell_1$ 進行監督融合可達到 $0.832$，超過五成員集成 ($0.813$)。MUS 隨著模型質量的提高而擴展，在 BiomedCLIP 中達到 $0.899$ ($ρ= 0.846$)，而這種關係在分佈內仍然有意義 ($ρ= 0.523$)，但在嚴重的分佈轉移下則失效 (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$)。MUS 非常適合擴散發現，但對於小型焦點病變如結節則不太可靠。代碼和實驗材料可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ 上公開獲取。

docs.title: Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation
docs.text:
2610.09209v1 by Thushara Manjari Naduvilakandy, Hyeju Jang, Mohammad Al Hasan

Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping. Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.

摘要：物質使用障礙（SUD）諮詢需要患者的反應反映出潛在的認知狀態，例如信念、應對策略和變化的準備程度。雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）可以生成流暢的文本，但它們往往無法產生認知上連貫且臨床上現實的患者行為，特別是在道德和數據稀缺的臨床環境中。此外，在醫療應用中部署前沿規模的LLMs面臨實際挑戰，包括高計算成本、延遲、隱私問題以及在資源有限環境中的有限可部署性，這促使了對認知對齊的小型語言模型（SLMs）的需求。我們提出了一個基於認知的SUD患者對話生成框架，該框架明確建模並對齊潛在的認知組件與患者歷史和諮詢師問題。我們的流程分為兩個階段：認知組件檢測和認知組件對齊的對話生成。為了使小型模型能夠有效學習，我們結合了來自高容量教師模型的知識蒸餾、人類標註的偏好優化和注意力引導的獎勵塑造。使用自動評分指標如BERTScore、ROUGE、METEOR和BLEU，以及LLM作為評判者的命中指標，對比人類和教師模型參考的廣泛評估顯示，基於認知的微調顯著改善了認知實現和對齊，相較於通用指令調整的基準和心理健康領域特定的SLMs，對於開放式認知組件尤其有強勁的提升。

docs.title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
docs.text:
2610.09146v1 by Yexiao He, Yucheng Tang, Pengfei Guo, Yufan He, Andriy Myronenko, Can Zhao, Ang Li, Daguang Xu, Dong Yang

Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. This is especially concerning in medicine, where new clinical evidence, updated guidelines, and new therapies can change established practice. Fine-tuning can update the model, but it requires access to model weights and additional training. Parameter-free methods avoid training, but they may overfit a fixed validation set, lack reliable domain knowledge, or lose visual details by saving experience only as text. To address these limitations, we present a model-agnostic framework that allows frozen LLMs and VLMs to learn from deployment experience through three forms of external expertise: a Skill that guides reasoning and tool use, a Knowledge Memory that stores reliable facts supported by earlier cases or trusted external evidence, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base that keeps visual examples and guides the model to relate each retrieved case to the current image. Instead of relying on a fixed validation set, a validation strategy keeps an update only if it helps on new cases without degrading performance on earlier ones. Across six benchmarks covering clinical diagnosis, clinical workflows, medical reasoning, and medical and non-medical visual reasoning, and with four open-weight and closed-source base models, our framework improves performance during online deployment by up to 34.2% over the base model on medical tasks, generalizes to unseen cases, transfers to other models without further optimization, and works in non-medical domains.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）和視覺語言模型（VLMs）在部署後通常是凍結的，因此它們不會從解決的案例中學習。這在醫學領域尤其令人擔憂，因為新的臨床證據、更新的指導方針和新療法可能會改變既定的實踐。微調可以更新模型，但需要訪問模型權重和額外的訓練。無參數的方法避免訓練，但可能會對固定的驗證集過擬合，缺乏可靠的領域知識，或僅通過將經驗保存為文本而失去視覺細節。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一個模型無關的框架，允許凍結的LLMs和VLMs通過三種形式的外部專業知識從部署經驗中學習：一個指導推理和工具使用的技能、一個存儲可靠事實的知識記憶，這些事實由早期案例或可信的外部證據支持，以及一個保持視覺範例的多模態知識庫，並引導模型將每個檢索到的案例與當前圖像相關聯。驗證策略不依賴於固定的驗證集，僅在對新案例有幫助而不降低早期案例性能的情況下進行更新。在涵蓋臨床診斷、臨床工作流程、醫學推理以及醫學和非醫學視覺推理的六個基準測試中，並且使用四個開放權重和封閉源代碼的基礎模型，我們的框架在醫學任務中在線部署期間將性能提高了最多34.2%，對未見案例具有良好的泛化能力，能夠轉移到其他模型而無需進一步優化，並且在非醫學領域中也能運作。

docs.title: Epistemic Uncertainty-Aware Defect Detection for Quality Control in Medical Device Manufacturing
docs.text:
2610.09057v1 by Raham A. Butt, Marco Romanelli, Roche C. de Guzman

Objective: We investigate whether accounting for epistemic uncertainty can improve the reliability of automated defect detection in medical device manufacturing. Methods: We consider a machine learning framework that operates on heterogeneous manufacturing and device-report data represented with Knowledge Graphs. To mitigate errors arising from uncertainty in the decision model, we analyze a principled rejection strategy to abstain from predictions whose estimated epistemic uncertainty exceeds a specified threshold. We evaluate the approach using standard synthetic benchmarks and real-world medical device report data. Results: The theoretical results establish the validity of the method characterizing the regimes under which it is expected to be effective. Empirically, the rejection strategy enables explicit control of coverage, that is, the proportion of samples for which the model issues predictions, while improving performance on the retained samples. On 266,170 real-world FDA MAUDE device reports, a 10% abstention rate reduces classification error by 48%, and more aggressive rejection (approximately 70% coverage) yields near-perfect accuracy on the retained samples. On standard synthetic manufacturing benchmarks, abstaining on 9% of the decisions, our approach reduces the risk up to 63% compared with the standard no-abstention approach. Conclusions: Abstaining from predictions with high epistemic uncertainty can provide a practical tool for controlling the reliability of machine learning-based defect detection, especially in high-stakes medical device manufacturing applications. Significance: Uncertainty-aware defect detection may support safer and more reliable quality assurance in medical device manufacturing by identifying cases that require additional inspection rather than issuing potentially harmful predictions.

摘要：目標：我們研究考慮到認知不確定性是否能提高醫療器械製造中自動缺陷檢測的可靠性。方法：我們考慮一個基於異構製造和設備報告數據的機器學習框架，這些數據用知識圖譜表示。為了減少由於決策模型中的不確定性引起的錯誤，我們分析了一種原則性的拒絕策略，以避免對那些估計的認知不確定性超過指定閾值的預測。我們使用標準合成基準和真實世界的醫療器械報告數據來評估該方法。結果：理論結果確立了該方法的有效性，描述了其預期有效的範疇。實證上，拒絕策略使得對覆蓋率的明確控制成為可能，即模型發出預測的樣本比例，同時提高保留樣本的性能。在266,170份真實世界的FDA MAUDE設備報告中，10%的棄權率將分類錯誤降低了48%，而更激進的拒絕（約70%的覆蓋率）在保留樣本上達到了近乎完美的準確性。在標準合成製造基準上，對9%的決策進行棄權，我們的方法將風險降低了最多63%，與標準的無棄權方法相比。結論：對於具有高認知不確定性的預測進行棄權可以提供一種實用工具，以控制基於機器學習的缺陷檢測的可靠性，特別是在高風險的醫療器械製造應用中。意義：考慮不確定性的缺陷檢測可以通過識別需要額外檢查的案例，而不是發出可能有害的預測，來支持醫療器械製造中的更安全和更可靠的質量保證。

docs.title: Careful Judge: Safe and Efficient Human-AI Collaborative Decision Making
docs.text:
2610.09043v1 by Chenyu Zhang, Rachel Luo, Boyi Li, Anjali Parashar, Marco Pavone, Apoorva Sharma

In human-AI collaborative decision making, human review can prevent unsafe AI decisions, but each human judgment is costly. Treating human intervention after AI abstention as a one-off fallback misses the opportunity to improve future AI decisions for greater automation, yet AI adaptively learning from selectively queried human feedback breaks safety guardrails calibrated for old models. We approach this challenge with CARE---calibrated adaptive rectification and escalation---an end-to-end pipeline that combines AI models and human reviewers to guarantee safe, human-aligned decisions, while continuously learning from human feedback to achieve greater automation with fewer human queries. CARE is principled, general, modular, and works with any black-box AI model. Our novel adaptive calibration module guarantees risk control at every time step for any rectification module. We further show how CARE improves query efficiency when the AI model is well trained and the human-AI misalignment has a clear structure. Experiments on four safety-critical real-world datasets spanning driving, language, and robotics demonstrate that CARE achieves human-aligned decisions while reducing human queries by 25-81% relative to baselines.

摘要：在人類與人工智慧的協作決策中，人類審查可以防止不安全的人工智慧決策，但每一次人類判斷都是有成本的。將人工介入視為人工智慧放棄後的一次性備用措施，錯失了改善未來人工智慧決策以實現更大自動化的機會，然而，人工智慧從選擇性查詢的人類反饋中自適應學習，則打破了為舊模型校準的安全防護措施。我們用CARE來應對這一挑戰——校準的自適應修正和升級——這是一個端到端的流程，結合了人工智慧模型和人類審查者，以保證安全且符合人類需求的決策，同時不斷從人類反饋中學習，以實現更高的自動化，並減少人類查詢次數。CARE是原則性、通用性、模塊化的，並且可以與任何黑箱人工智慧模型協同工作。我們的新型自適應校準模塊保證了在每一時間步驟中對任何修正模塊的風險控制。我們進一步展示了當人工智慧模型訓練良好且人類與人工智慧之間的不一致性具有明確結構時，CARE如何提高查詢效率。在四個涉及駕駛、語言和機器人技術的安全關鍵真實世界數據集上的實驗表明，CARE在實現符合人類需求的決策的同時，相對於基準減少了25-81%的人工查詢。

docs.title: BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment
docs.text:
2610.09026v1 by Kemal Davaslioglu, Nathan Conger, Sastry Kompella, Yalin E. Sagduyu, Nathaniel D. Bastian

We present BEACON-SP, an ontology-grounded Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework for clinician-facing decision support in behavioral health settings such as suicide prevention, where effective assessment requires integrating heterogeneous clinical, behavioral, social, and temporal evidence. BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events, and temporal relationships. The framework is enabled by a comprehensive suicide prevention ontology that integrates the Three-Step Theory, the Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model, and the Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology into a unified representation of patient risk factors. We construct ontology-grounded patient knowledge graphs and evaluate BEACON-SP for clinician-facing question answering. Compared with a vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline on a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, BEACON-SP improves completeness, clinical relevance, and evidence grounding under a corrected comparative evaluation protocol, with a small gain on factual accuracy. In paired criterion-level comparisons, GraphRAG is preferred in 76.4% of cases. These results demonstrate the potential of ontology-guided GraphRAG to provide structured, contextualized patient evidence for clinical decision support.

摘要：我們提出了 BEACON-SP，一個基於本體的圖檢索增強生成（GraphRAG）框架，旨在為行為健康領域中的臨床決策支持提供幫助，例如自殺預防，這需要有效的評估來整合異質的臨床、行為、社會和時間證據。 BEACON-SP 將患者知識圖與本體引導的檢索相結合，以支持跨診斷、藥物、風險和保護因素、生活事件以及時間關係的多跳推理。該框架由一個全面的自殺預防本體支持，該本體將三步理論、綜合動機-意志模型和自殺健康社會決定因素本體整合成患者風險因素的統一表示。我們構建了基於本體的患者知識圖，並評估了 BEACON-SP 在臨床問題回答中的表現。與在涵蓋 15 個臨床類別和 100 名患者的 1,500 條查詢基準上的基於向量的檢索增強生成（RAG）基線相比，BEACON-SP 在經過修正的比較評估協議下提高了完整性、臨床相關性和證據基礎，並在事實準確性上有小幅提升。在配對的標準級別比較中，GraphRAG 在 76.4% 的案例中被偏好。這些結果展示了本體引導的 GraphRAG 在為臨床決策支持提供結構化、情境化患者證據方面的潛力。

docs.title: Hybrid++: The Bridge between PDE Models and Deep Learning for Gamma Noise Removal
docs.text:
2610.08892v1 by Mahipal Jetta, Sujato Dutta

Multiplicative gamma noise is one of the dominant noise factors in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and medical ultrasound images. They are dependent on pixel level noises due to which they are highly varying across the image and harder to handle as compared to additive noise. The denoising methods to address this noise currently include classical partial differential equation (PDE) methods which are good for interpretation but lack the restoration ability as compared to the state-of-the-art models while deep convolutional networks like DnCNN achieve high performance but at the cost of transparency due to which practitioners are skeptical to use them in high-risk critical fields like medicine. This paper presents Hybrid++, a novel trainable nonlinear reaction-diffusion architecture that addresses both the concerns - staying interpretable while offering performance close to huge black-box models. It combines a fully learnable PDE initialization with a 3-stage reaction-diffusion network having 64-channel multiscale filter banks, 4-layer Squeeze-and-Excitation attention-based influence functions and a 64-dimensional noise level embedding. It uses a two-phase training strategy, stage-wise optimization followed by joint end-to-end refinement which enables co-adaptation of all learnable parameters. On the FoE benchmark, Hybrid++ substantially improves over classical PDE, BM3D and the original TNRD baselines. In the severe-noise setting L=1, it comes within 0.23 dB PSNR of a separately trained DnCNN while using only about 8% of its parameters. We therefore position Hybrid++ not as a universal state-of-the-art image restoration backbone, but as a compact, physically structured reaction-diffusion model for multiplicative gamma noise.

摘要：乘法伽瑪噪聲是合成孔徑雷達（SAR）和醫療超聲影像中主要的噪聲因素之一。它們依賴於像素級的噪聲，因此在影像中變化很大，相較於加性噪聲更難處理。目前針對這種噪聲的去噪方法包括經典的偏微分方程（PDE）方法，這些方法在解釋上表現良好，但相較於最先進的模型缺乏恢復能力，而像DnCNN這樣的深度卷積網絡則在性能上表現優異，但在透明度上有所妥協，因此實務工作者對其在高風險的關鍵領域如醫學中的使用持懷疑態度。本文提出了Hybrid++，一種新穎的可訓練非線性反應擴散架構，旨在解決這兩個問題——在保持可解釋性的同時，提供接近大型黑箱模型的性能。它結合了一個完全可學習的PDE初始化與一個具有64通道多尺度濾波器組、4層壓縮與激勵注意力基於影響函數的3階段反應擴散網絡，以及一個64維的噪聲水平嵌入。它使用兩階段的訓練策略，階段優化後進行聯合端到端的精煉，這使得所有可學習參數能夠共同適應。在FoE基準上，Hybrid++在經典PDE、BM3D和原始TNRD基準上有了顯著改善。在嚴重噪聲設置L=1下，它的PSNR僅比單獨訓練的DnCNN低0.23 dB，同時僅使用約8%的參數。因此，我們將Hybrid++定位為一種緊湊的、物理結構化的乘法伽瑪噪聲反應擴散模型，而非通用的最先進影像恢復骨幹。

docs.title: A Swarm-Coordinated Multi-Robot System for Early Stress Detection in Agricultural Rows Using Multimodal Leaf Sensing
docs.text:
2610.08603v1 by Rishi Gupta, Astha Goyal, Vinay Vishwakarma

Early stress detection in crops is a necessity today to improve efficiency and reduce waste of time, money, and effort. However, most modern techniques, such as hyperspectral imaging and AI-based systems, are too costly and complex for medium and small-scale farmers to implement. This paper showcases CropSentry, a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing to continuously monitor crop health by tracking stress levels. The system comprises two autonomous bots that continuously detect leaf color and environmental data row by row. The observations are spatially mapped and sent over to the master bot, which uses color-coded row segments to generate a real-time web-based dashboard displaying crop health. After 63 observations were collected during the experiments, the results showed an overall crop health classification accuracy of 84.12%, with 82.60% for healthy plants, 88% for nutrient-deficient plants, and 80% for diseased plants. Also, 100% wireless communication success rate across 10 slave observations was achieved. Close-range leaf inspection across multiple bots can detect early stress in crops while remaining affordable, accessible, and scalable. It provides farmers with timely information to improve resource utilization and crop management.

摘要：早期檢測作物壓力在今天是提高效率和減少時間、金錢和努力浪費的必要條件。然而，大多數現代技術，如高光譜成像和基於人工智慧的系統，對中小型農民來說過於昂貴和複雜。本文展示了CropSentry，一種低成本的地面多機器人系統，利用多模態葉片感測技術持續監測作物健康，通過追蹤壓力水平。該系統由兩個自主機器人組成，這些機器人逐行持續檢測葉片顏色和環境數據。觀測結果被空間映射並發送到主機器人，主機器人使用顏色編碼的行段生成實時的基於網頁的儀表板，顯示作物健康狀況。在實驗中收集了63次觀測後，結果顯示整體作物健康分類準確率為84.12%，健康植物為82.60%，缺乏養分的植物為88%，而病害植物為80%。此外，在10次從屬觀測中實現了100%的無線通信成功率。多機器人的近距離葉片檢查能夠檢測作物的早期壓力，同時保持經濟實惠、可及性和可擴展性。它為農民提供及時的信息，以改善資源利用和作物管理。

docs.title: FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation
docs.text:
2610.08574v1 by Anabik Pal, Ganesh Patidar, Bikash Santra

Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.

摘要：皮膚癌是全球健康的一個重大問題，早期檢測和準確的病變輪廓描繪對於有效的診斷和治療計劃至關重要。自動化的皮膚病變分析可以協助皮膚科醫生，病變分割作為計算機輔助診斷系統中的基本步驟。傳統的基於深度學習的分割模型通常依賴於集中式訓練，圖像及其相應的分割掩模會被收集到中央伺服器上。這種數據聚合在醫療應用中引發了隱私問題，並需要大量的集中計算資源。為了解決這些限制，我們探討了聯邦學習在隱私保護的皮膚病變分割中的可行性。使用ISIC 2018皮膚病變分割挑戰數據集的訓練和驗證集來模擬分佈式學習環境並開發聯邦分割模型。所得到的模型在ISIC 2018測試集和PH2數據集上進行評估，以評估其性能和泛化能力。實驗結果表明，聯邦模型的性能與集中式訓練相當，同時在本地訓練模型的基礎上持續改進。這些發現展示了聯邦學習在無需集中聚合醫療影像的情況下，進行協作皮膚病變分割的潛力。

docs.title: Latent space bias directions in LLMs capture confidence, not fairness
docs.text:
2610.08559v1 by Stephanie Buttigieg, Maeve Madigan, Parameswaran Kamalaruban, Stuart Burrell

Activation steering has gained popularity as a lightweight inference-time debiasing technique for large language models. However, prior work reports that steering vectors generalise poorly, with unintended effects on model performance and limited transfer to new datasets. Our work analyses what the debiasing direction used for activation steering actually encodes, in order to shed light on its inconsistent performance. We study the linear debiasing direction obtained by contrasting the activations of anti-biased and biased prompts, and evaluate it as a steering intervention across bias and general knowledge benchmarks. We find that this direction is dominated by model confidence, pointing from regions of high to low-probability tokens in activation space rather than encoding a meaningful representation of model bias. Steering along it does reduce measured bias, but this is a consequence of reducing model confidence: on QA benchmarks we find that this steering drives the model to abstain from answering, with a side effect of improving fairness metrics. Our experiments show that model confidence is the dominant separating factor between biased and anti-biased prompts in hidden space, indicating that isolating a linear representation of bias which is disentangled from model confidence is difficult and steering-based debiasing results should be interpreted with care. In short, steering appears to reduce bias, not by correcting the model's underlying preferences, but by making it less confident, even on tasks unrelated to bias.

摘要：激活引導作為大型語言模型的輕量級推論時去偏見技術已獲得廣泛關注。然而，先前的研究報告指出，引導向量的泛化能力較差，對模型性能產生意外影響，並且在新數據集上的轉移有限。我們的研究分析了用於激活引導的去偏見方向實際上編碼了什麼，以便闡明其不一致的性能。我們研究了通過對比反偏見和偏見提示的激活所獲得的線性去偏見方向，並在偏見和一般知識基準上評估其作為引導干預的效果。我們發現，這一方向主要受模型信心的主導，指向激活空間中高概率標記到低概率標記的區域，而不是編碼模型偏見的有意義表徵。沿著這一方向的引導確實減少了測量到的偏見，但這是因為降低了模型的信心：在問答基準上，我們發現這種引導使模型選擇不回答，並且副作用是改善了公平性指標。我們的實驗顯示，模型信心是隱藏空間中偏見和反偏見提示之間的主要分隔因素，這表明將偏見的線性表徵與模型信心解耦是困難的，因此基於引導的去偏見結果應謹慎解讀。總之，引導似乎減少了偏見，不是通過修正模型的基本偏好，而是通過使其信心降低，即使在與偏見無關的任務上也是如此。

docs.title: Systemization of Knowledge (SoK): Human-Centered AI Safety for Youth
docs.text:
2610.08554v1 by Pratyasha Saha, Yaman Yu, Yang Wang

While HCI increasingly examines AI-safety for youth, the literature lacks a comprehensive view of what risks have been identified, how they are addressed, and whether proposed protections work in-practice. We systematically reviewed 100 empirical HCI studies involving children and youth interacting with or exposed to AI across schools, homes, care settings, and public services. Using the YAIR taxonomy for risks and the MIT Mitigation Taxonomy for countermeasures, we map which risks have been identified, whether each risk is addressed by countermeasure(s), and whether each countermeasure for that risk is implemented and even evaluated. The risk-countermeasure mapping shows that most risks are matched only with proposed/ideated countermeasures; few countermeasures have been implemented, and fewer still evaluated; and existing evaluations often measure technical performance rather than protection from harm. We identify where coverage is absent, where safeguards remain untested, and propose concrete directions for HCI research to strengthen youth AI-safety.

摘要：雖然人機互動（HCI）越來越多地檢視青少年的人工智慧安全，但文獻中缺乏對已識別風險的全面觀察、如何應對這些風險，以及所提議的保護措施在實際中是否有效的分析。我們系統性地回顧了100項涉及兒童和青少年與人工智慧互動或接觸的實證HCI研究，這些研究涵蓋了學校、家庭、照護環境和公共服務。使用YAIR風險分類法和MIT緩解分類法，我們映射了已識別的風險、每個風險是否有對應的緩解措施，以及每個風險的緩解措施是否已實施甚至評估。風險-緩解措施的映射顯示，大多數風險僅與提議/構思的緩解措施相匹配；實施的緩解措施很少，評估的則更少；而現有的評估往往測量技術性能而非防止傷害的效果。我們確定了哪些領域缺乏覆蓋、哪些保障措施仍未經測試，並提出具體的方向以促進HCI研究，加強青少年的人工智慧安全。

docs.title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
docs.text:
2610.08528v1 by Asim Khan, Samee Ullah Khan, Dwarikanath Mahapatra

Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

摘要：臨床診斷本質上是一個結構化的推理過程，然而現有的深度學習模型往往繞過這一結構，直接將影像特徵映射到疾病標籤，而未明確探討臨床醫生系統性評估的形態和質地標準。這限制了診斷的透明度，並可能妨礙安全的臨床應用。我們提出了 MedCORE（醫療標準導向推理與證據），這是一個在視覺-語言架構內運作的結構化診斷框架。對於每個輸入影像，MedCORE 將診斷過程分解為臨床定義的標準，將每個標準空間定位到診斷相關的影像區域，通過多尺度表示編碼證據，以捕捉宏觀結構和微觀質地的病理特徵，並使用圖注意力網絡精煉標準表示，該網絡明確建模標準之間的依賴關係。標準表示進一步與臨床文本描述符對齊，通過類別視覺原型加強，並使用不確定性校準的加權進行聚合，這種加權按比例減少低置信度的診斷證據。MedCORE 在三種臨床異質的影像模式中進行了驗證，包括在 ISIC 2018 上的皮膚鏡病變分類、在 BUSI 上的乳腺超聲病變特徵描述，以及在 IDRiD 上的糖尿病視網膜病變分級。在定量方面，MedCORE 在 ISIC 2018 上達到了 89.2% 的準確率、85.7% 的宏觀 F1 和 96.4% 的 AUC；在 BUSI 上達到了 96.1% 的準確率、95.2% 的宏觀 F1 和 98.4% 的 AUC；在 IDRiD 上達到了 84.3% 的準確率、80.2% 的宏觀 F1 和 92.8% 的 AUC。這些結果顯示出相較於強大的 CNN、Transformer、生物醫學視覺-語言、基於概念和基於原型的基準，持續改進的表現。

docs.title: Language-model ratings of depression reflect the rater more than the patient
docs.text:
2610.08501v1 by Baihan Lin

Depression has no diagnostic blood test. Language models promise tireless, consistent assessment, but can accurate raters disagree about individuals? We pre-registered 880 language-model raters, crossing 11 open models with prompting and scoring choices, and applied them to 189 interviews against the eight-item Patient Health Questionnaire. Model choice explained 30.0% of summed-symptom score variance, stable participant differences 10.5%. Two randomly drawn raters with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) >= 0.70 disagreed on screening decisions for 40% of participants, on average. Average over-rating governed how many were flagged, yet equal-capacity raters chose differently for about one participant in five. A locked analysis of 86 new interviews reproduced the main pre-registered findings. Exploratory recalibration with 40 labelled participants raised accuracy from about 60% to 75% and halved disagreement, leaving one participant in five decided differently. Calibration repaired much of the rater dependence without securing agreement about individuals.

摘要：憂鬱症沒有診斷性的血液測試。語言模型承諾提供不知疲倦且一致的評估，但準確的評估者能否對個體達成共識？我們預先註冊了880名語言模型評估者，交叉使用11個開放模型與提示和評分選擇，並將其應用於189次訪談，對照八項患者健康問卷。模型選擇解釋了30.0%的總症狀分數變異，穩定的參與者差異為10.5%。兩名隨機抽取的評估者，其接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUC）>= 0.70，對40%的參與者的篩查決策存在分歧，平均而言。平均過度評分決定了有多少被標記，然而能力相等的評估者對約五分之一的參與者做出了不同的選擇。對86個新訪談的鎖定分析重現了主要的預先註冊發現。對40名標記參與者的探索性重新校準將準確度從約60%提高到75%，並將分歧減半，仍然有五分之一的參與者做出了不同的決定。校準修復了大部分的評估者依賴性，但未能確保對個體的共識。

docs.title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
docs.text:
2610.08482v2 by Maryam Baizhigitova, Andrew Seohwan Yu, Po-Hao Chen, Naveen Subhas, Sixu Chen, Xinxin Wang, Kunio Nakamura, Richard Lartey, Xiaojuan Li, Mingrui Yang

Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice.
