We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

摘要：視覺-語言模型 (VLMs) 正在越來越多地應用於三維醫學影像，但其在膝關節 MRI 的應用仍然有限，特別是在解釋臨床實踐中使用的互補序列方面。我們介紹了 Knee3DVLM，一種序列感知的 VLM，使用全體積 DESS 和流體敏感的 TSE MRI 來預測 57 個從 MRI 骨關節炎膝關節評分 (MOAKS) 中衍生的解剖學解析二元診斷目標，以進行結構化報告。我們使用主題不重疊的骨關節炎倡議分區評估了僅 DESS、僅 TSE 和配對 DESS-TSE 配置。在一個包含 1,074 次檢查的保留隊列中，融合模型達到了 72.98% 的平均準確率、71.17% 的平衡準確率、78.96% 的平均 ROC-AUC 和 78.74% 的宏 ROC-AUC，這是三種配置中最高的值。在一項與釋出的 3DReasonKnee 隊列對齊的次級多類別分析中，Knee3DVLM 在五個病理類別中數值上高於報告的最強 3DReasonKnee 配置。這些發現支持雙序列全體積建模以進行全面的膝關節 MRI 評估。

docs.title: Sensor Geometry as a Flow-Matching Prior for Multi-Channel Brain Signals
docs.text:
2610.08355v1 by Jaedong Hwang

Flow-matching models start from an isotropic Gaussian source, the standard choice when the correlation structure of the data is unknown in advance. For multi-channel brain recordings, however, part of this structure is known in advance. Electrodes sit at fixed positions on the head, and volume conduction through the skull and scalp makes nearby electrodes co-vary in a way that is shared across subjects. Existing EEG generative models nonetheless leave the network to learn this from scratch. We put this structure into the source instead. From the sensor coordinates alone, we build a k-nearest-neighbor graph and take a graph-Matérn function of its Laplacian as the source covariance, so the flow starts from spatially coherent patterns rather than channel-independent noise. The change adds no learned parameters, works with any coupling and any drift network, and uses the same three hyperparameters on every dataset. Across eight EEG datasets and four flow-matching methods, the graph-Matérn source lowers the spectral discrepancy between generated and real signals in the five clinical bands (PSD-KL) on most datasets. PSD-KL falls by 12% to 17% in geometric mean over datasets depending on the method and by up to 40% on PhysioNet-MI, the densest montage. We show that the improvement stems from the spatial eigenvectors of the local graph of sensor positions, since randomizing the eigenvectors while preserving the eigenvalue spectrum eliminates the gain. Furthermore, a prior fitted directly to the empirical data covariance performs worse than isotropic noise. The same construction applies unchanged to MEG, intracranial EEG with patient-specific grids, and a traffic-sensor network, lowering PSD-KL for every method on each. https://jd730.github.io/projects/GraphPrior

摘要：流匹配模型從各向同性的高斯源開始，這是當數據的相關結構事先未知時的標準選擇。然而，對於多通道腦電圖記錄，這部分結構是事先已知的。電極固定在頭部的特定位置，通過顱骨和頭皮的體積傳導使得相鄰的電極以一種在不同受試者之間共享的方式共同變化。現有的腦電圖生成模型仍然讓網絡從零開始學習這一點。我們將這一結構直接放入源中。僅根據傳感器坐標，我們構建了一個k最近鄰圖，並將其拉普拉斯算子的圖-馬特恩函數作為源協方差，因此流從空間一致的模式開始，而不是通道獨立的噪聲。這一變化不增加任何學習參數，適用於任何耦合和任何漂移網絡，並在每個數據集上使用相同的三個超參數。在八個腦電圖數據集和四種流匹配方法中，圖-馬特恩源降低了生成信號與真實信號之間在五個臨床頻段（PSD-KL）的頻譜差異，對於大多數數據集而言。根據方法的不同，PSD-KL在數據集上的幾何平均下降了12%到17%，在PhysioNet-MI這個最密集的佈局上則下降了最多40%。我們顯示，這一改進源於傳感器位置的局部圖的空間特徵向量，因為在保留特徵值譜的同時隨機化特徵向量會消除增益。此外，直接擬合到經驗數據協方差的先驗表現不如各向同性噪聲。相同的構造不變地適用於MEG、具有患者特定網格的顱內腦電圖以及交通傳感器網絡，降低每種方法在每個數據集上的PSD-KL。 https://jd730.github.io/projects/GraphPrior

docs.title: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation
docs.text:
2610.08327v1 by Xilin Dang, Weilin Ruan, Xue Yang, Jinghao Wang, Xiaowei Hu, Jinpeng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng

Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. MedZERO couples an Examiner that generates frontier medical question-option pairs with a Reasoner that solves them through evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools. To support reliable, continual improvement, MedZERO adopts controlled knowledge accumulation, which maintains temporary exploratory knowledge and curated persistent knowledge in reasoning. We evaluate MedZERO on five public medical reasoning benchmarks using 4B- and 8B-scale base models under open-ended evaluation. Across all settings, MedZERO consistently outperforms the underlying base models and prior self-evolving baselines, achieving up to 13.7 average accuracy-point gains over the next-best self-evolving baseline.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）在醫療問題回答和臨床推理方面顯示出潛力，但其改進仍受到靜態參數知識和高昂專家監督的限制。自我進化代理提供了一種有前景的替代方案，通過使模型能夠通過迭代任務生成和問題解決來改進。然而，大多數現有的自我進化方法是為了易於驗證的領域而設計的，例如數學和編程，在這些領域中，解決方案可以通過精確答案或可執行程序來檢查。醫療推理根本上是不同的：它是開放式的、知識密集型的，且通常只能部分驗證。我們提出了MedZERO，一個用於開放式醫療推理的自我進化框架。MedZERO結合了一個生成前沿醫療問題-選項對的考官和一個通過基於證據的多輪推理與外部知識工具解決這些問題的推理器。為了支持可靠的持續改進，MedZERO採用了受控的知識積累，這保持了臨時的探索性知識和策劃的持久知識在推理中。我們在五個公共醫療推理基準上評估了MedZERO，使用4B和8B規模的基礎模型進行開放式評估。在所有設置中，MedZERO始終超越基礎模型和先前的自我進化基準，實現了高達13.7的平均準確度點增益，超過了下一個最佳的自我進化基準。

docs.title: Sensor-Language-Action Models
docs.text:
2610.08244v1 by Yuekai Xu, Zitao Shuai, Yuzhe Yang

Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.

摘要：感測器不僅對理解世界有用，還對決定下一步行動具有重要意義。然而，現有的感測器模型在感知方面基本上停滯不前：它們識別狀態或預測結果，將行動單獨建模，通常通過特定任務的封閉標籤空間。我們引入了感測-語言-行動（SLA）建模，這是一個將多模態感測觀察、自然語言和行動連接在統一模型中的框架。SLA使用語言作為感知與行動之間的語義介面，允許異質行動被表示、預測和解釋，同時仍然基於底層的感測證據。我們建立了一個大規模的SLA基準，包含超過116,000個個體、79種感測模態和60個行動組的數據集，以及一個多面向的標註管道，該管道對齊用戶上下文、感測動態和行動證據。在此框架的基礎上，我們提出了OpenSLA，一個統一的SLA模型，用於層次行動預測、狀態理解和行動解釋。在臨床預測、手術室和代謝健康等現實世界任務上的廣泛實驗驗證了其優於最先進技術的卓越性能。OpenSLA還展示了引人注目的能力，包括語言引導的證據基礎和對未見行動和群體的零樣本泛化。

docs.title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
docs.text:
2610.08231v1 by Neriah Ben David, Ori Meir, Or Ordentlich

NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4

摘要：NVFP4 是一種對於大型語言模型 (LLM) 推理來說具有吸引力的數據類型，提供緊湊的存儲和原生的張量核心加速。然而，使用 NVFP4 保持準確性需要仔細的量化。在這項工作中，我們開發了一種名為 NVFP4 的優化平滑和縮放的新型量化方案 (OSFP4)。對於每個線性投影，它使用一個對角平滑矩陣，其條目經過優化，以最小化在 NVFP4 下的平方矩陣乘積量化誤差，考慮到所使用的四捨五入程序（無論是四捨五入到最近的數字，還是 GPTQ 風格的連續干擾消除）。這需要對平滑條目以及區塊縮放進行聯合優化，這是通過分析一種乘法抖動 FP4 量化器而非固定的確定性量化器來促進的。實驗顯示，OSFP4 在相應的量化設置中實現了評估競爭者中最高的平均準確性，同時在測量的工作負載上保留了大約 94-97\% 的供應商 NVFP4 預填吞吐量。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4 獲得。

docs.title: Symphony for Text Generation: Benchmarking Clinical Note Generation
docs.text:
2610.08161v1 by Daniel Varab, Victor Petrén Bach Hansen, Asbjørn W. Helge, Kevin Pelgrims, Mathias Baltzersen, Adrian Young-San Roessler, Vanessa Klungtvedt, Maximilian Brand, Lasse Krogsbøll, Henrik Cullen, Lars Maaløe

Ambient documentation systems are rapidly gaining adoption, yet their impact on clinical note quality remains poorly characterized. We introduce MedConv, a multilingual dataset of 300 clinical encounters in English, Danish, and German, and use it alongside the Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark (ACI-BENCH) to compare Corti, a clinical AI platform, with two leading, accessible ambient scribe software applications built on general-purpose AI. We present a controlled clinical evaluation framework that combines entailment metrics with LLM-judged pairwise comparisons across eight dimensions adopted from PDSQI-9. Results show that Corti's API-based text-generation infrastructure is on par with or outperforms leading commercial scribes. We further show that Corti's configurable API provides the flexibility necessary to fine-tune quality dimensions for specific documentation use cases. We present the evaluation methodology and release a dataset to support future reproducible comparison of ambient documentation systems.

摘要：環境文檔系統正在迅速獲得採用，但其對臨床筆記質量的影響仍然缺乏明確的描述。我們介紹了 MedConv，一個包含 300 個臨床接觸的多語言數據集，涵蓋英語、丹麥語和德語，並將其與環境臨床智能基準（ACI-BENCH）一起使用，以比較 Corti，一個臨床 AI 平台，與兩個基於通用 AI 的領先可訪問環境記錄軟件應用程序。我們提出了一個受控的臨床評估框架，將推理指標與 LLM 判斷的成對比較結合，涵蓋從 PDSQI-9 採用的八個維度。結果顯示，Corti 的基於 API 的文本生成基礎設施與領先的商業記錄工具相當或表現更佳。我們進一步展示了 Corti 可配置的 API 提供了必要的靈活性，以便為特定文檔使用案例微調質量維度。我們呈現了評估方法論並發布了一個數據集，以支持未來對環境文檔系統的可重複比較。

docs.title: SAGE: Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution for Grounded Medical QA Data Synthesis
docs.text:
2610.08093v1 by Chuan Li, Chengyu Wang, Cen Chen, Ye Lyu, Mingyuan Fan, Ming Gao

Developing reliable models for clinical tasks, such as Medical Question Answering (QA), is severely constrained by the limited availability of high-quality, expert-annotated training data. This challenge is exacerbated by stringent privacy requirements and the impracticality of utilizing large open-source corpora or proprietary cloud APIs within resource-limited clinical settings. To address these obstacles, we introduce SAGE (\textit{Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution}), a novel data synthesis framework that enables small, locally deployed models to generate high-quality medical training data. SAGE leverages lightweight, publicly available taxonomies such as MeSH as semantic anchors, imposing a structured prior to effectively guide and ground the data generation process. At its core, SAGE iteratively interleaves atomic (individual concept-based) and associative (relation-based) synthesis, bootstrapping training data from minimal seeds. This approach eliminates the need for large collections of medical documents or reliance on external APIs, providing a practical solution for on-premises data creation. Extensive experiments across multiple medical question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that models fine-tuned with SAGE-synthesized data consistently outperform those trained using self-derived or conventional document-based paradigms, highlighting tangible improvements in data efficiency and resource utilization for medical LLM development. Code is available at https://github.com/DIaacKr/SAGE.

摘要：開發可靠的臨床任務模型，例如醫療問題回答（QA），受到高品質、專家標註的訓練數據有限可用性的嚴重限制。這一挑戰因嚴格的隱私要求以及在資源有限的臨床環境中使用大型開源語料庫或專有雲端API的實用性不足而加劇。為了解決這些障礙，我們介紹了SAGE（\textit{語義錨點引導演化}），這是一個新穎的數據合成框架，使小型本地部署模型能夠生成高品質的醫療訓練數據。SAGE利用輕量級的公共可用分類法，如MeSH，作為語義錨點，施加結構化的先驗，以有效引導和基礎數據生成過程。SAGE的核心是迭代地交錯原子（基於個別概念）和關聯（基於關係）合成，從最小的種子啟動訓練數據。這種方法消除了對大量醫療文檔的需求或對外部API的依賴，為本地數據創建提供了一種實用的解決方案。在多個醫療問題回答基準上的廣泛實驗表明，使用SAGE合成數據進行微調的模型始終優於使用自我衍生或傳統文檔基礎範式訓練的模型，突顯了在醫療LLM開發中數據效率和資源利用的實質性改善。代碼可在https://github.com/DIaacKr/SAGE獲得。

docs.title: Multimodal Knowledge Distillation for Gastric Adenocarcinoma Classification from Whole-Slide Images
docs.text:
2610.07913v1 by Shrihari Dumbre, Bikash Santra

Gastric adenocarcinoma (GA) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and accurate histopathological subtype classification from whole-slide images (WSIs) is essential for effective treatment planning. While multimodal approaches that integrate pathology report text with WSIs can improve classification, existing methods often depend on computationally expensive transformer architectures and large language models. We propose a multimodal knowledge distillation (MKD) framework that combines a pretrained WSI image encoder and a clinical text encoder using Low-Rank Multimodal Fusion (LMF) to efficiently model cross-modal interactions during training. Each WSI is represented as a bag of patches paired with a slide-level diagnostic caption. The teacher model learns fused image-text representations for subtype classification, while the student model distills this knowledge to enable accurate image-only inference. We evaluate our method on the PatchGastric benchmark dataset and achieve at least 3.35% higher mean accuracy than state-of-the-art approaches, without relying on transformer-based fusion, multi-task learning, or large language models. The source code is available at https://github.com/helomelo1/MKD-LMF.

摘要：胃腺癌（GA）是全球癌症相關死亡率的主要原因，從全片影像（WSIs）中準確的組織病理亞型分類對於有效的治療計劃至關重要。雖然整合病理報告文本與WSIs的多模態方法可以改善分類，但現有的方法往往依賴於計算成本高昂的Transformer架構和大型語言模型。我們提出了一種多模態知識蒸餾（MKD）框架，該框架結合了預訓練的WSI影像編碼器和臨床文本編碼器，使用低秩多模態融合（LMF）在訓練期間高效建模跨模態交互。每個WSI被表示為一組與幻燈片級診斷標題配對的補丁袋。教師模型學習融合的影像-文本表示以進行亞型分類，而學生模型則蒸餾這些知識以實現準確的僅影像推斷。我們在PatchGastric基準數據集上評估我們的方法，並達到至少3.35%的平均準確率高於最先進的方法，而不依賴於基於Transformer的融合、多任務學習或大型語言模型。源代碼可在 https://github.com/helomelo1/MKD-LMF 獲得。

docs.title: Label-Efficient Deep Learning for ECG Delineation: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark against Widely Used Delineation Tools
docs.text:
2610.07885v1 by Jeonghwa Lim, Minje Park, Yeongyeon Na, Yujin Eom, Soyeon Lim, Young Ho Lee, Yu Jeong Kim, Sunghoon Joo, Ki Hong Lee

Electrocardiogram (ECG) delineation, the identification of waveform boundaries, is a foundational step that translates raw ECG signals into clinically interpretable measurements. Deep learning has advanced this task but remains dependent on costly expert annotations. Label-efficient strategies such as self-supervised pretraining and semi-supervised learning are expected to ease this burden, yet it remains unclear whether they yield reliable delineation and whether the deep models they produce outperform the delineation tools used in practice. We address this in two stages. First, comparing self-supervised objectives with supervised or semi-supervised fine-tuning across one internal and four external datasets, we find that pretraining helps but the objective matters, and that the value of semi-supervised fine-tuning depends on the pretraining objective. Second, we benchmark the selected deep learning model against widely used open-source (NeuroKit2, Prominence, ECGdeli) and commercial (CalECG) tools using three complementary metrics. The model ranks best on every metric and dataset, outperforming the strongest tool by a clear margin on the rhythm-diverse set (mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%; averaged point-wise sensitivity 92.6 vs. 76.4%), and degrades the least from sinus to arrhythmia. A rhythm-stratified and point-wise analysis further characterizes the distinctive behavior of each tool, yielding practical guidance for tool selection. These results provide systematic, multi-dataset evidence that self-supervised pretraining is effective for ECG delineation and enables a label-efficiently trained deep learning model to outperform widely used delineation tools by leveraging abundant unlabeled data. This supports adopting such models in diverse, real-world clinical settings.

摘要：心電圖（ECG）輪廓描繪，即波形邊界的識別，是將原始ECG信號轉換為臨床可解釋測量的基礎步驟。深度學習已經推進了這項任務，但仍然依賴於昂貴的專家標註。預期標籤高效策略，如自監督預訓練和半監督學習，能夠減輕這一負擔，但仍不清楚它們是否能產生可靠的輪廓描繪，以及它們所生成的深度模型是否優於實際使用的輪廓描繪工具。我們將此問題分為兩個階段來解決。首先，通過在一個內部數據集和四個外部數據集上比較自監督目標與監督或半監督微調，我們發現預訓練有幫助，但目標很重要，且半監督微調的價值取決於預訓練目標。其次，我們使用三個互補的指標，將所選的深度學習模型與廣泛使用的開源（NeuroKit2、Prominence、ECGdeli）和商業（CalECG）工具進行基準測試。該模型在每個指標和數據集上均排名最佳，在節律多樣的數據集上明顯超越最強工具（mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%；平均逐點靈敏度 92.6 vs. 76.4%），並且從竇性心律到心律不整的降級最小。對節律分層和逐點分析進一步描述了每個工具的獨特行為，為工具選擇提供了實用指導。這些結果提供了系統的多數據集證據，表明自監督預訓練對ECG輪廓描繪是有效的，並使得標籤高效訓練的深度學習模型能夠通過利用豐富的未標記數據超越廣泛使用的輪廓描繪工具。這支持在多樣的現實臨床環境中採用這類模型。

docs.title: Novice Reliance Calibration in AI-Assisted Decision Making: The Role of Explanations and Self-Assessment
docs.text:
2610.07800v1 by Eun Jeong Kang, Peter, Duan, Swati Mishra

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools are widely used to support decision making in tasks and domains where no immediate performance feedback is available. In these settings, users cannot learn to adjust their reliance behavior over time through trial and error. However, little is known about how novice users calibrate reliance on AI when external feedback is unavailable, or whether AI explanations can support calibration in its absence. We introduce reliance calibration as an organizing construct for studying how novice users dynamically adjust reliance behavior, and examine how AI explanations and meta-cognitive self-assessment shape it. Through a between-subjects study with 110 participants completing a clinical entity extraction task with AI assistance and limited performance feedback, we observe that novice users exhibit systematic drift toward over-reliance in the presence of explanations, while higher self-reported task understanding is associated with more selective reliance behavior. These results extend reliance calibration research into human-AI collaboration contexts without real-time performance signals and present actionable guidelines on designing AI tools that must support appropriate reliance in these settings.

摘要：人工智慧（AI）工具被廣泛用於支持在沒有即時表現反饋的任務和領域中的決策制定。在這些情況下，用戶無法通過反覆試驗來學習隨時間調整其依賴行為。然而，對於新手用戶在缺乏外部反饋的情況下如何調整對AI的依賴，或者AI解釋是否能在缺乏反饋的情況下支持這種調整，了解的資訊卻很少。我們引入依賴調整作為一個組織性構念，用於研究新手用戶如何動態調整依賴行為，並檢視AI解釋和元認知自我評估如何影響這一過程。通過一項包含110名參與者的被試間研究，這些參與者在AI輔助下完成一項臨床實體提取任務，並且獲得有限的表現反饋，我們觀察到新手用戶在有解釋的情況下表現出系統性的過度依賴趨勢，而自我報告的任務理解程度較高則與更具選擇性的依賴行為相關。這些結果將依賴調整研究擴展到沒有實時表現信號的人機協作情境，並提供了設計必須在這些情境中支持適當依賴的AI工具的可行指導方針。

docs.title: Unanimously Wrong: Certified Abstention from How Medical LLM Consensus Forms
docs.text:
2610.07570v1 by Xiaoyang Wang, Tianrui Wang, Christopher C. Yang

In clinical practice, agreement among independent experts is treated as evidence of reliability, and multi-round consensus has become a core mechanism of agentic medical question-answering systems. When such a system must decide whether to trust its own answer, the prevailing signal is again agreement, now among the sampled answers. But agreement is a fragile proxy for correctness. A system can be unanimously wrong, returning the same incorrect answer on every sample, and on these questions agreement-based signals carry no information. The cause is that these signals read only the final state of the consensus and discard how it was reached. Agreement that was reached by resolving disagreement with evidence looks identical, at the end, to agreement that was present from the first sample because every sample shares one misconception. ProbeGuard is a certified abstention framework that bases the abstention decision on how the consensus formed. Process features trace agreement trajectories, minority persistence, and retrieval saturation. For unanimous votes, rationale semantic entropy checks whether the reasons behind the vote cohere, and an active probe retrieves counter-evidence and measures whether the consensus survives. A stratified Learn-then-Test calibration then converts these scores into a distribution-free bound on selective risk. We evaluate ProbeGuard on three medical QA benchmarks and a hard-frontier reference, with a published multi-round agentic RAG substrate, against six abstention baselines. On MedQA, 13.4% of unanimous votes are wrong, and no agreement-based signal can flag them. Process signals raise the discrimination of correct from incorrect consensus from chance to 0.696 AUROC. The certified rule answers six in ten unanimous-layer questions at an observed selective risk of 9.0%, and nine in ten once in-domain calibration data accumulate.

摘要：在臨床實踐中，獨立專家的一致意見被視為可靠性的證據，而多輪共識已成為代理醫療問答系統的核心機制。當這樣的系統必須決定是否信任自己的答案時，主要的信號再次是一致性，這次是在抽樣的答案之間。然而，一致性是一個脆弱的正確性代理。系統可以在所有樣本中一致地錯誤，返回相同的不正確答案，而在這些問題上，基於一致性的信號並不提供任何信息。原因在於這些信號僅僅讀取共識的最終狀態，並忽略了它是如何達成的。通過用證據解決分歧達成的一致性，在最後看起來與從第一個樣本開始就存在的一致性是相同的，因為每個樣本都共享一個誤解。ProbeGuard是一個經過認證的放棄框架，基於共識形成的方式來決定是否放棄。過程特徵追蹤一致性軌跡、少數持續性和檢索飽和度。對於一致的投票，理由語義熵檢查投票背後的理由是否一致，而主動探測則檢索反證據並測量共識是否持續。分層的先學後測校準然後將這些分數轉換為無分佈的選擇風險界限。我們在三個醫療QA基準和一個困難邊界參考上評估ProbeGuard，並與六個放棄基準進行比較，這些基準有一個已發表的多輪代理RAG基礎。在MedQA上，13.4%的全體投票是錯誤的，並且沒有基於一致性的信號能夠標記它們。過程信號將正確與不正確共識的區分從偶然提升到0.696 AUROC。經過認證的規則在觀察到的選擇風險為9.0%時，回答了十分之一的一致層問題，而當領域內的校準數據累積後，則回答了十分之九。

docs.title: PsyCIDRA: A Dual-Agent Framework for Psychiatric Interviewing and Diagnostic Reasoning
docs.text:
2610.07473v1 by Milad Mohammadi, Fatemeh Akrami Shamsabadi, Zahra Mohseni, Amirhossein Safdarian, Malekfarhad Malek, Hadi Moradi, Hesham Faili

Large language models show promise in clinical reasoning, but psychiatric interviewing requires guiding an evolving conversation. Their ability to carry out this interactive assessment remains less studied. We present PsyCIDRA, a dual-agent framework linking free-form psychiatric interviewing with diagnostic reasoning for expert review. Its interviewer agent uses tools to maintain working notes, load expert-written skills, and retrieve ICD-11 references to guide inquiry. Its diagnostic reasoning agent then receives the completed interview transcript and reports hypotheses alongside supporting, conflicting, and missing evidence, withholding a final hypothesis when none is sufficiently supported. Using patient profiles generated with PsyCPG, we first evaluate PsyCIDRA in simulation. Across four models on 53 evaluation cases, it achieves higher diagnostic agreement than direct prompting. On 81 held-out simulated cases, rank-1 accuracy is 60.5% versus 51.9%. In a blinded study of 101 human participants in separate arms, PsyCIDRA agrees with psychologists on whether to propose a diagnostic hypothesis in 79.6% of cases, compared with 65.4% for direct prompting. Together, these findings support the potential of LLM agents to assist psychiatric assessment through free-form dialogue. By examining diagnostic reasoning, interview quality, and safety together, this study contributes to understanding the capabilities and limitations of psychiatric interview agents.

摘要：大型語言模型在臨床推理中顯示出潛力，但精神病訪談需要引導一個不斷演變的對話。它們進行這種互動評估的能力仍然研究較少。我們提出了PsyCIDRA，一個雙代理框架，將自由形式的精神病訪談與專家審查的診斷推理聯繫起來。其訪談代理使用工具來維持工作筆記、加載專家撰寫的技能，並檢索ICD-11參考資料以指導詢問。然後，它的診斷推理代理接收完成的訪談文字記錄，並報告假設以及支持的、相互矛盾的和缺失的證據，當沒有任何證據足夠支持時，則不提出最終假設。使用PsyCPG生成的患者檔案，我們首先在模擬中評估PsyCIDRA。在53個評估案例的四個模型中，它達到的診斷一致性高於直接提示。在81個保留的模擬案例中，排名第一的準確率為60.5%，而直接提示為51.9%。在對101名人類參與者進行的盲測研究中，PsyCIDRA在79.6%的案例中與心理學家一致是否提出診斷假設，而直接提示則為65.4%。這些發現共同支持LLM代理通過自由形式對話協助精神病評估的潛力。通過共同檢查診斷推理、訪談質量和安全性，本研究有助於理解精神病訪談代理的能力和限制。

docs.title: Adaptive Gait Biofeedback With Participant-Held-Out Modeling and Participant-Specific Updating in Chronic Ankle Instability
docs.text:
2610.07428v1 by Jaeyoon, Kim, Veronika Lebisova, Jeniya Sultana, Jaeyoung Cho, Jaeho Jang

Adaptive gait biofeedback may support repeated practice in chronic ankle instability, but its evaluation must address model performance and human response. We evaluated a temporal convolutional classifier on protocol-defined, angle-derived GOOD/BAD gait-cycle labels using participant-held-out leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation in 20 participants. Seven participants in the adaptive-intervention group completed nine sessions over three weeks, with one motion-capture recording analyzed per session. Models updated after failed sessions were compared offline with their parent models on the same-session validation subset used for candidate selection and the first subsequent adaptive-session recording. Frontal-plane ankle angle was compared between the adaptive group and 10 sequentially enrolled controls at Baseline, Post, and 7-day Retention. Across 20 held-out folds, mean fold-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.948, sensitivity for angle-threshold-exceeding BAD cycles was 0.941, and specificity for angle-threshold-meeting GOOD cycles was 0.366. Mean BAD-class F1 was higher in candidate models by 0.187 on the same-session subset and 0.118 on the first subsequent recording. At Post, the adaptive group had a baseline-adjusted frontal-plane ankle angle 5.168 degrees lower than controls (95% confidence interval, 1.766-8.569 degrees lower); the Retention contrast was uncertain. These findings characterize population-model discrimination and offline participant-specific updating during repeated biofeedback use, alongside a nonrandomized Post frontal-plane ankle angle association. They do not establish independent clinical gait classification or a causal benefit of updating.

摘要：適應性步態生物回饋可能支持慢性踝關節不穩定的重複練習，但其評估必須考慮模型性能和人類反應。我們在20名參與者中使用參與者保留的逐一主題交叉驗證，評估了一種基於協議定義、角度衍生的好/壞步態週期標籤的時間卷積分類器。適應性介入組的七名參與者在三週內完成了九個會話，每個會話分析了一次運動捕捉錄影。失敗會話後更新的模型與其父模型在同一會話驗證子集上進行了離線比較，該子集用於候選選擇和第一次隨後的適應會話錄影。適應組的正面平面踝關節角度與10名按序入組的對照組在基線、後測和7天保持期進行了比較。在20個保留摺疊中，平均摺疊級別的接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUROC）為0.948，對於角度閾值超過的壞週期的敏感性為0.941，對於角度閾值符合的好週期的特異性為0.366。候選模型在同一會話子集上的平均壞類別F1比率高出0.187，在第一次隨後的錄影中高出0.118。在後測時，適應組的基線調整後的正面平面踝關節角度比對照組低5.168度（95%置信區間，低1.766-8.569度）；保持期的對比結果不確定。這些發現特徵化了人群模型的區分能力和在重複生物回饋使用期間的離線參與者特定更新，以及非隨機的後測正面平面踝關節角度關聯。它們並未建立獨立的臨床步態分類或更新的因果效益。

docs.title: A doctrine-grounded visual question answering dataset for Tactical Combat Casualty Care
docs.text:
2610.07339v1 by Junseob Kim, Jade Chng, Ayman Ali, Victor Moas, Yichun Lee, Po-Chun Chin, Sunil Hwang, Rishikesan Kamaleswaran

Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TC3) requires responders to connect visual observations of injuries and interventions with established clinical guidance. Developing vision-language models to support this process requires supervision that links visible evidence to traceable doctrine. We present TC3-VQA, a dataset constructed from public instructional and field TC3 videos and authoritative TC3 documents. It contains 581 items spanning 11 concepts, with 1,860 questions covering intervention recognition, doctrine, clinical reasoning, procedural guidance, and refusal when visual information is insufficient. Doctrine-based answers preserve verbatim source passages and character offsets. Construction combines visual annotation, passage retrieval, entailment checks, and verification across model families. Equipment boxes, anatomical labels, temporal segments, and source metadata accompany the question-answer pairs. Automated audits and ratings by two physicians and two medical students characterize annotation quality, with human ratings available for 88 retained items. The dataset provides a resource for adapting vision-language models to TC3, studying the connection between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, and evaluating recognition, doctrine recall, and abstention.

摘要：戰術戰鬥傷患護理 (TC3) 要求應急人員將傷害和干預的視覺觀察與既定的臨床指導相連接。開發支持此過程的視覺-語言模型需要將可見證據與可追溯的教義聯繫起來的監督。我們提出了 TC3-VQA，這是一個由公共教學和現場 TC3 影片以及權威 TC3 文件構建的數據集。它包含 581 個項目，涵蓋 11 個概念，並有 1,860 個問題涉及干預識別、教義、臨床推理、程序指導以及在視覺信息不足時的拒絕。基於教義的答案保留逐字來源段落和字符偏移。構建過程結合了視覺標註、段落檢索、推理檢查和跨模型系列的驗證。設備框、解剖標籤、時間段和來源元數據伴隨著問題-答案對。由兩名醫生和兩名醫學生進行的自動審核和評分特徵標註質量，並且對 88 個保留項目提供了人工評分。該數據集為將視覺-語言模型調整至 TC3、研究視覺證據與臨床知識之間的聯繫，以及評估識別、教義回憶和棄權提供了一個資源。

docs.title: TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes
docs.text:
2610.07224v1 by Jose D. Posada, Somalee Datta, Priya Desai

Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.

摘要：臨床筆記捕捉了有關病人護理的大部分文件內容，但在移除受保護的健康信息（PHI）之前，這些筆記無法用於研究。去識別化通常被視為一個檢測問題。僅僅檢測是不夠的：刪除會刪除臨床內容以及識別符號，日期空白會破壞進行縱向分析所需的時間間隔，而在每次出現時分配一個新的隨機替代品會打斷病人筆記之間的聯繫。我們提出了 TIDE 2.0，一個 MIT 授權的引擎，具有兩個可分離的階段：一個可互換的識別器和一個鍵控匿名化器。這兩者都在機構擁有的硬體上運行。替代品是以加密方式生成的，沒有存儲的聯繫表。日期通過每位病人的、保持間隔的偏移量進行變更；在給定的鍵下，每個值在所有出現中都接收相同的替代品；而在新鍵下生成的釋放無法與早期的釋放相連。我們還發布了 TIDE2-Sentry，這是一個從大型語言模型中提煉出的識別器。在來自兩個機構的兩個金標註語料庫上，默認配置在第一個機構的語料庫中達到了 0.88 的跨度級召回率，在第二個機構的語料庫中達到了 0.77，精確度分別為 0.88 和 0.87。我們報告了每個類別的召回率和精確度，並附上這些總體數據。該引擎是開源的，識別器則在受限的研究使用協議下提供，因此機構可以在自己的環境中運行、檢查和擴展這兩者。

docs.title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
docs.text:
2610.07132v1 by Berke Arda, Ahmetcan Yavuz, Paul Gerry, Sebastian Lobentanzer, Nobin Sarwar, Joan Giner-Miguelez, Kongtao Chen, Luyao Zhang, Mrinmaya Sachan, Mubashara Akhtar

Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.

摘要：Croissant 已經成為機器可讀數據集元數據的標準，但填寫其字段仍然需要大量人力，並且需要仔細閱讀伴隨的數據集文檔。我們提出了第一個基準，能夠進行與社區標準架構對齊的元數據提取的端到端評估。該基準包含 602 篇論文，其中包括 102 篇經過人工驗證的金標註和 500 篇由 LLM 生成的銀標註，涵蓋了完整的 Croissant 架構，包括核心和負責任的人工智慧 (RAI) 字段。利用這個基準，我們評估了一系列提取系統，涵蓋前沿模型、開放權重模型和代理架構，並在一個兩級評估框架下進行，該框架結合了基於規則的評分和通過人工審核選擇的 LLM 評審。我們發現，單次提取在我們評估的四個代理架構中始終表現更好：在各個主幹中，這些分解變體的準確性低於單次全上下文提取。最大的差距出現在長格式的 RAI 字段，這需要綜合和解釋分散在論文中的信息，而不是從單一位置複製，這是一個當前系統仍然遠未可靠的情境。我們釋出基準、評估代碼、評審審核、實時演示以及面向新系統的排行榜。

docs.title: Conditional Rank Allocation for Taxonomy-Aware Medical Language Model Adaptation
docs.text:
2610.06765v1 by Guangyuan Dong, Ziwei Hong, Xuehao Zhou, Zidong Yu, Bingchen Liu, Kehan Liu, Chuang Liu, Rong Fu, Yuchao Hou

Medical question answering spans specialties and clinical operations that may benefit from different adaptation directions. We propose ARBOR, a parameter-efficient method that selects rank-one components from a shared low-rank basis for each question. An additive gate combines question representations, specialty tags, operation tags, and their interaction; a learned coefficient scales the adapter residual. An illustrative separation under orthogonal, equiprobable subtasks shows how conditional selection can avoid an approximation floor faced by a fixed update with the same active rank. This result motivates the design without asserting a corresponding bound for medical corpora. On Qwen3-8B across CMB, CMExam, MedQA, and MedMCQA, five-seed experiments yield 69.69% mean accuracy across benchmarks, exceeding LoRA r16 and MoELoRA by 1.26 and 1.30 percentage points, respectively. The reported advantage over LoRA r16 increases from 0.08 to 1.94 points as training expands from one to seven specialties. Tag perturbations and atom masking support the usefulness of clinical routing, while atom clusters align with the supplied specialty labels (adjusted Rand index 0.62). Calibration, transfer, and measured costs further characterize the method. These findings support structured conditional adaptation for medical QA, while leaving clinical safety and broader deployment untested.

摘要：醫療問題回答涵蓋了可能從不同適應方向中受益的專科和臨床操作。我們提出了 ARBOR，一種參數高效的方法，從每個問題的共享低秩基礎中選擇秩一組件。一個加法閘門結合了問題表示、專科標籤、操作標籤及其交互作用；學習的係數縮放適配器殘差。在正交、等概率子任務下的說明性分離顯示了條件選擇如何避免固定更新面臨的近似下限，該更新具有相同的活躍秩。這一結果促進了設計，而不斷言對醫療語料的相應界限。在 Qwen3-8B 上，針對 CMB、CMExam、MedQA 和 MedMCQA 的五次種子實驗在基準測試中產生了 69.69% 的平均準確率，分別超過了 LoRA r16 和 MoELoRA 1.26 和 1.30 個百分點。相對於 LoRA r16 報告的優勢隨著訓練從一個專科擴展到七個專科，從 0.08 增加到 1.94 點。標籤擾動和原子掩碼支持臨床路由的有用性，而原子簇則與提供的專科標籤對齊（調整的 Rand 指數為 0.62）。校準、轉移和測量成本進一步特徵化了該方法。這些發現支持醫療 QA 的結構化條件適應，同時未測試臨床安全性和更廣泛的部署。

docs.title: BrainTRACE: Tracing Longitudinal, Multimodal, and Volumetric Evidence in Brain MRI Clinical Reasoning
docs.text:
2610.06571v1 by Qizhen Lan, Mengchen Fan, Hang Zhang, Jingwei Duan, Moule Lin, Jialin Chen, Baocheng Geng, Xiaoqian Jiang

Brain MRI interpretation is a longitudinal clinical reasoning problem: radiologists compare serial studies, integrate information across MRI sequences, localize findings within volumetric anatomy, and translate this evidence into report-grounded assessments. Existing medical VQA and 3D imaging benchmarks capture important parts of this workflow, but often evaluate brain MRI through isolated images, static volumes, or ungrounded report-style answers, thereby obscuring failures in the evidence chain that support clinical validity. We introduce BrainTRACE, a report-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can trace the evidence structure required for longitudinal brain MRI interpretation. BrainTRACE contains 7,273 scored VQA instances derived from 1,778 longitudinal patients, 7,299 MRI studies, and approximately 29k co-registered 3D MRI sequence volumes. The benchmark is organized by five levels of clinical reasoning, from acquisition recognition to case-level synthesis, and by evidence demands covering longitudinal comparison, report-grounded references, multi-sequence integration, and volumetric spatial evidence. BrainTRACE supports rendered inputs compatible with standard VLM interfaces, a 3D-evidence condition, and a decomposed case-reasoning track that audits six steps in a longitudinal evidence chain. Evaluation of 20 VLM configurations shows that current systems can identify isolated visual cues but rarely compose them into grounded longitudinal interpretations. We release the benchmark specification, evaluation lists, scoring implementation, scoring rubrics, and audit-record format to support reproducible progress in brain MRI VLM evaluation.

摘要：腦部MRI解讀是一個縱向臨床推理問題：放射科醫生比較連續的研究，整合MRI序列中的信息，在體積解剖中定位發現，並將這些證據轉化為基於報告的評估。現有的醫學VQA和3D影像基準捕捉了這一工作流程的重要部分，但通常通過孤立的圖像、靜態體積或無根據的報告風格答案來評估腦部MRI，從而掩蓋了支持臨床有效性的證據鏈中的失敗。我們引入了BrainTRACE，一個基於報告的基準，用於評估視覺-語言模型是否能夠追蹤縱向腦部MRI解讀所需的證據結構。BrainTRACE包含來自1,778名縱向患者、7,299個MRI研究和約29k個共同註冊的3D MRI序列體積的7,273個得分VQA實例。該基準按五個臨床推理層級組織，從獲取識別到案例級綜合，並按證據需求涵蓋縱向比較、基於報告的參考、多序列整合和體積空間證據。BrainTRACE支持與標準VLM接口兼容的渲染輸入、一個3D證據條件，以及一個分解的案例推理軌跡，審核縱向證據鏈中的六個步驟。對20個VLM配置的評估顯示，當前系統可以識別孤立的視覺線索，但很少將其組合成有根據的縱向解釋。我們發布基準規範、評估列表、得分實現、得分標準和審計記錄格式，以支持腦部MRI VLM評估的可重複進展。

docs.title: Proof-Grounded Patient-Specific Clinical Explanations from Knowledge-Graph Reasoning
docs.text:
2610.06549v1 by Surajit Das

Clinical decision-support outputs can lack an au- ditable link between patient observations, encoded knowledge, conclusions, and recommendations. We present the CKG Clinical Explanation Engine, a downstream layer for a frozen, training-free clinical knowledge-graph reasoner that converts patient inference states and disease knowledge into typed facts, explicit rule-application traces, provenance-linked conclusions, and policy-licensed recommendations. The design separates measurement availability, representation completeness, and disease-specific activation; consequently, observed zero-activation evience is not treated as missing and partial representation is distinct from unobserved evidence. Optional language generation is restricted to symbolically licensed content. Across five usable workbooks (6,720 patients; 20,160 patient-disease traces; 1,021,440 feature-evidence rows), IG-range validity and knowledge provenance were 100%, numerical cross-sheet fidelity was 100% (120,960/120,960), and exported logical/report trace completeness was 100% (20,160/20,160). Availability representation consistency was 99.7028% (1,018,404/1,021,440); all 3,036 disagreements were confined to three systematic feature-cohort patterns. The corpus contained 86,783 observed zero-activation and 139,949 observed partially represented instances. A separate seeded 25-patient end-to-end audit completed without execution failure and passed all pre-specified trace, licensing, provenance, and state-consistency checks. These results establish structural and implementation auditability, not clinical correctness or utility.

摘要：臨床決策支持的輸出可能缺乏可審核的連結，這些連結存在於患者觀察、編碼知識、結論和建議之間。我們提出了CKG臨床解釋引擎，這是一個下游層，用於一個凍結的、無需訓練的臨床知識圖推理器，將患者推理狀態和疾病知識轉換為類型事實、明確的規則應用痕跡、來源連結的結論和政策授權的建議。該設計將測量可用性、表示完整性和疾病特定的啟用分開；因此，觀察到的零啟用證據不被視為缺失，而部分表示與未觀察到的證據是不同的。可選的語言生成僅限於符號授權的內容。在五個可用的工作簿中（6,720名患者；20,160條患者-疾病痕跡；1,021,440條特徵-證據行），IG範圍的有效性和知識來源均為100%，數值跨表的忠實度為100%（120,960/120,960），導出的邏輯/報告痕跡完整性為100%（20,160/20,160）。可用性表示的一致性為99.7028%（1,018,404/1,021,440）；所有3,036個分歧都局限於三個系統特徵-隊列模式。語料庫中包含86,783個觀察到的零啟用和139,949個觀察到的部分表示實例。一個單獨的種子25名患者的端到端審計在未發生執行失敗的情況下完成，並通過了所有預先指定的痕跡、授權、來源和狀態一致性檢查。這些結果建立了結構和實施的可審核性，而不是臨床的正確性或效用。

docs.title: Topology-Informed Prompt-Conditioned Universal Segmentation of Uterine Structures from Ultrasound and MRI
docs.text:
2610.06494v1 by Yongheng Sun, Yuexi Gu, Jingwen Sun, Maureen Kohi, Mingxia Liu

Multi-structure segmentation of the uterus is important for computer-assisted screening, diagnosis, and treatment planning of uterine diseases, where ultrasound and MRI provide complementary clinical information. However, developing a unified model across these modalities is challenging due to their substantially different image appearances, anatomical contexts, spatial resolutions, and label spaces. Moreover, existing datasets often define different segmentation targets, making joint learning challenging and potentially leading to negative transfer across heterogeneous tasks. To this end, we propose a Topology-informed Prompt-conditioned Universal Segmentation (TPUS) framework for segmenting multiple uterine structures across ultrasound and MRI. TPUS introduces a graph-based multi-dataset backbone comprising modality-specific stems and a modality-shared graph-based encoder-decoder to support modality-sensitive input adaptation, structural feature reasoning, and joint representation learning across heterogeneous uterine segmentation tasks. In addition, TPUS uses task-aware class prompts to condition the segmentation process for different datasets and label spaces, a dynamic convolutional adaptation module to generate task-specific output responses, and a topology-informed loss to encourage anatomically consistent predictions. Experiments on a uterine ultrasound dataset and a T2-weighted uterine myoma MRI dataset demonstrate that TPUS achieves Dice scores of 0.898 and 0.693 on the two held-out test sets, respectively, outperforming several generic and universal segmentation baselines. Source code can be accessed at https://github.com/YonghengSun1997/TPUS.

摘要：多結構的子宮分割對於計算機輔助篩查、診斷和子宮疾病的治療規劃非常重要，其中超聲波和MRI提供互補的臨床信息。然而，由於這些模態在影像外觀、解剖背景、空間解析度和標籤空間上存在顯著差異，開發一個統一的模型是具有挑戰性的。此外，現有數據集通常定義不同的分割目標，這使得聯合學習變得困難，並可能導致異質任務之間的負轉移。為此，我們提出了一個拓撲知識驅動的提示條件通用分割（TPUS）框架，用於對超聲波和MRI中的多個子宮結構進行分割。TPUS引入了一個基於圖的多數據集骨幹，包含模態特定的幹和一個模態共享的基於圖的編碼器-解碼器，以支持模態敏感的輸入適應、結構特徵推理和異質子宮分割任務的聯合表示學習。此外，TPUS使用任務感知的類別提示來調節不同數據集和標籤空間的分割過程，使用動態卷積適應模塊生成任務特定的輸出響應，並使用拓撲知識驅動的損失來促進解剖一致的預測。在一個子宮超聲波數據集和一個T2加權子宮肌瘤MRI數據集上的實驗表明，TPUS在兩個保留的測試集上分別達到了0.898和0.693的Dice分數，超越了幾個通用和通用分割基準。源代碼可以在 https://github.com/YonghengSun1997/TPUS 獲取。

docs.title: Toward Reliable Infant Pose Estimation: A Training-Dynamics Approach to Noisy Annotation Detection
docs.text:
2610.06423v1 by Emanuele Cardinale, Sara Moccia, Alessandro Cacciatore, Lucia Migliorelli

Spontaneous movement analysis in preterm infants relies increasingly on markerless pose estimation (PE) to derive clinically relevant motion biomarkers directly from video recordings. Training accurate infant PE models requires large sets of manually annotated keypoints, and human annotation is inherently prone to error. Noisy keypoints (i.e., keypoints mislocalized with respect to their true anatomical position) are especially problematic in this clinical setting, since they can propagate as artificial artifacts into the reconstructed joint trajectories. Building on the small-loss hypothesis and training-dynamics-based sample selection established in the noisy-label learning literature, we propose a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations. A hybrid convolutional-attention model is trained to predict the anatomical category of each keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features; the resulting cross-entropy training dynamics are then used to derive per-keypoint descriptors, which are partitioned into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. We validate the approach on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of 65 hospitalized preterm infants, under two realistic noise scenarios (random positional perturbation and left-right swapping) across multiple noise levels. Results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of up to 91.9% in noisy-keypoint detection. The framework further generalizes to the heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering CE-detected noisy keypoints from the training set also yields measurable improvements (up to 7.4 AP points) in downstream pose estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high noise levels.

摘要：自發性運動分析在早產嬰兒中越來越依賴無標記姿勢估計（PE），以直接從視頻錄像中推導出臨床相關的運動生物標記。訓練準確的嬰兒PE模型需要大量手動標註的關鍵點，而人類標註本質上容易出錯。在這種臨床環境中，噪聲關鍵點（即相對於其真實解剖位置錯位的關鍵點）特別成為問題，因為它們可能作為人工伪影傳播到重建的關節軌跡中。基於小損失假設和在噪聲標籤學習文獻中建立的訓練動態樣本選擇，我們提出了一個新框架來檢測噪聲關鍵點標註。一個混合卷積-注意力模型被訓練來根據每個關鍵點的空間坐標和局部視覺特徵預測其解剖類別；隨後，得到的交叉熵訓練動態被用來推導每個關鍵點描述符，這些描述符通過無監督聚類被劃分為乾淨和噪聲子集。我們在NeoPose上驗證了該方法，這是一個新收集的65名住院早產嬰兒的數據集，並在多個噪聲水平下的兩種現實噪聲場景（隨機位置擾動和左右交換）中進行測試。結果顯示，所提出的方法在噪聲關鍵點檢測中達到了高達91.9%的F1分數。該框架進一步推廣到異質的COCO基準，從訓練集中過濾CE檢測的噪聲關鍵點也在中到高噪聲水平下帶來了可測量的改進（高達7.4 AP點）在下游姿勢估計準確性上。

docs.title: Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC~6
docs.text:
2610.06241v1 by Guilherme Silva, Pedro Silva, Gladston Moreira, Eduardo Luz

Wearable and bedside electrocardiogram (ECG) monitors must adapt to patient-specific morphology to maintain arrhythmia detection accuracy across users, yet personalization is typically performed offline and cannot account for individual physiology, electrode placement, or recording drift. On-device adaptation by backpropagation is expensive for microcontroller-class medical devices because it requires an optimizer state, repeated backward passes through convolutional layers, and labeled arrhythmic beats that may not be available at deployment time. This letter proposes prototype-only head adaptation as a compact personalization primitive for TinyML ECG systems. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN; 1,314 parameters and 72.6k multiply-accumulate operations per beat) is trained offline on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database under an inter-patient protocol, frozen as a feature extractor, and exported to a PSoC 6 microcontroller. Patient-specific adaptation then reduces to computing closed-form class means in a 32-dimensional embedding space, requiring no convolutional backward pass, no iterative optimization, and only one forward pass per support beat. Prototype adaptation improves inter-patient macro-F1 from 0.635/0.639/0.646 to 0.731/0.771/0.797 at 1/5/10-shot, outperforming linear stochastic-gradient-descent (SGD) head fine-tuning at every shot count for the target tiny backbone. On-device replay over 18 one-shot episodes on a PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F matches the host macro-F1 for the prototype head (0.798), with 11.39 ms per beat, 5.2 KB flash, and 22.2 KB SRAM. A restricted variant that updates only the normal-class prototype from passively buffered sinus beats yields a consistent +0.05 macro-F1 gain, reducing the annotation burden during initial

摘要：可穿戴和床邊心電圖（ECG）監測器必須適應病人特定的形態，以保持跨用戶的心律不整檢測準確性，然而個性化通常是在離線進行，無法考慮個體生理、電極放置或錄音漂移。對於微控制器級別的醫療設備，通過反向傳播進行設備內適應是昂貴的，因為這需要優化器狀態、在卷積層中重複進行反向傳播，以及在部署時可能無法獲得的標記心律不整的節拍。本文提出原型專用頭適應作為TinyML ECG系統的一種緊湊個性化原語。一維卷積神經網絡（1-D CNN；每個節拍1,314個參數和72.6k次乘加運算）在MIT-BIH心律不整數據庫上根據跨病人協議進行離線訓練，凍結為特徵提取器，並導出到PSoC 6微控制器。病人特定的適應則簡化為在32維嵌入空間中計算閉式類別均值，無需卷積反向傳播、無需迭代優化，且每個支持節拍僅需一次前向傳播。原型適應在1/5/10次拍攝時將跨病人宏觀F1從0.635/0.639/0.646提高到0.731/0.771/0.797，超越了每次拍攝計數下針對目標小型骨幹的線性隨機梯度下降（SGD）頭微調。在PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F上進行的18次一次性回放與原型頭的主機宏觀F1（0.798）相匹配，每個節拍11.39毫秒，5.2 KB閃存和22.2 KB SRAM。一個限制變體僅從被動緩衝的正弦節拍中更新正常類別原型，產生一致的+0.05宏觀F1增益，減少了初始標註負擔。

docs.title: Auditable Clinical Timeline Reconstruction with Provenance-Aware Evidence Graphs
docs.text:
2610.06177v1 by Judith Jeyafreeda Andrew

A patient-timeline reconstruction system is auditable only if it keeps the mentions behind each answer, records how facts were revised, and declines to answer when the evidence is not in the text. This study tests these three properties on a fully synthetic corpus (1,000 patients, 3,353 notes, 220 revision edges). Two provenance-aware Evidence Graph operators reduced the node-plus-edge count to 67% and 63% (77-78% of serialized size) while preserving every answer and mention link across 6,813 query points answerable by recency; a fixed-window baseline returned no value for 53.4% of points, unflagged. On evidence-unavailable controls that announce the omission, a BioClinicalBERT gate and a zero-shot LLM gate responded mainly to the announcement. On marker-free controls, BERT abstained on 0 of 81 notes while its accuracy fell from 93.8% to 59.3% across all three relation classes; the LLM's coverage fell from 75.6% to 27.7% on notes its own model family judged undeterminable. Against 482 regenerated gold spans, the LLM's cited evidence reached recall 0.850 and precision 0.864; BERT's span head, trained without span labels, did not localize evidence. A temporally versioned provenance graph stored abstentions as typed, queryable edges. The clean task admits a 0.651-accuracy shortcut, and results describe implementation behaviour on synthetic data, not clinical performance.

摘要：病人時間線重建系統只有在保留每個答案背後的提及、記錄事實如何被修訂，以及在證據不在文本中時拒絕回答的情況下，才是可審計的。本研究在一個完全合成的語料庫上測試這三個特性（1,000名病人，3,353條筆記，220條修訂邊）。兩個考慮來源的證據圖運算子將節點加邊的數量減少到67%和63%（序列化大小的77-78%），同時保留每個答案和提及鏈接，涵蓋6,813個可由近期回答的查詢點；固定窗口基線在53.4%的點上未返回任何值，且未被標記。在宣布省略的證據不可用控制中，BioClinicalBERT閘和零樣本LLM閘主要對公告作出反應。在無標記的控制中，BERT在81條筆記中沒有放棄，然而其準確率在所有三個關係類別中從93.8%下降到59.3%；LLM在其自身模型家族判斷為無法確定的筆記上的覆蓋率從75.6%下降到27.7%。對於482個再生的金標跨度，LLM引用的證據達到召回率0.850和精確率0.864；未經跨度標籤訓練的BERT跨度頭未能定位證據。一個時間版本的來源圖將放棄記錄為類型化的、可查詢的邊。這個乾淨的任務允許0.651的準確率捷徑，結果描述了在合成數據上的實施行為，而非臨床表現。

docs.title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
docs.text:
2610.06170v1 by Abdul Basit, Muhammad Abdullah Hanif, Muhammad Shafique

Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. From a 66-source corpus indexed into 4,289 retrieval chunks, the pipeline produced a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark spanning 16 topics and 53 subtopics. Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%). Across these endpoints, 25.5% of items were missed by at least four. Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive. Generated construction labels remain metadata rather than validated psychometric categories. Because expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing remain future work, MS-Exam-Gen is not a clinically certified examination. It should be interpreted as an automatically filtered, source-grounded candidate benchmark and reproducible audit workflow for item-level and topic-specific LLM evaluation.

摘要：生物醫學大型語言模型（LLM）的評估需要對狹窄、持續演變的來源基礎專科知識進行可審計的評估。多發性硬化症MRI（MS-MRI）提供了一個高風險的文本知識測試案例，因為正確的推理需要當前的診斷標準、標準化的獲取和報告知識、縱向監測概念、病變形態學以及對困難模仿的識別。我們提出了MS-Exam-Gen，一個可重複的框架，用於構建和審計基於文本的多選題（MCQ）基準，以評估MS-MRI知識；它不評估直接的MRI影像解釋。MS-Exam-Gen針對來源基礎的標準、協議、報告和鑑別診斷。該框架結合了專家來源索引、考試導向的主題引導、基於證據的MCQ生成、自動質量審核、同一家族一致性篩選和實證校準。從一個66個來源的語料庫中索引出4,289個檢索塊，該流程生成了一個鎖定的3,058項候選基準，涵蓋16個主題和53個子主題。在12個主要LLM端點的評估中，產生了36,696個項目級預測，並在42.8個百分點的準確率範圍內（89.7%到46.9%）分離了性能。在這些端點中，25.5%的項目至少被漏掉了四個。生成後的審核顯示，更新的構建減少了可測量的答案提示，而選項順序測試顯示絕對的MCQ分數仍然對位置敏感。生成的構建標籤仍然是元數據，而不是經過驗證的心理測量類別。由於專家裁定和完整的選項順序對照仍然是未來的工作，MS-Exam-Gen並不是一個臨床認證考試。它應被解釋為一個自動過濾的、來源基礎的候選基準和可重複的審計工作流程，用於項目級和主題特定的LLM評估。

docs.title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
docs.text:
2610.06146v1 by Morgan May, Simon Caton, Pierpaolo Dondio

Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.

摘要：準確量化預測不確定性或改善模型校準在醫學影像分類中扮演著重要角色，特別是在黑色素瘤診斷中，準確的不確定性量化對患者護理可能有重大影響。改善校準的方法之一是數據增強。此外，作為一種合成增加數據集大小的方法，數據增強已被證明能改善在不平衡數據集上訓練的模型的性能。然而，數據增強作為原始數據的一部分轉換對於在不平衡數據集上訓練的模型的校準，特別是在黑色素瘤分類中，影響仍然未被充分探索。我們在SIIM-ISIC 2020黑色素瘤分類數據集上訓練神經網絡，在有和沒有數據增強的兩種條件下，並比較兩種情境下的AUC和預期校準誤差（ECE）之間的差異。我們的結果顯示使用不同增強方法在不確定性校準上有所改善。

docs.title: Representation Disentanglement for Fair Chest X-Ray Diagnosis
docs.text:
2610.06041v1 by Yujie Sun, Ruizhe Li, Xiaowu Sun

Deep learning has advanced chest X-ray (CXR) diagnosis, yet demographic biases in learned representations may contribute to performance disparities across intersectional groups. We propose a single-encoder framework combining dual-level decorrelation with prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning to reduce demographic dependence while accounting for within-class variation. We further propose Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction (DRAR), a new metric that quantifies the reduction in demographic structure within disease representations. The framework is evaluated on four classification tasks using 34,809 CheXpert test images across eight intersectional groups, defined by age, sex and ethnicity. Compared with empirical risk minimization (ERM), our method reduces the mean equalized-odds gap from 15.41\% to 10.86\% and the AUC gap from 5.95\% to 5.01\%. Our method achieves a DRAR of 59.04\% relative to ERM, with only a slight decrease in mean AUC. These results demonstrate that representation disentanglement can reduce demographic bias and improve intersectional fairness. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/06Yujie/Fair-Medical-Imaging}.

摘要：深度學習已經推進了胸部 X 光片 (CXR) 的診斷，但學習表示中的人口統計偏見可能會導致不同交叉群體之間的表現差異。我們提出了一種單編碼器框架，將雙層去相關化與原型引導的跨群體對比學習相結合，以減少對人口統計的依賴，同時考慮到類內變異。我們進一步提出了人口統計表示對齊減少 (DRAR)，這是一種新的度量標準，用於量化疾病表示中人口結構的減少。該框架在四個分類任務上進行評估，使用了 34,809 張 CheXpert 測試圖像，涵蓋了八個交叉群體，這些群體是根據年齡、性別和種族定義的。與經驗風險最小化 (ERM) 相比，我們的方法將平均均衡機率差距從 15.41\% 降低到 10.86\%，AUC 差距從 5.95\% 降低到 5.01\%。我們的方法相對於 ERM 實現了 59.04\% 的 DRAR，平均 AUC 僅有輕微下降。這些結果表明，表示解耦可以減少人口統計偏見並改善交叉公平性。代碼可在 \url{https://github.com/06Yujie/Fair-Medical-Imaging} 獲得。

docs.title: HuatuoGPT-3: RL-Only Domain Adaptation from Base Models
docs.text:
2610.05966v1 by Junying Chen, Xinyuan Xie, Ziniu Li, Wenyuan Gu, Jianquan Li, Xiang Wan, Guangjun Yu, Ruoyu Sun, Haizhou Li, Benyou Wang

Domain adaptation aims to turn a general-purpose large language model (LLM) into an expert for a target domain. While the dominant SFT+RL pipeline offers a convenient cold start, it may reduce exploration diversity and introduces additional complexity through multi-stage optimization. These limitations motivate RL-only adaptation. However, pure on-policy RL suffers from a cold-start problem, while mixed-policy RL still falls short: informative tokens in teacher outputs are learned too slowly in early training, and stale teacher outputs can hinder later improvement. We identify these two failure modes as Gradient Starvation and Teacher-Distribution Anchoring. To address them, we propose One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO), which treats teacher outputs as transient guidance for policy improvement. OnePO combines Adaptive Objective Evolution to strengthen learning on informative low-probability teacher tokens and Teacher Retirement to discard teacher outputs once the current policy can surpass them. On medical adaptation, OnePO achieves 67.2 on HealthBench (Total) with only 20K training samples, outperforming SFT+RL and pure RL by 2.7 and 7.4 points, respectively. We further scale OnePO to produce HuatuoGPT-3, an open-source medical LLM series whose 27B variant reaches 70.1 on HealthBench (Total) and 71.4 on HealthBench Professional, surpassing frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra. Models and code are available at https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3.

摘要：領域適應旨在將通用的大型語言模型 (LLM) 轉變為特定領域的專家。雖然主流的 SFT+RL 流程提供了方便的冷啟動，但它可能會降低探索的多樣性，並通過多階段優化引入額外的複雜性。這些限制促使了僅使用強化學習的適應。然而，純粹的在線強化學習面臨冷啟動問題，而混合策略的強化學習仍然不夠理想：教師輸出中的信息性標記在早期訓練中學習得太慢，而過時的教師輸出可能會妨礙後期的改進。我們將這兩種失敗模式稱為梯度飢餓和教師分佈錨定。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了單階段策略優化 (OnePO)，它將教師輸出視為策略改進的瞬時指導。OnePO 結合了自適應目標演變，以加強對信息性低概率教師標記的學習，並使用教師退休來在當前策略能夠超越教師輸出時丟棄教師輸出。在醫療適應方面，OnePO 在 HealthBench (總體) 上達到了 67.2，只使用了 20K 訓練樣本，分別比 SFT+RL 和純強化學習高出 2.7 和 7.4 分。我們進一步擴展 OnePO，產生了 HuatuoGPT-3，一系列開源醫療 LLM，其中 27B 變體在 HealthBench (總體) 上達到 70.1，在 HealthBench 專業版上達到 71.4，超越了前沿模型如 GPT-6 Astra。模型和代碼可在 https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3 獲得。

docs.title: VERA: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Agentic co-Evolution
docs.text:
2610.05923v1 by Junqi Liu, Yongyang Pan, Zhuosong Jiang, Dongbai Li, Bo Zhang, Xitong Ling, Sheng Wang, Hanrong Ye, Yufan He, Can Zhao, Pengfei Guo, Dong Yang, Andriy Myronenko, Yuyin Zhou, Tianyu Liu, Daguang Xu, Yucheng Tang

Competent agents need precise and verifiable environments, such as sandboxes that are resumable at any stage and evolve from observable evidence. However, most long-horizon work exposes how rare these are: for example, an agent in medical research must ground a finding, classify it, and write a report over dozens of dependent steps, yet recent environments score only the outcome. To address the challenges in stable training, we present VERA, which builds such environments at scale and lets agents evolve on them. VERA builds these environments from initial trajectories: an agent writes rubrics, executable checks, a judge verifies each sandbox, and only those that pass enter the training bank. On these environments, VERA alternates between two updates: train the model with rubric rewards, or edit the harness skills. We also create a verifier which gates model checkpoints and harness edits using explicit development-set acceptance criteria. This attribution distinguishes VERA's co-evolution from single-axis baselines: its updates target not only the cause but the outcome. With an open-source corpus of 9,000+ long-horizon verifiable environments, a 9B model paired with its co-evolved agent beats the strongest baseline by 10.3 and 13.0 points in the two domains. At 27B, it surpasses the baseline on AutoCoWorkBench (71.6) and AutoMedBench (80.7), transfers to unseen workflows, and retains general capabilities.

摘要：有能力的代理需要精確且可驗證的環境，例如可以在任何階段恢復的沙盒，並從可觀察的證據中演變而來。然而，大多數長期工作的結果顯示這些環境是多麼稀有：例如，在醫學研究中，代理必須將發現進行基礎，對其進行分類，並在數十個相互依賴的步驟中撰寫報告，但最近的環境僅評分結果。為了應對穩定訓練中的挑戰，我們提出了VERA，它能夠大規模構建這樣的環境並讓代理在其上演變。VERA從初始軌跡構建這些環境：代理撰寫評分標準、可執行檢查，評審驗證每個沙盒，只有通過的沙盒才能進入訓練庫。在這些環境中，VERA在兩個更新之間交替：用評分獎勵訓練模型，或編輯工具技能。我們還創建了一個驗證器，使用明確的開發集接受標準來控制模型檢查點和工具編輯。這一歸因使VERA的共同演變與單軸基準區分開來：其更新不僅針對原因，還針對結果。擁有超過9,000個長期可驗證環境的開源語料庫，與其共同演變的代理配對的9B模型在兩個領域中超過了最強基準10.3和13.0分。在27B時，它在AutoCoWorkBench (71.6) 和AutoMedBench (80.7)上超過了基準，能夠轉移到未見的工作流程，並保持一般能力。

docs.title: Non-invasive Seizure Detection Using Wearable Wrist-worn Accelerometry and Deep Learning
docs.text:
2610.05919v1 by Nilushika Udayangani Hewa Dehigahawattage, Kishor Nandakishor, Marimuthu Palaniswami

Seizure monitoring and detection are crucial for reducing the morbidity and mortality associated with seizures. Current epilepsy care, often involving expensive video-electroencephalography (VEEG) monitoring, requires specialized expertise and is limited to in-hospital settings, and intrusive in nature. Seizure diaries, on the other hand, suffer from unreliability due to under-reporting, leading to incorrect therapeutic decisions. Wearable non-invasive seizure detection may offer a more tolerable and feasible solution for long-term ambulatory monitoring. This study explores a wearable remote monitoring system utilizing a single wrist-worn accelerometer device and capable of detecting multiple types of seizures, including shorter duration events. We enrolled 79 patients under video-electroencephalography monitoring to wear accelerometer devices and collect data. Concurrent VEEG recordings were reviewed by board-certified epileptologists to produce annotations, including seizure onset, offset, and seizure type. Using this data, we constructed a deep neural network based on the time-series ResNet architecture, which could discriminate among seizure and non-seizure events. Our proposed approach achieved a seizure detection sensitivity of 95.65% and an overall false alarm rate of 0.15/24 hours during the evaluation, which spanned 5576 hours of total recording. Additionally, it resulted in an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.98 and an area under the precision-re call curve (AUC-PRC) of 0.67 when averaged over 20 patients who experienced 46 convulsive seizures. These promising results suggest that the proposed seizure detection system can be effectively used for long-term ambulatory seizure monitoring. Future steps include validating our findings in larger datasets and assessing the utility of detection for additional seizure types.

摘要：癲癇監測和檢測對於減少與癲癇發作相關的發病率和死亡率至關重要。當前的癲癇護理通常涉及昂貴的視頻腦電圖（VEEG）監測，這需要專業的專家，並且僅限於住院環境，且具有侵入性。另一方面，癲癇日記因為報告不足而存在不可靠的問題，導致不正確的治療決策。可穿戴的非侵入性癲癇檢測可能提供一種更可接受和可行的長期門診監測解決方案。本研究探討了一種可穿戴的遠程監測系統，利用單個手腕佩戴的加速度計設備，能夠檢測多種類型的癲癇發作，包括較短持續時間的事件。我們招募了79名接受視頻腦電圖監測的患者佩戴加速度計設備並收集數據。並行的VEEG記錄由經董事會認證的癲癇專家審查，以生成註釋，包括癲癇發作的開始、結束和類型。利用這些數據，我們構建了一個基於時間序列ResNet架構的深度神經網絡，能夠區分癲癇發作和非癲癇發作事件。我們提出的方法在評估期間達到了95.65%的癲癇檢測敏感性，並且整體虛報率為0.15/24小時，該評估涵蓋了5576小時的總錄音。此外，對於經歷46次癲癇發作的20名患者，該系統在接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUC-ROC）上達到了0.98，在精確度-召回曲線下面積（AUC-PRC）上達到了0.67。這些令人鼓舞的結果表明，所提出的癲癇檢測系統可以有效用於長期門診癲癇監測。未來的步驟包括在更大數據集上驗證我們的發現，並評估檢測對其他癲癇類型的實用性。

docs.title: CCQ: A Multi-State Child Care Quality Dataset to Support AI for Children's Health Research
docs.text:
2610.05863v1 by Victor Li, Yuzhang Xie, Ziwei Dong, Qingyang Zhu, Wenjing Ma, Carl Yang, Jinbing Bai, Huiwen Xu, Jiaying Lu

High-quality child care in early life is a critical determinant of children's growth and development. Research on child care quality has been constrained by fragmented, non-research-friendly, and privacy-bound datasets. We present CCQ (Child Care Quality), a large-scale, de-identified dataset for applied data science research at the intersection of AI and early childhood health. CCQ integrates 59,372 child care provider records across 12 U.S. states, covering diverse provider types as well as data schemas. To ensure research utility while protecting privacy, we implement an automated, LLM-based curation pipeline that anonymizes, cleans, and standardizes raw state records into two complementary releases: a cleaned textual release and a fully preprocessed tabular release. We also benchmark traditional machine learning models, tabular foundation models, and language models on quality rating prediction and important features analytics. Within a state, tabular classifiers on the preprocessed tables perform best. Across states, zero-shot transfer is near chance, but modest target-state supervision recovers most of the within-state performance, and pretraining on other states benefits finetuned language models. We release both datasets with all code to accelerate AI-driven research on child care quality and ultimately improve children's health and development.

摘要：高品質的早期兒童照護是兒童成長和發展的重要決定因素。對於兒童照護質量的研究受到碎片化、非研究友好和隱私限制數據集的制約。我們提出了CCQ（兒童照護質量），這是一個大型的去識別化數據集，用於AI與早期兒童健康交叉領域的應用數據科學研究。CCQ整合了來自美國12個州的59,372條兒童照護提供者記錄，涵蓋了多樣的提供者類型以及數據架構。為了確保研究的實用性並保護隱私，我們實施了一個自動化的基於LLM的策展管道，將原始州記錄匿名化、清理和標準化為兩個互補的版本：一個是清理過的文本版本，另一個是完全預處理的表格版本。我們還對傳統機器學習模型、表格基礎模型和語言模型在質量評分預測和重要特徵分析上進行了基準測試。在一個州內，預處理表格上的表格分類器表現最佳。在各州之間，零-shot轉移接近隨機，但適度的目標州監督恢復了大部分州內性能，而在其他州的預訓練有助於微調的語言模型。我們釋放了這兩個數據集及所有代碼，以加速基於AI的兒童照護質量研究，最終改善兒童的健康和發展。

docs.title: LifeLong Digital Twin: A Unified Modeling Paradigm and Agent Harness for Event-Driven Lifelong Health State Trajectories
docs.text:
2610.05566v1 by Jin Jiang, Sean Yates, Jasper Chong, Raymond Brooks, Alex Lawson, Yuqin Qin, Liangcai Gao

Human health is a continuous, dynamic trajectory shaped by the cumulative interplay of biological processes, clinical events, behaviors and environmental exposures across the life course. Unifying the full breadth of lifelong health information, including longitudinal records, genetic variation, molecular profiles and environmental histories, is essential for whole-person modeling and remains a major challenge. We introduce LifeLong Digital Twin, a unified, event-driven modeling paradigm that organizes Life Events into daily Health States and accumulates them into Lifelong Health Context. An accompanying Agent Harness incorporates multimodal evidence beyond the language model's textual context. We evaluate four language models across 25 disease endpoints on three tasks: Disease Trajectory Forecasting, Disease Risk Ranking and Multi-horizon Disease Prediction. The approach yields marked gains over the reference condition: model-averaged F1 increases by 22.0% for disease identification in trajectory forecasting and 18.3% for five-year disease outcomes; thyroid-disease F1 reaches 0.669. The framework provides a foundation for whole-person digital twins and research on personalized lifelong disease prevention.

摘要：人類健康是一個持續的、動態的軌跡，受到生物過程、臨床事件、行為和環境暴露在生命過程中累積交互作用的影響。統一整個生命健康信息的全貌，包括縱向記錄、遺傳變異、分子特徵和環境歷史，對於整體人模型至關重要，並且仍然是一個主要挑戰。我們介紹了 LifeLong Digital Twin，一種統一的、事件驅動的建模範式，將生命事件組織成每日健康狀態，並將其累積成終身健康背景。隨附的 Agent Harness 包含超越語言模型文本上下文的多模態證據。我們在三個任務上評估了四種語言模型，涵蓋 25 種疾病終點：疾病軌跡預測、疾病風險排名和多時間範圍疾病預測。該方法在參考條件下產生了顯著的增益：在軌跡預測中，疾病識別的模型平均 F1 提高了 22.0%，五年疾病結果提高了 18.3%；甲狀腺疾病的 F1 達到 0.669。該框架為整體人數位雙胞胎和個性化終身疾病預防研究提供了基礎。

docs.title: A Strong Baseline for Evaluating Vision Encoders in Multimodal Large Language Models
docs.text:
2610.05413v1 by Yilin Yang, Jun-Tao Tang, Kengyi Wang, Siyuan Su, Gaoyong Luo, Mingda Chen

Evaluating vision encoders requires metrics that reliably predict their downstream performance in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Although recent studies have shown that cross-modal metrics can better capture such performance, unimodal metrics remain the dominant choice in practice. In this work, we revisit cross-modal evaluation of vision encoders through large-scale experiments. We identify important limitations in both the experimental design and methodological formulation of prior approaches. After addressing these limitations and introducing simple improvements, we propose RAVEL, a training-free method based on cross-modal nearest-neighbor retrieval. Despite its simplicity, RAVEL achieves state-of-the-art performance across our experiments, outperforming prior methods by a substantial margin. Our results demonstrate that simple cross-modal metrics, when evaluated under a careful and comprehensive setup, can provide a strong basis for evaluating vision encoders for MLLMs.

摘要：評估視覺編碼器需要能可靠預測其在多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）中的下游表現的指標。儘管最近的研究顯示跨模態指標能更好地捕捉這種表現，但單模態指標在實踐中仍然是主流選擇。在本研究中，我們通過大規模實驗重新檢視視覺編碼器的跨模態評估。我們識別出先前方法在實驗設計和方法論制定上的重要限制。在解決這些限制並引入簡單改進後，我們提出了RAVEL，一種基於跨模態最近鄰檢索的無需訓練的方法。儘管其簡單，RAVEL在我們的實驗中達到了最先進的表現，顯著超越了先前的方法。我們的結果顯示，當在仔細且全面的設置下評估時，簡單的跨模態指標可以為評估MLLMs的視覺編碼器提供堅實的基礎。

docs.title: BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series
docs.text:
2610.05409v1 by Yue Li, Kangqi Ni, Zhen Tan, Tianlong Chen

Action-conditioned time-series forecasting requires accounting for how future actions and exogenous forcings influence multiple targets through partially observed effects with different delays and persistence. Direct conditioning leaves the evolution and target-specific influence of these effects implicit in the predictor, while static relational graphs specify connections without tracking evolving effects. This motivates representing future-driver influence through structured latent states that evolve over the forecast horizon and route information to individual targets. We introduce BeliefGraph-JEPA, a structured latent world model that factorizes driver influence into typed latent-effect states. These states are rolled forward under future drivers and routed through a graph to target-specific nodes, forming the predictive base of a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A capacity-controlled residual supplements this base with direct driver information. On four multi-target clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial systems, the framework outperforms a range of pretrained and supervised known-future-covariate baselines. Matched controls isolate latent dynamics, future rollout, graph routing, and residual capacity; future rollout and graph-first residual routing improve forecasting across all four systems.

摘要：行動條件的時間序列預測需要考慮未來行動和外生驅動如何通過部分觀察的效果影響多個目標，這些效果具有不同的延遲和持續性。直接條件化使這些效果的演變和目標特定影響在預測器中隱含，而靜態關係圖則在不追蹤演變效果的情況下指定連接。這促使我們通過結構化的潛在狀態來表示未來驅動的影響，這些潛在狀態在預測範圍內演變並將信息路由到個別目標。我們引入了BeliefGraph-JEPA，一種結構化的潛在世界模型，將驅動影響分解為類型化的潛在效果狀態。這些狀態在未來驅動下向前推進，並通過圖路由到目標特定的節點，形成聯合嵌入預測架構的預測基礎。一個容量控制的殘差補充了這一基礎，提供直接的驅動信息。在四個多目標的臨床、農業、環境和工業系統上，該框架超越了一系列預訓練和監督的已知未來協變基準。匹配控制隔離了潛在動態、未來展開、圖路由和殘差容量；未來展開和圖優先的殘差路由在所有四個系統中改善了預測。

docs.title: Same Predictions, Different Harms: Causal Auditing of Patient World Models
docs.text:
2610.05198v1 by Yicheng Qi, Xiyi Xiong

Patient world models used for clinical trial simulation can agree on transition kernels and arm-specific risks, yet disagree on the fraction of patients harmed by switching treatment---the counterfactual quantity that matters for intervention-aware reasoning. We audit this reliability gap in a two-stage shared-response SCM: a categorical intermediate health state is followed by common terminal care. Under independent stages, the sharp harm interval has closed-form endpoints for at most three intermediate states, with an exactness boundary at four states. Declared dependence and response-mismatch budgets yield calibrated outer bounds when stage independence or complete mediation is relaxed; in a symmetric three-state model the entire sensitivity frontier is sharp, $[0,\min{1/2,1/3+(ρ+δ)/2}]$, and shows exactly how budgets erase the gain over endpoint-only bounds. Two eight-variable response LPs propagate interventional uncertainty for finite-sample audits. Exact witnesses verify attainability. On public clinical simulators (EpiCare; sepsis), native configurations show little resolved stage dependence and no additional joint-compatibility gain over pairwise transport---honest negative results for reliability claims. All experiments are locally reproducible; guarantees remain conditional on the stated causal model. The results provide a concrete protocol for deciding when a patient world model is safe to trust for counterfactual harm.

摘要：病人世界模型在臨床試驗模擬中可以就轉換核和特定臂的風險達成一致，但對於因轉換治療而受到傷害的病人比例卻存在分歧——這是對於介入意識推理而言重要的反事實數量。我們在一個兩階段的共享反應結構模型中審核這一可靠性差距：一個類別性的中間健康狀態之後是共同的終端護理。在獨立階段下，尖銳的傷害區間對於最多三個中間狀態具有封閉形式的端點，四個狀態則有一個精確度邊界。宣告的依賴性和反應不匹配預算在放寬階段獨立性或完全中介時產生經過校準的外部界限；在對稱的三狀態模型中，整個敏感性邊界是尖銳的，$[0,\min{1/2,1/3+(ρ+δ)/2}]$，並且準確顯示了預算如何抹去相對於僅端點界限的增益。兩個八變量反應線性規劃推進介入不確定性以進行有限樣本審核。精確的見證者驗證了可達性。在公共臨床模擬器（EpiCare；敗血症）上，本地配置顯示出很少的解決階段依賴性，並且對於成對傳輸沒有額外的聯合相容性增益——這對於可靠性聲明來說是誠實的負面結果。所有實驗都是局部可重複的；保證仍然依賴於所述的因果模型。這些結果提供了一個具體的協議，用於決定何時可以安全地信任病人世界模型以進行反事實傷害的推斷。

docs.title: Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning for the Retrieval of Immunotherapy-Associated Molecular Signatures from Histopathology
docs.text:
2610.05157v1 by Sigrid Vila-Bagaria, Mar Teixidó, Miquel Piñol, Felip Vilardell, Robert Montal, Veronica Vilaplana

Gastric Adenocarcinoma is a leading cause of cancer mortality. Although "Inflamed/Non-Inflamed" subtypes have been proposed to predict immunotherapy response, their identification relies on a costly 10-gene RNA signature. We propose a Cross-modal Contrastive Multiple Instance Learning (CCMIL) framework for cross-modal retrieval, imputing these molecular signatures directly from standard Hematoxylin & Eosin (H&E) slides. By leveraging a supervised contrastive objective, CCMIL aligns visual morphological patterns with molecular phenotypes into a shared latent space. This establishes an interpretable search-by-case retrieval engine, enabling pathologists to query a whole slide image to surface transcriptomically coherent neighbors and approximate RNA signatures without genomic sequencing at inference. Our results demonstrate that this retrieval-first approach captures the continuous phenotypic spectrum of tumor inflammation and yields clinically interpretable attention heatmaps. Furthermore, the learned representation also supports competitive downstream classification, providing a practical molecular pre-screening strategy.

摘要：胃腺癌是癌症死亡的主要原因。雖然已提出「發炎/非發炎」亞型以預測免疫療法的反應，但其識別依賴於昂貴的10基因RNA特徵。我們提出了一個跨模態對比多實例學習（CCMIL）框架，用於跨模態檢索，直接從標準的蘇木精-伊紅（H&E）切片中推斷這些分子特徵。通過利用監督對比目標，CCMIL將視覺形態模式與分子表型對齊到共享的潛在空間中。這建立了一個可解釋的按案例檢索引擎，使病理學家能夠查詢整個切片圖像，以顯示轉錄組學上相干的鄰近樣本並在推理時近似RNA特徵，而無需基因組測序。我們的結果表明，這種檢索優先的方法捕捉了腫瘤發炎的連續表型光譜，並產生臨床可解釋的注意力熱圖。此外，學習到的表示還支持具有競爭力的下游分類，提供了一種實用的分子預篩選策略。

docs.title: AutoSciBench: Autonomous Benchmark Generation for Evaluating Scientific Agents
docs.text:
2610.05140v1 by Dongki Kim, Namkyeong Lee, Surag Nair, Carl Edwards, Xiner Li, Edward De Brouwer, Jenna Lynn Collier, Sung Ju Hwang, Gabriele Scalia, Ehsan Hajiramezanali

As agents rapidly evolve, existing benchmarks can become saturated, limiting their ability to distinguish capabilities and reveal remaining failure modes. Particularly in scientific domains, constructing and updating benchmarks requires substantial time, labor, and domain expertise, making it difficult to keep evaluation aligned with advances in agent capabilities. We address this challenge by investigating whether scientific-agent benchmarks can be automatically generated and iteratively adapted as agent capabilities evolve. We introduce AutoSciBench, a framework that represents each task as a high-level concept specifying the scientific domain, data modality, and required reasoning approach, together with a low-level recipe specifying how the question, environment, and ground-truth answer are constructed and verified. Agents attempt to solve each task, producing solver trajectories and corresponding judge feedback which AutoSciBench uses to revise the recipe or concept, closing observed shortcuts and shifting tasks toward raw-data re-examination, interpretation of intermediate results, and evidence integration. Experience distilled from completed refinement trajectories further guides new concept generation, allowing lessons from earlier task refinement to inform subsequent benchmark construction. Starting from existing benchmarks, we evaluate AutoSciBench across computational biology, materials science, and clinical imaging. Generated benchmarks reduce average solver accuracy by 22.4 and 25.5 percentage points relative to the human-curated benchmarks in computational biology and materials science, respectively, while generated tasks receive higher average quality ratings across all three domains, suggesting that scientific-agent evaluation can adapt as agent capabilities advance.

摘要：隨著代理的快速演變，現有的基準可能會變得飽和，限制其區分能力和揭示剩餘失敗模式的能力。尤其在科學領域，構建和更新基準需要大量的時間、勞力和領域專業知識，這使得評估難以與代理能力的進步保持一致。我們通過研究科學代理基準是否可以自動生成並隨著代理能力的演變進行迭代調整來解決這一挑戰。我們介紹了AutoSciBench，一個將每個任務表示為高級概念的框架，該概念指定了科學領域、數據模態和所需的推理方法，並附有一個低級配方，指定如何構建和驗證問題、環境和真實答案。代理嘗試解決每個任務，產生求解者軌跡和相應的評判反饋，AutoSciBench利用這些信息來修訂配方或概念，關閉觀察到的捷徑，並將任務轉向原始數據的重新檢查、中間結果的解釋和證據整合。從完成的精煉軌跡中提煉的經驗進一步指導新的概念生成，使得早期任務精煉的經驗能夠為後續基準構建提供參考。從現有基準開始，我們在計算生物學、材料科學和臨床影像學中評估AutoSciBench。生成的基準在計算生物學和材料科學中，分別將平均求解者準確率降低了22.4和25.5個百分點，相較於人工策劃的基準，而生成的任務在所有三個領域中獲得了更高的平均質量評分，這表明科學代理評估可以隨著代理能力的進步而調整。

docs.title: LogSig-SSM: Time-Series Modelling with Multi-Scale Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models
docs.text:
2610.05051v1 by Felix Oury, Nicolas Calvo Peiro, Reiko J. Tanaka

Time-series data are often sampled irregularly at high frequencies and exhibit long-range dependencies, which makes long-horizon modelling difficult. Continuous-time models such as neural controlled differential equations (NCDEs) and neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) can handle irregular sampling, but they scale poorly to long sequences. Selective state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba scale linearly with sequence length, but they provide limited recurrent mixing across hidden dimensions within a single block. We propose LogSig-SSM (Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models), which first compresses long multivariate time series into a shorter sequence of tokens using multi-scale windowed log-signatures, and then processes these tokens with a selective SSM backbone. LogSig-SSM is scalable and robust to irregular sampling, combining log-signature tokens that capture higher-order cross-channel interactions with a selective SSM that models long-range dependencies. The model also admits a continuous-time interpretation as an NCDE/NRDE-style system driven by a log-signature-based input, in which selectivity induces an input-dependent rescaling of the latent dynamics. Across four benchmarks, namely long-sequence classification on UEA, high-frequency physiological regression on PPG-DaLiA, multivariate weather forecasting, and irregularly sampled clinical prediction on PhysioNet Sepsis, LogSig-SSM outperforms or matches strong SSM and continuous-time baselines while training up to $30\times$ faster and using up to $37\times$ less GPU memory than Mamba on the longest sequences.

摘要：時間序列數據通常在高頻率下不規則地採樣，並且表現出長期依賴性，這使得長期建模變得困難。連續時間模型如神經控制微分方程（NCDEs）和神經粗微分方程（NRDEs）能夠處理不規則採樣，但對於長序列的擴展性較差。選擇性狀態空間模型（SSMs）如Mamba在序列長度上呈線性擴展，但在單個區塊內提供的隱藏維度間的重複混合有限。我們提出了LogSig-SSM（狀態空間模型的對數簽名壓縮），該模型首先使用多尺度窗口對數簽名將長多變量時間序列壓縮為較短的標記序列，然後用選擇性SSM主幹處理這些標記。LogSig-SSM具有可擴展性，並且對不規則採樣具有魯棒性，結合了捕捉高階跨通道互動的對數簽名標記和建模長期依賴性的選擇性SSM。該模型還允許以NCDE/NRDE風格系統的連續時間解釋，該系統由基於對數簽名的輸入驅動，其中選擇性引起潛在動態的輸入依賴性重縮放。在四個基準測試中，即UEA的長序列分類、PPG-DaLiA的高頻生理回歸、多變量天氣預測以及PhysioNet Sepsis的不規則採樣臨床預測，LogSig-SSM的表現超過或匹配強大的SSM和連續時間基準，同時在最長序列上訓練速度快達$30\times$，並且使用的GPU內存比Mamba少達$37\times$。

docs.title: Invisible Ink, Visible Lies: How Production Watermarking Causes LLMs to Hallucinate
docs.text:
2610.04860v1 by Haocheng Ye, Aoting Hu, Xinwei Zhang, Xunzhu Tang, Shuchao Pang, Jason Xue

Text watermarking helps identify AI-generated content, but its effect on factual reliability remains underexplored. In this paper, we study watermarking hallucination: factual errors induced or amplified by watermarking even when the required evidence is present in the context and the unwatermarked model can answer correctly. Using a controlled retrieval-augmented generation setting, we compare unwatermarked and watermarked generations under the same context, query, and decoding configuration, and quantify their factual accuracy decrease.
