docs.title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
docs.text:
2610.12407v1 by Shashank Hegde, Alexander Popov, Elie Aljalbout, Nikolai Smolyanskiy

World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.

摘要：世界行動模型（WAMs）預測行動和未來觀察，通常基於重建的表示，這種表示承載著嘈雜的、冗餘的信息，可能會使下游預測變得複雜。我們介紹LeWAM，一種雙向Transformer，用於前向、後向、逆動力學和政策預測，這是一個無解碼器的JEPA潛在模型，通過所有四種模式端到端訓練。我們看到以下好處：1）對齊：線性探針從LeWAM的潛在中讀取機器人和物體狀態的效果優於從常規的Le世界模型（僅前向的JEPA世界模型），而且潛在忽略了視覺干擾者，與LeWM一樣，且遠優於基於重建的WAM。2）行動：LeWAM的閉環評估與在相同編碼器上以匹配大小訓練的常規流匹配政策相匹配，同時也提供了一個世界模型。3）規劃：在使用WAMs進行規劃時採樣原始行動，讓MPC利用動力學模型的不準確性；而在政策頭的噪音空間中進行規劃則改善了這些WAM的閉環性能。

docs.title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
docs.text:
2610.12403v1 by Hongxing Li, Dingming Li, Yixin Li, Yong Du, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen

Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.

摘要：技能增強代理透過將成功的軌跡提煉成可重用的策略來提高樣本效率。然而，大多數現有的方法仍然以文本為中心，將空間佈局和動作-狀態對應線性化為失去關鍵幾何結構的語言。最近的努力已開始納入視覺證據，但將技能的構建和更新與政策優化分開，導致它們的相互改進尚未得到充分探索。我們提出了ViSkill，一個視覺原生的技能學習框架，將成功的互動編碼為可直接被VLM代理訪問的複合視覺技能卡。檢索到的技能指導推理和獎勵塑形，而成功的軌跡則被提煉回庫中，形成一個封閉的反饋循環，在這個循環中，技能積累和政策改進相互增強。一個可選的冷啟動機制進一步加速早期學習。在Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上進行評估，ViSkill的整體成功率達到0.89，冷啟動初始化後上升至0.91，超越了所有評估的專有和開源基準，同時收斂速度快於標準PPO。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill獲得。

docs.title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
docs.text:
2610.12402v1 by Hongxing Li, Jinyue Su, Dingming Li, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen

Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

摘要：現有的空間推理基準主要測試空間感知：從已在輸入中可見的關係中讀取信息。然實際世界的空間智慧需求預測性空間推理：從觀察中構建場景，預測干預如何改變它，並推理未見的結果。我們介紹了 SpaceCast-Bench，這是第一個直接且診斷性地評估這種能力的基準。它基於觀察-轉換-推斷框架，包含來自182個現實世界場景的3,862個問題，涵蓋三個層級的16種任務類型：靜態感知、本地預測和全局預測，逐步要求場景理解、空間狀態更新和對未觀察結果的關係推理。對21個模型的評估揭示了明顯的差距：最強的模型僅達到58.0%，而人類表現為87.2%，而專注於空間的模型則接近隨機機會。受控分析進一步顯示，橋接視圖對整合分佈式觀察至關重要，並且明確的3D證據比生成的結果圖像或視頻更可靠地惠及模型。在我們程序生成的數據上進行微調，將 Qwen3-VL-4B 從34.0%提升至65.7%，在六個域外基準上獲得宏觀平均增益。

docs.title: HRIL: Learning Multimodal Synergy via Higher-Order Tensor Modeling
docs.text:
2610.12393v1 by Qun Dai, Liangjian Wen, Jiang Duan, Yong Dai, Dongkai Wang, Maolin Wang, Mingjie Wang, Jianzhuang Liu, He Yan, Zhao Kang

Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. Code is released at https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL.

摘要：自我監督的多模態表示學習在各個領域取得了顯著的成功，但由於跨模態互動的複雜性，捕捉協同信息仍然具有挑戰性。與各個模態之間共享的信息不同，協同效應出現在與任務相關的信號僅從多個模態的聯合配置中產生，而無法從任何單一模態中獨立恢復。這項工作專注於如何在多模態表示中保留這種協同信號的信息容量。關鍵觀察是，協同信息體現在模態之間的高階統計依賴性中，這為明確建模聯合互動提供了一個原則性的目標。受到這一見解的啟發，我們提出了高階表示與信息學習（HRIL），該方法構建了一個基於模態嵌入的實證交叉矩量張量，以表示多向互動。HRIL採用塔克分解來獲取核心張量，並輔以一個考慮協同效應的正則化器，以防止能量集中並保留高階耦合能力，以捕捉協同信息。在受控協同任務和現實世界基準上的實驗顯示，與現有的多模態對比方法相比，HRIL在協同互動主導的任務上取得了顯著的改進。代碼已在 https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL 上發布。

docs.title: GeoReform: Reflective Formalization Evolution for Multimodal Geometry Problem Solving
docs.text:
2610.12391v1 by Jialu Wang, Ruichen Zhang, Xiaoou Liu, Hua Wei, Tianlong Chen

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to identify and use geometric relations in diagrams. Recent methods address this challenge by converting geometric entities, relations, and constraints into explicit textual representations for the model to reason over. However, effective formalization is highly non-trivial: on Geometry3K, structure injection fixes 28 errors but introduces 13 new ones among 200 examples. Redundant relations can distract the model, while ambiguous references to diagram elements can lead it to apply constraints incorrectly. This suggests that the key challenge is not merely extracting more geometric facts, but organizing them into representations that support downstream reasoning. To fully exploit the power of formalization, we further propose GeoReform, a reflective formalization evolution framework that treats formalization as an optimizable policy rather than a fixed parser output. GeoReform executes the full reasoning pipeline, collects failed rollouts, diagnoses defects in the current representation, and mutates the policy to better select, ground, group, and present geometric entities, relations, constraints, and targets. On Geometry3K, GeoReform improves Qwen3VL-2B accuracy from 42.0\% to 56.0\%. Extensive experiments and analyses across geometry reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that effective formalization is crucial for improving multimodal geometry reasoning.

摘要：多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在識別和使用圖表中的幾何關係方面經常遇到困難。最近的方法通過將幾何實體、關係和約束轉換為明確的文本表示來解決這一挑戰，以便模型進行推理。然而，有效的形式化是非常不簡單的：在Geometry3K上，結構注入修正了28個錯誤，但在200個示例中引入了13個新錯誤。冗餘的關係可能會分散模型的注意力，而對圖表元素的模糊引用可能會導致它錯誤地應用約束。這表明，關鍵挑戰不僅僅是提取更多的幾何事實，而是將它們組織成支持下游推理的表示。為了充分利用形式化的力量，我們進一步提出了GeoReform，一個反思性形式化演變框架，將形式化視為可優化的策略，而不是固定的解析器輸出。GeoReform執行完整的推理管道，收集失敗的展開，診斷當前表示中的缺陷，並變異策略以更好地選擇、基礎、分組和呈現幾何實體、關係、約束和目標。在Geometry3K上，GeoReform將Qwen3VL-2B的準確率從42.0\%提高到56.0\%。在幾何推理基準上的廣泛實驗和分析表明，有效的形式化對於改善多模態幾何推理至關重要。

docs.title: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search
docs.text:
2610.12390v1 by Ziming Dai, Dabiao Ma, Ziheng Guo, Jack Dong, Zimu Zhou

Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.

摘要：工業風險控制系統通常依賴結構化數據模型來進行高效預測，但大量有價值的信息仍然嵌入在非結構化的長文本中。通過手動特徵工程提取這些信息是勞動密集型的，而要求大型語言模型（LLM）處理每個實時輸入可能無法滿足實際部署要求。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了LLM-BlockFE，一種LLM引導的離線特徵構建框架，將長文本轉換為可執行的特徵程序，從而避免在在線推理過程中調用LLM。LLM-BlockFE通過逐步附加不可變代碼塊來構建特徵程序，並使用下游模型評估候選特徵。為了解決傳統貪婪搜索容易陷入次優解的傾向，我們的方法引入了一種基於深度校準信貸分配的區塊級回滾機制，並以交錯的方式推進多條獨立的搜索軌跡，通過共享每條軌跡探索方向的固定描述來減少冗餘探索。搜索結束後，生成的程序被凍結並部署以提取結構化特徵供下游預測模型使用。在兩個公共數據集和兩個私有數據集中，LLM-BlockFE在每個數據集的全數據集比較中，相對於最強基線實現了0.0069到0.0358的絕對AUC提升。五個已部署的金融風險控制應用的上線後監控顯示，相對於現有的手動設計策略，絕對KS提升了0.02到1.56個百分點。

docs.title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
docs.text:
2610.12386v1 by Gokul Puthumanaillam, Tao Sun, Elie Aljalbout, Moritz Reuss, Zhaoshuo Li, Fabio Ramos, Ankit Goyal, Jenai Xuning Yang

The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

摘要：目前改善機器人基礎模型（RFM）的主流方法依賴於更大的模型、更多的機器人示範以及昂貴的大規模訓練。我們展示了一種有效且高效的互補方法：正確的推理配方可以顯著提高現有最先進RFM的零次任務表現。我們將這個配方稱為ARC。它由三個關鍵成分組成：推理痕跡、一個可擴展的自動標記管道，以及一種將預訓練RFM適應以使用這些痕跡進行控制的策略。首先，我們發現有效的推理痕跡應該基於機器人的下一個行動並解釋其因果結構：為什麼這個行動是合適的以及它應該產生什麼效果。其次，我們展示這些痕跡可以從現有的示範中自動生成，使我們能夠從DROID構建ARC-Trace-DROID，而無需收集新的機器人數據。第三，我們展示了最先進的VLA（視覺語言模型）如$π_{0.5}$和WAM（行為模型）如Cosmos3-Nano-Policy如何學會使用這些痕跡進行控制，並根據每個模型的架構和能力進行微調和推理。使用ARC，我們在零次RFM表現上獲得了前所未有的增益，據我們所知，這些增益是在沒有額外機器人示範或基礎規模訓練的情況下取得的。經過適應的模型在RoboLab-120和MolmoSpaces上建立了新的最先進紀錄，在RoboLab-Reasoning-50上獲得了高達50個百分點的增益。在真實機器人上，ARC使得$π_{0.5}$的任務成功率提高了82.2個百分點。項目網站：https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

docs.title: Latent Core Tokenizer: Compress, but Meaningfully
docs.text:
2610.12376v1 by Felermino D. M. A. Ali, Millicent Ochieng, Ogbemi Ekwejunor-Etchie, Ade Famoti, Jacki O'Neill, Debjit Paul

Tokenizers are commonly optimized for compression, but a compact vocabulary does not necessarily distribute its capacity evenly across languages. We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), a language-agnostic approach that separates structural discovery from vocabulary construction. LCT uses Minimum Description Length, entropy-based boundary signals, and morphotactic constraints to identify reusable linguistic units before constructing a shared vocabulary. Across 104 languages with a 200K-token vocabulary, LCT achieves lower fertility and higher MorphScore than BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, while maintaining comparable cross-lingual disparity in tokenization cost. Across four multilingual downstream benchmarks, LCT improves aggregate score by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, respectively. Our findings show that compression alone does not predict representation quality and highlight the importance of morphology-driven structural discovery and how frequency is used to allocate the final vocabulary across languages.

摘要：Tokenizers 通常是針對壓縮進行優化的，但緊湊的詞彙表並不一定在各種語言之間均勻分配其容量。我們介紹了潛在核心分詞器（Latent Core Tokenizer, LCT），這是一種與語言無關的方法，將結構發現與詞彙構建分開。LCT 使用最小描述長度、基於熵的邊界信號和形態約束來識別可重用的語言單元，然後再構建共享的詞彙表。在 104 種語言中，使用 200K-token 的詞彙表，LCT 在生育率上表現得比 BPE、Unigram 和考慮平衡的 BPE 更低，並且在 MorphScore 上更高，同時在分詞成本的跨語言差異上保持可比性。在四個多語言的下游基準測試中，LCT 分別比 BPE、Unigram 和考慮平衡的 BPE 提高了 1.48、1.83 和 2.00 分的總分。我們的研究結果顯示，僅僅依賴壓縮無法預測表示質量，並強調了形態驅動的結構發現的重要性，以及如何使用頻率來在各種語言之間分配最終的詞彙表。

docs.title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
docs.text:
2610.12375v1 by Babak Barazandeh, Connor Swanson, Chinmay Kulkarni, Nikhil Mungel

Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).

摘要：代理人被應用於從旅行規劃和股票交易到 IT 事件分流的各種應用中。 在大多數情況下，LLM 代理人獨立運作，僅有最小的基於規則的保護措施，這導致了不可逆轉行動所帶來的成本和安全問題。 最近的研究通過使用保護代理來監控行為或事後評估日誌來解決這一問題。 第一種方法為每一步增加了成本和延遲；第二種方法在執行後給出判決，當時代幣已經被消耗，損害已經造成。 為了克服這一問題，我們提出了 OnTrack，一種流式監控機制，通過將代理的步驟和依賴與記錄的成功運行進行比較，來在每步約一毫秒內提醒用戶或阻止代理。 我們在三種不同的訪問範疇中研究這個問題：完全參考訪問（歷史運行和工具架構）、中等訪問（僅工具架構）和無先前知識（僅生成的步驟日誌）。 隨著數據訪問的減少，OnTrack 監控能力的期望值也隨之降低，範圍從計劃違規檢測到識別循環、停滯和重複的工具調用。 最後，我們使用 SWE-bench 軌跡評估 OnTrack。 根據前 8 步，我們的方法將失敗的軌跡排名低於成功的軌跡，優於內容相似性方法（+0.057 AUROC）。 通過中止政策，我們節省了約 18% 的計算資源，這些資源本來會在失敗的運行中被消耗，其中 83% 的中斷運行實際上是走向失敗的（6 次中止中有 5 次是正確的）。

docs.title: Which Skill to Distill? SGUID: Selecting a Compact Skill Bank for Model-Skill Co-Evolution
docs.text:
2610.12367v1 by Yuhan Liu, Xiyao Ma, Zhongkai Sun, Xu Han, Chengyuan Ma, Benjamin Z. Yao, Chenlei Guo

Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.

摘要：技能、在推理時新增的可重用程序指導，可以顯著提高大型語言模型（LLM）的下游性能（Li et al., 2026）。先前的研究通過語義相關性從技能庫中檢索技能，然後將其用作推理時的修補或模型蒸餾。然而，每個技能的個別效用在很大程度上被忽視。我們首先顯示，在以技能為條件的政策作為教師的政策蒸餾中，檢索到的技能中不到 25% 提供有用的蒸餾信號。我們接著提出 SGUID，一種選擇緊湊技能子集以進行蒸餾的方法。SGUID 只保留在訓練過程中持續產生有效學習信號的技能。然後將選定的技能進行蒸餾，以產生更好的模型。我們的結果顯示，並非所有技能都值得蒸餾。在 Olmo 和 Qwen 兩個家族的四個模型中，蒸餾 6 個選定的技能在四個模型中的三個模型上，在平均 avg@12 的表現上達到了或超過了完整技能庫的蒸餾，而在第二輪蒸餾 3 個新選定技能後，四個模型的表現均有所提升，而完整技能庫的規模則大達 11 倍。重要的是，SGUID 支持穩定的模型-技能共同演化：在一次蒸餾後，從更新的模型的回饋中策劃出一個新的候選技能庫，SGUID 選擇下一步要內化的技能。在第二輪中，這個循環選擇了 3 個新技能，並將 Qwen3-8B 的表現從 64.3% 提高到 66.3%。選擇步驟對於穩定性至關重要：在 Qwen3-4B 上，天真地用未過濾的技能更新模型會降低性能，包括 HMMT25 上的 0.3 個百分點的下降，而 SGUID 在第一輪後將 HMMT25 提高了 0.5 分，在第二輪後提高了 1.1 分。這些結果確定了技能選擇是穩定模型-技能共同演化的關鍵機制。

docs.title: HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing
docs.text:
2610.12363v1 by Xiazhen Wu, Wansong Qin, Yangbin Zheng, Liangda Fang, Zhan Li, Xiujie Huang, Liushen Zhou, Quanlong Guan

Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

摘要：智能評分和自動打分技術構成了智慧教育的關鍵基礎設施。然而，現有的文檔解析和手寫識別基準主要是為了結構良好的印刷文檔或孤立的數學表達式而設計，缺乏能夠捕捉學生答卷固有的複雜特徵的數據集，包括多行推導過程、文本和數學公式的異質混合，以及如刪除線等噪聲伪影。為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了HANS，這是第一個專門為現實教育場景構建的數據集，涵蓋了數學表達式、自然語言文本、手繪表格以及包括修正和刪除在內的多樣噪聲模式，並附有細緻的註釋，為穩健的識別研究建立了可靠的基礎。在HANS的基礎上，我們提出了NA-GOT，一個端到端的框架，通過一個在特徵層面運作的輕量級噪聲抑制模塊實現兩階段的噪聲抑制，並輔以融入解碼階段的噪聲感知注意機制。實驗結果表明，HANS對現有方法提出了重大挑戰，而NA-GOT在答題過程識別的準確性和穩定性方面取得了顯著改善。該數據集將在發表時公開提供。

docs.title: Cited but Not Consulted: A Counterfactual Audit of Legal Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
docs.text:
2610.12361v1 by Saisab Sadhu, Shreeyans Arora, Pratinav Seth

Large language models increasingly justify legal decisions by naming the statute or precedent behind a verdict, treated as evidence that the decision follows from it. We test this directly: holding case facts fixed, we substitute the named legal authority for an unrelated one and decode a model's evolving verdict from its hidden states. Across seven open-weight models (8B-70B) and four benchmarks spanning judicial and contractual reasoning, when explicitly required to justify a verdict by naming the governing authority, models name the correct one in 66.7%-100% of generations, while the verdict changing when the authority changes is far less consistent: 0.0%-21.7% on CaseHOLD, 30.0%-76.7% on ECHR and SCOTUS, and 43.3%-50.0% on ContractNLI. Neither scale nor a purpose-built legal-reasoning model (a best-effort LoRA reproduction; Section 6) closes this gap. A red-teaming evaluation on five core models finds compliance with an adversarial instruction hidden in the case facts (73.3%-96.4%) exceeds verdict-swap sensitivity by a wide margin, holding without exception across model rankings. Naming a legal authority is thus a poor proxy for a verdict's dependence on it, while the same verdict remains separately vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Both findings replicate across checks ruling out prompt-wording noise and confounded sampling, and bear directly on the use of generated legal explanations as compliance or audit artefacts.

摘要：大型語言模型越來越多地通過命名判決背後的法規或先例來為法律決策辯護，這被視為該決策遵循這些依據的證據。我們直接測試這一點：在固定案件事實的情況下，我們將命名的法律權威替換為不相關的權威，並從模型的隱藏狀態解碼其不斷演變的判決。在七個開放權重模型（8B-70B）和四個涵蓋司法和合約推理的基準中，當明確要求通過命名治理權威來為判決辯護時，模型在66.7%-100%的生成中命名正確的權威，而當權威改變時，判決改變的情況則遠不如一致：在CaseHOLD上為0.0%-21.7%，在ECHR和SCOTUS上為30.0%-76.7%，在ContractNLI上為43.3%-50.0%。無論是規模還是專門構建的法律推理模型（最佳努力的LoRA重現；第6節）都無法縮小這一差距。對五個核心模型的紅隊評估發現，對案件事實中隱藏的對抗性指令的遵從性（73.3%-96.4%）遠超過判決交換的敏感性，並在模型排名中毫無例外地保持一致。因此，命名法律權威並不是判決依賴於它的良好代理，而相同的判決仍然容易受到對抗性操縱。這兩個發現通過排除提示措辭噪音和混淆抽樣的檢查得以重複，並直接影響生成的法律解釋作為合規或審計文物的使用。

docs.title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict
docs.text:
2610.12360v1 by Kaiser Sun, Bernal Jimenez Gutierrez, Hongjun Liu, Jingyu Zhang, Jie Gao, Mark Dredze, Daniel Khashabi

When retrieved evidence contradicts an agent's prior beliefs, does it revise its answer, acknowledge uncertainty, or persist with an incorrect conclusion? Existing evaluations of agentic systems focus primarily on task success, offering limited insight into how agents handle such conflicts. We propose to evaluate agents on epistemic humility (EH): the agent's willingness to recognize, act on, and communicate uncertainty during task execution. We operationalize EH through three trajectory-level behavioral dimensions: Identify, Solve, and Escalate (ISE). Through knowledge conflict, situations where the backbone language model's parametric knowledge contradicts the evidence it encounters, or where two contextual sources disagree, we evaluate two conflict settings: (1) controlled conflict and (2) naturally occurring conflict during multi-step agentic execution, each paired with matched no-conflict controls. Evaluating four agents, we find that higher task accuracy does not necessarily correspond to greater epistemic humility: some high-accuracy configurations recognize conflicts during execution but do not communicate unresolved uncertainty in their incorrect final answers. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that agents frequently detect conflicts in early steps of execution but fail to maintain or resolve them in later steps. Finally, we show that model-level interventions can improve EH, but often at the cost of task accuracy, suggesting that epistemic humility emerges from the interaction among the backbone model, agent harness, and evaluation environment.

摘要：當檢索到的證據與代理人的先前信念相矛盾時，代理人會修正其答案、承認不確定性，還是堅持錯誤的結論？現有的代理系統評估主要集中在任務成功上，對於代理人如何處理這種衝突提供的見解有限。我們提議對代理人進行知識謙遜（EH）的評估：代理人在任務執行過程中承認、採取行動並傳達不確定性的意願。我們通過三個軌跡層級行為維度來操作化EH：識別、解決和升級（ISE）。通過知識衝突，即主幹語言模型的參數知識與其所遇到的證據相矛盾的情況，或兩個上下文來源之間存在分歧的情況，我們評估兩種衝突設置：（1）受控衝突和（2）在多步代理執行過程中自然發生的衝突，每種情況都配對相應的無衝突控制。我們評估了四個代理，發現較高的任務準確性不一定對應於更大的知識謙遜：一些高準確性配置在執行過程中識別衝突，但在其不正確的最終答案中不傳達未解決的不確定性。軌跡層級分析進一步顯示，代理人經常在執行的早期步驟中檢測到衝突，但在後期步驟中未能維持或解決這些衝突。最後，我們展示了模型層級的干預可以改善EH，但往往以任務準確性為代價，這表明知識謙遜源於主幹模型、代理工具和評估環境之間的相互作用。

docs.title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
docs.text:
2610.12355v1 by Hongxing Li, Yixin Li, Dingming Li, Zixuan Wang, Yuchen Yan, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Yongliang Shen

Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.

摘要：空間推理仍然是視覺-語言模型（VLMs）的一個持續弱點，因為 RGB 輸入並未直接提供幾何證據。現有的解決方案要麼在推理時將 3D 注入模型，付出架構和延遲的成本，要麼使用僅監督最終答案的結果獎勵進行訓練。空間錯誤源於感知：錯誤判斷的深度或方向只能通過場景的真實幾何來修正，而 3D 掃描的空間訓練語料庫已經提供了這些幾何信息。我們提出了 GPD（幾何特權蒸餾），使幾何證據成為在政策自蒸餾（OPSD）中的特權。對於每個問題，深度、語義和鳥瞰圖（BEV）線索被渲染為緊湊的文本並與參考答案一起路由到教師；一個僅應用於不正確軌跡的特權 KL 增強了 GRPO，且部署的模型仍然僅為 RGB。在 4B 主幹上，GPD 在 VSI-Bench 上達到 57.1，並在 MindCube、SPARBench、MMSI-Bench 和 ViewSpatial 上平均達到 37.6，超越了 GRPO 和答案特權 OPSD 在空間推理基準中的表現。消融實驗確認了 3D 和答案特權的互補性、問題條件路由相對於全上下文注入的優勢，以及將蒸餾限制在不正確軌跡上的好處。

docs.title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
docs.text:
2610.12345v1 by Haohui Wang, Jiahao Xu, Wangzhi Zhan, Tong Zeng, Dongqi Fu, Hong Li, Swastik Roy, Naren Ramakrishnan, Chris North, Jian Kang, Yujun Yan, Dawei Zhou

Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but the required concepts can receive substantially different levels of pretrained support. Frequent concepts are more likely to be well learned, whereas rare concepts may remain weakly represented. We introduce a novel notion named prior barrier to quantify how strongly the pretrained model supports competing concepts over the target concept. We observe that prior barriers follow a long-tail distribution, placing head and tail concepts at different starting points for SFT: head concepts face lower prior barriers, whereas tail concepts require additional instructions to overcome their higher prior barriers. Our theoretical analysis further derives a predictive risk bound for SFT under long-tail prior barriers, explicitly characterizing how the prior barrier and accumulated SFT evidence jointly determine predictive performance. Motivated by this prior barrier-dependent demand, we propose PASS, an adaptive SFT instruction selection method that constructs reference-derived concepts and estimates the distinguishing evidence provided by each instruction, and adaptively allocates the selection budget toward concepts that remain insufficiently covered under the current selection. In this way, PASS jointly considers which instructions can provide useful evidence and where additional supervision is needed under a limited budget. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art instruction selection methods on four backbone-budget settings. An ablation study further shows that PASS's adaptive allocation consistently improves over uniform allocation.

摘要：監督式微調 (SFT) 將預訓練的大型語言模型 (LLMs) 調整至下游任務，但所需的概念可能會獲得實質上不同程度的預訓練支持。頻繁的概念更有可能被良好學習，而稀有的概念可能仍然表現不佳。我們引入了一個新概念，稱為先驗障礙，以量化預訓練模型對目標概念的競爭概念的支持程度。我們觀察到先驗障礙遵循長尾分佈，將頭部和尾部概念置於 SFT 的不同起點：頭部概念面臨較低的先驗障礙，而尾部概念則需要額外的指導來克服其較高的先驗障礙。我們的理論分析進一步推導出在長尾先驗障礙下 SFT 的預測風險界限，明確描述了先驗障礙和累積的 SFT 證據如何共同決定預測性能。受到這一依賴於先驗障礙的需求的啟發，我們提出了 PASS，一種自適應的 SFT 指令選擇方法，該方法構建參考衍生概念並估算每個指令提供的區分證據，並自適應地將選擇預算分配給在當前選擇下仍然不足的概念。這樣，PASS 共同考慮哪些指令可以提供有用的證據，以及在有限預算下需要額外監督的地方。實驗表明，我們的方法在四個基礎預算設置上始終優於七種最先進的指令選擇方法。一項消融研究進一步顯示，PASS 的自適應分配始終優於均勻分配。

docs.title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
docs.text:
2610.12341v1 by Kaisen Yang, Qingle Liu, Kejin Wang, Yicheng Zhao, Jieming Li, Shenghan Zheng, Ruize Yang, Bojun Yang, Heng Gong, Xiang Gao, Lanyue Zhang, Kaiyu Zhong, Zhuo Liu, Shaoxuan Li, Chengxi Li, Yong Yan, Weixuan Zhang, Tianwei Luo, Situ Wang, Youjie Zheng, Sihan Zhao, Shengyuan Wang, Huan-ang Gao, Jiazheng Xu, Xiaohui Xie, Wentao Han, Hongning Wang

Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.

摘要：對抗性遊戲推動了從啟發式搜索到強化學習的進步，但從有限樣本中學習和調整策略仍然具有挑戰性。AI代理提供了一種替代方案，將遊戲經驗轉化為可執行政策的修訂。基於啟發式學習（HL），我們正式定義對抗性啟發式學習（AHL），這是一種使用AI代理作為學習引擎來精煉遊戲政策和支持軟體的範式，同時保持模型權重不變。我們推出了AAArena，一個基準，包括12個真實的對抗性遊戲和1,920個存檔的人類程序，評估協議模擬了現實世界的遊戲競賽。代理解釋規則、選擇對手、分析重播並修訂遊戲代理，以在固定的比賽和評估預算內達到最高排名。我們評估了\val{completedmodels}模型和配置：Opus5.5與Claude Code獲得6枚金牌，而沒有評估的配置超過剩餘的6個人類梯子。在規則規範更複雜的遊戲中，表現通常較弱。進一步的實驗顯示，對手選擇和密集反饋支持政策改進，並且代理從自己比賽的在政策重播和其他玩家比賽的非政策重播中學習。這些結果突顯了HL在對抗性遊戲中的潛力，並確定了遊戲理解、策略實施和長期政策開發中的持續挑戰。

docs.title: VFold: Symmetry-Aware Cross-Layer Value Cache Compression
docs.text:
2610.12338v1 by Neha Verma, Sungwon Kim, Kenton Murray, Kevin Duh

While caching key-value (KV) states accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) decoding, this cache can dominate memory usage at long context lengths. One solution is to compress this memory by exploiting inter-layer cache similarities. However, most existing techniques necessitate architectural changes to LLMs and incur substantial overhead. In this work, we propose a symmetry-aware value cache merging strategy that reduces cache memory while avoiding both harmful performance degradation and architectural overhead during decoding. Furthermore, we show that this approach can be exploited alongside existing cache compression techniques, composing with high-ratio quantization or key cache pruning to reach compression ratios that neither method reaches alone, with minimal additional cost. Ultimately, our findings reveal a major source of underutilized capacity in the value cache, offering a simple yet highly effective direction for scaling context windows under memory constraints.

摘要：雖然快取鍵值（KV）狀態可以加速大型語言模型（LLM）的解碼，但在長上下文長度下，這個快取可能會主導記憶體使用。一種解決方案是通過利用層間快取相似性來壓縮這個記憶體。然而，大多數現有技術需要對LLM進行架構更改，並產生大量開銷。在這項工作中，我們提出了一種對稱感知的值快取合併策略，該策略在解碼過程中減少快取記憶體，同時避免有害的性能下降和架構開銷。此外，我們展示了這種方法可以與現有的快取壓縮技術一起利用，與高比例量化或鍵快取修剪組合，以達到單獨方法無法實現的壓縮比，且附加成本極小。最終，我們的研究結果揭示了值快取中一個主要的未充分利用的容量來源，為在記憶體限制下擴展上下文窗口提供了一個簡單而又有效的方向。

docs.title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
docs.text:
2610.12337v1 by Jialei He, Enhe Liu, Sifan Song, Pengfei Jin, Jionglong Su, Hongbin Wang, Zhixiang Lu, Yanhao Huang, Anteng Cai, Zhengyong Jiang, Jiaman Ding, S. Kevin Zhou, Jinfeng Wang

Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.

摘要：解剖連續性為醫學影像重建提供了補充信息，但其使用需要考慮局部解剖結構和切片取樣的變異。我們介紹了ContiLNN，它通過雙向封閉形式的連續時間（Bi-CfC）模塊增強了二維重建骨幹，以進行切片間建模，同時保留平面內特徵提取。切片索引間隔調節由局部特徵和隱藏狀態決定的閘門，使得傳播能夠響應取樣變異，而無需數值ODE整合。參考引導的一致性將第一和第二階切片強度差異對齊，以保留解剖變異，同時從凍結的骨幹中進行蒸餾有助於保持平面內的真實性。在五個訓練種子中，ContiLNN在CT去噪、MRI超解析度和減少計數的PET重建方面，分別提高了平均PSNR 0.1907、1.0176和1.2482 dB，且在所有三個任務中RMSE均較低。CT結果對於一名保留的患者具有描述性。PET消融支持超出額外點狀容量的有序傳播。在連續訓練下，Bi-CfC在所有測試的取樣條件下實現了比擁有相似參數數量和算術成本的Bi-GRU更高的真實性。匹配的七切片分析顯示其延遲低52.8%和峰值GPU內存使用低57.0%相比Bi-GRU。混合間隙訓練改善了兩個運算元的稀疏和不規則上下文性能，但在指標和上下文中並未形成統一的排名。對於較少的訓練患者和第二個骨幹的實驗進一步支持了數據效率和骨幹兼容性。

docs.title: RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning
docs.text:
2610.12333v1 by Ruixiang Ouyang, Guanren Qiao, Fansen Meng, Yueci Deng, Ruixing Jin, Kui Jia, Guiliang Liu

Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.

摘要：準確模擬剛體互動對於預測物理世界模型至關重要。儘管在物體動態建模方面最近取得了一些進展，但捕捉表面之間的局部接觸如何影響物體運動仍然具有挑戰性。雖然端到端的世界模型可以預測整個場景或物體之間的互動，但在實際情況中，剛體接觸本質上是局部的，只有附近的表面才能直接交換接觸力。基於這一觀察，我們引入了剛體接觸推理（RiCo），它通過稀疏的接觸表面點的鄰域來表示物體之間的互動。RiCo將每個點的狀態與附近表面的相對幾何、運動和物理特性結合，然後在物體的點之間進行推理，以確定這些局部接觸如何共同影響其運動。通過將跨物體推理限制在附近表面，同時在每個剛體內部傳播接觸信息，RiCo保留了細粒度的互動細節，而不需要建模每對場景點的成本。這些特性使RiCo具備更高的準確性和接觸保真度。在MOVi基準上的實驗表明，與基準相比，RiCo將100幀的位置和方向誤差分別減少了31-35%和約38%。此外，RiCo實現了高接觸保真度，與真實數據相比，滲透時間和平均深度的差異分別為11.0%和2.22毫米。RiCo還從小規模訓練場景進一步推廣到包含270個物體的場景，實現了零樣本泛化。我們的現實世界多球碰撞實驗進一步提供了模擬到現實轉移的初步證據。

docs.title: Prediction-Powered Data Fusion for Treatment Effect Estimation
docs.text:
2610.12332v1 by Yonghan Jung, Shu Yang

Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) identify treatment effects without confounding but are often small, whereas observational studies (OBS) are large but may be confounded. Many estimators combining a small RCT with a large OBS have been developed for the average treatment effect (ATE) and the conditional ATE (CATE). However, existing ATE estimators either make assumptions on the OBS or do not borrow enough power from them. The CATE has been studied less than the ATE. Existing CATE methods either assume the OBS are unconfounded, rely on a model of the confounding function, or accept bias in exchange for lower variance. We therefore propose a framework that, without special assumptions on the OBS, fuses the OBS and the RCT by preserving the unbiasedness of RCT-based estimation while borrowing power from the large OBS to boost precision. Applying this principle, we build an ATE estimator, AIPW-Fusion, with closed-form weights and confidence intervals, and two CATE learners, DR-Fusion and R-Fusion. Experiments corroborate our findings.

摘要：隨機對照試驗（RCT）能夠在沒有混淆的情況下識別治療效果，但通常樣本量較小；而觀察性研究（OBS）則樣本量較大，但可能會受到混淆的影響。許多估計器結合了小型RCT和大型OBS，旨在估計平均治療效果（ATE）和條件平均治療效果（CATE）。然而，現有的ATE估計器要麼對OBS做出假設，要麼未能充分利用OBS的能力。CATE的研究相較於ATE較少。現有的CATE方法要麼假設OBS是無混淆的，要麼依賴於混淆函數的模型，或是接受偏差以換取較低的方差。因此，我們提出了一個框架，在不對OBS做特殊假設的情況下，通過保留基於RCT的估計的無偏性，同時借用大型OBS的能力來提高精確度，融合OBS和RCT。根據這一原則，我們構建了一個ATE估計器AIPW-Fusion，具有封閉形式的權重和置信區間，以及兩個CATE學習器DR-Fusion和R-Fusion。實驗驗證了我們的發現。

docs.title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
docs.text:
2610.12327v1 by Qitong Wang, Xinwei Niu, Mingluo Su, Shanwei Zhao, Shiai Zhu, Huan Wang

The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLM）推理的解碼階段具有記憶束縛的特性，導致顯著的延遲。由Hessian指導的逐層無訓練網路修剪方法已成為解決這一問題的突出方案，因為修剪減少了在解碼過程中從記憶中讀取的非零參數數量。儘管如此，這類方法通常使用預先收集的自然序列來計算Hessian，而模型在解碼過程中則是使用自生成的標記，這在兩個序列之間造成了分佈的偏移。基於自然序列計算的Hessian與基於生成序列計算的Hessian不同。我們觀察到，這種差異導致生成過程中的激活分佈偏離了用於修剪的分佈，進一步影響了修剪後模型的性能。此外，大多數現有的LLM修剪方法主要針對稀疏矩陣-矩陣（SpMM）乘法，對於主導解碼的稀疏矩陣-向量（SpMV）操作的支持有限。為了解決這些問題，我們引入了SparseDecoding，一個針對準確和高效LLM解碼的原則性解碼感知修剪框架。具體而言，在算法軸上，SparseDecoding從在密集模型自回歸生成過程中收集的逐層激活中構建校準矩陣，排除預填充，從而將修剪目標與解碼激活對齊。在系統軸上，我們開發了一種優化的N:M稀疏矩陣-向量內核，具有位掩碼索引和固定步長遍歷。在代表性LLM（Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B / 32B）上的大量實證結果顯示，我們的方法在長文本生成基準上始終優於標準固定文本校準，同時在A100 GPU上實現了高達1.48倍的端到端實時計算解碼加速。

docs.title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
docs.text:
2610.12325v1 by Julian Chan, Javier Mora Jimenez

Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.

摘要：LLM 科學代理僅依賴其初始任務上下文，還是會根據實驗反饋調整其決策？我們在神經運算元適應中研究這個問題，這裡一個大型語言模型（LLM）在有限的試驗預算下選擇微調配置。在部分微分方程（PDE）家族內部和之間的轉移中，LLM 在幾乎每個匹配比較中都實現了比隨機搜索和貝葉斯優化更低的保留測試 nRMSE。僅僅依賴最終性能無法區分發生了什麼，因此我們通過控制干預來驗證每個歸因。在觀察到任何驗證分數之前，LLM 的第一個配置已經在相應的隨機搜索池中排名接近頂部，這表明存在有用的初始偏見。一個互補的冷啟動干預顯示，所選的基學習率隨著 PDE 描述而變化。一旦反饋可用，重新分配評估配置之間的驗證分數會在每個測試案例中改變下一個提案，而保持值的重寫則不會產生可比的總體效果。這些干預確立了 LLM 的決策級行動對給定任務和觀察結果的反應，顯示它結合了任務依賴的先驗和對實驗反饋的敏感性。

docs.title: Verdict Without the Rule: Diagnosing and Auditing Regulatory Rule Sensitivity in LLM Compliance Systems
docs.text:
2610.12313v1 by Saisab Sadhu, Aadit Sengupta, Vinay kumar Sankarapu, Pratinav Seth

Large language model compliance systems are deployed on the assumption that a verdict depends on the regulatory rule it is given. We test this directly across five models and 20 regulatory and platform-policy domains: delete, swap, or negate the governing rule while holding the case fixed, and check whether the verdict changes (OCS) or the model's internal representation of compliance shifts at all (ICS-delta). Neither moves much: models' verdicts are often invariant to substantial perturbations of the supplied rule, and the guard model, evaluated here under a custom-rule adaptation of its native taxonomy, is the least rule-sensitive and least accurate of the five, barely above chance (51%, versus 90-92% for general-purpose models). This reflects easy cases more than blanket neglect: on cases where deleting the rule changes a previously correct model prediction, models do track it closely. Neither better prompting nor direct intervention on the model's internal representations closes this gap. Accuracy alone does not establish that a compliance verdict is grounded in the supplied rule.

摘要：大型語言模型的合規系統是基於這樣的假設：裁決取決於所提供的監管規則。我們在五個模型和20個監管及平台政策領域中直接測試這一點：刪除、交換或否定主導規則，同時保持案例不變，並檢查裁決是否改變（OCS）或模型對合規的內部表示是否有任何變化（ICS-delta）。這兩者都沒有太大變化：模型的裁決通常對所提供規則的重大擾動不變，並且在這裡根據其本土分類法的自定義規則適應評估的守護模型，是五個模型中對規則最不敏感且準確性最低的，幾乎接近隨機（51%，而通用模型為90-92%）。這反映了簡單案例的情況，而不是全面忽視：在刪除規則改變之前正確的模型預測的案例中，模型確實密切跟蹤它。無論是更好的提示還是對模型內部表示的直接干預，都無法縮小這一差距。僅僅準確性並不能證明合規裁決是基於所提供的規則。

docs.title: Looking Inside LLMs: Small-World Connectivity as a Signature of Reasoning Performance
docs.text:
2610.12304v1 by Zheng Huang, Sansheng Cao, Enpei Zhang, Weikang Qiu, Elynn Chen, Xiang Zhang, Yaoqing Yang, Rex Ying, Dawei Zhou, Yujun Yan

Understanding large language model (LLM) reasoning requires looking beyond behavioral performance to examine how reasoning ability is reflected in internal organization. Inspired by neuroscience findings linking higher intelligence to stronger small-world organization in functional brain networks, we investigate small-world connectivity as a structural signature of LLM reasoning. We construct functional graphs from attention-head activation similarities and find that a higher small-world index (SWI), capturing local clustering and short global paths, consistently correlates with better fluid reasoning performance across models and training checkpoints. Since local clustering is central to small-world organization, we further examine how heads important for model performance connect within and across communities. We find that these heads tend to have a larger share of connection weight within their own communities (high core scores) and a more concentrated weight distribution across communities (low bridge scores). These observations motivate the hypothesis that high core and low bridge scores serve as structural indicators of head importance for reasoning capability. We validate this hypothesis through pruning, introducing Small-World Allocation (SWA), a hierarchical sparsity allocation method guided by these scores. Across six LLMs, SWA better preserves small-world organization and model performance than competing allocation strategies, reducing WikiText perplexity by up to 20%. Together, these findings identify small-world functional connectivity as a measurable signature of LLM reasoning performance, offering a structural perspective that complements behavioral evaluation.

摘要：理解大型語言模型（LLM）推理需要超越行為表現，檢視推理能力如何在內部組織中反映出來。受到神經科學研究的啟發，該研究將更高的智力與功能性大腦網絡中的強小世界組織聯繫起來，我們調查小世界連通性作為LLM推理的結構特徵。我們從注意力頭的激活相似性構建功能圖，發現較高的小世界指數（SWI），捕捉局部聚類和短的全局路徑，與模型和訓練檢查點之間的流暢推理表現持續相關。由於局部聚類是小世界組織的核心，我們進一步檢查對模型性能重要的頭部在社群內部和社群之間的連接方式。我們發現這些頭部在其自身社群內的連接權重佔比更大（高核心分數），而在社群之間的權重分佈則更集中（低橋樑分數）。這些觀察促使我們提出假設：高核心分數和低橋樑分數作為推理能力的重要性結構指標。我們通過修剪來驗證這一假設，推出小世界分配（SWA），這是一種基於這些分數的分層稀疏分配方法。在六個LLM中，SWA比競爭的分配策略更好地保留了小世界組織和模型性能，將WikiText困惑度降低了多達20%。總的來說，這些發現將小世界功能連通性確定為LLM推理性能的可測量特徵，提供了一種補充行為評估的結構視角。

docs.title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models
docs.text:
2610.12303v1 by Saurabh Mathur, Sahil Sidheekh, Bhavan Vasu, Farbod Tavakkoli, Prasad Tadepalli, Kristian Kersting, Sriraam Natarajan

Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity prediction (Tox21), mutagenesis, and citation matching (Cora), and show that it improves over purely symbolic, neural, and LLM-based baselines, while producing interpretable weighted rule ensembles. By replacing combinatorial search with gradient-guided LLM hypothesis generation, grasp retains boosting guarantees without sacrificing the transparency of symbolic outputs.

摘要：宣告式邏輯程式提供了一種強大且可解釋的抽象方式，用於編碼關係結構和神經符號推理，通過將依賴關係表達為加權的組合規則。然而，從數據中誘導它們仍然根本上很困難，因為符號搜索空間的組合爆炸成為瓶頸。大型語言模型（LLMs）最近作為強大的假設生成器出現，但當單獨使用時，它們缺乏進行系統性歸納推理的能力，這是可靠地合成符合複雜關係分佈的有效程式所需的。我們介紹了 grasp（增強型概率邏輯程式合成），這是一個神經符號框架，將關係結構學習視為功能梯度提升，其中弱學習者是一階規則，而難以處理的內部搜索則委託給 LLM 提議的預言者。我們在四個關係基準上評估 grasp，涵蓋分子毒性預測（Tox21）、突變性和引用匹配（Cora），並顯示它在純符號、神經和基於 LLM 的基準上有所改善，同時產生可解釋的加權規則集。通過用梯度引導的 LLM 假設生成替代組合搜索，grasp 保留了提升保證，而不犧牲符號輸出的透明度。

docs.title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
docs.text:
2610.12299v1 by Dahyun Chung, Siyoon Jin, Hyunwook Choi, Honggyu An, Junyoung Seo, Hyunsung Kim, Seung Wook Kim, Seungryong Kim

Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

摘要：自我中心的世界模型預測基於代理行動的第一人稱觀察，但大多數模型專注於單一代理。真實的具身環境通常涉及多個代理在共享環境中行動和互動。現有的多代理世界模型依賴於粗略的行動，如運動、相機控制或離散命令，導致細緻的具身互動未被充分探索。我們將多代理自我中心世界建模定義為多個代理通過細緻行動在共享世界中同步生成自我流。這需要跨視角的行動一致性、共享環境的一致性，以及互動引起的狀態更新的一致傳播。我們提出了多代理自我中心世界模型（ME-World），該模型在共享的標記序列中共同去噪多個自我流，並將每個流的條件設定在所有代理的目標視角姿勢上，並用共享環境記憶來支持生成。我們在真實和合成的多代理數據上進行訓練和評估，並引入共享世界一致性度量來測量環境、一致更新和身份一致性。實驗表明，ME-World在共享世界一致性、行動控制、身份保留和視頻質量上優於現有方法。

docs.title: Machine Learning Meets High-Energy Nuclear Physics: From Pattern Recognition to Physics-Integrated Discovery
docs.text:
2610.12293v1 by Xun Chen, Weiyao Ke, Yu-Gang Ma, Long-Gang Pang, Kai Zhou

Machine learning (ML) in high-energy nuclear physics (HENP) is entering a new stage in which physical knowledge is incorporated more directly into data analysis, simulation, and physics inference. This mini-review focuses on developments that have matured in the past several years. Whereas earlier applications emphasized event classification, pattern recognition, and surrogate models for selected observables, recent work has moved toward physics-integrated workflows: calibrated Bayesian extraction of QCD matter properties, dense-matter equation-of-state inference from heavy-ion and neutron-star data, generative event modeling, neural unfolding of weak physical signals, differentiable inverse solvers, gauge-equivariant and diffusion-based lattice-field samplers, and neural reconstruction of model functions in holographic QCD. We survey recent applications of ML in heavy-ion collisions, neutron-star physics, lattice QFT, and holographic or continuum QCD. The emphasis is not on ML architectures alone, but on how they enter concrete physics workflows, how physical constraints such as symmetries, conservation laws, causality, thermodynamic stability, and topology are imposed, and how uncertainty quantification and validation determine whether an AI-assisted result can support a reliable physics conclusion.

摘要：機器學習（ML）在高能核物理（HENP）中正進入一個新的階段，物理知識更直接地融入數據分析、模擬和物理推斷中。這篇迷你評論集中於過去幾年成熟的發展。早期的應用強調事件分類、模式識別和選定可觀測量的替代模型，而最近的工作則轉向物理整合的工作流程：經過校準的貝葉斯提取量子色動力學（QCD）物質性質、從重離子和中子星數據推斷致密物質狀態方程、生成事件建模、弱物理信號的神經展開、可微逆解算器、規範等變和基於擴散的格點場取樣器，以及在全息QCD中模型函數的神經重建。我們調查了機器學習在重離子碰撞、中子星物理、格點量子場論和全息或連續QCD中的最近應用。重點不僅在於機器學習架構本身，而在於它們如何進入具體的物理工作流程，如何施加物理約束，例如對稱性、守恆定律、因果性、熱力學穩定性和拓撲，還有不確定性量化和驗證如何決定AI輔助的結果是否能支持可靠的物理結論。

docs.title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails
docs.text:
2610.12292v1 by Seyedarmin Azizi, Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo, Massoud Pedram

A typed decision model reads a piece of text and returns a probability over caller-defined options, each with a short written definition, generating no text. Recent work places these models in agent systems as guardrails: the component that reads a proposed tool call or incoming message and decides whether to allow it. We evaluate seven open-weight models in that role and report the two error directions separately: a fail-open error allows a prohibited action and is a vulnerability; a fail-closed error blocks a permitted one and is only a cost. On prompt-injection, jailbreak and toxic-content screening, accuracy at the allow-or-block decision ranges from 36% to 72% against a chance level of 50%. A low error rate in one direction only reflects which answer a model defaults to: one allows nearly everything, another blocks nearly everything. On a synthetic suite of agent tool calls, six lines of server log text that say nothing about the policy raise a gate's fail-open rate from 0% to 63% on a policy it otherwise decides correctly. Giving the permissive option a misleading name, with its definition and the judged text untouched, raises that rate to between 93% and 100% on the four models that place the label in their input. Every defense we tested is defeated, either by an attacker who targets its mechanism or by attacker-controlled text. Escalating the least confident decisions does not help either: a decision an attack has reversed is no less confident than the one it replaced. Parsing each policy field into a typed value does eliminate one attack, but it also makes the model unnecessary: a deterministic rule over those values reaches 100% accuracy on all six policies. These models can reduce how many cases reach a reviewer, but on this evidence they should not be the component that decides. Code is available at https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/option-channel-attack.

摘要：一個類型化的決策模型讀取一段文本並返回對呼叫者定義的選項的概率，每個選項都有一個簡短的書面定義，並不生成任何文本。最近的研究將這些模型放置在代理系統中作為護欄：該組件讀取提出的工具調用或傳入消息並決定是否允許它。我們在這個角色中評估了七個開放權重模型，並分別報告了兩個錯誤方向：一個失敗開放錯誤允許禁止的行為，是一種漏洞；一個失敗關閉錯誤阻止了允許的行為，僅僅是一種成本。在提示注入、越獄和有毒內容篩選方面，允許或阻止決策的準確性範圍從36%到72%，而機會水平為50%。在一個方向上低錯誤率僅反映模型默認的答案：一個幾乎允許所有東西，另一個幾乎阻止所有東西。在一組合成的代理工具調用中，六行不涉及政策的伺服器日誌文本將一個政策的失敗開放率從0%提高到63%，而該政策在其他情況下正確決定。給予寬容選項一個誤導性的名稱，並保持其定義和判斷文本不變，將該率提高到在四個將標籤放入其輸入的模型中介於93%到100%之間。我們測試的每一個防禦都被擊敗，要麼是由針對其機制的攻擊者，要麼是由攻擊者控制的文本。提升最不自信的決策也沒有幫助：一個被攻擊逆轉的決策並不比其替代的決策更自信。將每個政策字段解析為類型值確實消除了某一攻擊，但這也使模型變得不必要：對這些值的確定性規則在所有六個政策上達到100%準確性。這些模型可以減少多少案例進入審核者，但根據這些證據，它們不應該是決策的組件。代碼可在 https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/option-channel-attack 獲得。

docs.title: Unlocking the Regulatory Genome by ARGUS: An Evidence-Constrained Agentic Framework for Interpreting Single Nucleotide Variants
docs.text:
2610.12281v1 by Pratik Dutta, Matthew B. Obusan, Max Chao, Rekha Sathian, Nimisha Papineni, Ramana V. Davuluri

Over 90% of disease-associated variants from genome-wide association studies fall in noncoding regulatory regions, yet their functional interpretation remains a central open problem in genomic medicine. Large language models prompted to interpret such variants routinely hallucinate transcription factor (TF) binding changes, fabricate experimental support, and assign biological significance to statistically negligible signals. We present ARGUS (Agentic Regulatory Genomics for an Uncertainty-aware Scientist), which strictly separates deterministic biological computation from LLM-mediated reasoning. ARGUS wraps 458 DNABERT-based TF binding models in a hypothesis-directed investigation loop where a planner selects evidence sources based on current uncertainty, a verifier deterministically interprets each observation, and intermediate results change the investigation path. On variant rs6983267 at the 8q24 cancer risk locus, the same planner produces four divergent trajectories for four TFs. FOXA1 is rescued in 3 steps when real ADASTRA allele-specific binding data (15 experiments, FDR = 0.030) reveals a model false negative masked by saturation. KLF6 traverses 8 steps across ADASTRA, JASPAR motif analysis, and ENCODE cCRE regulatory annotation before abstaining due to mixed indirect evidence. RAD21 abstains in 8 steps after ADASTRA returns a coverage-qualified but nonsignificant allelic test (5 experiments, FDR = 0.65), and SP1, which shares FOXA1's saturated retained prediction, abstains because no direct experimental evidence exists at this locus. All observations come from real ADASTRA, JASPAR, and ENCODE cCRE queries; none are simulated. A comparison of fixed-priority and LLM-mediated planning shows that the LLM planner reaches identical verdicts with fewer tool calls by declining evidence that cannot resolve the claim under test.

摘要：超過90%的與疾病相關的變異來自全基因組關聯研究，這些變異位於非編碼調控區域，但它們的功能解釋仍然是基因組醫學中的一個核心未解問題。大型語言模型在解釋這些變異時，經常會產生轉錄因子（TF）結合變化的幻覺，捏造實驗支持，並將生物學意義賦予統計上微不足道的信號。我們提出了ARGUS（面向不確定性感知科學家的代理調控基因組學），它嚴格區分決定論的生物計算與LLM介導的推理。ARGUS將458個基於DNABERT的TF結合模型包裹在一個假設導向的調查循環中，規劃者根據當前的不確定性選擇證據來源，驗證者確定性地解釋每個觀察結果，而中間結果則改變調查路徑。在8q24癌症風險位點的變異rs6983267上，同一個規劃者為四個TF產生了四條不同的軌跡。當真實的ADASTRA等位基因特異性結合數據（15個實驗，FDR = 0.030）揭示了一個被飽和掩蓋的模型假陰性時，FOXA1在3步內被挽救。KLF6在ADASTRA、JASPAR基序分析和ENCODE cCRE調控註釋中跨越8步，然後由於混合間接證據而放棄。RAD21在ADASTRA返回一個覆蓋合格但不顯著的等位基因測試（5個實驗，FDR = 0.65）後，在8步內放棄，而SP1因為在此位點沒有直接實驗證據而放棄，SP1與FOXA1的飽和保留預測相同。所有觀察結果均來自真實的ADASTRA、JASPAR和ENCODE cCRE查詢；沒有任何是模擬的。固定優先級和LLM介導的規劃比較顯示，LLM規劃者在拒絕無法解決待測主張的證據時，能以更少的工具調用達成相同的判決。

docs.title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
docs.text:
2610.12274v1 by Haolin Yang, Jipeng Zhang, Jian Xie, Shuaishuai Gong, Sirui Han, Yike Guo

Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.

摘要：文本到 SQL 的模型通常被訓練為將問題直接映射到靜態查詢，而現實世界中的數據庫代理則通過與實時數據庫的有狀態、多輪互動來運作——檢查架構、執行探測查詢、診斷錯誤和修正假設。這造成了一個關鍵的訓練與部署不匹配，因為調解這種互動的執行環境僅在推理時引入。為了縮小這一差距，我們提出了 HarnessSQL，一個原生於執行環境的後訓練框架，能在監督微調和強化學習過程中保留完整的互動結構。HarnessSQL 構建了獨立的、可執行的數據庫環境，配合隱藏的執行預言機，將教師直接推出到目標 SQL 執行環境中，並僅保留經過驗證的軌跡以進行全序列的 SFT，隨後進行執行獎勵的 RL。在 Spider 2.0-SQLite 中，HarnessSQL 顯著提高了緊湊模型的執行準確性，將 Qwen3-8B 從 15.5% 提升至 45.2%，將 Qwen3-14B 從 22.2% 提升至 54.8%，同時有效轉移到如 BIRD-Interact 和 LiveSQLBench 等分佈外的互動基準。我們的研究結果表明，直接在其執行環境中訓練數據庫代理對於掌握複雜的長期數據庫工作流程至關重要。

docs.title: DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception
docs.text:
2610.12266v1 by Jinghua Hou, Zhe Liu, Hengshuang Zhao

Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.

摘要：多模態大型語言模型在橋接視覺與語言方面取得了顯著進展，促進了人機互動、機器人技術和自動駕駛等各種感知任務。然而，現有的基於 MLLM 的感知方法主要依賴於基於文本的坐標表示，這會導致過多的標記開銷，或是固定範圍量化，這在範圍和精度上受到限制，特別是在具有無界空間範圍和高定位精度要求的 3D 領域。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了一種名為 DVD 的動態向量解碼方法，該方法統一了 2D 和 3D 感知任務的表示。具體而言，我們首先將多樣的感知表示（即 2D 邊界框、2D 面具和 3D 邊界框）轉換為 1D 向量序列，然後將其映射到高維空間中的緊湊離散標記。接著，一個輕量級的去標記器通過將輸出標記解碼回原始的 2D 和 3D 感知表示，實現了與 MLLM 的無縫整合。在包括 RefCOCO 系列、SUN-RGBD、KITTI、Hypersim 和 nuScenes 的 2D 和 3D 感知基準上進行的廣泛實驗表明，DVD 在 2D 和 3D 任務中實現了卓越的性能，並顯著減少了標記開銷和推理延遲。DVD 提供了一個高效且通用的框架，用於將感知能力整合到 MLLM 中，克服了現有方法的固有限制。

docs.title: How Much Audio Is Left In An Embedding? An Inversion Audit Of Audio Encoders
docs.text:
2610.12250v1 by Marios Glytsos, Brian McFee

Pretrained audio encoders are reused for downstream tasks that are often unknown when the encoder is trained, so their usefulness depends partly on which signal properties survive the pretext objective. We study this retained information through paired source reconstruction. Using a shared Stable Audio Open latent diffusion decoder, we reconstruct five-second, 44.1-kHz stereo music from frozen representations produced by supervised classifiers (VGGish, ConvNeXt), an audio-text contrastive model (CLAP), and a waveform-reconstruction model (EnCodec). These objectives impose different pressures to preserve source detail, while their exposed interfaces vary substantially in temporal and spectral resolution. Evaluating on the Million Song Dataset (MSD), we find clear differences in reconstructability across encoder families, while within encoder comparisons show improved recovery when finer temporal or spectral structure is exposed. Even compressed task oriented embeddings support reconstructions that preserve measurable source specificity and high level musical content.

摘要：預訓練的音頻編碼器被重複利用於下游任務，而這些任務在編碼器訓練時通常是未知的，因此它們的有用性部分取決於哪些信號特性能夠在預訓練目標中保留。我們通過配對源重建來研究這些保留的信息。使用共享的穩定音頻開放潛在擴散解碼器，我們從由監督分類器（VGGish、ConvNeXt）、音頻-文本對比模型（CLAP）和波形重建模型（EnCodec）生成的凍結表示中重建五秒、44.1 kHz的立體音樂。這些目標對保留源細節施加了不同的壓力，而它們暴露的介面在時間和頻譜分辨率上有顯著差異。在百萬歌曲數據集（MSD）上進行評估時，我們發現不同編碼器家族之間在重建能力上存在明顯差異，而在編碼器內部比較中，當暴露更精細的時間或頻譜結構時，恢復效果有所改善。即使是壓縮的任務導向嵌入也支持保留可測量的源特異性和高水平音樂內容的重建。

docs.title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
docs.text:
2610.12248v1 by Heeseung Kim

Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

摘要：可穿戴的增強現實（AR）助手正朝著持續的現實世界互動發展，這些助手通過第一人稱視頻和音頻感知用戶的活動，並在未被明確要求的情況下提供及時的口頭指導。雖然主動視頻助手、口語對話系統和自我中心任務理解各自都取得了快速進展，但現有系統並未解決從連續的第一人稱流中決定何時發言和說什麼的聯合問題。我們介紹了EgoVoice，這是一個用於訓練和評估主動自我中心口語助手的框架。從HoloAssist的真實人類講師視頻錄製中，我們通過源分離和語音重合成構建乾淨的音頻流，並將每個視頻會話轉換為一種格式，在這種格式中，模型必須在每個時刻決定是保持沉默還是提供口頭指導。我們使用我們的數據對全模態LLM進行微調，並通過直接偏好優化進一步改善其主動干預行為。針對封閉和開源模型的實驗顯示，現有系統很少能夠產生時機良好、意義深遠的主動干預，而EgoVoice在干預時機、內容相關性和人類偏好方面相較於零樣本基礎模型顯示出明顯的改進。

docs.title: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
docs.text:
2610.12247v1 by David Leko, Luka Benić, Guillermo Bernárdez, Nina Miolane, Olga Fink, Lev Telyatnikov

Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.

摘要：拓撲深度學習將基於圖的學習擴展到更高階的領域，例如超圖、細胞和單純複形。這些領域通常是通過圖提升的過程從輸入圖中的模式構建而成。全域訓練在模型執行之前構建並存儲完整的提升表示。在像 Reddit（233k 節點和 57.3M 邊）這樣的大型密集數據集上，這種全域實現成為一個嚴重的計算瓶頸，通常使訓練變得不可行。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了 Cluster-TNN，一個領域無關的框架，通過局部提升來避免這一瓶頸。在預處理過程中對輸入圖進行分區後，Cluster-TNN 在運行時動態抽樣節點集群的組，重建它們的誘導子圖以形成小批次，並在每個小批次內應用所選的提升。保留抽樣節點之間的所有邊緣保留了構建跨集群的高階結構所需的連通性，生成現有拓撲神經網絡可以直接處理的拓撲小批次。在與全圖執行的 21 次匹配比較中，Cluster-TNN 在每個配置中均降低了峰值 GPU 記憶體，平均降低 83.2%，同時保持競爭性的預測性能。值得注意的是，這樣的減少使我們能夠首次在大型數據集如 Reddit 和 OGBN 產品上訓練多個不同的高階拓撲神經網絡。這些結果確立了 Cluster-TNN 作為一種通用策略，能夠將拓撲深度學習擴展超越全域領域構建的限制。

docs.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
docs.text:
2610.12242v1 by Tianyu Fu, Tengxuan Liu, Ruoxi Wang, Yixin Dong, Yi Ge, Yichen You, Yu Wang

Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.

摘要：大型語言模型 (LLM) 路由將推理工作分配到不同的模型上，推進了 LLM 服務的成本-品質帕累托邊界。雖然在會話或查詢層級的粗粒度路由已被廣泛應用於生產系統，但最近的算法研究顯示，細粒度的標記級路由可以帶來顯著的效率和品質提升。然而，有效地提供標記級路由的推理對現有系統提出了重大挑戰。基於單一 LLM 假設，目前的系統在標記級路由下遭受嚴重的步驟不同步和頻繁的批次接納延遲，並且對開發者施加了高實施複雜性。為了解決這些挑戰，我們設計了 TokenRouter，一個高效且對開發者友好的標記級路由 LLM 推理服務系統。TokenRouter 遵循請求中心編程和模型中心執行的原則：開發者從單一請求的角度描述路由邏輯，而運行時為每個 LLM 啟動一個子服務器並異步分發請求。每個子服務器使用延遲批次調度器，其最佳超參數是從系統的數學吞吐量模型中推導出來的。在多種路由算法、工作負載和模型對中，TokenRouter 的解碼吞吐量比現有系統高出 2.01-64.15 倍，顯著推進了標記級 LLM 路由的服務效率。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter 獲得。

docs.title: AdaCast: Conditional Parameter Generation for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting
docs.text:
2610.12240v1 by Darahaas Nallagatla, Darryl Cherian Jacob, Pan He

Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved strong forecasting performance across domains. However, most adaptation methods remain static. Existing all-in-one methods learn a single set of dataset-level parameter updates and apply the same adapted model to every input. As a result, they cannot adapt the model parameters to the temporal patterns, seasonality and dynamics of each input time series. This limits their ability to produce forecasts that are tailored to heterogeneous inputs. To address this limitation, we propose AdaCast, a conditional parameter generation framework for time-series forecasting. AdaCast uses a generator to produce input-specific low-rank parameter updates for a frozen pretrained TSFM. These updates adapt the model to each input during both training and inference. Across six public benchmarks, AdaCast consistently outperforms static adaptation baseline in in-domain forecasting and improves zero-shot generalization to held-out datasets across domains. These results demonstrate that conditional parameter generation provides an effective approach for adaptive forecasting.

摘要：時間序列基礎模型（TSFMs）在各個領域中已實現強大的預測性能。然而，大多數適應方法仍然是靜態的。現有的全能方法學習一組數據集級別的參數更新，並將相同的適應模型應用於每個輸入。因此，它們無法將模型參數適應於每個輸入時間序列的時間模式、季節性和動態。這限制了它們生成針對異質輸入的預測的能力。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了AdaCast，一種用於時間序列預測的條件參數生成框架。AdaCast使用生成器為一個凍結的預訓練TSFM生成特定於輸入的低秩參數更新。這些更新在訓練和推理期間使模型適應每個輸入。在六個公共基準測試中，AdaCast在領域內預測中始終優於靜態適應基線，並改善了對各個領域中保留數據集的零樣本泛化。這些結果表明，條件參數生成為自適應預測提供了一種有效的方法。

docs.title: La-Ribo: RNA Co-Design via Geometry-Latent Flow Matching
docs.text:
2610.12236v1 by Runze Ma, Will Hua, Shuangjia Zheng

RNA function arises from the coupling of nucleotide sequence and three-dimensional structure, motivating their joint design. Coordinating global folding with nucleotide-level detail remains challenging under limited structural supervision. We introduce La-Ribo, a generative framework for RNA sequence-structure co-design via geometry-latent flow matching. La-Ribo retains a sparse phosphate-sugar--base scaffold and encodes nucleotide identity and local conformation in residue-wise latents. A shared flow network generates both jointly, and an RNA-specific decoder then reconstructs all heavy atoms. To expand supervision, we construct a quality-controlled corpus of 168,561 RNA structures, integrating experimental data with predictions from three folding models, including 10,631 MSA-supported structures generated in this work. La-Ribo improves designability and codesignability over the evaluated baselines across sampling budgets and two refolding models, and the same prior supports scaffold-conditioned inverse folding without additional training.

摘要：RNA 功能源於核苷酸序列與三維結構的耦合，這促進了它們的聯合設計。 在有限的結構監督下，協調全局摺疊與核苷酸層級的細節仍然具有挑戰性。 我們介紹了 La-Ribo，一個通過幾何潛在流匹配進行 RNA 序列-結構共同設計的生成框架。 La-Ribo 保留了一個稀疏的磷酸-糖-鹼基支架，並在殘基層次的潛在變量中編碼核苷酸的身份和局部構象。 一個共享的流網絡同時生成這兩者，然後一個特定於 RNA 的解碼器重建所有重原子。 為了擴大監督，我們構建了一個質量控制的 168,561 個 RNA 結構的語料庫，將實驗數據與來自三個摺疊模型的預測整合，包括在本工作中生成的 10,631 個 MSA 支持的結構。 La-Ribo 在評估的基準上改善了設計性和共同設計性，涵蓋了取樣預算和兩個重新摺疊模型，並且相同的先驗支持在不額外訓練的情況下進行支架條件的逆摺疊。

docs.title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
docs.text:
2610.12235v1 by Zijun Wang, Zewen Liu, Minhua Lin, Zhaotian Weng, Zhan Shi, Bing He, Yisi Sang, Dakuo Wang, Benoit Dumoulin, Wei Jin, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie, Hanqing Lu

AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.
