Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.

摘要：數據視頻是一種將數據可視化與視頻敘事相結合的媒體形式，廣泛應用於新聞報導和商業分析。與一般視頻理解相比，數據視頻理解更強調準確地從動畫圖表中讀取數據，整合跨圖表和時間的證據，以及理解敘事組織和視覺設計如何傳達信息。然而，現有的基準針對的要麼是一般視頻，要麼是靜態圖表，數據視頻理解尚未得到系統性的評估。我們提出了DataVista，這是首個針對數據視頻理解的基準，包含961個真實世界的數據視頻和6,775個評估問題，這些問題在一個三層級的漸進能力框架下組織（數據感知、時間推理、敘事理解），並涵蓋五個主題領域的10種細分問題類型。對19個主流MLLM的系統評估顯示，表現最佳的模型Gemini-3.1-Pro達到了70.0%的整體準確率，仍然遠低於人類專家的表現，且模型在因果推理和敘事結構方面的表現最差。增加幀數和添加字幕主要有助於數據感知和時間推理，而在敘事理解方面的提升有限。對模型反應的進一步分析識別出在圖表閱讀、證據判斷和指令理解中的典型失敗模式。該基準可在https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista獲得。

docs.title: MetaOPD: Meta-Learned Token Weighting for On-Policy Distillation
docs.text:
2610.11989v1 by Zipeng Wang, Xinpeng Dong, Yuefan Wang, Pingchen Lu, Xian Wei, Kun Kuang, Fei Wu, Zhongxiang Dai, Min Zhang

On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using token-level teacher supervision. However, uniform weighting overlooks differences in token learning value, while existing weighting methods rely on predefined mappings from prediction signals to token weights. These mappings are not learned from the effectiveness of the resulting student updates, limiting their ability to adapt to evolving learning needs. In this paper, we propose MetaOPD, a bilevel optimization framework that jointly learns the student model and a lightweight token-weighting network. The inner objective updates the student through weighted OPD, while the outer objective optimizes the weighting network using validation loss on reference solutions after a virtual student update. Differentiating through this update connects weighting decisions to their effects on post-update performance, allowing the mapping from prediction signals to token weights to evolve alongside the student. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning and three out-of-domain datasets, covering two student scales and seven baselines, demonstrate the effectiveness of MetaOPD, with Avg@8/Pass@8 gains over OPD of 1.99/5.97 percentage points for the 0.6B student and 2.25/6.41 points for the 1.7B student.

摘要：在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，學生使用其自身生成的回應進行訓練，並採用令牌級的教師監督。然而，統一加權忽略了令牌學習價值的差異，而現有的加權方法依賴於從預測信號到令牌權重的預定映射。這些映射並不是從結果學生更新的有效性中學習而來，限制了它們適應不斷變化的學習需求的能力。在本文中，我們提出了MetaOPD，一個雙層優化框架，該框架共同學習學生模型和輕量級令牌加權網絡。內部目標通過加權OPD更新學生，而外部目標則在虛擬學生更新後使用參考解的驗證損失來優化加權網絡。通過這一更新進行微分將加權決策與其對更新後性能的影響聯繫起來，允許從預測信號到令牌權重的映射隨著學生的進步而演變。在六個數學推理和三個域外數據集上的實驗，涵蓋兩個學生規模和七個基準，證明了MetaOPD的有效性，對於0.6B學生，Avg@8/Pass@8的增益分別為1.99/5.97個百分點，對於1.7B學生則為2.25/6.41個百分點。

docs.title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
docs.text:
2610.11978v1 by Xing Li, Qingcheng Chang, Jinzhong Ning, Changfeng Xu, Shenlong Zhang, Yijia Zhang, Ling Luo, Hongfei Lin

Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.

摘要：Jev是一個「系統一」模型，它在給定選項中返回一個選擇，而不是生成文本。我們研究這種專門的決策模型與通用大型語言模型（LLMs）之間的比較。我們在涵蓋知識、推理和多語言理解的13個選擇題基準上評估Jev，並將其與19個LLMs進行比較，分為三個層級：前沿、代表性和小型。Jev在知識和常識基準上與前沿LLMs具有競爭力，並在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上獲得最佳分數。在數學以外的領域，它的表現也超過了大多數代表性LLMs和所有小型LLMs。然而，在數學文字題上，它的表現不如人意：在MathQA上，它比前沿中位數低17.7分，並且得分低於所有19個LLMs。這些結果表明，專門的決策模型可以在主要依賴知識的決策上與通用LLMs匹敵，但在需要多步計算的決策上則不然。

docs.title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
docs.text:
2610.11966v1 by Mengdi Liu, Wenjue Chen, Wenyue Chen, Cheng Yang, Fanqi Kong, Zhangyang Gao, Xiaoxue Cheng, Yiheng Li, Yujian Yuan, Keliang Li, Hong Chang, Shiguang Shan, Chenglin Wu

Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.

摘要：研究想法創新是科學進步的基本引擎，但在可擴展和可控的方式下生成和評估仍然困難。這一挑戰在於其固有的開放性和多目標性質，想法應該平衡新穎性、合理性和可行性。儘管最近基於大型語言模型的方法通過精心設計的提示或代理管道取得了進展，但它們受到預定義的靜態創意工作流程的限制。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了MindFlow，一個明確將創意表述為心智中的圖結構流的框架，該框架由模塊化思維運算符組成，並由概率心智超網絡建模。給定一個研究主題，控制器動態地抽樣思維流以生成候選想法。這一開放性問題通過基於比賽的相對排名進行優化，使控制器能夠逐步偏好更高質量的思維流。我們進一步引入了一種評估協議，聯合評估問題發現和問題解決，超越僅基於標題或摘要的判斷。在多樣的主題中，MindFlow顯示出其作為一個明確、可控和可優化的研究想法創新者的優越性。

docs.title: Can LLMs Fix It Without Code? Toward Automated Verification of No-Code Bug Fixes
docs.text:
2610.11963v1 by Utku Boran Torun, Veli Karakaya, Eray Tüzün

A no-code fix resolves an invalid bug report by directing the user to change a setting, update to a version where the problem is already fixed, or adjust their workflow. Manually verifying whether a proposed no-code fix resolves the reported bug takes considerable developer time. This study proposes an automated, execution-based pipeline for evaluating the capability of large language models (LLMs) to generate no-code fixes in a real browser environment. We evaluate 322 no-code fixes generated by the 12 configurations released with the benchmark of a previous study, covering bug reports categorized as Faulty Configuration, Wrong Version, or External System & Dependency. An executor agent applies each fix by following its natural-language instructions, and an issue-specific checker determines whether the reported bug persists. We repeat the pipeline with three executors: two Computer-Use Agents, OpenCUA-72B and Claude Sonnet 5, and one multimodal agentic LLM, Meta's Muse Glimmer. Only 17.6% of the candidate issues could be set up and passed both sanity gates. Across the 322 fixes, 14.6% to 49.7% resolved the bug depending on the executor, and the strongest configuration, Claude Opus 4.6 in the Vanilla pipeline, resolved up to 74.1% of its fixes under Claude Sonnet 5. Changing only the executor shifted a configuration's resolution rate by 38.8% on average, and the three executors reached the same verdict on only 46.9% of the fixes. Compared with human execution, the executors matched the human consensus for 66.1% to 88.1% of the sampled fixes. Even under the best executor, fewer than half of the LLM-generated no-code fixes resolve the reported bug, so such fixes need verification before they reach users. Execution-based verification can provide this, but the measured capability depends strongly on the executor, which evaluations must report and control.

摘要：一個無代碼的修復通過指導用戶更改設置、更新到已修復問題的版本或調整工作流程來解決無效的錯誤報告。手動驗證提議的無代碼修復是否解決了報告的錯誤需要相當多的開發者時間。本研究提出了一個自動化的基於執行的管道，用於評估大型語言模型（LLMs）在真實瀏覽器環境中生成無代碼修復的能力。我們評估了322個由之前研究基準釋出的12個配置生成的無代碼修復，涵蓋了被分類為錯誤配置、錯誤版本或外部系統與依賴的錯誤報告。一個執行代理通過遵循其自然語言指令來應用每個修復，並且一個針對特定問題的檢查器確定報告的錯誤是否仍然存在。我們使用三個執行者重複該管道：兩個計算機使用代理，OpenCUA-72B和Claude Sonnet 5，以及一個多模態代理LLM，Meta的Muse Glimmer。只有17.6%的候選問題能夠設置並通過兩個合理性檢查。在322個修復中，根據執行者的不同，解決錯誤的比例從14.6%到49.7%不等，而最強的配置，Claude Opus 4.6在Vanilla管道中，在Claude Sonnet 5下解決了高達74.1%的修復。僅改變執行者平均會使配置的解決率變化38.8%，而三個執行者對僅46.9%的修復達成相同的裁決。與人類執行相比，執行者在66.1%到88.1%的抽樣修復中與人類共識相匹配。即使在最佳執行者下，少於一半的LLM生成的無代碼修復解決了報告的錯誤，因此這些修復在到達用戶之前需要驗證。基於執行的驗證可以提供這一點，但測量的能力在很大程度上依賴於執行者，評估必須報告並控制這一點。

docs.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
docs.text:
2610.11959v1 by Xiaomi LLM-Core Team, :, Zongming Qiao, Ziyue Hua, Zirui Ou, Zihao Yue, Zihan Jiang, Zhuo Huang, Zhiyang Chen, Zhixian Zheng, Zhipeng Xu, Zhengrui Ma, Yuyang Hu, Yuhang Dong, Yuechen Zhang, Yudong Wang, Yuanxin Liu, Yixin Yang, Yishuo Cai, Yikai Zhao, Yihan Yan, Yifan Zhang, Yifan Song, Xiyu Wei, Xing Zhang, Xin Zhang, Xiaoqian Liu, Xiaodong Ji, Xiangwei Deng, Xueyu Guo, Wenhan Ma, Weimin Xiong, Weikun Wang, Weiji Zhuang, Shuo Liu, Shuhuai Ren, Shuhao Gu, Shimao Chen, Shijie Cao, Shihua Yu, Shicheng Li, Shengjie Zhou, Shaolei Zhang, Rang Li, Qiying Wang, Qingkai Fang, Qianli Chen, Minzheng Wang, Liwen Wang, Linli Yao, Linghao Zhang, Liangyu Cheng, Liang Zhao, Lei Li, Jinhao Dong, Jinyu Xiang, Jianyu Wei, Jiangshan Duo, Huaqiu Liu, Huanjie Fan, Hongyi Guan, Hongshen Xu, Hao Tian, Hanyu Li, Hailin Zhang, Gang Wang, Fuli Luo, Feng Wei, Dong Zhang, Dawei Zhu, Chiheng Lou, Chenhong He, Chenhao He, Chenghua Liu, Bowen Ye, Bowen Shen, Boshen Xu, Bo Yang, Bingquan Xia, Bangjun Xiao, Baixuan Xu, Zhouxiang Mao, Zhiyang Zhang, Zhixiang Xu, Zhenru Lin, Zhengju Tang, Zhaojun Huang, Yuzhe Weng, Yuxing Xiang, Yuxiao Li, Yuheng Yang, Yuhang Wang, Yuchen Liu, Yuanyuan Tian, Yuanliang Dong, Yu Cheng, Yongzhe He, Yongshun Liang, Yong Wang, Yiyan Wang, Yitian Gong, Yijie Zhang, Yanshu Xin, Xun Zhang, Xingjian Zhao, Wenyu Yang, Wenshan Huang, Wenhao Li, Tingwei Huang, Tianyu Yu, Tianyang Lu, Taoyu Yang, Sinan Du, Shutong Tian, Shulin Du, Shengfan Wang, Shanchuan Fang, Qihao Zhang, Qibin Yang, Qian Yu, Qian Tu, Pengrong Xie, Peipei Wang, Peidian Li, Minkun Guo, Mingchen Shao, Luohan Gao, Lijie Wang, Liang Shi, Kaiqi Chen, Kaiming Liu, Kaifei Wang, Kai Yang, Jinlong Xue, Jiechen Zhang, Jiaxuan Liu, Hongxu An, Hao Peng, Hanglong Lü, Guonan Wang, Feiyu Yang, Fanyu Cao, Fangyue Liu, Fan Cui, Cong Wang, Chun Chen, Chenxu Bai, Chengxuan Zhu, Chenghua Wang, Boyi Zeng

Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.

摘要：強化學習（RL）是推進大型基礎模型自我改進的核心訓練範式。這份報告介紹了MiMo-V2.6系列，這是一個全模態的家族，通過擴展RL計算來推進模型智能的邊界。在進行RL之前，我們在一個廣泛的多模態語料庫上進行中期訓練，以提供充足的探索空間，並在預訓練的混合-SWA架構上建立穩固的基礎設施，以支持隨後的擴展。我們在三個維度上擴展RL計算：（1）更大的批次和更高的吞吐量，使用異步訓練，每步消耗1,568個樣本和2.7-3.7B個標記，上下文長度可達1M；（2）更多樣化和複雜的環境，涵蓋代碼、一般、視覺和網絡領域，並在多種代理裝置下進行；以及（3）更多的評分計算，通過群組代理評分產生更準確的獎勵信號，以應對長期任務，並引導模型朝向更短、更具標記效率的解決方案。為了在大規模訓練中保持穩定，我們凍結了MoE路由器，並建立了多層防禦以防止獎勵黑客。我們進一步為混合任務代理RL建立基礎設施，包括統一的軌跡表示、高併發的多框架滾動、解耦的控制和數據平面，以及訓練-推理一致性。我們開源了訓練動態、RL環境和RL框架，以促進對擴展RL和模型自我改進的重現和進一步研究。

docs.title: When History Helps and Hurts: Selective History Use across Multimodal Turns
docs.text:
2610.11948v1 by Shuoyang Sun, Kerui Gu, Hao Fang, Shaoli Huang, Bin Chen

Reliable multimodal interaction depends on selective use of conversational history: an earlier question may remain relevant while its previous answer is outdated, whereas a current request may depend on historical evidence despite conflicting new observations. Existing multi-turn evaluations rarely separate these history-use demands from underlying question difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce ReTurn, a benchmark of 7,000 base tasks spanning visual and audio evidence for evaluating selective history use. For task-carrying history, Reconfirm/Reground require applying a historical question to current media while varying historical agreement; for evidence-carrying history, Retrieve/Rebind require answering a current question using historical media while varying current-media competition. Each pair preserves the target question, media, and answer. Tasks support open-ended and multiple-choice evaluation, with matched single-turn counterparts serving as answerability references. Across 13 omni-modal, vision-language, and audio-language models, median model-level open-ended accuracy falls from 93.7% with direct input to 72.3% in conversation. Behavioral probes show that high question recall can coexist with weaker task application, while competing media can redirect answers away from historical targets. Supervised adaptation yields only partial gains. ReTurn provides a controlled framework for assessing whether multimodal models select and use the historical information required by each request.

摘要：可靠的多模態互動依賴於對對話歷史的選擇性使用：早期的問題可能仍然相關，而其之前的答案則可能已過時，儘管當前的請求可能依賴於歷史證據，儘管存在相互矛盾的新觀察。現有的多輪評估很少將這些歷史使用需求與基本問題難度分開。為了填補這一空白，我們引入了 ReTurn，一個包含 7,000 個基礎任務的基準，涵蓋視覺和音頻證據，以評估選擇性歷史使用。對於任務承載的歷史，Reconfirm/Reground 需要將歷史問題應用於當前媒體，同時變化歷史一致性；對於證據承載的歷史，Retrieve/Rebind 需要使用歷史媒體回答當前問題，同時變化當前媒體的競爭。每對任務保留目標問題、媒體和答案。任務支持開放式和多選評估，匹配的單輪對應任務作為可回答性參考。在 13 個全模態、視覺-語言和音頻-語言模型中，中位數模型級別的開放式準確率從直接輸入的 93.7% 下降到對話中的 72.3%。行為探測顯示，高問題回憶可以與較弱的任務應用共存，而競爭媒體可以將答案從歷史目標轉移。監督適應僅帶來部分增益。ReTurn 提供了一個受控框架，用於評估多模態模型是否選擇並使用每個請求所需的歷史信息。

docs.title: Project Greenhouse: Progress Toward Fully Open and Sovereign Agentic Search
docs.text:
2610.11922v1 by Jimmy Lin, Sahel Sharifymoghaddam, Lingwei Gu, Nour Jedidi

Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.

摘要：Project Greenhouse 代表了我們對一個簡單論點的探索：我們相信，有可能僅用適度的計算資源來構建完全開放和主權的代理搜尋模型。作為第一個里程碑，我們描述了如何使用一個簡單的兩步驟食譜來構建一個具有競爭力的逐點解碼器重排序器，這個食譜包括從零開始的預訓練，然後是基於監督的微調，僅從常見的數據集開始。與文獻中主流的方法相反，我們不依賴於第三方的現有開放權重骨幹，因此我們完全控制模型訓練，從頭到尾。我們能夠在不超過少數幾個 GPU 的情況下完成大部分實驗。本報告闡明了我們方法的重要性和好處，並分享了能夠透明、獨立重現模型訓練各方面的工件。除了捕捉我們努力的數據、代碼和配置外，我們還釋放了我們的 Gaggle 模型系列的檢查點，展示了我們方法的可行性，並為驗證我們更廣泛的論點提供了第一步。

docs.title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
docs.text:
2610.11920v1 by Yichen Liu, Chunfeng Yuan, Haowei Liu, Wenjuan Li, Zefeng Lin, Bing Li, Xu Chen, Weiming Hu

For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories. To address these limitations, we propose QGMem, a novel memory construction and activation framework motivated by human memory, in which experience is organized into events and query-relevant events are modeled by graph as working memory. QGMem converts long dialogue histories into event-indexed atomic memory units that preserve individual experiences and consolidates related units into dynamic memory traces that retain state trajectories and current states. When a query arrives, hybrid memory retrieval gathers complementary candidate memories, and query-aware reranking activates the most relevant units as a compact working memory. To expose relational dependencies in the working memory and support conflict-aware reasoning, QGMem organizes the working memory as a local graph, which is then encoded as a graph token and provided to the LLM together with the textual working memory to improve evidence utilization during answer generation. Experiments across six benchmarks validate the framework and show consistent gains in retrieval, multi-hop evidence composition, conflict resolution, and ultra-long dialogue reasoning with compact contexts and moderate inference cost.

摘要：對於持久且個性化的對話代理，記憶系統可以使它們通過存儲過去的互動和檢索相關信息來記住、更新和推理長期歷史。現有的記憶系統通常遵循兩種範式：平面結構記憶和基於圖的記憶。前者輕量級，但使事件關係和狀態更新隱含，而後者則明確建模記憶結構，但會產生額外的構建成本並引入長期歷史中的無關關係。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了QGMem，一個受到人類記憶啟發的創新記憶構建和激活框架，其中經驗被組織成事件，並通過圖模型化查詢相關事件作為工作記憶。QGMem將長對話歷史轉換為事件索引的原子記憶單元，這些單元保留個體經驗，並將相關單元整合成動態記憶痕跡，以保持狀態軌跡和當前狀態。當查詢到達時，混合記憶檢索收集互補的候選記憶，而查詢感知的重新排序激活最相關的單元作為緊湊的工作記憶。為了揭示工作記憶中的關係依賴並支持衝突感知推理，QGMem將工作記憶組織為一個局部圖，然後將其編碼為圖令牌，並與文本工作記憶一起提供給LLM，以改善在生成答案過程中的證據利用。跨越六個基準的實驗驗證了該框架，並顯示在檢索、多跳證據組合、衝突解決和超長對話推理方面的一致增益，具有緊湊的上下文和適度的推理成本。

docs.title: From Surface to Depth: Towards Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning in Multimodal Emotion Understanding
docs.text:
2610.11918v1 by Jia Li, Yichao He, Yangchen Yu, Qiankun Li, Xinyi Li, Baiyi Ye, Zhenzhen Hu, Richang Hong, Erik Cambria

Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly incorporate explainable reasoning for emotion understanding. However, reasoning based mainly on observable affective cues can reduce emotion understanding to superficial cue-label associations, giving rise to the Clever Hans effect. Such shortcuts become unreliable when affective cues are implicit, conflicting across modalities, linguistically misleading, or obscured by redundant details. In contrast, human emotions are shaped by how individuals interpret and evaluate surrounding events beyond observable cues. Inspired by appraisal theories of emotion, we formulate multimodal emotion understanding as a progression from perception to cognitive appraisal, and introduce a dataset, a model, and a benchmark to support this novel paradigm. CogEmo-40K is a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset constructed through a perception-to-appraisal pipeline to elicit evidence-grounded reasoning across six cognitive appraisal dimensions underlying emotion. CogEmo-MoE is a compact sparse MLLM that introduces interleaved MoE blocks for appraisal-specific adaptation, enabling effective appraisal reasoning at a substantially smaller scale than typical emotion MLLMs. CogEmo-Bench introduces an Appraisal Evidence Quality Score (AEQS) to assess cognitive-affective understanding across six complementary appraisal dimensions, addressing the limitation of conventional emotion metrics that evaluate what emotion is predicted but not why it arises. Extensive experiments show that our paradigm not only leads CogEmo-Bench, but also exhibits strong cross-domain generalization. Our findings suggest that perception-to-appraisal reasoning can move beyond surface-level cue-label associations toward more reliable multimodal emotion understanding and closer cognitive alignment between MLLMs and humans.

摘要：最近的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）越來越多地融入可解釋的推理來理解情感。然而，主要基於可觀察的情感線索進行推理可能會將情感理解簡化為表面上的線索-標籤關聯，從而產生聰明漢斯效應。當情感線索隱含、跨模態衝突、語言上具有誤導性或被冗餘細節掩蓋時，這種捷徑變得不可靠。相對而言，人類情感受到個體如何解釋和評估周圍事件的影響，超越可觀察的線索。受到情感評價理論的啟發，我們將多模態情感理解構建為從感知到認知評價的進程，並引入一個數據集、一個模型和一個基準來支持這一新穎的範式。CogEmo-40K是一個大型指令調整數據集，通過感知到評價的管道構建，以引發基於證據的推理，涵蓋情感背後的六個認知評價維度。CogEmo-MoE是一個緊湊的稀疏MLLM，為評價特定的適應引入交錯的MoE區塊，使得在比典型情感MLLM更小的規模上實現有效的評價推理。CogEmo-Bench引入了一個評價證據質量分數（AEQS），以評估六個互補評價維度中的認知-情感理解，解決了傳統情感指標的局限性，這些指標評估預測了什麼情感，但並不解釋為什麼會產生。廣泛的實驗顯示，我們的範式不僅引領了CogEmo-Bench，還展現了強大的跨領域泛化能力。我們的研究結果表明，感知到評價的推理可以超越表面層的線索-標籤關聯，朝向更可靠的多模態情感理解，以及MLLM與人類之間更緊密的認知對齊。

docs.title: Not Every Change Is Necessary: Recoverable Drift in Large Language Model Unlearning
docs.text:
2610.11915v1 by Xunlei Chen, Qinghui Gong, Jingkun Xue, Qihe Liu, Shijie Zhou, Fei Ye

Machine unlearning in large language models aims to remove unwanted knowledge while preserving the model's remaining capabilities. Although existing methods use retention objectives or restrict where edits occur, achieving the desired forgetting level can still leave collateral changes that impair non-target behavior. Our recovery comparisons suggest that some of these changes can be reversed while preserving observed forgetting performance. In this work, we present Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U), a framework that combines targeted forgetting with the recovery of non-target capabilities. PTP-U first applies local analytic edits to weaken target knowledge associations, then aligns non-target output distributions with those of the original model to recover capabilities while maintaining fixed forgetting constraints. Both stages serve a common goal: satisfying the forgetting requirements while preserving fluent generation and performance on non-target tasks. Across three benchmarks, PTP-U achieves the strongest forgetting-retention trade-off among evaluated methods, reaching 81.22%-91.03% forgetting while preserving 94.20% non-target utility on average. At matched forgetting, PTP-U consistently retains higher non-target utility.

摘要：機器忘記在大型語言模型中的目的是移除不必要的知識，同時保留模型的其他能力。雖然現有的方法使用保留目標或限制編輯發生的地方，但達到所需的遺忘水平仍可能留下影響非目標行為的附帶變化。我們的恢復比較表明，這些變化中的一些可以在保留觀察到的遺忘性能的同時被逆轉。在這項工作中，我們提出了提議然後投影的忘記（PTP-U），這是一個將有針對性的遺忘與非目標能力的恢復相結合的框架。PTP-U 首先應用局部分析編輯來削弱目標知識的關聯，然後將非目標輸出分佈與原始模型的分佈對齊，以在保持固定遺忘約束的同時恢復能力。這兩個階段的共同目標是：滿足遺忘要求，同時保持流暢的生成和在非目標任務上的性能。在三個基準中，PTP-U 在評估的方法中實現了最強的遺忘-保留權衡，達到 81.22%-91.03% 的遺忘，同時平均保留 94.20% 的非目標效用。在匹配的遺忘下，PTP-U 始終保持更高的非目標效用。

docs.title: Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations
docs.text:
2610.11907v1 by Shuran Ma, JiaLe Li, Yuxin Dong, Shan Zheng, Qingyun Jiang, Xiang Chen, Qi Zhu, Deyi Ji, Yifan Yang, Jianfeng Pan, Yu Tian, Xue Yang

Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.

摘要：幻覺仍然是大型視覺-語言模型（LVLMs）的一個重大挑戰。現有的無需訓練的方法通常通過對比解碼或視覺增強來減輕幻覺，這往往在生成過程中增加視覺證據的相對影響力。這引發了一個基本問題：LVLMs 能否動態調節不同上下文來源的貢獻以抑制幻覺？在這項工作中，我們研究並量化 LVLMs 在解碼過程中如何協調多個上下文來源，並檢查這種內在行為如何指導幻覺的減輕。我們發現 LVLMs 表現出一種內在的視覺注意傾向，可以指導自適應的視覺引導，而文本上下文也可以對減輕幻覺有所貢獻。基於這些發現，我們提出了 AIMS（自適應信息多源引導），這是一個輕量級的無需訓練的框架，能夠在解碼過程中自適應地協調視覺、預填文本和生成的上下文。具體而言，AIMS 為三個上下文領域構建緊湊的原型，並根據當前查詢估計它們的親和力，以確定頭部引導權重。生成的多源引導方向應用於查詢表示，實現自適應上下文整合，而無需額外的模型訓練或輔助前向傳遞。對多個 LVLMs 和解碼策略的廣泛實驗表明，AIMS 有效減輕了物體幻覺，同時保持了具有競爭力的通用多模態能力。

docs.title: Can Decision Models Understand Stance? Evaluating Jev Against General-Purpose LLMs
docs.text:
2610.11901v1 by Xing Li, Jinzhong Ning, Yijia Zhang, Liang Yang, Hongfei Lin

Stance detection requires identifying an author's attitude toward a given target, sometimes based on conversational context. Jev, a specialized decision model designed for structured decision-making, offers an alternative to general-purpose large language models (LLMs). In this work, we evaluate Jev on two stance detection datasets, VAST (English texts) and ZS-CSD (Chinese conversations), comparing it with four general-purpose LLMs and two fine-tuned models. Results show that Jev achieves competitive performance on VAST, matching GPT-5.6 and outperforming the other general-purpose LLMs. However, it falls behind stronger LLMs on ZS-CSD, particularly in distinguishing favor from against. Further analysis suggests that this limitation may be related to understanding reply relationships and stance direction rather than conversation length alone. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of Jev for stance detection.

摘要：立場檢測需要識別作者對特定目標的態度，有時依賴於對話背景。Jev是一種專門的決策模型，旨在進行結構化決策，提供了一種替代通用大型語言模型（LLMs）的方法。在這項工作中，我們在兩個立場檢測數據集上評估Jev，分別是VAST（英文文本）和ZS-CSD（中文對話），並將其與四個通用大型語言模型和兩個微調模型進行比較。結果顯示，Jev在VAST上達到了具有競爭力的表現，與GPT-5.6相當，並且超越了其他通用大型語言模型。然而，在ZS-CSD上，它在區分贊成與反對方面落後於更強的LLMs。進一步的分析表明，這一限制可能與理解回覆關係和立場方向有關，而不僅僅是對話長度。這些發現突顯了Jev在立場檢測中的潛力和局限性。

docs.title: Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications from LLM-Chats to Autonomous AI Agent System
docs.text:
2610.11899v1 by Irene Weber

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically. In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents. This survey describes seven recurring forms---LLM chats, custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-enhanced workflows, copilots, coding agents, and, in part, agentic RAG---in a common vocabulary of agents and tools. Each is characterized along four structural dimensions (agentic RAG only partially): the architectural pattern, the control of execution and the point of user intervention, the number of agent calls per task, and tool use. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地作為軟體系統中的組件嵌入，並以聊天機器人、助手、檢索增強生成、工作流程、編碼代理和人工智慧代理等標籤進行市場推廣。這些標籤是否代表真正的架構形式或僅僅作為品牌尚未進行系統性評估。在調查的來源中，標籤確實帶有架構內容，尤其在供應商的使用中最為明顯：助手表示一種路由器-工作者架構，在逐步用戶確認下運行主應用程序，而最近轉向標籤代理的變化與人工智慧計劃的多步執行相吻合，使用者僅看到結果。四大主要供應商的編碼代理共享一種架構，即一個將任務委派給子代理的推理與行動循環。本調查描述了七種重複出現的形式——LLM 聊天、自訂代理、檢索增強生成（RAG）、人工智慧增強工作流程、助手、編碼代理，以及部分代理 RAG——在一個共同的代理和工具詞彙中。每一種形式都沿著四個結構維度進行特徵化（代理 RAG 只有部分特徵化）：架構模式、執行控制和用戶介入點、每個任務的代理呼叫數量，以及工具使用。來自研究出版物和供應商文檔的22個系統的示範語料庫為描述提供了基礎，並顯示它們的極限所在。

docs.title: Evaluating Exact Output and Checkpoint-State Prediction in Real Programs
docs.text:
2610.11889v1 by Xiaohong Chen, David Bucur, Chenglong Ma, Yi Zhang, Lingming Zhang, Sriram Vishwanath, Grigore Rosu

We present a benchmark for predicting final output and checkpoint state from source and input alone. It extends CRUXEval-style output prediction with paired shorter- and longer-trace inputs and checkpoints inside and after a loop. The benchmark contains 400 cases from 371 Python and C++ programs, evaluated under seven settings from four model families without tools or code execution. Of 11,200 planned predictions, 11,151 produced gradable responses. Reasoning-enabled settings outperform their off counterparts by 33.1 to 55.2 percentage points on completed responses. The strongest setting scores 93.0% on shorter-trace final output, 77.0% on longer-trace final output, and 65.5% and 63.5% on the two state tasks; these scores also hold when missing responses count as wrong. Across 2,397 matched Python comparisons with identical source, changing to the longer-trace input yields 528 correct-to-wrong changes and 147 reversals. Source-clustered analyses preserve this accuracy gap, while adjusted Python models give no evidence of a positive incremental association between cumulative state load and error. Changed inputs and checkpoint tasks alter several factors together, so the gaps do not isolate trace length or an internal state-tracking mechanism. The benchmark exposes errors hidden by short-output scores alone.

摘要：我們提出了一個基準，僅根據源代碼和輸入來預測最終輸出和檢查點狀態。它擴展了CRUXEval風格的輸出預測，包含配對的短追蹤和長追蹤輸入，以及循環內部和之後的檢查點。該基準包含來自371個Python和C++程序的400個案例，在四個模型系列的七個設置下進行評估，未使用工具或代碼執行。在11,200個計劃的預測中，11,151個產生了可評分的回應。啟用推理的設置在完成的回應上比其對應的非推理設置高出33.1到55.2個百分點。最強的設置在短追蹤最終輸出上得分93.0%，在長追蹤最終輸出上得分77.0%，在兩個狀態任務上分別得分65.5%和63.5%；這些分數在缺失回應被計算為錯誤時也保持不變。在2,397個源代碼相同的Python比較中，改為長追蹤輸入產生528個正確轉為錯誤的變化和147個反轉。源聚類分析保留了這一準確性差距，而調整後的Python模型則未顯示累積狀態負載與錯誤之間存在正增量關聯的證據。改變的輸入和檢查點任務共同改變了幾個因素，因此這些差距並未孤立追蹤長度或內部狀態跟踪機制。該基準揭示了僅由短輸出分數隱藏的錯誤。

docs.title: LEVER: Adaptive Cost-Aware Proof Search Over AND/OR Graphs
docs.text:
2610.11862v1 by Nihal Jain, Shuangjie Yao, Begum Cicekdag, Zhuo Zhang, Suman Jana

Mathematicians value proofs for more than correctness: among correct proofs, simplicity, purity and the computational cost of finding them vary widely. Yet LLM-powered theorem provers largely search for any correct proof, and improve its quality only after it is found. We propose LEVER, a proof search algorithm that makes the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizes it during search. LEVER scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph, combining realized objective values with predictions for open subgoals, so the objective guides search before a proof is complete. The same mechanism optimizes computational cost, proof length, topical impurity, and even their weighted combinations, while the Lean kernel enforces correctness. On PutnamBench in Lean 4, under matched budgets, LEVER costs 34% less than a strong single-conversation agent while raising the solve rate from 80% to 96%. On reducing topical impurity, i.e., how far a proof strays from its theorem's subject, it improves over post-hoc refactoring (42% reduction against 33%) at two-thirds of the cost and more reliably; on proof length, the metric refactoring is built for, it approaches refactoring. Varying the objective's weights traces a quality-cost trade-off curve, so the user can choose how much a better proof is worth. Overall, LEVER is a performant, cost-efficient and tunable proof search algorithm for navigating the space of correct proofs.

摘要：數學家對證明的重視不僅僅在於其正確性：在正確的證明中，簡潔性、純粹性和尋找它們的計算成本差異很大。 然而，LLM 驅動的定理證明者主要尋找任何正確的證明，並且僅在找到後才改善其質量。 我們提出了 LEVER，一種證明搜尋算法，使正確證明的目標可編程，並在搜尋過程中進行優化。 LEVER 在 AND/OR 證明圖上對部分證明進行評分，將實現的目標值與未解子目標的預測相結合，因此目標在證明完成之前就指導搜尋。 相同的機制優化計算成本、證明長度、主題不純性，甚至它們的加權組合，而 Lean 核心則強制執行正確性。 在 Lean 4 的 PutnamBench 上，在匹配預算下，LEVER 的成本比強大的單次對話代理低 34%，同時將解決率從 80% 提高到 96%。 在減少主題不純性方面，即證明與其定理主題的偏離程度，它在成本的三分之二下，對後期重構的改進（42% 的減少對 33%）更為可靠；在證明長度方面，該指標重構是為此而建，它接近重構。 變化目標的權重描繪出質量-成本的權衡曲線，因此用戶可以選擇更好的證明值多少。 總體而言，LEVER 是一種高效、成本效益高且可調整的證明搜尋算法，用於導航正確證明的空間。

docs.title: Abstracts
Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
docs.text:
2610.12445v1 by Oskar J. Hollinsworth, Alex F. Spies, Tigist Diriba, Adam Gleave, Chris Cundy

Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.

摘要：最近的事件突顯了監控 LLM 代理的挑戰以及模型欺騙人類的危險。我們顯示通過探針的白盒欺騙檢測可以擴展到前沿監控設置，方法是收集迄今為止最大的欺騙數據集來訓練探針，並引入一種新穎的探針架構，可以在多層和多個標記之間聚合信息。我們的探針在 SHADE-Arena 中達到了 98.8% 的 AUC，超越了 Opus 5.5 的文本監控基準，並顯示出隨著基礎模型的擴展，效能有所改善。為了將我們的探針推向極限，我們在幾個情況下進行測試，在這些情況下，僅從上下文無法確定欺騙。在這些情況中，我們稱之為內省欺騙，真實情況只能通過仔細引導或對模型訓練數據的透徹了解來確定。在其中一次評估中，我們顯示探針可以區分包含模型真正隱藏目標的轉錄本與其他目標，AUC 高達 99.7%。我們的探針還能輕易檢測出在政治敏感話題上撒謊的顯著開放權重模型，以及在壓力下對其信念的表述。我們發布了名為 FIBS 的訓練數據集，以幫助推動有效探針的前沿部署，並鼓勵社群以更多的欺騙和破壞例子來擴展這一數據集。

docs.title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
docs.text:
2610.12386v1 by Gokul Puthumanaillam, Tao Sun, Elie Aljalbout, Moritz Reuss, Zhaoshuo Li, Fabio Ramos, Ankit Goyal, Jenai Xuning Yang

The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

摘要：目前改善機器人基礎模型（RFM）的主流方法依賴於更大的模型、更多的機器人示範以及昂貴的大規模訓練。我們展示了一種有效且高效的互補方法：正確的推理配方可以顯著提高現有最先進RFM的零次任務表現。我們將這個配方稱為ARC。它由三個關鍵成分組成：推理痕跡、一個可擴展的自動標記管道，以及一種將預訓練RFM適應以使用這些痕跡進行控制的策略。首先，我們發現有效的推理痕跡應該基於機器人的下一個行動並解釋其因果結構：為什麼這個行動是合適的以及它應該產生什麼效果。其次，我們展示這些痕跡可以從現有的示範中自動生成，使我們能夠從DROID構建ARC-Trace-DROID，而無需收集新的機器人數據。第三，我們展示了最先進的VLA（視覺語言模型）如$π_{0.5}$和WAM（行為模型）如Cosmos3-Nano-Policy如何學會使用這些痕跡進行控制，並根據每個模型的架構和能力進行微調和推理。使用ARC，我們在零次RFM表現上獲得了前所未有的增益，據我們所知，這些增益是在沒有額外機器人示範或基礎規模訓練的情況下取得的。經過適應的模型在RoboLab-120和MolmoSpaces上建立了新的最先進紀錄，在RoboLab-Reasoning-50上獲得了高達50個百分點的增益。在真實機器人上，ARC使得$π_{0.5}$的任務成功率提高了82.2個百分點。項目網站：https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

docs.title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
docs.text:
2610.12375v1 by Babak Barazandeh, Connor Swanson, Chinmay Kulkarni, Nikhil Mungel

Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).

摘要：代理人被應用於從旅行規劃和股票交易到 IT 事件分流的各種應用中。 在大多數情況下，LLM 代理人獨立運作，僅有最小的基於規則的保護措施，這導致了不可逆轉行動所帶來的成本和安全問題。 最近的研究通過使用保護代理來監控行為或事後評估日誌來解決這一問題。 第一種方法為每一步增加了成本和延遲；第二種方法在執行後給出判決，當時代幣已經被消耗，損害已經造成。 為了克服這一問題，我們提出了 OnTrack，一種流式監控機制，通過將代理的步驟和依賴與記錄的成功運行進行比較，來在每步約一毫秒內提醒用戶或阻止代理。 我們在三種不同的訪問範疇中研究這個問題：完全參考訪問（歷史運行和工具架構）、中等訪問（僅工具架構）和無先前知識（僅生成的步驟日誌）。 隨著數據訪問的減少，OnTrack 監控能力的期望值也隨之降低，範圍從計劃違規檢測到識別循環、停滯和重複的工具調用。 最後，我們使用 SWE-bench 軌跡評估 OnTrack。 根據前 8 步，我們的方法將失敗的軌跡排名低於成功的軌跡，優於內容相似性方法（+0.057 AUROC）。 通過中止政策，我們節省了約 18% 的計算資源，這些資源本來會在失敗的運行中被消耗，其中 83% 的中斷運行實際上是走向失敗的（6 次中止中有 5 次是正確的）。

docs.title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict
docs.text:
2610.12360v1 by Kaiser Sun, Bernal Jimenez Gutierrez, Hongjun Liu, Jingyu Zhang, Jie Gao, Mark Dredze, Daniel Khashabi

When retrieved evidence contradicts an agent's prior beliefs, does it revise its answer, acknowledge uncertainty, or persist with an incorrect conclusion? Existing evaluations of agentic systems focus primarily on task success, offering limited insight into how agents handle such conflicts. We propose to evaluate agents on epistemic humility (EH): the agent's willingness to recognize, act on, and communicate uncertainty during task execution. We operationalize EH through three trajectory-level behavioral dimensions: Identify, Solve, and Escalate (ISE). Through knowledge conflict, situations where the backbone language model's parametric knowledge contradicts the evidence it encounters, or where two contextual sources disagree, we evaluate two conflict settings: (1) controlled conflict and (2) naturally occurring conflict during multi-step agentic execution, each paired with matched no-conflict controls. Evaluating four agents, we find that higher task accuracy does not necessarily correspond to greater epistemic humility: some high-accuracy configurations recognize conflicts during execution but do not communicate unresolved uncertainty in their incorrect final answers. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that agents frequently detect conflicts in early steps of execution but fail to maintain or resolve them in later steps. Finally, we show that model-level interventions can improve EH, but often at the cost of task accuracy, suggesting that epistemic humility emerges from the interaction among the backbone model, agent harness, and evaluation environment.

摘要：當檢索到的證據與代理人的先前信念相矛盾時，代理人會修正其答案、承認不確定性，還是堅持錯誤的結論？現有的代理系統評估主要集中在任務成功上，對於代理人如何處理這種衝突提供的見解有限。我們提議對代理人進行知識謙遜（EH）的評估：代理人在任務執行過程中承認、採取行動並傳達不確定性的意願。我們通過三個軌跡層級行為維度來操作化EH：識別、解決和升級（ISE）。通過知識衝突，即主幹語言模型的參數知識與其所遇到的證據相矛盾的情況，或兩個上下文來源之間存在分歧的情況，我們評估兩種衝突設置：（1）受控衝突和（2）在多步代理執行過程中自然發生的衝突，每種情況都配對相應的無衝突控制。我們評估了四個代理，發現較高的任務準確性不一定對應於更大的知識謙遜：一些高準確性配置在執行過程中識別衝突，但在其不正確的最終答案中不傳達未解決的不確定性。軌跡層級分析進一步顯示，代理人經常在執行的早期步驟中檢測到衝突，但在後期步驟中未能維持或解決這些衝突。最後，我們展示了模型層級的干預可以改善EH，但往往以任務準確性為代價，這表明知識謙遜源於主幹模型、代理工具和評估環境之間的相互作用。

docs.title: A Structural Theory of Cognitive Representation and Problem Solving,Contexts, Invariance, and the Knowledge Space
docs.text:
2610.12306v1 by Antal Jakovác, András Telcs

Learning and problem solving depend critically on the structure of internal representations. While many modern data-driven artificial systems achieve strong predictive performance, their learned representations often lack explicit structure for expressing abstraction, invariance, and task-relevant regularities. We propose a minimal structural framework in which representational operations relevant to problem solving, such as context formation, invariance recognition, representative selection, abstraction, and procedural reuse, are made explicit. The central notion is that of a \emph{context}, formalized as a partition of a subset of an underlying state space, which fixes the distinctions, granularity, and form in which a problem can be posed. Within this setting, invariance recognition and representative selection are treated as fundamental representational operations. The framework is realized as a Knowledge Space composed of two coupled graph structures: a Concept Graph that hosts constructed and refined concepts, and a Procedure Graph that encodes typed operations over representations. Together, these structures provide a minimal cognitive-representational algebra for operating on representations without assuming sophisticated inference, learning, control, perception, or motor mechanisms. Using simple illustrative examples and a finite weak-solver demonstration, we show that appropriate representational organization can simplify the form and scope of admissible regularities, even when problem solving is carried out by a fixed and limited solver. The contribution of the paper is structural rather than algorithmic: it identifies representational prerequisites for abstraction, invariance, and procedural reuse in problem solving, and states explicit success and failure conditions for the weak-solver setting.

摘要：學習和問題解決在很大程度上依賴於內部表徵的結構。雖然許多現代數據驅動的人工系統在預測性能上表現出色，但它們所學習的表徵往往缺乏明確的結構來表達抽象性、不變性和與任務相關的規律。我們提出了一個最小結構框架，其中與問題解決相關的表徵操作，如上下文形成、不變性識別、代表性選擇、抽象和程序重用，都被明確化。核心概念是\emph{上下文}，它被形式化為基礎狀態空間子集的劃分，這固定了問題可以提出的區分、粒度和形式。在這個設置中，不變性識別和代表性選擇被視為基本的表徵操作。該框架實現為一個知識空間，由兩個耦合的圖結構組成：一個概念圖，承載構建和精煉的概念，以及一個程序圖，編碼對表徵的類型操作。這些結構共同提供了一個最小的認知-表徵代數，用於操作表徵，而不假設複雜的推理、學習、控制、感知或運動機制。通過簡單的示例和有限的弱解算器演示，我們展示了適當的表徵組織可以簡化可接受規律的形式和範圍，即使問題解決是由固定和有限的解算器進行的。本文的貢獻是結構性的，而非算法性的：它確定了問題解決中抽象、不變性和程序重用的表徵前提，並明確陳述了弱解算器設置的成功和失敗條件。

docs.title: Looking Inside LLMs: Small-World Connectivity as a Signature of Reasoning Performance
docs.text:
2610.12304v1 by Zheng Huang, Sansheng Cao, Enpei Zhang, Weikang Qiu, Elynn Chen, Xiang Zhang, Yaoqing Yang, Rex Ying, Dawei Zhou, Yujun Yan

Understanding large language model (LLM) reasoning requires looking beyond behavioral performance to examine how reasoning ability is reflected in internal organization. Inspired by neuroscience findings linking higher intelligence to stronger small-world organization in functional brain networks, we investigate small-world connectivity as a structural signature of LLM reasoning. We construct functional graphs from attention-head activation similarities and find that a higher small-world index (SWI), capturing local clustering and short global paths, consistently correlates with better fluid reasoning performance across models and training checkpoints. Since local clustering is central to small-world organization, we further examine how heads important for model performance connect within and across communities. We find that these heads tend to have a larger share of connection weight within their own communities (high core scores) and a more concentrated weight distribution across communities (low bridge scores). These observations motivate the hypothesis that high core and low bridge scores serve as structural indicators of head importance for reasoning capability. We validate this hypothesis through pruning, introducing Small-World Allocation (SWA), a hierarchical sparsity allocation method guided by these scores. Across six LLMs, SWA better preserves small-world organization and model performance than competing allocation strategies, reducing WikiText perplexity by up to 20%. Together, these findings identify small-world functional connectivity as a measurable signature of LLM reasoning performance, offering a structural perspective that complements behavioral evaluation.

摘要：理解大型語言模型（LLM）推理需要超越行為表現，檢視推理能力如何在內部組織中反映出來。受到神經科學研究的啟發，該研究將更高的智力與功能性大腦網絡中的強小世界組織聯繫起來，我們調查小世界連通性作為LLM推理的結構特徵。我們從注意力頭的激活相似性構建功能圖，發現較高的小世界指數（SWI），捕捉局部聚類和短的全局路徑，與模型和訓練檢查點之間的流暢推理表現持續相關。由於局部聚類是小世界組織的核心，我們進一步檢查對模型性能重要的頭部在社群內部和社群之間的連接方式。我們發現這些頭部在其自身社群內的連接權重佔比更大（高核心分數），而在社群之間的權重分佈則更集中（低橋樑分數）。這些觀察促使我們提出假設：高核心分數和低橋樑分數作為推理能力的重要性結構指標。我們通過修剪來驗證這一假設，推出小世界分配（SWA），這是一種基於這些分數的分層稀疏分配方法。在六個LLM中，SWA比競爭的分配策略更好地保留了小世界組織和模型性能，將WikiText困惑度降低了多達20%。總的來說，這些發現將小世界功能連通性確定為LLM推理性能的可測量特徵，提供了一種補充行為評估的結構視角。

docs.title: Machine Learning Meets High-Energy Nuclear Physics: From Pattern Recognition to Physics-Integrated Discovery
docs.text:
2610.12293v1 by Xun Chen, Weiyao Ke, Yu-Gang Ma, Long-Gang Pang, Kai Zhou

Machine learning (ML) in high-energy nuclear physics (HENP) is entering a new stage in which physical knowledge is incorporated more directly into data analysis, simulation, and physics inference. This mini-review focuses on developments that have matured in the past several years. Whereas earlier applications emphasized event classification, pattern recognition, and surrogate models for selected observables, recent work has moved toward physics-integrated workflows: calibrated Bayesian extraction of QCD matter properties, dense-matter equation-of-state inference from heavy-ion and neutron-star data, generative event modeling, neural unfolding of weak physical signals, differentiable inverse solvers, gauge-equivariant and diffusion-based lattice-field samplers, and neural reconstruction of model functions in holographic QCD. We survey recent applications of ML in heavy-ion collisions, neutron-star physics, lattice QFT, and holographic or continuum QCD. The emphasis is not on ML architectures alone, but on how they enter concrete physics workflows, how physical constraints such as symmetries, conservation laws, causality, thermodynamic stability, and topology are imposed, and how uncertainty quantification and validation determine whether an AI-assisted result can support a reliable physics conclusion.

摘要：機器學習（ML）在高能核物理（HENP）中正進入一個新的階段，物理知識更直接地融入數據分析、模擬和物理推斷中。這篇迷你評論集中於過去幾年成熟的發展。早期的應用強調事件分類、模式識別和選定可觀測量的替代模型，而最近的工作則轉向物理整合的工作流程：經過校準的貝葉斯提取量子色動力學（QCD）物質性質、從重離子和中子星數據推斷致密物質狀態方程、生成事件建模、弱物理信號的神經展開、可微逆解算器、規範等變和基於擴散的格點場取樣器，以及在全息QCD中模型函數的神經重建。我們調查了機器學習在重離子碰撞、中子星物理、格點量子場論和全息或連續QCD中的最近應用。重點不僅在於機器學習架構本身，而在於它們如何進入具體的物理工作流程，如何施加物理約束，例如對稱性、守恆定律、因果性、熱力學穩定性和拓撲，還有不確定性量化和驗證如何決定AI輔助的結果是否能支持可靠的物理結論。

docs.title: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
docs.text:
2610.12247v1 by David Leko, Luka Benić, Guillermo Bernárdez, Nina Miolane, Olga Fink, Lev Telyatnikov

Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.

摘要：拓撲深度學習將基於圖的學習擴展到更高階的領域，例如超圖、細胞和單純複形。這些領域通常是通過圖提升的過程從輸入圖中的模式構建而成。全域訓練在模型執行之前構建並存儲完整的提升表示。在像 Reddit（233k 節點和 57.3M 邊）這樣的大型密集數據集上，這種全域實現成為一個嚴重的計算瓶頸，通常使訓練變得不可行。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了 Cluster-TNN，一個領域無關的框架，通過局部提升來避免這一瓶頸。在預處理過程中對輸入圖進行分區後，Cluster-TNN 在運行時動態抽樣節點集群的組，重建它們的誘導子圖以形成小批次，並在每個小批次內應用所選的提升。保留抽樣節點之間的所有邊緣保留了構建跨集群的高階結構所需的連通性，生成現有拓撲神經網絡可以直接處理的拓撲小批次。在與全圖執行的 21 次匹配比較中，Cluster-TNN 在每個配置中均降低了峰值 GPU 記憶體，平均降低 83.2%，同時保持競爭性的預測性能。值得注意的是，這樣的減少使我們能夠首次在大型數據集如 Reddit 和 OGBN 產品上訓練多個不同的高階拓撲神經網絡。這些結果確立了 Cluster-TNN 作為一種通用策略，能夠將拓撲深度學習擴展超越全域領域構建的限制。

docs.title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
docs.text:
2610.12235v1 by Zijun Wang, Zewen Liu, Minhua Lin, Zhaotian Weng, Zhan Shi, Bing He, Yisi Sang, Dakuo Wang, Benoit Dumoulin, Wei Jin, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie, Hanqing Lu

AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.

摘要：AI 研究代理自動化提議、實施和評估實驗的循環，為遞歸自我改進開辟了一條道路。然而，它們提出實驗的能力超過了在真實環境中執行實驗的能力，使得結果預測成為在有限實驗預算下持續自我改進的關鍵能力。我們調查語言模型作為研究世界模型（RWMs），這些模型預測候選干預在研究環境中的結果。我們的評估基於來自九個研究環境的超過 2,600 條實驗記錄，涵蓋了預訓練、後訓練和推理，代表了超過 171,000 小時的 H100 GPU 實驗。從真實實驗經驗中獲得的研究知識改善了 RWM 對同一環境中未見干預的預測（Spearman +0.27），並且可以在不同環境中重複使用。例如，僅使用來自 OLMo3、Marin 和 Nanochat 的預訓練經驗，RWM 在 Qwen3 環境中將選擇後悔降低了 78%，相比於零經驗設置。這些好處延伸至固定選擇預算下的多輪自動研究：擁有環境內和跨環境研究知識的 RWM 分別提高了最佳增益 15.8% 和 11.6%。對 13 個用作 RWM 的語言模型的消融實驗顯示，添加研究知識可以比僅改變模型或增加推理努力來得更有效地改善干預排名。這些發現支持語言模型作為 RWM，並激勵未來積累實驗數據以進行 RWM 訓練。

docs.title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
docs.text:
2610.12183v1 by Ming Chen, Rong-Xi Tan, Ke Xue, Yu-Jie Zhou, Taiye Lu, Zhi-Xuan Gao, Peng Xie, Zijun Shen, Chen Lu, Haopu Shang, Chao Qian

Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.

摘要：黑箱優化（BBO）出現在許多科學和工程問題中，這些問題的目標評估成本高且有限。最近的大型語言模型（LLM）代理提供了一種新的方法來處理BBO，通過結合任務語義、計算、優化工具和基於反饋的決策，顯示出由於與數學上嚴謹的工具的整合而具有巨大的潛力。然而，現有的代理BBO研究使用不同的任務領域和系統配置，使得它們的結果難以比較，個別設計選擇的影響也難以孤立。因此，我們介紹了AgenticBBO-Bench，一個跨領域的代理BBO基準，涵蓋合成函數、超參數優化、數據庫調優、芯片設計和分子設計，並在統一的有限預算評估協議下進行。在我們的實驗中，代理BBO在所有五個領域中達到了比直接基於LLM的方法更高的家庭平均分數，並在四個領域中超越了最佳數值優化器。我們進一步研究了三個影響代理性能的因素：優化工具、任務信息和先驗知識，以及LLM在搜索過程中的角色。我們的結果顯示，額外的數值工具並不總是能一致地提高性能，任務語義廣泛有用，而更具體的先驗則不太可靠，數值優化器可以有效地吸收代理所建立的搜索軌跡帶來的收益。最後，我們在AgenticBBO-Bench中引入了一個五任務的前沿挑戰，並在Codex代理框架下評估了七個LLM，其中GPT-6 Astra和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash位於所評估模型的性能和成本的Pareto前沿。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo獲得。

docs.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
docs.text:
2610.12176v1 by Hyunin Lee, Jinglue Xu, Jeffrey Seely, Donghyun Lee, Somayeh Sojoudi, Matei Zaharia, Yujin Tang

Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.

摘要：遞歸自我改進（RSI）在無法驗證的任務上，例如開放式研究，當其輸出超過人類專家能可靠評估的範圍時，面臨監督瓶頸，這使得模型本身（優化對象）成為最佳可用的優化器和評估者。然而，單一模型實例在這種同質循環下難以批評和改進其自身的複雜推理。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了多代理自我監督（MASS），這是一種RSI方法，交替進行進化工作流優化和對自生成軌跡的監督微調。根據早期發現，多代理拓撲在複雜推理方面表現出色，MASS促使單一基礎模型迭代地提出、執行和自我評估多代理工作流。通過受結構護欄約束的進化搜索，模型優化這些類計算圖的協調，發現針對特定任務最有效的不同角色和信息路由。在兩個使用Qwen3.6-27B的MASS循環中，該模型在四個開放式公共基準上每個輸出標記的性能提高了1.2-1.6倍。由於改進後的模型隨後作為更好的優化器和評估者，這種交替框架使模型能力的持續遞歸自我啟動成為可能。此外，多代理軌跡的訓練效率也更高：在其上訓練的學生超越了在1.4倍更多訓練標記上訓練的單代理學生。這些發現表明，從多代理軌跡共同學習協調和有界子代理執行可以為RSI提供有效的信號。

docs.title: Scalable Hierarchical Graph Generation via Soft Community Structure
docs.text:
2610.12163v1 by Ahmet Tüzen, Helge Langseth, Kjetil Nørvåg

Generating large attributed graphs requires reproducing the topology, generating attributes jointly with the structure, and remaining scalable. Many real-world graphs exist as a single large graph, so a generative model has to generalize from the one graph it is fit on, without independent samples. We present Schema, which recursively decomposes a reference graph into a hierarchy of soft communities, assigning each node a membership distribution. Generation is then split into three stages, each trained independently: (1) synthesizing node attributes conditioned on soft memberships, (2) generating intra-community edges from local structural context, and (3) modeling inter-community connections over bridge nodes whose membership mass is distributed across several communities. No stage forms the full adjacency matrix, and each stage operates on a subgraph bounded by the community size. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that covers structural fidelity, memorization, downstream utility, and scalability. On four real-world attributed graphs, Schema recovers the balance between local and long-range structure more closely than any other model that generates attributes, while reproducing only a small fraction of the reference edges. It retains the downstream accuracy of the reference graph without raising it artificially above that level. Baselines that match its structural fidelity memorize the reference, while those with higher downstream accuracy either exceed the reference accuracy or fail to complete on the larger graphs. We measure scalability on six additional graphs with up to 10 million nodes.

摘要：生成大型屬性圖需要重現拓撲結構，與結構共同生成屬性，並保持可擴展性。許多現實世界的圖存在為一個大型圖，因此生成模型必須從其擬合的單一圖中進行概括，而沒有獨立的樣本。我們提出了 Schema，它將參考圖遞歸地分解為一個軟社群的層次結構，並為每個節點分配一個成員分佈。生成過程分為三個階段，每個階段獨立訓練：（1）根據軟成員資格合成節點屬性，（2）從局部結構上下文生成社群內邊緣，以及（3）建模跨社群連接，這些連接通過其成員質量分佈在多個社群中的橋接節點。沒有一個階段形成完整的鄰接矩陣，每個階段在由社群大小界定的子圖上運作。我們還介紹了一個評估協議，涵蓋結構保真度、記憶化、下游效用和可擴展性。在四個現實世界的屬性圖上，Schema 更接近於恢復局部和長距結構之間的平衡，超過了任何其他生成屬性的模型，同時僅重現參考邊緣的一小部分。它保持了參考圖的下游準確性，而不會人為地提高到那個水平。與其結構保真度相匹配的基準會記住參考，而那些具有更高下游準確性的基準要麼超過參考準確性，要麼無法在較大的圖上完成。我們在六個額外的圖上測量可擴展性，這些圖的節點數量高達 1000 萬。

docs.title: Use and Disuse: Intent-Structured Experience Consolidation for Memory and Learning in LLM Agents
docs.text:
2610.12124v1 by Xiangyi Zeng, Baihang Liu, Xutong Wang, Ze Jin, Yunpeng Li, Qixu Liu

The evolution of Large Language Model agents from single-task execution to long-term autonomous operation highlights the critical challenge of transforming continuous experiences into reusable knowledge. To address this, we propose Hippocam, a hierarchical memory and continual learning architecture. Hippocam draws inspiration from two characteristics of human memory: cognitive processes selectively maintain information relevant to current goals, while long-term memories form gradually through repeated consolidation. Accordingly, Hippocam structures an agent's ongoing work as nested intents. The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.

摘要：大型語言模型代理從單一任務執行演變到長期自主運作，突顯了將持續經驗轉化為可重用知識的關鍵挑戰。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了Hippocam，一種層次記憶和持續學習架構。Hippocam從人類記憶的兩個特徵中獲得靈感：認知過程選擇性地維持與當前目標相關的信息，而長期記憶則通過重複鞏固逐漸形成。因此，Hippocam將代理的持續工作結構化為嵌套意圖。活動上下文始終集中於當前意圖，而已完成的意圖則被鞏固為與任務相關的結果和後續工作所需的狀態，而不是攜帶其完整的工作細節。同時，一種遞歸前綴鞏固機制反覆鞏固早期歷史，導致長期未使用的經驗變得越來越抽象。原始互動得以保留，使代理能夠通過層次結構逐步恢復更細緻的細節，並在獲得足夠信息後停止。關鍵是，當過去的經驗被回憶並重新整合到當前工作中時，它們會與新經驗一起經歷隨後的鞏固，從而被加強、補充和更新。通過這種使用與不使用的記憶動態，Hippocam將工作上下文、長期記憶、知識積累和技能學習連接在一個不斷演變的經驗過程中。這使得代理能夠通過自身的經驗學習和發展能力，而無需參數更新。

docs.title: Using Weisfeiler-Leman Features for Algorithm Selection in Constraint Optimisation
docs.text:
2610.12119v1 by Alessio Pellegrino, Jacopo Mauro

Algorithm Selection is essential for efficient Constraint Programming. Over the years, many algorithm selectors based on machine learning methods have been successfully applied, yet traditional feature extraction methods often rely on manually decided instance-level statistics that fail to capture the underlying problem structure. In this paper we aim to bridge this gap by introducing a novel, automated feature extraction methodology that integrates graph conversion and Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernels to generate robust structural representations of problem instances. The 1-WL test bounds the graph-distinguishing power of standard message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and suitable GNN architectures match this bound \citep{Xuetal2018}. WL-based features offer an alternative that does not require training a GNN. Our primary contribution is a cut-based representation (\texttt{WLc}) designed to model structural partitions and provide a more nuanced predictive signal. We evaluate our approach on instances from the 2023--2025 MiniZinc Challenges across two tasks: maximizing Borda count scores and maximizing predictive accuracy. Experimental results across Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and Multi-Layer Perceptrons demonstrate that cut-based features outperform \texttt{fzn2feat} with SVMs, while results with RFs and MLPs are closer.

摘要：算法選擇對於高效的約束編程至關重要。多年來，許多基於機器學習方法的算法選擇器已成功應用，然而傳統的特徵提取方法往往依賴於手動決定的實例級統計，這無法捕捉潛在的問題結構。在本文中，我們旨在填補這一空白，通過引入一種新穎的自動化特徵提取方法，該方法整合了圖轉換和Weisfeiler-Lehman圖核，以生成問題實例的穩健結構表示。1-WL測試界定了標準消息傳遞圖神經網絡（GNNs）的圖區分能力，而合適的GNN架構符合這一界限\citep{Xuetal2018}。基於WL的特徵提供了一種不需要訓練GNN的替代方案。我們的主要貢獻是一種基於切割的表示（\texttt{WLc}），旨在建模結構分區並提供更細緻的預測信號。我們在2023-2025年MiniZinc挑戰賽中的實例上評估我們的方法，涵蓋兩個任務：最大化Borda計數分數和最大化預測準確性。在支持向量機、隨機森林和多層感知機上的實驗結果顯示，基於切割的特徵在SVM中優於\texttt{fzn2feat}，而在RF和MLP中的結果則更接近。

docs.title: Universal Textual Teaching for LLMs
docs.text:
2610.12114v1 by Zhanyi Lu, Huan Wang

Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret or reuse across models and limits KD for API-only or costly-to-train models. This paper studies knowledge transfer for large language models (LLMs). We introduce Universal Textual Teaching (UTT), a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into a textual, interpretable, and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer. Specifically, UTT first identifies representative gap cases through paired evaluations, and iteratively updates the Primer via multi-role interactions: the Student attempts each task, the Prompter turns evaluation feedback into a teaching instruction, the Teacher provides a targeted demonstration, and the Synthesizer consolidates validated lessons. Empirically, on the challenging math (Omni-MATH-2) and code generation (KernelBench) tasks, extensive results confirm the effectiveness of the method: UTT remarkably raises the Student's accuracy from 9.4% to 48.6% and Fast1 accuracy from 9% to 35% on KernelBench, while increasing mathematical reasoning accuracy from 27.6% to 51.7%. UTT also performs better than representative prompt engineering and parameter-based KD methods. Of note, UTT is shown to be generalizable across different Teachers and Students: a Primer synthesized for one Teacher-Student pair can generalize to other Students that do not participate in the synthesis.

摘要：知識蒸餾（KD）將知識從更強大的教師模型轉移到較弱的學生模型，但大多數方法需要訓練學生參數，從而將蒸餾的知識綁定到特定的架構和檢查點。這種隱式表示難以解釋或在模型之間重用，並限制了僅限於API或訓練成本高的模型的KD。本文研究大型語言模型（LLMs）的知識轉移。我們介紹了通用文本教學（UTT），這是一個無需參數更新的框架，將觀察到的教師-學生知識差距蒸餾為一種可解釋且可重用的自然語言工件，稱為Primer。具體而言，UTT首先通過配對評估識別代表性的差距案例，並通過多角色互動迭代更新Primer：學生嘗試每個任務，提示者將評估反饋轉化為教學指令，教師提供針對性的示範，而合成者整合驗證的教訓。在具有挑戰性的數學（Omni-MATH-2）和代碼生成（KernelBench）任務上，實證結果確認了該方法的有效性：UTT顯著將學生的準確率從9.4%提高到48.6%，並將KernelBench上的Fast1準確率從9%提高到35%，同時將數學推理準確率從27.6%提高到51.7%。UTT的表現也優於代表性的提示工程和基於參數的KD方法。值得注意的是，UTT被證明在不同的教師和學生之間具有可泛化性：為一對教師-學生合成的Primer可以泛化到其他未參與合成的學生。

docs.title: ILM: An AI-Powered Storytelling Educational Tool
docs.text:
2610.12064v1 by Suhaila Mohammed, Abdelaziz Serour, Allison Lahnala

Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.

摘要：數位技術使伊斯蘭敘事變得更易於獲取，但現有平台對於結構化學習和理解這些故事的支持有限，特別是在阿拉伯語和多語言環境中。我們提出了ILM，一個針對先知故事的互動教育平台，結合了阿拉伯語自然語言處理、結構化知識表示和基於檢索的問題生成。經管理員批准的阿拉伯語敘事由知識圖譜(KG)構建引擎處理，該引擎識別實體和敘事關係，並將其存儲為結構化知識，使學習者能夠通過可視化故事地圖探索故事，並回答從KG生成的基於實體和關係的問題。另設有多語言檢索管道，從原始敘事中檢索相關段落，以生成多選和開放式理解問題。對於開放式問題，LLM作為評審，根據檢索到的段落和參考答案評估學習者的回答以確定正確性。該平台還將可蘭經內容作為單獨的豐富層納入，允許選定的敘事補充來源支持的信息。通過將結構化知識與基於段落的檢索相結合，ILM支持阿拉伯語和多語言內容的敘事探索、理解和評估。該系統展示了結構化知識表示和基於檢索的生成相結合以支持伊斯蘭敘事互動學習的可行性。演示版可在anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF獲得。

docs.title: MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation
docs.text:
2610.12039v1 by Mahtab Sarvmaili

Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.

摘要：圖神經網絡（GNNs）從化學圖數據中預測分子性質，但預測準確性並未解釋圖信息如何支持個別決策。緊湊的預測保留理由不一定能揭示哪些變更會逆轉決策或模型能容忍哪些修改。我們提出了多角度圖解釋器（MPGE），統一事實支持、反事實敏感性和樣本容忍度，針對一個固定的分類器。事實視角，最初稱為原型（PT），尋求一組緊湊的保留邊集，具有相同的標籤和所需的信心。反事實（CF）解釋尋求有限的改變預測的刪除；樣本（EXE）解釋尋求保留標籤和信心的非平凡有限刪除。共享的約束公式連接預測行為、緊湊性和編輯成本，而單獨的目標生成這三種視角。我們的CF-GNNExplainer的圖分類擴展學習對稱邊排名並驗證離散候選，記錄不成功的搜索。單獨的 BBBP 片段後端返回經過RDKit清理的分子。我們在MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD和BBBP上評估主要的GCN實現，使用語義覆蓋、條件質量、穩定性和運行時間。成功的事實掩碼在各數據集上平均保留了8.6%--15.5%的輸入邊；有限的反事實覆蓋率為4.8%--67.6%，樣本保留覆蓋率為98.9%--100.0%。探索性控制揭示了硬投影和保留節點信息的影響。定量比較和分子可視化特徵化模型支持、敏感性和容忍度，而不將其視為經過驗證的化學機制。

docs.title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
docs.text:
2610.11978v1 by Xing Li, Qingcheng Chang, Jinzhong Ning, Changfeng Xu, Shenlong Zhang, Yijia Zhang, Ling Luo, Hongfei Lin

Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.

摘要：Jev是一個「系統一」模型，它在給定選項中返回一個選擇，而不是生成文本。我們研究這種專門的決策模型與通用大型語言模型（LLMs）之間的比較。我們在涵蓋知識、推理和多語言理解的13個選擇題基準上評估Jev，並將其與19個LLMs進行比較，分為三個層級：前沿、代表性和小型。Jev在知識和常識基準上與前沿LLMs具有競爭力，並在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上獲得最佳分數。在數學以外的領域，它的表現也超過了大多數代表性LLMs和所有小型LLMs。然而，在數學文字題上，它的表現不如人意：在MathQA上，它比前沿中位數低17.7分，並且得分低於所有19個LLMs。這些結果表明，專門的決策模型可以在主要依賴知識的決策上與通用LLMs匹敵，但在需要多步計算的決策上則不然。

docs.title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
docs.text:
2610.11966v1 by Mengdi Liu, Wenjue Chen, Wenyue Chen, Cheng Yang, Fanqi Kong, Zhangyang Gao, Xiaoxue Cheng, Yiheng Li, Yujian Yuan, Keliang Li, Hong Chang, Shiguang Shan, Chenglin Wu

Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.

摘要：研究想法創新是科學進步的基本引擎，但在可擴展和可控的方式下生成和評估仍然困難。這一挑戰在於其固有的開放性和多目標性質，想法應該平衡新穎性、合理性和可行性。儘管最近基於大型語言模型的方法通過精心設計的提示或代理管道取得了進展，但它們受到預定義的靜態創意工作流程的限制。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了MindFlow，一個明確將創意表述為心智中的圖結構流的框架，該框架由模塊化思維運算符組成，並由概率心智超網絡建模。給定一個研究主題，控制器動態地抽樣思維流以生成候選想法。這一開放性問題通過基於比賽的相對排名進行優化，使控制器能夠逐步偏好更高質量的思維流。我們進一步引入了一種評估協議，聯合評估問題發現和問題解決，超越僅基於標題或摘要的判斷。在多樣的主題中，MindFlow顯示出其作為一個明確、可控和可優化的研究想法創新者的優越性。

docs.title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
docs.text:
2610.11920v1 by Yichen Liu, Chunfeng Yuan, Haowei Liu, Wenjuan Li, Zefeng Lin, Bing Li, Xu Chen, Weiming Hu

For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories. To address these limitations, we propose QGMem, a novel memory construction and activation framework motivated by human memory, in which experience is organized into events and query-relevant events are modeled by graph as working memory. QGMem converts long dialogue histories into event-indexed atomic memory units that preserve individual experiences and consolidates related units into dynamic memory traces that retain state trajectories and current states. When a query arrives, hybrid memory retrieval gathers complementary candidate memories, and query-aware reranking activates the most relevant units as a compact working memory. To expose relational dependencies in the working memory and support conflict-aware reasoning, QGMem organizes the working memory as a local graph, which is then encoded as a graph token and provided to the LLM together with the textual working memory to improve evidence utilization during answer generation. Experiments across six benchmarks validate the framework and show consistent gains in retrieval, multi-hop evidence composition, conflict resolution, and ultra-long dialogue reasoning with compact contexts and moderate inference cost.

摘要：對於持久且個性化的對話代理，記憶系統可以使它們通過存儲過去的互動和檢索相關信息來記住、更新和推理長期歷史。現有的記憶系統通常遵循兩種範式：平面結構記憶和基於圖的記憶。前者輕量級，但使事件關係和狀態更新隱含，而後者則明確建模記憶結構，但會產生額外的構建成本並引入長期歷史中的無關關係。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了QGMem，一個受到人類記憶啟發的創新記憶構建和激活框架，其中經驗被組織成事件，並通過圖模型化查詢相關事件作為工作記憶。QGMem將長對話歷史轉換為事件索引的原子記憶單元，這些單元保留個體經驗，並將相關單元整合成動態記憶痕跡，以保持狀態軌跡和當前狀態。當查詢到達時，混合記憶檢索收集互補的候選記憶，而查詢感知的重新排序激活最相關的單元作為緊湊的工作記憶。為了揭示工作記憶中的關係依賴並支持衝突感知推理，QGMem將工作記憶組織為一個局部圖，然後將其編碼為圖令牌，並與文本工作記憶一起提供給LLM，以改善在生成答案過程中的證據利用。跨越六個基準的實驗驗證了該框架，並顯示在檢索、多跳證據組合、衝突解決和超長對話推理方面的一致增益，具有緊湊的上下文和適度的推理成本。

docs.title: Not Every Change Is Necessary: Recoverable Drift in Large Language Model Unlearning
docs.text:
2610.11915v1 by Xunlei Chen, Qinghui Gong, Jingkun Xue, Qihe Liu, Shijie Zhou, Fei Ye
