摘要：程式驗證通過在定理證明器中構建機器可檢查的證明來確立軟體的正確性。這對於由大型語言模型（LLMs）生成的程式碼特別有價值，因為這些程式碼流暢但不保證正確性。然而，幾乎所有現有的證明器都僅追求通過率，無論需要多少抽樣或搜尋預算，並忽略了成功與成本的邊界；然而，實際的軟體通常承擔數百個相互依賴的證明義務，因此在規模上重要的不是某個定理是否可以被證明，而是有多少可以經濟地被證明。我們介紹了 CoCo-Prover，它將成本效益的程式證明形式化為基於成本的元層決策，基於兩級證明圖：每個聲明內的 AND/OR 證明超圖與跨聲明的引理依賴圖相連；在每一步，它回答兩個問題：選擇哪些開放目標，以及對這些目標購買哪些行動。選擇保持符號化，作為對證明圖的拓撲通過。行動選擇是通過元層決策進行的代理協調：一個代理路由器將每個有限的專家調用視為單獨定價的最佳努力計算，根據證據的累積，將異質專家代理與配置相匹配，遵循演變的路由規則。在 Lean 4 中的五個程式驗證基準，包括函數級 CLEVER、VERINA 和 AlgoVeri，以及庫級 NTP4VC 和 Vero，我們顯示 CoCo-Prover 在成功與成本的邊界上達到了比基準更好的表現，包括邊界編碼代理和最先進的基於 LLM 的證明器：它在每個基準上達到了最佳解決率，在兩個基準上達到高達 100%。與我們評估中最強的基準和最強的 LLM 相比，它還將成本降低了高達 30.9%。

docs.title: Alice: A Large-Scale German Benchmark for Rubric-Based Multi-Dimensional Automatic Short Answer Scoring
docs.text:
2610.09661v1 by Zhifan Sun, Sebastian Gombert, Jannik Lossjew, Tobias Wyrwich, Berrit Katharina Czinczel, David Bednorz, Marcus Kubsch, Knut Neumann, Hendrik Drachsler

Automatic Short Answer Scoring (ASAS) is central to NLP for Education. However, openly available benchmarks remain scarce, and existing datasets largely address how well students answer a question directly rather than how well they master underlying concepts (knowledge elements) such as thermal energy or epistemic activities (skills) such as reasoning or claim. To address this gap, we introduce Alice, a large-scale, rubric-based German ASAS dataset that is pedagogically aligned and comprises three subtasks: (i) learning performance (Alice-LP), (ii) knowledge elements (Alice-KE), and (iii) skills (Alice-SK). We further formulate rubric-based ASAS as a rubric-retrieval task and benchmark the dataset with a range of language models, from encoder-only models to lightweight LLMs. We also benchmark the dataset with zero-shot prompting via LLMs and a standard classification baseline. The experiments show that LLMs, in particular, struggle to score knowledge elements and skills in the zero-shot setting. They also indicate that rubric text is often useful, especially for Alice-KE and Alice-SK, while on Alice-LP gains over sample-solution-focused inputs are more modest and vary by model and input format.

摘要：自動短答案評分（ASAS）對於教育中的自然語言處理至關重要。然而，公開可用的基準仍然稀少，現有數據集主要關注學生如何直接回答問題，而不是他們如何掌握基礎概念（知識元素），例如熱能或認知活動（技能），例如推理或主張。為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了Alice，一個大規模、基於評分標準的德語ASAS數據集，該數據集在教學上是對齊的，並包含三個子任務：（i）學習表現（Alice-LP），（ii）知識元素（Alice-KE），以及（iii）技能（Alice-SK）。我們進一步將基於評分標準的ASAS公式化為一個評分標準檢索任務，並使用一系列語言模型對數據集進行基準測試，從僅編碼模型到輕量級LLMs。我們還通過LLMs和標準分類基線對數據集進行零樣本提示的基準測試。實驗顯示，LLMs，特別是在零樣本設置中，對於評分知識元素和技能存在困難。它們還表明，評分標準文本通常是有用的，特別是對於Alice-KE和Alice-SK，而在Alice-LP上，相較於以樣本解決方案為重點的輸入所帶來的增益則較為謹慎，並且因模型和輸入格式而異。

docs.title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
docs.text:
2610.09644v1 by Alexis Beer, Liudmyla Klochko, Mathieu d'Aquin

Complementing the many efforts in providing semantic representations of concepts, notions, and entities in materials science, we report and illustrate a process by which we can automatically build a knowledge graph of the fast evolving field of machine learning applied to the prediction of material properties, focusing on MLIP (Machine Learning Interatomic Potential). This LLM-based process relies on multiple steps, from information extraction in documents and articles to a validation loop using SHACL constraints to detect and correct errors. It is carried out on a model-by-model basis, focusing on the consistency of representation, therefore enabling an iterative construction where the addition of new models is facilitated. We illustrate the process by showing a few interesting aspects that can be queried from a knowledge graph built from the models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard.

摘要：補充在材料科學中提供概念、觀念和實體的語義表示的眾多努力，我們報告並說明了一個過程，通過這個過程我們可以自動構建一個快速發展的機器學習領域的知識圖譜，該領域應用於材料性質的預測，重點是MLIP（機器學習原子間勢）。這個基於LLM的過程依賴於多個步驟，從文檔和文章中的信息提取到使用SHACL約束進行的驗證循環，以檢測和修正錯誤。這是在模型逐個基礎上進行的，重點是表示的一致性，因此使得新模型的添加變得更加方便，從而實現了迭代構建。我們通過展示一些可以從根據Matbench Discovery排行榜中列出的模型構建的知識圖譜中查詢的有趣方面來說明這一過程。

docs.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
docs.text:
2610.09643v1 by Gabriel Ocana-Santero, Marko Tvrdic

Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

摘要：藥物發現對於神經疾病傳統上集中於疾病所改變的分子。但導致病理的分子不一定是逆轉病理的最佳切入點。在此，我們探討哪些未被改變的分子控制點可以被利用來恢復病理神經迴路至功能狀態。我們提出了CircuitATLAS，一個基於來源的系統神經科學知識圖譜和目標發現的代理框架，專注於迴路病。它結構化了跨疾病、表型、電生理學、迴路、大腦區域、細胞類型和分子效應者的文獻衍生關係，同時故意排除直接的疾病-基因和疾病-蛋白質邊緣，以減少捷徑推理。該圖譜包含383萬個節點和766萬條邊，包括531萬個LLM提取的關係，並整合了結構化數據集，如人類細胞圖譜和新的多模態體內測量。我們接著介紹了一個代理工作流程，從可測量的疾病表型推理到它們的迴路和細胞基質，再到分子干預、治療可行性和臨床限制。最後，我們介紹了一個由人類主導的體內實驗室循環，將假設生成與實驗迭代聯繫起來。在這個框架內，一個代理提名ATP1A3，即神經元alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase，作為皮層興奮性的控制點；ATP1A3的抑制性神經元特異性表達在體內消除了對局部4-氨基吡啶挑戰的β和γ波反應，然後將經過驗證的目標帶入結構引導的小分子篩選，最終在一個定義的測定中解決調節的方向。因此，CircuitATLAS提供了一個發現治療藥物的框架，不僅基於疾病中分子上所受到的干擾，還基於可以控制以恢復迴路功能的內容。

docs.title: On-Policy Distillation Teaches New Skills but Not New Knowledge
docs.text:
2610.09639v1 by Yixuan Tang, Yi Yang

On-policy distillation (OPD) strengthens language-model reasoning, yet whether students acquire new factual knowledge or compositional skill for multi-step reasoning remains unknown. We separate these capabilities using a controlled synthetic framework that measures the student's initial capabilities and independently controls the teacher's additional facts, compositional skill, or both. Across four models from three families, reverse-KL OPD reliably transfers compositional skill across unseen reasoning structures, but transfers minimal factual knowledge. Decoupling the distillation recipe reveals the source of this asymmetry: replacing reverse KL with forward KL restores factual transfer, whereas student rollouts specifically improve the execution of multi-step reasoning. Experiments on recent factual QA and competition mathematics show a similar asymmetry under reverse-KL OPD, yielding notable reasoning gains without factual memory expansion. Together, these results demonstrate that on-policy distillation does not expand a model's parametric knowledge, but instead teaches it to organize and compose the knowledge it already possesses.

摘要：在政策蒸餾（OPD）中加強了語言模型的推理能力，但學生是否獲得了新的事實知識或多步推理的組合技能仍然未知。我們使用一個受控的合成框架來區分這些能力，該框架測量學生的初始能力並獨立控制教師的附加事實、組合技能或兩者。 在來自三個家族的四個模型中，反向KL OPD可靠地在未見的推理結構中轉移組合技能，但轉移的事實知識非常有限。 解耦蒸餾配方揭示了這種不對稱的來源：用正向KL替換反向KL可以恢復事實轉移，而學生的展開則特別改善了多步推理的執行。 在最近的事實問答和競賽數學實驗中，反向KL OPD下顯示出類似的不對稱，產生顯著的推理增益而不擴展事實記憶。 總體而言，這些結果表明，政策蒸餾並不擴展模型的參數知識，而是教會它組織和組合它已經擁有的知識。

docs.title: Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents
docs.text:
2610.09590v1 by Hong Su

Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.

摘要：長期運行的自主代理必須重用累積的推理經驗，而不允許明確的歷史記憶和大型語言模型的上下文無限制地增長。然後，現有的記憶機制主要是檢索、總結或壓縮過去的內容，並不直接學習何時應該啟動特定類型的思維，或從時間上分散的經驗中發現新的思維知識。本文提出了一種情境條件的思維記憶框架，將歷史推理經驗轉化為一種輕量級策略，以預測在當前情境中應該思考什麼，同時將詳細的推理留給大型語言模型。情境可以表示時間或時空的演變，而不僅僅是當前狀態。臨時經驗也會定期在多個獨立的情節中進行分析，以識別重複的長期規律，這些規律被整合為新的思維知識，並進一步被輕量級策略內化。實驗顯示，所學習的策略在時間規則泛化上達到1.000 F1，將DeepSeek推理的F1從0.789提高到0.868，將在線處理時間從每個查詢0.3636毫秒減少到0.0382毫秒，並在足夠的重複交叉經驗證據後達到1.000的關係發現F1和未來思考準確率。

docs.title: World Potential Model: Pretrained World Knowledge as Progress Potentials
docs.text:
2610.09560v1 by Jun Zhao, Jixin Tang, Yang Shu, Jinyang Wu, Yuyang Lu, Jingqi Tong, Hao Xu, Weifeng Ge, Qi Zhang

Long-horizon language agents often receive supervision only from terminal task outcomes, leaving little signal for distinguishing productive intermediate behavior from stagnation or even regression. Rather than learning a separate value function or process reward model for every task, we ask whether pretrained models can recognize task progress from their existing world knowledge. We formalize this capability with a World Potential Model (WPM), a goal-conditioned evaluator of task-relative realized progress in agent contexts. In ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, off-the-shelf pretrained models substantially outperform chance at recovering realized-progress structure without task-specific evaluator fine-tuning. We further anchor these progress judgments to task-specific milestones to obtain scalar world potentials, whose temporal differences provide process-sensitive step-level credit for policy optimization. Under matched comparisons, WPM-guided optimization improves success over outcome-only GRPO across all evaluated configurations. Together, these results provide initial evidence that pretrained world knowledge can support reusable realized-progress evaluation and provide useful supervision for long-horizon agents.

摘要：長期語言代理通常僅從最終任務結果中獲得監督，這使得區分有生產力的中間行為與停滯甚至退步的信號變得微乎其微。與其為每個任務學習一個單獨的價值函數或過程獎勵模型，我們詢問預訓練模型是否能夠從其現有的世界知識中識別任務進展。我們用世界潛力模型（WPM）形式化這一能力，這是一種基於目標的評估器，用於評估代理上下文中任務相對的實現進展。在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 中，現成的預訓練模型在恢復實現進展結構方面顯著超越隨機機會，而無需針對特定任務的評估器微調。我們進一步將這些進展判斷錨定到特定任務的里程碑，以獲得標量世界潛力，其時間差提供了對政策優化的過程敏感的步驟級信用。在匹配比較下，WPM 引導的優化在所有評估配置中改善了相較於僅基於結果的 GRPO 的成功率。綜合這些結果，初步證據表明預訓練的世界知識可以支持可重用的實現進展評估，並為長期代理提供有用的監督。

docs.title: Abstracts
ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
docs.text:
2610.12386v1 by Gokul Puthumanaillam, Tao Sun, Elie Aljalbout, Moritz Reuss, Zhaoshuo Li, Fabio Ramos, Ankit Goyal, Jenai Xuning Yang

The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

摘要：目前改善機器人基礎模型（RFM）的主流方法依賴於更大的模型、更多的機器人示範以及昂貴的大規模訓練。我們展示了一種有效且高效的互補方法：正確的推理配方可以顯著提高現有最先進RFM的零次任務表現。我們將這個配方稱為ARC。它由三個關鍵成分組成：推理痕跡、一個可擴展的自動標記管道，以及一種將預訓練RFM適應以使用這些痕跡進行控制的策略。首先，我們發現有效的推理痕跡應該基於機器人的下一個行動並解釋其因果結構：為什麼這個行動是合適的以及它應該產生什麼效果。其次，我們展示這些痕跡可以從現有的示範中自動生成，使我們能夠從DROID構建ARC-Trace-DROID，而無需收集新的機器人數據。第三，我們展示了最先進的VLA（視覺語言模型）如$π_{0.5}$和WAM（行為模型）如Cosmos3-Nano-Policy如何學會使用這些痕跡進行控制，並根據每個模型的架構和能力進行微調和推理。使用ARC，我們在零次RFM表現上獲得了前所未有的增益，據我們所知，這些增益是在沒有額外機器人示範或基礎規模訓練的情況下取得的。經過適應的模型在RoboLab-120和MolmoSpaces上建立了新的最先進紀錄，在RoboLab-Reasoning-50上獲得了高達50個百分點的增益。在真實機器人上，ARC使得$π_{0.5}$的任務成功率提高了82.2個百分點。項目網站：https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

docs.title: An Investigation of Model Coherence: Narrow Finetunes Contradict Themselves Under Resampling
docs.text:
2610.12129v1 by Robert Graham, Yariv Barsheshat, Phil Blandfort, Sabri Alouache

A large body of research measures model coherence based on output variance without adequately considering competing causes. We identify two such causes, ambiguity and indifference, and we introduce a set of 175 questions where contradicting answers cannot easily be explained by either. We then measure incoherence in terms of contradictions when resampling answers to the same question. In contrast to other methods our metric has high specificity, and only ranks models as incoherent when the issues are glaring. Even so, we find narrow finetunes score poorly. Inspecting inconsistencies flagged by our method, we find that model organisms from the literature display severe issues such as identity conflation, introspection failures and rationalizations. These findings suggest that the pathologies induced by narrow finetuning may limit what these models can tell us about coherent misaligned behaviour.

摘要：大量研究基於輸出變異性來衡量模型的一致性，但未充分考慮競爭性原因。我們確定了兩個這樣的原因，模糊性和漠不關心，並引入了一組175個問題，其中矛盾的答案無法輕易解釋。我們然後在重新抽樣對同一問題的答案時，以矛盾的形式衡量不一致性。與其他方法相比，我們的指標具有高特異性，僅在問題明顯時才將模型評為不一致。即便如此，我們發現狹窄的微調得分不佳。檢查我們的方法標記的不一致性時，我們發現文獻中的模型生物體顯示出嚴重問題，例如身份混淆、自省失敗和合理化。這些發現表明，狹窄微調引發的病理可能限制了這些模型能告訴我們的關於一致的錯位行為的資訊。

docs.title: MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation
docs.text:
2610.12039v1 by Mahtab Sarvmaili

Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.

摘要：圖神經網絡（GNNs）從化學圖數據中預測分子性質，但預測準確性並未解釋圖信息如何支持個別決策。緊湊的預測保留理由不一定能揭示哪些變更會逆轉決策或模型能容忍哪些修改。我們提出了多角度圖解釋器（MPGE），統一事實支持、反事實敏感性和樣本容忍度，針對一個固定的分類器。事實視角，最初稱為原型（PT），尋求一組緊湊的保留邊集，具有相同的標籤和所需的信心。反事實（CF）解釋尋求有限的改變預測的刪除；樣本（EXE）解釋尋求保留標籤和信心的非平凡有限刪除。共享的約束公式連接預測行為、緊湊性和編輯成本，而單獨的目標生成這三種視角。我們的CF-GNNExplainer的圖分類擴展學習對稱邊排名並驗證離散候選，記錄不成功的搜索。單獨的 BBBP 片段後端返回經過RDKit清理的分子。我們在MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD和BBBP上評估主要的GCN實現，使用語義覆蓋、條件質量、穩定性和運行時間。成功的事實掩碼在各數據集上平均保留了8.6%--15.5%的輸入邊；有限的反事實覆蓋率為4.8%--67.6%，樣本保留覆蓋率為98.9%--100.0%。探索性控制揭示了硬投影和保留節點信息的影響。定量比較和分子可視化特徵化模型支持、敏感性和容忍度，而不將其視為經過驗證的化學機制。

docs.title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
docs.text:
2610.12026v1 by Yan Yang, Jikun Rong, Minzhao Zhu, Zheyi Zhao, Qirui Hu, Zihan Lan, Weixin Mao, Yinhao Li, Zhen Fu, Hua Chen

Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.

摘要：人形機器人是一個有前景的通用操作平台。最近的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）政策直接從多模態觀察中學習行動，而世界行動模型（WAM）進一步結合未來視覺預測來改善行動生成。然而，在層次化的人形系統中，VLA 和 WAM 政策輸出參考行動，這些行動隨後通過全身控制、機器人動力學、平衡和接觸來實現。這種層次結構創造了一個行動與執行之間的差距：政策產生的參考可能與機器人實現的運動不同。如果不明確建模實現的身體狀態，未來的視覺預測必須共同解釋場景演變以及參考行動與執行運動之間的差異，這使得將行動與其物理結果聯繫起來變得困難。我們提出 HWAM，一種具有聯合狀態-行動生成的人形世界行動模型，將機器人在執行後的本體感知狀態作為明確的預測目標。通過聯合生成參考行動及其實現的身體狀態，HWAM 直接將執行運動的監督納入行動學習。HWAM 通過三條互補的條件路徑進行訓練。政策路徑僅根據當前觀察共同去噪狀態-行動軌跡，匹配部署條件。前向動力學建模（FDM）預測基於行動和執行後狀態的未來視覺觀察，而逆向動力學建模（IDM）則從視覺轉換中重建關節軌跡。這些路徑共同連接政策參考、實現的身體運動和視覺結果。在 LimX OLI 人形機器人的三個真實機器人任務中，HWAM 在評估的基準中達到了最高的成功率。在糖果採摘任務中，HWAM 的成功率為 70.6%，而 Fast-WAM 為 43.3%。

docs.title: The Polytopal Neural Network
docs.text:
2610.12004v1 by A. Emilie J. Wedenborg, Anders V. Nørskov, Teresa Dorszewski, Kristoffer Wickstrøm, Morten Mørup

Understanding how deep neural networks process information remains a central challenge. Existing interpretability methods often compromise structural fidelity, rely on prespecified corpora, or explain models post-hoc. We propose Polytopal Neural Networks (PNNs), a framework that extracts distinct layer-wise aspects by enforcing a polytope-based structure that is used directly in subsequent information processing. We scale our approach using learned corpus representations and an amortized simplex inference procedure and highlight how the framework also gives a direct route to vector quantized (VQ) training. In PNNs, observations are explicitly described by their alignment with layer-specific aspects. Empirical results show that imposing polytopal constraints on neural network representations preserves meaningful structures in the latent space with minimal degradation in performance, favorable compressed representations when compared to VQ representations in unsupervised learning, while also providing a performant new approach to VQ deep learning training. Our findings suggest that deep networks can enforce interpretable polytope-based representations, offering a principled path toward more transparent AI systems with minimal performance compromise.

摘要：理解深度神經網絡如何處理信息仍然是一個核心挑戰。現有的可解釋性方法往往妥協於結構的真實性，依賴於預先指定的語料庫，或在事後解釋模型。我們提出了多面體神經網絡（PNNs），這是一個通過強制基於多面體的結構來提取不同層級方面的框架，該結構直接用於隨後的信息處理。我們使用學習到的語料表示和攤銷的單純形推理程序來擴展我們的方法，並強調該框架也為向量量化（VQ）訓練提供了一條直接的途徑。在PNNs中，觀察結果明確地通過與層特定方面的對齊來描述。實證結果顯示，對神經網絡表示施加多面體約束能夠在潛在空間中保留有意義的結構，性能降級最小，與無監督學習中的VQ表示相比，提供了有利的壓縮表示，同時也為VQ深度學習訓練提供了一種高效的新方法。我們的發現表明，深度網絡可以強制執行可解釋的基於多面體的表示，為更透明的人工智能系統提供了一條原則性的道路，並且性能損失最小。

docs.title: From Surface to Depth: Towards Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning in Multimodal Emotion Understanding
docs.text:
2610.11918v1 by Jia Li, Yichao He, Yangchen Yu, Qiankun Li, Xinyi Li, Baiyi Ye, Zhenzhen Hu, Richang Hong, Erik Cambria

Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly incorporate explainable reasoning for emotion understanding. However, reasoning based mainly on observable affective cues can reduce emotion understanding to superficial cue-label associations, giving rise to the Clever Hans effect. Such shortcuts become unreliable when affective cues are implicit, conflicting across modalities, linguistically misleading, or obscured by redundant details. In contrast, human emotions are shaped by how individuals interpret and evaluate surrounding events beyond observable cues. Inspired by appraisal theories of emotion, we formulate multimodal emotion understanding as a progression from perception to cognitive appraisal, and introduce a dataset, a model, and a benchmark to support this novel paradigm. CogEmo-40K is a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset constructed through a perception-to-appraisal pipeline to elicit evidence-grounded reasoning across six cognitive appraisal dimensions underlying emotion. CogEmo-MoE is a compact sparse MLLM that introduces interleaved MoE blocks for appraisal-specific adaptation, enabling effective appraisal reasoning at a substantially smaller scale than typical emotion MLLMs. CogEmo-Bench introduces an Appraisal Evidence Quality Score (AEQS) to assess cognitive-affective understanding across six complementary appraisal dimensions, addressing the limitation of conventional emotion metrics that evaluate what emotion is predicted but not why it arises. Extensive experiments show that our paradigm not only leads CogEmo-Bench, but also exhibits strong cross-domain generalization. Our findings suggest that perception-to-appraisal reasoning can move beyond surface-level cue-label associations toward more reliable multimodal emotion understanding and closer cognitive alignment between MLLMs and humans.

摘要：最近的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）越來越多地融入可解釋的推理來理解情感。然而，主要基於可觀察的情感線索進行推理可能會將情感理解簡化為表面上的線索-標籤關聯，從而產生聰明漢斯效應。當情感線索隱含、跨模態衝突、語言上具有誤導性或被冗餘細節掩蓋時，這種捷徑變得不可靠。相對而言，人類情感受到個體如何解釋和評估周圍事件的影響，超越可觀察的線索。受到情感評價理論的啟發，我們將多模態情感理解構建為從感知到認知評價的進程，並引入一個數據集、一個模型和一個基準來支持這一新穎的範式。CogEmo-40K是一個大型指令調整數據集，通過感知到評價的管道構建，以引發基於證據的推理，涵蓋情感背後的六個認知評價維度。CogEmo-MoE是一個緊湊的稀疏MLLM，為評價特定的適應引入交錯的MoE區塊，使得在比典型情感MLLM更小的規模上實現有效的評價推理。CogEmo-Bench引入了一個評價證據質量分數（AEQS），以評估六個互補評價維度中的認知-情感理解，解決了傳統情感指標的局限性，這些指標評估預測了什麼情感，但並不解釋為什麼會產生。廣泛的實驗顯示，我們的範式不僅引領了CogEmo-Bench，還展現了強大的跨領域泛化能力。我們的研究結果表明，感知到評價的推理可以超越表面層的線索-標籤關聯，朝向更可靠的多模態情感理解，以及MLLM與人類之間更緊密的認知對齊。

docs.title: How Is Automated Research Evaluated? A Survey of Benchmarks and Evaluation Practices
docs.text:
2610.11877v1 by Liulei Zhang, Dejing Zhou, Chuyue Huang, Guanhua Chen, Yutong Yao, Lidia S. Chao, Chi Man Vong, Derek F. Wong

Automated research systems support literature synthesis, ideation, experiments, writing, and peer review, but their evaluation is dispersed across tasks, benchmarks, and studies that are difficult to compare directly. We review this literature from the perspective of evaluation design and evidence, covering six targets: literature synthesis, research ideation, executable workflows, scholarly writing and communication, automatic peer review, and end-to-end research. We compare task construction, evidence sources, evaluators, and scoring procedures to explain the capabilities assessed by different designs. Our synthesis highlights three recurring lessons: output checks, process checks, and human studies provide complementary information; evaluator calibration is specific to the property being assessed; and resource budgets and attempt selection are integral to interpreting performance comparisons. We identify diagnostic evaluation designs and documented gaps in supporting evidence, and translate these comparisons into reporting and audit recommendations for specific evaluation settings. The survey helps readers navigate existing evaluations, select appropriate benchmarks, and design subsequent studies.

摘要：自動化研究系統支持文獻綜述、創意發想、實驗、寫作和同行評審，但其評估分散在各種任務、基準和難以直接比較的研究中。我們從評估設計和證據的角度回顧這些文獻，涵蓋六個目標：文獻綜述、研究創意、可執行工作流程、學術寫作與交流、自動同行評審，以及端到端研究。我們比較任務構建、證據來源、評估者和評分程序，以解釋不同設計所評估的能力。我們的綜述突顯出三個重複出現的教訓：輸出檢查、過程檢查和人類研究提供互補信息；評估者的校準特定於所評估的屬性；資源預算和嘗試選擇對於解釋性能比較至關重要。我們識別出診斷評估設計和支持證據中的文檔缺口，並將這些比較轉化為特定評估環境的報告和審計建議。這項調查幫助讀者導航現有評估，選擇適當的基準，並設計後續研究。

docs.title: Probability-Signature Dynamics: Unpacking Modular Addition Learning Within Two-Layer Networks
docs.text:
2610.11833v1 by Yunji Wang, Junjie Yao, Linyu Liu, Pinyan Lu, Zhi-Qin John Xu

Neural networks trained on modular addition tasks often develop Fourier-structured representations that support exact generalization. While prior work has identified these Fourier circuits, the mechanism by which gradient-based training selects them from the data distribution remains unclear. We address this question using probability signatures, which express leading gradient interactions through conditional statistics of the training distribution. For modular addition, these signatures are cyclic shift operators and are diagonalized by the discrete Fourier transform, yielding approximately decoupled Fourier-mode dynamics. This explains the emergence of Fourier sparsity, frequency matching, and phase alignment. The same framework resolves a puzzle under label noise: corrupted examples can show faster early loss decrease than clean examples, despite lacking a coherent generalization rule. We show that noise increases conditional label collisions, strengthening early shared-coordinate reinforcement. Finally, this method can be applied to other operators. Taking XOR as an example, we observed the predicted frequency in experiments.

摘要：神經網絡在模組加法任務上訓練時，通常會發展出支持精確泛化的傅立葉結構表示。雖然先前的研究已經識別出這些傅立葉電路，但基於梯度的訓練如何從數據分佈中選擇它們的機制仍然不清楚。我們使用概率簽名來解決這個問題，這些簽名通過訓練分佈的條件統計來表達主要的梯度交互。對於模組加法，這些簽名是循環移位算子，並且通過離散傅立葉變換對角化，產生近似解耦的傅立葉模式動力學。這解釋了傅立葉稀疏性、頻率匹配和相位對齊的出現。同樣的框架解決了標籤噪聲下的一個謎題：受損的例子在早期損失減少上可能比乾淨的例子更快，儘管缺乏一致的泛化規則。我們顯示噪聲增加了條件標籤碰撞，增強了早期共享坐標的強化。最後，這種方法可以應用於其他運算符。以XOR為例，我們在實驗中觀察到了預測的頻率。

docs.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
docs.text:
2610.11794v1 by Haoyu Zhao, Zhengxu Yu, Zhiyuan He, Meng Fang, Rasul Tutunov, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Weilin Luo, Jun Wang

Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

摘要：學習在不熟悉的環境中行動需要代理推斷世界的運作方式，並在新證據到來時修正該理解。然而，有限的觀察可以支持多種世界模型，這些模型解釋了過去的互動，但在未見狀態下預測不同的結果。我們介紹 Memento 3，基於 Memento 系列，讓凍結的 LLM 代理能夠通過外部記憶持續學習明確的世界模型。該代理維護一本自然語言的規則手冊作為持久的語義記憶，記錄關於環境動態的可修訂假設，同時對未知方面保持不確定。它將這本規則手冊編譯成可執行的代碼以進行預測和規劃。通過觀察、反思、規則修訂、編譯和驗證的持續循環，代理利用預測誤差來完善規則手冊及其代碼。只有當 LLM 判斷更新的代碼忠實於規則手冊且單元精確重播再現觀察到的轉變時，更新的代碼才會被接受。我們將這一過程視為基於模型的遞歸自我改進 (RSI) 路徑：代理自主探索環境，修訂其世界模型，並利用經過驗證的更新來指導後續的互動和學習，而基礎的 LLM 則保持不變。一個人口擴展在平行維持多個世界模型，分享互動證據並利用它們的預測來指導探索。在 ARC-AGI-3 上，單模型代理清除所有 25 個公共遊戲的每一級，達到平均相對人類行動效率 (RHAE) 100.0，並使用 44% 的人類行動計數。在一個 Atari Pong 案例研究中，學習到的反饋控制器在三個評估的回合中以 21:0 贏得每一局，且開局不同，無需進一步的 LLM 調用。

docs.title: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
docs.text:
2610.11775v1 by Ilya Lasy, Nora Yinuo Cai, Kola Ayonrinde

Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain. However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful. We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain. Leveraging the SSH, we introduce RouterInterp, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations. On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with ${\sim}65\%$ higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods. This work provides a scalable method for generating more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.

摘要：稀疏專家混合模型（MoE）通過將標記路由到僅在處理部分標記時啟用的模塊化專家網絡，比密集模型更有效地擴展。關於MoE模型性能的一個主要假設是，每個專家專注於一個單一且一致的領域。然而，假設這一假設的可解釋性努力通常未能成功。我們提出並提供證據支持一種替代解釋，我們稱之為重疊專業假設（SSH）：專家專注於一個不相交的細粒度特徵聯集，而不是一個廣泛的領域。利用SSH，我們介紹了RouterInterp，一種解釋專家路由的方法，它識別出對路由決策預測最具指標性的稀疏自編碼器特徵，並生成統一的自然語言解釋。在gpt-oss-20b上，RouterInterp以約65%的更高檢測準確率解釋專家路由，超過了先前基於標記統計的方法。這項工作提供了一種可擴展的方法，用於生成更準確的專家路由解釋，並增進我們對基礎模型中先前無法解釋組件的理解。

docs.title: Equal Path Cost, Unequal Output Effects: Understanding Perturbation Propagation in Diffusion Models
docs.text:
2610.11380v1 by Wei Guo, Yaowen Zhang, Xingtong Ge, Jun Zhang

Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling, with their sampling procedures routinely modified to control generation and improve efficiency. These modifications introduce perturbations along the sampling trajectory, raising a central question: how do such perturbations affect generated output? To address this question, we develop a theoretical framework to investigate perturbation propagation, combining dynamical analysis of the sampling process with an information-theoretic characterization of output responses. Within this framework, we quantify perturbation strength using the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between perturbed and reference trajectory distributions, termed as path cost, which is shown to bound, but do not determine, changes in the output distribution. Building on this analysis, we derive a response identity that connects the propagation and accumulation of local perturbations with the information captured by a selected feature mean, explaining why changes in the output distribution can remain undetected by its first-order response. We test our theoretical analysis through controlled interventions at equal path cost in pretrained diffusion models, revealing distinct patterns of output sensitivity across sampling stages and spatial frequencies. To assess whether our framework can diagnose perturbations arising from practical approximations, we apply it to cache-based acceleration and show that our propagation analysis reliably identifies sampling intervals where caching causes larger image errors.

摘要：擴散模型在生成建模方面取得了顯著的成功，其採樣程序經常被修改以控制生成並提高效率。這些修改在採樣軌跡上引入了擾動，提出了一個核心問題：這些擾動如何影響生成的輸出？為了解決這個問題，我們開發了一個理論框架來研究擾動的傳播，將採樣過程的動態分析與輸出響應的信息論特徵相結合。在這個框架內，我們使用Kullback--Leibler (KL) 散度來量化擾動強度，這是擾動和參考軌跡分佈之間的差異，稱為路徑成本，這已被證明可以界定但不決定輸出分佈的變化。在此分析的基礎上，我們推導出一個響應恆等式，將局部擾動的傳播和積累與所選特徵均值所捕獲的信息聯繫起來，解釋了為什麼輸出分佈的變化可能在其一階響應中未被檢測到。我們通過在預訓練的擴散模型中進行等路徑成本的控制干預來測試我們的理論分析，揭示了在採樣階段和空間頻率之間的輸出敏感性存在明顯的模式。為了評估我們的框架是否能診斷出來自實際近似的擾動，我們將其應用於基於緩存的加速，並顯示我們的傳播分析可靠地識別出緩存導致較大圖像誤差的採樣區間。

docs.title: Rethinking Contrastive Loss in CLIP Post-training: A Complementary Framework with Frozen Text Encoder
docs.text:
2610.11374v1 by Zidan Wang, Yaqian Li, Xiaokai Zhang, Kaiwen Long, Kun He, Hanpeng Liu

CLIP serves as a foundational vision-language model and the de facto vision encoder for downstream VLMs such as LLaVA. Post-training offers a lightweight route to refine CLIP, but recent work argues that the standard contrastive loss is unsuitable for post-training due to catastrophic forgetting under small batches, motivating designs that abandon the contrastive objective in favor of distillation. We revisit this premise and find that, for the InfoNCE objective, the reported forgetting is driven primarily not by insufficient negatives but by an inappropriate magnitude of the contrastive temperature $τ$: with $τ$ set sufficiently small, contrastive post-training improves rather than degrades the pretrained CLIP, which we explain through the temperature dependence of the InfoNCE gradient. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ComCLIP}, a lightweight single-epoch post-training recipe that freezes CLIP's text encoder---so the refined vision encoder is a drop-in replacement with unchanged architecture and inference cost---and trains the vision encoder with a properly-tempered contrastive loss, an MSE anchoring loss against the original CLIP, and a relational distillation loss from DINOv2. Over multiple seeds, ComCLIP matches the self-distillation baseline CLIP-Refine on zero-shot classification while significantly improving the transferability of visual features, measured by linear probing ($48.99$ vs.\ $42.28$ on ViT-B/16), and on ViT-L/14 it also improves MMVP over CLIP-Refine ($24.20$ vs.\ $19.01$); CLIP-Refine remains stronger on image-text retrieval. Used as a drop-in vision encoder for LLaVA-1.5-7B without re-aligning the projector or LLM, ComCLIP yields no net change across $8$ VLM benchmarks, i.e., the refinement does not break downstream compatibility. Code and models are available at https://github.com/showstarpro/ComCLIP.git.

摘要：CLIP 作為一個基礎的視覺-語言模型以及下游 VLM（視覺語言模型）如 LLaVA 的事實上視覺編碼器。後訓練提供了一種輕量化的路徑來精煉 CLIP，但最近的研究認為標準的對比損失不適合後訓練，因為在小批量下會發生災難性遺忘，這促使設計放棄對比目標而轉向蒸餾。我們重新審視這一前提，發現對於 InfoNCE 目標，報告的遺忘主要不是由於負樣本不足，而是由於對比溫度 $τ$ 的不當大小：當 $τ$ 設置得足夠小時，對比後訓練會改善而不是惡化預訓練的 CLIP，我們通過 InfoNCE 梯度的溫度依賴性來解釋這一點。在此基礎上，我們提出了 \textbf{ComCLIP}，這是一種輕量級的單輪次後訓練配方，凍結 CLIP 的文本編碼器——因此精煉的視覺編碼器是一個架構和推理成本不變的替代品——並使用適當調整的對比損失、針對原始 CLIP 的均方誤差錨定損失以及來自 DINOv2 的關係蒸餾損失來訓練視覺編碼器。在多個隨機種子下，ComCLIP 在零-shot 分類上與自蒸餾基線 CLIP-Refine 相匹配，同時顯著改善了視覺特徵的可轉移性，通過線性探測測量（$48.99$ 對 $42.28$ 在 ViT-B/16 上），在 ViT-L/14 上，它也改善了 CLIP-Refine 的 MMVP（$24.20$ 對 $19.01$）；CLIP-Refine 在圖像-文本檢索上仍然更強。作為 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的即插即用視覺編碼器，未重新對齊投影器或 LLM，ComCLIP 在 $8$ 個 VLM 基準測試中沒有產生淨變化，即精煉不破壞下游兼容性。代碼和模型可在 https://github.com/showstarpro/ComCLIP.git 獲得。

docs.title: Writing for the Reviewer: Defensive Writing in GPT Models
docs.text:
2610.11355v1 by Junchi Liao

Researchers increasingly use ChatGPT to revise their papers, and recent GPT versions often narrow or even retract the authors' claims. We call such changes defensive writing when the given material does not support them, and we test two explanations: the model corrects the authors' overclaiming, or it writes for an anticipated reviewer. We ask GPT versions and models from other developers to rewrite paragraphs from papers written before ChatGPT, or to write from an evidence sheet that lists a paper's method and results. Defensive writing grows with GPT version. GPT-6-astra retracts the authors' claims outright, and when it writes from the evidence sheet, it still adds the most ungrounded qualifications. The results favor the anticipated-review explanation, and correcting overclaiming explains only a small part. When the models are only asked to polish, defense stays near the level of the originals; mentioning review raises it, and one round of self-review raises it further. At the same time, fewer than one in ten of the claims GPT-6-astra retracts are overstated. AI reviewers score defensive rewrites higher, while human readers find them harder to read and the authors less certain. Combining AI writing with AI review may amplify this style.

摘要：研究人員越來越多地使用 ChatGPT 來修訂他們的論文，而最近的 GPT 版本往往會縮小甚至撤回作者的主張。當給定的材料不支持這些變更時，我們稱之為防禦性寫作，並測試兩種解釋：模型修正了作者的過度主張，或者它是為了預期的審稿人而寫作。我們要求 GPT 版本和其他開發者的模型重寫 ChatGPT 出現之前的論文段落，或者根據列出論文方法和結果的證據表進行寫作。防禦性寫作隨著 GPT 版本的增長而增加。GPT-6-astra 直接撤回了作者的主張，當它根據證據表寫作時，仍然添加了最不具根據的修飾語。結果支持預期審稿的解釋，而修正過度主張僅解釋了一小部分。當模型僅被要求潤飾時，防禦性寫作的水平接近原始版本；提及審稿會提高這一水平，而一輪自我審稿則進一步提高。同時，GPT-6-astra 撤回的主張中少於十分之一是過度陳述的。AI 審稿人對防禦性重寫的評分更高，而人類讀者則覺得這些重寫更難以閱讀，並且作者的確信度降低。將 AI 寫作與 AI 審稿結合可能會放大這種風格。

docs.title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
docs.text:
2610.11294v1 by Zehuan Chen, Chunhe Song

Presolve strongly affects mixed-integer programming (MIP) performance, yet learning-based methods only optimize parameter configurations and cannot express the non-commutative temporal dependencies among actions, whose default order is nearly unique on most domains, yet functionally necessary: artificially shuffling the order of the same sequence inflates the tail of the solve-time distribution by up to several-fold. We recast presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over a unified atomic action space, moving the decision object to action sequences; we call this framework ORDO---Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve. Its payoff is cross-domain generalization: on multiple unseen domains it attains end-to-end zero-shot speedup---to our knowledge the first for presolve action sequences---varying by domain and not explained by corpus richness, the strongest domain reaching the largest speedup once racing is added. Deployment uses sequence racing, in which candidate sequences run concurrently and the winner is kept, enabled by an execution-and-observation facility, added by modifying the SCIP source, that injects sequences along the native path and records which actions actually execute and in which round.

摘要：預處理對混合整數規劃（MIP）的性能有著強烈的影響，然而基於學習的方法僅能優化參數配置，無法表達行動之間的非交換性時間依賴性，其默認順序在大多數領域中幾乎是唯一的，但在功能上是必要的：人為地打亂相同序列的順序會使解決時間分佈的尾部膨脹幾倍。我們將預處理規劃重新表述為在統一的原子行動空間上進行自回歸序列生成，將決策對象移至行動序列；我們稱這個框架為ORDO——操作級別的回合感知動態排序，用於MIP預處理。它的收益是跨領域的泛化：在多個未見過的領域上，它實現了端到端的零樣本加速——據我們所知，這是預處理行動序列的首次——根據領域的不同而變化，並且無法用語料庫的豐富性解釋，最強的領域在加入競賽後達到了最大的加速。部署使用序列競賽，其中候選序列同時運行，並保留獲勝者，這是通過修改SCIP源代碼添加的執行和觀察設施來實現的，該設施沿著原生路徑注入序列並記錄哪些行動實際執行以及在第幾回合。

docs.title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
docs.text:
2610.11140v1 by Weiwei Ma, Xiaobing Yu, Peijie Qiu, Jin Yang, Zhaoqi An, Xuanzhao Dong, Xiaoqi Zhao, Xiaofeng Liu

Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.

摘要：臨床診斷本質上是順序性的：臨床醫生只有在預期額外證據能解決診斷不確定性時，才會從便宜的檢測升級到昂貴的檢測。我們提出了 ActiveMedAgent，一個將這種成本意識的順序邏輯引入多模態醫療 AI 的框架。在一個凍結的、可通過 API 訪問的視覺-語言模型下，ActiveMedAgent 追蹤候選診斷的概率分佈，並根據每一步的診斷效用減去成本來評分每次獲取。然後，一個輕量級的 MLP 控制器在這些評分的軌跡上離線訓練，學習何時請求額外證據以及何時做出承諾。在三個常用基準上，基於軌跡的策略學習始終優於無指導獲取和全模態基準。值得注意的是，我們識別出一種信息過載效應。在 175 個案例中，代理在較少的通道下產生了正確的診斷，而全模態基準失敗，顯示出學習省略哪些信息與學習獲取哪些信息同樣重要。

docs.title: Emergent Inverse-Depth Scaling From Nonlinearity In Attention
docs.text:
2610.11063v1 by Zirui Peng, Yizhou Liu, Ziming Liu, Jeff Gore

Scaling laws describe power-law improvements in model performance with dataset size and parameter count, yet their underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. To explain the parameter count scaling, existing theory posits power-law scaling with model depth. In linear-attention models, this scaling is tied to a power-law data spectrum: unable to selectively attend to relevant tokens, these models learn according to global spectral strength, with stronger directions learned before weaker ones. Large language models, however, can be strongly nonlinear. Here, we show that nonlinear attention yields inverse-depth decay of loss across all tested data spectra. Nonlinearity enables attention to focus selectively on relevant tokens, allowing strong and weak spectral directions to be learned in parallel. Similar focusing across layers motivates a connection to the central limit theorem: shared error across layers sets the loss plateau, while aggregation turns layer-specific differences into continued gains with depth. Our findings suggest that depth scaling may arise from nonlinearity in attention, which allows large language models to focus locally and may make the global covariance structure less relevant.

摘要：縮放法則描述了模型性能隨著數據集大小和參數數量的冪次改善，但其背後的機制尚未完全理解。為了解釋參數數量的縮放，現有理論假設模型深度與冪次縮放有關。在線性注意力模型中，這種縮放與冪次數據頻譜相關：這些模型無法選擇性地關注相關的標記，而是根據全局頻譜強度進行學習，強的方向在弱的方向之前學習。然而，大型語言模型可以是強非線性的。在這裡，我們展示了非線性注意力導致所有測試數據頻譜中損失的反深度衰減。非線性使得注意力能夠選擇性地關注相關的標記，允許強和弱的頻譜方向並行學習。各層之間的類似聚焦激發了與中心極限定理的聯繫：層之間共享的誤差設置了損失平臺，而聚合將層特定的差異轉化為隨深度持續增長的收益。我們的發現表明，深度縮放可能源於注意力中的非線性，這使得大型語言模型能夠進行局部聚焦，並可能使全局協方差結構變得不那麼相關。

docs.title: Optimizing Large Language Models with Chained LMOs
docs.text:
2610.10975v1 by Sungyoon Kim, Kaan Ozkara, Youngsuk Park

Muon has motivated a growing family of optimizers that compose multiple matrix normalizations, but these methods remain fragmented and lack a unified perspective. We introduce chained linear minimization oracles (chained LMOs), which cast these methods as compositions of LMOs. Despite their empirical success, many chains fall outside the standard LMO framework and can diverge on smooth convex objectives. To explain why composition can nevertheless help, we turn to linear associative memory and show that chaining can improve over Muon under anisotropic embeddings. Empirically, we propose TensorChain, a novel optimizer within the framework that stacks compatible weight matrices across different layers and normalizes the 3d tensor across its axes. In Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B pretraining, TensorChain outperforms all chained baselines in average token efficiency, with average token savings of 9.6% over Muon at matched validation loss.

摘要：Muon 激發了一個不斷增長的優化器家族，這些優化器組合了多種矩陣正規化，但這些方法仍然是零散的，缺乏統一的視角。我們引入了鏈式線性最小化預言機（chained LMOs），將這些方法視為 LMOs 的組合。儘管它們在實證上取得了成功，但許多鏈式方法卻超出了標準 LMO 框架，並且在平滑凸目標上可能會發散。為了解釋為什麼組合仍然可以有所幫助，我們轉向線性聯想記憶，並展示鏈式方法在各向異性嵌入下可以超越 Muon。在實證上，我們提出了 TensorChain，這是一個新穎的優化器，該優化器在框架內堆疊了不同層之間的相容權重矩陣，並沿著其軸對 3d 張量進行正規化。在 Qwen3 0.6B 和 1.7B 的預訓練中，TensorChain 在平均標記效率上超越了所有鏈式基準，與 Muon 在匹配的驗證損失下平均節省了 9.6% 的標記。

docs.title: TRACE: A Governance Framework for Measuring Explainability Debt in Production AI Systems
docs.text:
2610.10957v1 by Harish Kant Pathak

Production AI systems deployed in high-stakes domains accumulate a governance liability that existing monitoring frameworks fail to detect: the progressive inability to explain individual decisions when regulators, auditors, or affected individuals demand accountability. We introduce TRACE (Transparency, Risk, Accountability, Compliance, and Explainability), a seven-instrument governance framework for measuring, tracking, and remediating Explainability Debt in production AI systems. The foundational instrument, the Explainability Debt Score (EDS), quantifies the proportion of production decisions falling below a governance-defined explainability confidence threshold at any point in time. Complementary instruments include DART (Debt Accumulation Rate Tracker for breach forecasting), SHIV (Scenario Health and Integrity Validator for daily governance), FDE (Feature Drift Evaluator for causal attribution), HVE (Human Validation Engine), AIDE (Audit Intervention Decision Engine), and ZERO (Zero Explainability Risk Optimiser for remediation). Through a twelve-month longitudinal case study of a production fraud detection system processing 50,000 daily financial transactions, achieving 98.46% accuracy and ROC-AUC of 0.9990, we demonstrate that an EDS of 0.23 on audit day was statistically predictable six months in advance using DART trajectory analysis (beta = 0.008/week, R-squared = 0.94, 95% CI: [0.006, 0.010]), and that 78% of Explainability Debt was concentrated in the highest-regulatory-risk decision category (transactions above $10,000), a risk asymmetry completely invisible to system-level metrics. TRACE provides the first quantitative operational architecture for EU AI Act Article 13 compliance in production AI deployment, establishing a new subdiscipline of explanation governance distinct from explanation generation.

摘要：生產 AI 系統在高風險領域的部署積累了一種治理負債，現有的監控框架無法檢測到：當監管機構、審計師或受影響的個體要求問責時，逐漸無法解釋個別決策。我們介紹 TRACE（透明度、風險、問責、合規性和可解釋性），這是一個七項工具的治理框架，用於衡量、跟踪和修復生產 AI 系統中的可解釋性負債。基礎工具，即可解釋性負債分數（EDS），量化在任何時刻低於治理定義的可解釋性信心閾值的生產決策所佔的比例。補充工具包括 DART（違規預測的負債累積率跟踪器）、SHIV（每日治理的情境健康和完整性驗證器）、FDE（因果歸因的特徵漂移評估器）、HVE（人類驗證引擎）、AIDE（審計干預決策引擎）和 ZERO（零可解釋性風險優化器）。通過對一個處理每日 50,000 筆金融交易的生產欺詐檢測系統進行為期十二個月的縱向案例研究，該系統達到了 98.46% 的準確率和 0.9990 的 ROC-AUC，我們展示了在審計日的 EDS 為 0.23 是可以通過 DART 軌跡分析在六個月前進行統計預測的（beta = 0.008/週，R-squared = 0.94，95% CI: [0.006, 0.010]），並且 78% 的可解釋性負債集中在最高監管風險決策類別（交易金額超過 $10,000），這種風險不對稱在系統層級的指標中完全不可見。TRACE 為生產 AI 部署中的 EU AI Act 第 13 條合規性提供了首個定量運營架構，建立了一個與解釋生成不同的解釋治理新子學科。

docs.title: AI-Mediated Self: How HCI Defines and Relates to the Self
docs.text:
2610.10770v1 by Jenny Xiyu Fu, Qian Yang, Malte Jung

How might AI alter how we understand and experience the self? This scoping review analyzes 102 papers to examine how the self is defined in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI), how AI-self relationships are conceptualized, and what risks emerge when AI becomes entangled with selfhood. Our synthesis makes three contributions. First, we define AI-mediated self as a conceptual umbrella that connects dispersed work across education, workplace, health, and creative practices. Second, we consolidate six framings of the self with four domains of ethical risk-agency/autonomy, identity/authorship, relational capacity, and meaning-making-into a conceptual map that provides a reusable vocabulary across contexts. Third, we introduce the Inclusion of AI-Self framework, which situates AI-self relationships along a spectrum of proximity. Together, these contributions position selfhood as a central design space in HCI.

摘要：AI 如何改變我們理解和體驗自我的方式？這篇範疇回顧分析了 102 篇論文，以檢視自我在人體與計算機互動 (HCI) 領域中的定義，AI 與自我之間的關係如何被概念化，以及當 AI 與自我糾纏時出現的風險。我們的綜合分析有三個貢獻。首先，我們將 AI 媒介的自我定義為一個概念性傘，將教育、工作場所、健康和創意實踐等不同領域的研究聯繫起來。其次，我們將自我的六種框架與四個倫理風險領域——代理性/自主性、身份/創作、關係能力和意義建構——整合成一個概念地圖，提供可在不同情境中重複使用的詞彙。第三，我們引入了 AI-自我納入框架，該框架將 AI-自我關係置於一個接近度的光譜上。這些貢獻共同將自我定位為 HCI 中一個核心的設計空間。

docs.title: The Handover Problem: Governing Autonomy Transitions in Human-AI Collaboration
docs.text:
2610.10352v1 by Vicente Pelechano, Antoni Mestre, Manoli Albert, Miriam Gil

Human-machine systems rarely operate at a fixed level of AI autonomy. As operators and AI systems collaborate over time, control must shift: the AI can take on more responsibility when collaboration is stable, maintain its current role when evidence is ambiguous, or return control to the human when conditions deteriorate. Existing work on adaptive automation, supervisory control, trust in automation, and deskilling explains parts of this problem, but provides no auditable, multi-signal criterion for governing when autonomy should change across multi-cycle workflows. We formalise this challenge as the Handover Problem: deciding, at each operational cycle, whether to escalate, maintain, or revert AI autonomy while keeping the process reversible, recoverable, and auditable. We introduce the Handover Readiness Score (HRS), a transparent composite measure that integrates four signal dimensions: operator readiness, human-AI trust, learning stability, and operational performance. It is combined with a hysteresis-based transition policy that requires sustained positive evidence before increasing autonomy but reverts promptly when conditions worsen. Across software engineering and manufacturing domains, the HRS and hard safety guards address complementary failure regimes: guards enforce immediate corrective action when a single indicator breaches a critical threshold, while the HRS detects the slow, multi-signal erosion of operator readiness that no individual guard can observe. The framework establishes autonomy handover as a governance problem requiring explicit, composite, and auditable criteria. This provides a conceptual and formal foundation that adaptive automation research has not previously provided.

摘要：人機系統很少在固定的人工智慧自主程度下運作。隨著操作員和人工智慧系統隨著時間的合作，控制必須轉移：當合作穩定時，人工智慧可以承擔更多責任；當證據模糊時，保持其當前角色；或當條件惡化時，將控制權交回人類。現有關於自適應自動化、監督控制、自動化信任和技能下降的研究解釋了這個問題的部分，但未提供可審計的多信號標準來管理在多循環工作流程中自主權何時應該改變。

我們將這一挑戰形式化為交接問題：在每個操作循環中決定是否升級、維持或恢復人工智慧自主權，同時保持過程的可逆性、可恢復性和可審計性。我們引入了交接準備評分（HRS），這是一個透明的綜合指標，整合了四個信號維度：操作員準備度、人類-人工智慧信任、學習穩定性和操作性能。它與基於滯後的過渡政策相結合，該政策要求在提高自主權之前持續獲得正面證據，但在條件惡化時迅速恢復。

在軟體工程和製造領域，HRS和嚴格的安全防護措施解決了互補的失效模式：當單一指標突破臨界閾值時，防護措施強制執行立即的糾正行動，而HRS則檢測操作員準備度的緩慢、多信號侵蝕，這是任何單一防護措施無法觀察到的。該框架將自主權交接確立為一個治理問題，要求明確的、綜合的和可審計的標準。這提供了一個概念和形式的基礎，而自適應自動化研究之前並未提供。

docs.title: Comprehension Audits to Mitigate Risks from Automated AI Research
docs.text:
2610.10064v1 by Ronald J. Bodkin, Bahrad A. Sokhansanj, Gillian K. Hadfield

AI is already writing a majority of code for frontier AI labs. This creates a safety risk if there is insufficient human oversight. Existing work proposes minimum comprehension thresholds and unaided checks to mitigate this. To our knowledge, however, there is currently no published frontier-AI assurance regime that requires demonstrated evidence that the responsible humans understand what they are building as a precommitted condition for continuing development or usage. We propose comprehension audits, a novel development-process assurance mechanism in which the responsible people explain R&D contributions to auditors to demonstrate understanding. With independent administration and graded reports, they provide a gate: development of a contribution stops based on a failure to demonstrate human understanding until remediated, with escalating consequences for repeated failures. Our analysis of leading open-source AI projects finds increased output of code with reduced human review commentary rates per line of code, with far lower rates for automated fleet accounts. We advocate for labs to conduct them with embedded independent auditors.

摘要：AI 已經為前沿 AI 實驗室撰寫了大部分代碼。如果缺乏足夠的人類監督，這會帶來安全風險。現有的工作提出了最低理解門檻和未經幫助的檢查來減輕這個問題。然而，據我們所知，目前沒有已發表的前沿 AI 保證制度要求負責的人類提供證據，證明他們理解自己正在構建的內容，作為繼續開發或使用的前提條件。我們提出了理解審計，這是一種新穎的開發過程保證機制，負責的人解釋研發貢獻給審計員，以展示其理解。通過獨立管理和分級報告，他們提供了一個門檻：基於未能展示人類理解，貢獻的開發將停止，直到修正為止，並對重複失敗施加逐步升級的後果。我們對領先的開源 AI 項目的分析發現，代碼的輸出增加，而每行代碼的人類審查評論率減少，自動化車隊帳戶的評論率更低。我們倡導實驗室進行這些審計，並嵌入獨立審計員。

docs.title: Phase-HDC: Replacing Optimizer History with Gradient Thresholds in Discrete Phase Learning
docs.text:
2610.10630v1 by Ahmed Nebli

Training a compact model often needs far more memory than storing it, because the optimizer keeps its own records of past gradients. For a hyperdimensional classifier whose learned parameters are low-bit angles, which we call a \emph{phase memory}, these records take several times more memory than the model itself. We ask whether such a model can be trained while storing nothing but the model. The proposed method, Phase-HDC, turns each stored angle by at most one step per update, against the sign of its current gradient, and only when that gradient is large enough. We show that this simple rule is the exact solution of a first-order loss model in which every changed parameter pays a fixed cost. When everything except the update rule is held fixed, Phase-HDC matches the accuracy of Adam with 6-bit moments while storing three times less. Across eleven image, tabular, and text datasets, it stores 16--23$\times$ less than standard float32 Adam and 4--6$\times$ less than 8-bit Adam. The price is an average loss of about five accuracy points against float32 Adam, while Phase-HDC is more accurate than 8-bit Adam on six of the eleven datasets, including byte-level text prediction, where 8-bit Adam collapses. Instrumented training runs explain these outcomes. Once parameters must sit on a discrete grid, Adam's moments mainly decide whether a parameter moves at all, a decision that a threshold on the current gradient can make without memory, and coarse quantization of the moments breaks this decision for inputs that the data rarely contain. The storage savings are logical state rather than measured hardware memory.

摘要：訓練一個緊湊模型通常需要比存儲它更多的記憶體，因為優化器會保留過去梯度的記錄。對於一個學習參數為低位角度的超維分類器，我們稱之為\emph{相位記憶}，這些記錄佔用的記憶體是模型本身的幾倍。我們詢問是否可以在只存儲模型的情況下訓練這樣的模型。所提出的方法，Phase-HDC，在每次更新時最多將每個存儲的角度改變一步，根據其當前梯度的符號，並且僅在該梯度足夠大的時候進行。我們表明這一簡單規則是第一階損失模型的精確解，其中每個改變的參數都需支付固定成本。當除了更新規則以外的所有內容保持不變時，Phase-HDC的準確度與使用6位元瞬時數的Adam相匹配，同時存儲的記憶體少了三倍。在十一個圖像、表格和文本數據集上，它的存儲量比標準的float32 Adam少16--23$\times$，比8位元Adam少4--6$\times$。代價是相對於float32 Adam的平均損失約為五個準確度點，而Phase-HDC在十一個數據集中的六個上比8位元Adam更準確，包括字節級文本預測，在此情況下8位元Adam崩潰。儀器化的訓練運行解釋了這些結果。一旦參數必須位於離散網格上，Adam的瞬時數主要決定參數是否移動，這一決策可以在沒有記憶體的情況下由當前梯度的閾值做出，而瞬時數的粗量化會破壞這一決策，對於數據中很少包含的輸入。存儲的節省是邏輯狀態，而不是測量的硬體記憶體。

docs.title: What the Sleeve Feels: Explainable Machine Learning for Textile Pressure-Based Postural Screening
docs.text:
2610.10015v1 by Limon Bin Hossain, Md Sadib Rahman Ananta

Pressure-sensing smart textiles convert body-surface contact into a dense, image-like signal closely tied to posture and movement, making them a promising low-cost route to wearable posture screening. Realizing that promise, however, requires more than classification accuracy: a deployable system must generalize to wearers unseen during training, expose the physical evidence behind its decisions, and tolerate the small donning offsets that occur whenever a garment is removed and re-worn. This paper addresses these three requirements jointly using a knitted piezoresistive sleeve worn on the forearm as a testbed. We regroup fine-grained everyday activities into three coarser screening categories (neutral, potentially undesirable, and functional or transitional), engineer 29 interpretable pressure-distribution features spanning global intensity, spatial center of pressure, quadrant asymmetry, distribution complexity, and short-horizon temporal change, and evaluate under a strict subject-wise split. A tuned XGBoost classifier reaches 0.818 accuracy, 0.788 balanced accuracy, and 0.801 macro F1 on unseen test subjects, with tight frame-level bootstrap 95% intervals of about plus-minus 0.01 and a subject-to-subject standard deviation near 0.06 under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation. A simple 2D-CNN baseline trained on raw frames achieves broadly similar performance, showing that hand-engineered features are not left behind by a learned spatial representation on this task. SHAP-based explanation, a feature-group ablation, per-activity error analysis inside the pooled undesirable class, class-mapping sensitivity, and a simulated donning-rotation stress test together locate what the model relies on, where it degrades, and why, directly targeting the generalization, interpretability, and robustness gaps that determine whether such a system is deployable.

摘要：壓力感測智能紡織品將身體表面接觸轉換為一種密集的、類似影像的信號，與姿勢和運動密切相關，使其成為一種有前景的低成本可穿戴姿勢篩查方法。然而，實現這一承諾不僅需要分類準確性：可部署的系統必須能夠對訓練期間未見過的佩戴者進行泛化，揭示其決策背後的物理證據，並能容忍每當衣物被脫下再穿上時發生的小偏差。本文使用一種穿戴在前臂上的編織壓電套作為測試平台，共同解決這三個要求。我們將細緻的日常活動重新分組為三個較粗的篩查類別（中性、潛在不良和功能性或過渡性），設計了29個可解釋的壓力分佈特徵，涵蓋全球強度、壓力中心位置、象限不對稱、分佈複雜性和短期時間變化，並在嚴格的主題分割下進行評估。經過調整的XGBoost分類器在未見測試對象上達到0.818的準確率、0.788的平衡準確率和0.801的宏觀F1，並在留一主題交叉驗證下，框架級自助法95%置信區間約為正負0.01，主題間標準差接近0.06。基於原始幀訓練的簡單2D-CNN基線達到類似的表現，顯示手工設計的特徵在這項任務中並未被學習的空間表示所超越。基於SHAP的解釋、特徵組消融、在合併不良類別中的每個活動錯誤分析、類別映射敏感性以及模擬穿戴-旋轉壓力測試共同定位模型所依賴的內容、降級的地方及原因，直接針對決定此類系統是否可部署的泛化、可解釋性和穩健性差距。

docs.title: Outperformance Inverse Optimization: Learning Objective Functions that Outperform Agent Decisions
docs.text:
2610.09890v1 by Akira Kitaoka

Inverse optimization estimates the weights of an objective function that explain observed decisions as optimal solutions, and is used in a variety of fields. For mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), existing methods aim to reproduce the observations as optimal solutions, and thus learn compromise weights when the observations are suboptimal. We propose outperformance inverse optimization, which instead seeks weights that induce, at each state, an optimal solution outperforming the observed action in every component. We give a loss function that can be evaluated with forward-problem oracles alone and is thus applicable to MILPs, together with gradient-based and DC optimization algorithms for minimizing it. For weights inducing a unique outperforming optimal solution at all observations, we prove that the probability of failing to induce such a solution at a new state (the generalization error) is bounded by a quantity inversely proportional to the number of observations, and that this bound is tight in the number of observations up to logarithmic factors. In experiments on synthetic and real data, the proposed methods improve the prediction of solutions outperforming the actions over existing methods.

摘要：逆向優化估計目標函數的權重，以解釋觀察到的決策作為最佳解，並在多個領域中使用。對於混合整數線性規劃（MILPs），現有方法旨在重現觀察結果作為最佳解，因此在觀察結果不理想時學習妥協權重。我們提出了超越逆向優化，該方法尋求在每個狀態下誘導一個在每個組件上超越觀察行動的最佳解。我們給出了一個損失函數，可以僅用前向問題預言機進行評估，因此適用於MILPs，並提供基於梯度的和DC優化算法來最小化它。對於在所有觀察中誘導唯一超越最佳解的權重，我們證明在新狀態下無法誘導此類解的概率（泛化誤差）由一個與觀察數量成反比的量界定，並且這個界限在觀察數量上是緊密的，直到對數因子。在合成數據和實際數據的實驗中，所提出的方法改善了對超越行動的解的預測，優於現有方法。

docs.title: From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving
docs.text:
2610.09769v1 by Adrián Zámečník, Matěj Kripner, Martin Koutecký, Martin Balko, Jan Grebík, Pavel Hubáček, Robert Šámal, Václav Rozhoň

Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems extracted from four sets of papers, solving about 200 open problems. One experiment used papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science. There, we answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by their authors.

摘要：大型語言模型在數學研究中越來越發揮作用，而進展往往依賴於高效的證明搜尋、漸進的改進和仔細的驗證。我們描述了Bolzano，一個多代理的開源系統，它使用並行證明代理和驗證代理，並維持一個人類可讀的研究狀態。在專家選擇的問題上進行的初步手動使用產生了8個結果，其證明已由領域專家檢查。受到這些案例研究的激勵，我們在沒有問題特定人類指導的情況下運行了Bolzano，處理了約3,800個從四組論文中提取的開放問題，解決了約200個開放問題。一個實驗使用了被STOC 2026接受的論文，這是一個在理論計算機科學領域的頂級會議。在那裡，我們回答了論文中提出的四個問題，這得到了其作者的確認。

docs.title: Which Language Should a Skeleton Speak? Language Choices in Multilingual Reasoning
docs.text:
2610.09607v1 by HyeonSeok Lim, SeungWoo Song, Inho Won, Hoyun Song, Jihyo Kim, KyungTae Lim

Skeleton-based reasoning prompting is a promising training-free approach for structuring LLM reasoning, but prior work largely assumes an English-centric setting. We propose the Language-Aware Skeleton Exploration Framework (LASEF) to study skeleton-language choice in multilingual mathematical reasoning. Across math benchmarks, model scales, and languages, we show that English skeletons yield a small positive tendency on average, most visible for smaller models and low-resource languages. However, few language-level gains remain significant after correction, and English is not universally optimal. Combining greedy decoding, multi-rollout evaluation, translation ablation, and cross-benchmark validation, we further find three patterns of skeleton-language effects: directionally consistent, evaluation- and benchmark-dependent, and asymmetric negative. These effects cannot be fully explained by generation quality alone. Overall, skeleton language is a context-dependent design variable that requires multi-level exploration. All resources are released at https://github.com/lhsstn/LASEF.

摘要：骨架基礎的推理提示是一種有前景的無需訓練的方法，用於構建大型語言模型的推理，但之前的研究大多假設在以英語為中心的環境中進行。我們提出了語言感知骨架探索框架（LASEF），以研究多語言數學推理中的骨架-語言選擇。在數學基準測試、模型規模和語言之間，我們顯示英語骨架平均上產生小幅正向傾向，這在較小的模型和低資源語言中最為明顯。然而，經過修正後，少數語言層面的增益仍然顯著，且英語並非普遍最佳。結合貪婪解碼、多次回合評估、翻譯消融和跨基準驗證，我們進一步發現三種骨架-語言效應的模式：方向一致、依賴評估和基準、以及不對稱的負向效應。這些效應不能僅僅通過生成質量來完全解釋。總體而言，骨架語言是一個依賴於上下文的設計變量，需要多層次的探索。所有資源已在 https://github.com/lhsstn/LASEF 上釋出。

docs.title: Structured pre-generation elicitation versus single-shot prompting in AI-assisted enterprise decision-making: a randomised online experiment
docs.text:
2610.09593v1 by William Scott-Jackson

Generative AI speeds, and mostly improves, professional work, but there is concern that users who delegate both the production and the evaluation of an answer may accept weak output and engage less with the underlying reasoning (cognitive surrender). Interventions proposed so far, such as unassisted practice or slowing adoption, sit outside the working task. We tested a different approach: an interactive metacognitive scaffolding layer (Cognistance, a prototype developed at the Oxford Centre for Impact Research (OCIR) that asks users to clarify context, choose a strategic direction and explain their reasoning before the AI generates a deliverable). Mean composite quality was 32% higher with the scaffold, with the same direction for every rater. Gains were largest for trade-off articulation and strategic coherence and absent for technical specificity. A large part of the aggregate effect reflected rescue of weak prompts: floor-scored (off-task) deliverables fell from 34% to 5%. Among participants whose own prompt already stated the data-localisation problem, the advantage was 21%. Treatment participants reported greater involvement and took about 2.4 minutes longer on average (10.46 minutes). Immediate recall scores were higher, which tentatively suggests better retention, but in this limited experiment, was not robust to sensitivity analyses. Self-ratings of quality did not track rated quality in either condition. Structured elicitation before generation improved the rated quality and task relevance of AI-assisted strategy documents at modest cost in time. Delayed retention, error detection and effects in live organisations are the priorities for the next stage of research.

摘要：生成式 AI 加速並大多改善了專業工作，但人們擔心那些將答案的產出和評估都委託給 AI 的使用者可能會接受較弱的輸出，並對基礎推理的參與度降低（認知放棄）。目前提出的干預措施，如無輔助練習或減緩採用，均不在工作任務範疇內。我們測試了一種不同的方法：一個互動式的元認知支架層（Cognistance，一個在牛津影響研究中心（OCIR）開發的原型，要求使用者在 AI 生成可交付成果之前澄清上下文、選擇戰略方向並解釋他們的推理）。使用支架的平均綜合質量提高了 32%，每位評審的方向一致。對於權衡表達和戰略一致性的提升最為明顯，而在技術具體性方面則沒有增益。總體效果的很大一部分反映了對弱提示的救援：低分（偏離任務）的可交付成果從 34% 降至 5%。在那些自己的提示已經陳述數據本地化問題的參與者中，優勢為 21%。接受治療的參與者報告了更高的參與度，平均花費時間約長 2.4 分鐘（10.46 分鐘）。即時回憶分數較高，這初步暗示了更好的記憶保持，但在這次有限的實驗中，對敏感性分析並不穩健。自我評價的質量在任何條件下都未能跟隨評分質量。生成前的結構性引導改善了 AI 輔助戰略文件的評價質量和任務相關性，所需的時間成本相對適中。延遲保留、錯誤檢測和在實際組織中的效果是下一階段研究的重點。

docs.title: Dual- versus Single-Suggestion AI Support for Radiographic Interpretation in Residents: Randomized Multireader Study
docs.text:
2610.09589v1 by Lin Wu, Zhe Xu, Hongyi Wang, Feifei Zhou, Wei Deng, Chunlong Zhang, Yuting Zhu, Kaixiao Chen, Xiao Liang, Chen Yang, Yeyuan Chen, Hao Chen, Fuqing Zhou

Purpose: To compare dual- and single-suggestion AI support for radiographic interpretation by residents, particularly when the shared AI suggestion was incorrect. Materials and Methods: This prospective, multicenter, randomized three-arm reader study was conducted at three hospitals in China from July to September 2026 (ChiCTR2600129243). After specialty stratification, 132 residents with fewer than 3 years of clinical experience were randomized 1:1:1 to GPT-5.4 alone (group A), GPT-5.4 plus Kimi-K2.6 (group B), or GPT-5.4 plus Gemini-3.6 Flash (group C); 123 were analyzed. Participants interpreted 60 radiographs before and after AI support. The primary outcome was accuracy change. Welch ANOVA and Holm-adjusted t tests compared support conditions; HC3 linear models assessed specialty interaction. Results: Among 123 residents (mean age, 24.1 years +/- 1.4; 65 women), radiology residents showed greater accuracy improvement with dual- than single-suggestion support (B-A, 6.69 percentage points [95% CI, 0.97-12.40]; C-A, 7.87 percentage points [95% CI, 1.64-14.11]; Holm-adjusted P = .030 for both), whereas accuracy change did not differ in non-radiology residents (P = .20). When GPT-5.4 was incorrect, AI-assisted accuracy was higher with dual- than single-suggestion support in radiology residents (40.1% and 40.4% vs 20.0%) and non-radiology residents (31.3% and 31.0% vs 12.1%) (all Holm-adjusted P < .001). The dual-suggestion effect differed by specialty (interaction difference, 10.44 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.36-16.52; P < .001). Conclusion: Dual-suggestion support may mitigate the influence of erroneous AI suggestions, with greater accuracy improvement observed in radiology but not non-radiology residents.

摘要：目的：比較雙重和單一建議的人工智慧支持對住院醫師的放射影像解讀的影響，特別是在共享的人工智慧建議不正確的情況下。材料與方法：這項前瞻性、多中心、隨機三組讀者研究於2026年7月至9月在中國的三家醫院進行（ChiCTR2600129243）。在專業分層後，132名臨床經驗少於3年的住院醫師以1:1:1的比例隨機分配至僅使用GPT-5.4（A組）、GPT-5.4加Kimi-K2.6（B組）或GPT-5.4加Gemini-3.6 Flash（C組）；分析了123名參與者。參與者在人工智慧支持前後解讀60幅放射影像。主要結果是準確度的變化。使用Welch ANOVA和Holm調整的t檢驗比較支持條件；HC3線性模型評估專業互動。結果：在123名住院醫師中（平均年齡24.1歲 +/- 1.4；65名女性），放射科住院醫師在雙重建議支持下的準確度改善大於單一建議支持（B-A，6.69個百分點[95% CI，0.97-12.40]；C-A，7.87個百分點[95% CI，1.64-14.11]；Holm調整P = .030，兩者均如此），而非放射科住院醫師的準確度變化則無顯著差異（P = .20）。當GPT-5.4不正確時，放射科住院醫師在雙重建議支持下的人工智慧輔助準確度高於單一建議支持（40.1%和40.4%對20.0%），非放射科住院醫師則為（31.3%和31.0%對12.1%）（所有Holm調整P < .001）。雙重建議效果因專業而異（互動差異，10.44個百分點；95% CI，4.36-16.52；P < .001）。結論：雙重建議支持可能減輕錯誤人工智慧建議的影響，在放射科住院醫師中觀察到更大的準確度改善，但在非放射科住院醫師中則未見此情況。

docs.title: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
docs.text:
2610.09558v1 by Samuel Margolis, Paul Schmiedmayer, Alan Huang, Ethan Chen, Ishan Bhattacharjee, Atman Shah, Ben Viggiano, Fang Cao, Shriya Reddy, Roger Xia, Jack O'Sullivan, Daniel Katz, Matthew Wheeler, Euan Ashley, Bruna Gomes

Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets. Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.

摘要：藥物靶點發現需要區分那些因果驅動疾病的分子與那些僅僅與之相關的分子。訓練和評估 AI 代理人以端到端執行此工作流程是困難的，因為現實世界的生物銀行缺乏已知的因果真相，且參與者層級的數據受到訪問控制。我們介紹了 DrugTargetWorld，一個程序生成模擬生物銀行或“世界”的框架，具有已知但隱藏的因果結構。每個世界包含 54,000 名參與者的基因型、蛋白質、健康記錄、結果和合成的磁共振成像 (MRI)。代理人必須構建疾病表型，識別因果驅動蛋白，推斷調節的有益方向，並可選擇進行虛擬的“濕實驗室”實驗。我們在 20 個心血管世界和三個實驗預算中評估了九個代理人，共 540 集。Opus 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 獲得了最高的平均綜合得分，分別為 39.98 和 35.38（滿分 100），並且平均恢復了 64% 的因果驅動因子。然而，沒有任何代理人能可靠地區分誤導性的非因果蛋白，且性能仍然受到連接表型構建、因果證據和干預決策所需的綜合判斷的限制。通過使每個世界的因果結構對評估者已知但對代理人隱藏，DrugTargetWorld 將端到端的藥物靶點發現轉變為一個可擴展的訓練和評估問題，並具有可驗證的獎勵。

docs.title: MORA: Modeling Observed Changes for Drift-Robust Time-Series Anomaly Detection
docs.text:
2610.09473v1 by Xudong Mou, Tiejun Wang, Rui Wang, Hui Wang, Pin Liu, Tianyu Wo, Xudong Liu, Renyu Yang

Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) identifies deviations from patterns learned from historical data. In non-stationary settings, distribution drift and true anomalies can cause similar local changes, making it difficult to tell whether a deviation reflects abnormality or evolving context. Existing methods typically adapt to detected shifts or learn drift-insensitive representations, but do not resolve this ambiguity. We define this problem as \emph{temporal change disambiguation}: determining whether a local deviation is explained by broader temporal evolution. We introduce MORA, a drift-robust TSAD framework that reconstructs the same local target from paired short- and long-term views. The reconstruction gap measures contextual support for a local deviation, and a data-dependent correction mechanism conservatively adjusts the primary local anomaly score. Context can only reduce the score when it improves reconstruction of the same target. MORA needs neither drift annotations nor online adaptation. Experiments on four TSAD benchmarks show strong robustness to non-stationarity while preserving sensitivity to genuine anomalies.

摘要：時間序列異常檢測 (TSAD) 識別從歷史數據學習到的模式中的偏差。 在非穩態環境中，分佈漂移和真正的異常可能會導致類似的局部變化，使得難以判斷偏差是否反映異常或演變中的上下文。 現有的方法通常適應檢測到的變化或學習對漂移不敏感的表示，但並未解決這一模糊性。 我們將這個問題定義為 \emph{時間變化消歧義}：確定局部偏差是否由更廣泛的時間演變解釋。 我們引入 MORA，一個抗漂移的 TSAD 框架，從配對的短期和長期視角重建相同的局部目標。 重建差距衡量對局部偏差的上下文支持，而一個依賴數據的修正機制保守地調整主要的局部異常分數。 只有當上下文改善對相同目標的重建時，才能降低分數。 MORA 不需要漂移標註或在線適應。 在四個 TSAD 基準上的實驗顯示出對非穩態的強健性，同時保持對真正異常的敏感性。

docs.title: An Informational Curse of Horizon in Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning
docs.text:
2610.09247v1 by John L. Zhou, Yuxuan Dong, Jonathan C. Kao

The difficulty of learning goal-reaching policies is often attributed to a "curse of horizon" that manifests as bias accumulation in temporal-difference backups and noisy advantage estimates. In this work, we identify an additional informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where increasing the goal relabeling horizon can significantly reduce policy generalization and performance. Through a series of controlled experiments with oracle planners, we decouple the goal horizons sampled during training from those that the policy is asked to reach at test time. Even when evaluated only on a sequence of nearby subgoals, goal-conditioned behavioral cloning (BC) policies suffer from severe, training horizon-dependent performance degradation that is mitigated by reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. We explain this phenomenon as a horizon-dependent decrease in the conditional mutual information between actions and hindsight-relabeled goals, and find empirically that both BC and RL policies trained on longer-horizon goals exhibit a shift in sensitivity from goal to state information, as measured by the policy's input Jacobians. Motivated by this observation, we find that distilling the input Jacobians of short-horizon policies into long-horizon policies yields significant performance gains, especially in combinatorial manipulation tasks. Taken together, our results highlight goal relabeling horizon as an important consideration when learning generalist policies from offline data.

摘要：學習目標達成策略的困難通常歸因於一種「地平線詛咒」，這種詛咒表現為時間差備份中的偏差累積和噪聲優勢估計。在這項工作中，我們識別出在目標條件策略學習中存在一種額外的信息性地平線詛咒，增加目標重新標記的地平線會顯著降低策略的泛化能力和性能。通過一系列與預言規劃者的受控實驗，我們將訓練期間採樣的目標地平線與在測試時要求策略達成的目標地平線解耦。即使僅在一系列相近的子目標上進行評估，目標條件行為克隆（BC）策略也會遭受嚴重的、依賴於訓練地平線的性能下降，而這種下降是可以通過強化學習（RL）目標來緩解的。我們將這一現象解釋為動作與事後重新標記的目標之間的條件互信息隨地平線的變化而減少，並實證發現，無論是BC還是RL策略，在長地平線目標上訓練時，其敏感性從目標信息轉向狀態信息，這一點可以通過策略的輸入雅可比矩陣來衡量。受到這一觀察的啟發，我們發現將短地平線策略的輸入雅可比矩陣提煉到長地平線策略中會產生顯著的性能提升，特別是在組合操作任務中。綜合來看，我們的結果突顯了在從離線數據學習通用策略時，目標重新標記地平線是一個重要的考量。

docs.title: CurveTQ: Rotation-Free Trellis Quantization of LLM Weights via Curvature-Weighted Search
docs.text:
2610.09212v1 by Guanhua Ding, Zi Wang, Ruichao Li, Jack Liu

The best two-bit weight quantizers for large language models, such as QTIP and Proteus, rotate each weight matrix by a random orthogonal transform, which must be undone at every decoding step, then encode it with a trellis or lattice code under a Euclidean search; the layer Hessian enters only through error feedback between coding blocks. We show that this leaves part of the Hessian unused. Error feedback turns the loss into a weighted sum of per-coordinate rounding errors whose weights, the diagonal of the Hessian's LDL factorization, existing quantizers compute but never read. We put these weights into the Viterbi branch metric, so the search follows the curvature within each coding block. This also explains the rotation: it removes this within-block variation, so weighting in the native basis and rotating are substitutes. On three models the weighted native search matches a full-dimension randomized Hadamard to within about one point of downstream accuracy, and weighting after the rotation gains little. Around this search we build CurveTQ, a trellis codec with no rotation, which handles the weights' amplitude and marginal shape with a factored scale field and a closed-form quantile table, and stores a start state per coding block so the trellis can adapt to the residual that error feedback carries into it. At two bits CurveTQ is 1-3 points higher in mean downstream accuracy than QTIP and Proteus on three 4-8B Instruct models, even after both are given our start state, which alone lifts either baseline by 1-3 points. It also leads on a 35B mixture of experts, to our knowledge the first trellis-coded result on such a model. With no rotation to undo, our decoder is the fastest of the three at all tested batch sizes and bit widths.

摘要：最佳的兩位元權重量化器，像是 QTIP 和 Proteus，通過隨機正交變換旋轉每個權重矩陣，這必須在每個解碼步驟中被撤銷，然後在歐幾里得搜索下用樹狀碼或格碼進行編碼；層海森矩陣僅通過編碼區塊之間的錯誤反饋進入。我們顯示這會導致部分海森矩陣未被使用。錯誤反饋將損失轉換為每個坐標四捨五入誤差的加權總和，其權重為海森矩陣 LDL 分解的對角線，現有的量化器計算但從不讀取。我們將這些權重放入 Viterbi 分支度量中，因此搜索遵循每個編碼區塊內的曲率。這也解釋了旋轉：它消除了這種區塊內變異，因此在本地基底中的加權和旋轉是替代品。在三個模型上，加權的本地搜索與全維隨機哈達瑪德的準確度相差約一點，而旋轉後的加權增益不大。在這個搜索的基礎上，我們構建了 CurveTQ，一個沒有旋轉的樹狀編解碼器，它使用分解的尺度場和封閉形式的分位數表來處理權重的幅度和邊際形狀，並為每個編碼區塊存儲一個起始狀態，以便樹狀編碼器可以適應錯誤反饋帶入的殘差。在兩位元的情況下，CurveTQ 在三個 4-8B 指令模型上的平均下游準確度比 QTIP 和 Proteus 高出 1-3 點，即使在兩者都給予我們的起始狀態後，僅此一項就能使任一基線提升 1-3 點。它在 35B 專家混合模型上也領先，據我們所知，這是這樣模型上第一個樹狀編碼的結果。由於沒有需要撤銷的旋轉，我們的解碼器在所有測試的批量大小和位寬中都是三者中最快的。

docs.title: Do Vision Models Learn Physical Constraints or Rendering Shortcuts? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Grounded Physical Consistency
docs.text:
2610.09205v1 by M. Moein Esfahani, Sepehr Salem, Mohammed Alser, Vince Calhoun

Modern image editing models can satisfy a text instruction while breaking the physics of the edited scene. A new object may cast no shadow, a mirror may fail to reflect visible geometry, or an object may float above a surface that should support it. We study physical plausibility diagnosis, detecting whether an edited image violates scene physics, naming the violation type, localizing the affected region, and explaining the failure in language. We introduce a counterfactual benchmark whose controlled synthetic component uses Mitsuba~3 to generate 5,500 images from 500 scene families. Each family contains one clean image and ten matched violations involving shadows, reflection, support, surface response, and occlusion. The renderer pipeline provides category labels, affected-region masks and boxes, scene metadata, and explanation targets. We use LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B as diagnostic baselines rather than proposed methods. On a 1,650-image synthetic test set, the adapted baselines reach 64.0--67.8\% category macro-F1 on standard held-out scenes. For LLaVA-1.5-7B, category macro-F1 falls from 64.0\% on the standard split to 40.8\% under intervention shift.
