We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.

摘要：AI 研究代理自動化提議、實施和評估實驗的循環，為遞歸自我改進開辟了一條道路。然而，它們提出實驗的能力超過了在真實環境中執行實驗的能力，使得結果預測成為在有限實驗預算下持續自我改進的關鍵能力。我們調查語言模型作為研究世界模型（RWMs），這些模型預測候選干預在研究環境中的結果。我們的評估基於來自九個研究環境的超過 2,600 條實驗記錄，涵蓋了預訓練、後訓練和推理，代表了超過 171,000 小時的 H100 GPU 實驗。從真實實驗經驗中獲得的研究知識改善了 RWM 對同一環境中未見干預的預測（Spearman +0.27），並且可以在不同環境中重複使用。例如，僅使用來自 OLMo3、Marin 和 Nanochat 的預訓練經驗，RWM 在 Qwen3 環境中將選擇後悔降低了 78%，相比於零經驗設置。這些好處延伸至固定選擇預算下的多輪自動研究：擁有環境內和跨環境研究知識的 RWM 分別提高了最佳增益 15.8% 和 11.6%。對 13 個用作 RWM 的語言模型的消融實驗顯示，添加研究知識可以比僅改變模型或增加推理努力來得更有效地改善干預排名。這些發現支持語言模型作為 RWM，並激勵未來積累實驗數據以進行 RWM 訓練。

docs.title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
docs.text:
2610.12183v1 by Ming Chen, Rong-Xi Tan, Ke Xue, Yu-Jie Zhou, Taiye Lu, Zhi-Xuan Gao, Peng Xie, Zijun Shen, Chen Lu, Haopu Shang, Chao Qian

Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.

摘要：黑箱優化（BBO）出現在許多科學和工程問題中，這些問題的目標評估成本高且有限。最近的大型語言模型（LLM）代理提供了一種新的方法來處理BBO，通過結合任務語義、計算、優化工具和基於反饋的決策，顯示出由於與數學上嚴謹的工具的整合而具有巨大的潛力。然而，現有的代理BBO研究使用不同的任務領域和系統配置，使得它們的結果難以比較，個別設計選擇的影響也難以孤立。因此，我們介紹了AgenticBBO-Bench，一個跨領域的代理BBO基準，涵蓋合成函數、超參數優化、數據庫調優、芯片設計和分子設計，並在統一的有限預算評估協議下進行。在我們的實驗中，代理BBO在所有五個領域中達到了比直接基於LLM的方法更高的家庭平均分數，並在四個領域中超越了最佳數值優化器。我們進一步研究了三個影響代理性能的因素：優化工具、任務信息和先驗知識，以及LLM在搜索過程中的角色。我們的結果顯示，額外的數值工具並不總是能一致地提高性能，任務語義廣泛有用，而更具體的先驗則不太可靠，數值優化器可以有效地吸收代理所建立的搜索軌跡帶來的收益。最後，我們在AgenticBBO-Bench中引入了一個五任務的前沿挑戰，並在Codex代理框架下評估了七個LLM，其中GPT-6 Astra和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash位於所評估模型的性能和成本的Pareto前沿。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo獲得。

docs.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
docs.text:
2610.12176v1 by Hyunin Lee, Jinglue Xu, Jeffrey Seely, Donghyun Lee, Somayeh Sojoudi, Matei Zaharia, Yujin Tang

Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.

摘要：遞歸自我改進（RSI）在無法驗證的任務上，例如開放式研究，當其輸出超過人類專家能可靠評估的範圍時，面臨監督瓶頸，這使得模型本身（優化對象）成為最佳可用的優化器和評估者。然而，單一模型實例在這種同質循環下難以批評和改進其自身的複雜推理。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了多代理自我監督（MASS），這是一種RSI方法，交替進行進化工作流優化和對自生成軌跡的監督微調。根據早期發現，多代理拓撲在複雜推理方面表現出色，MASS促使單一基礎模型迭代地提出、執行和自我評估多代理工作流。通過受結構護欄約束的進化搜索，模型優化這些類計算圖的協調，發現針對特定任務最有效的不同角色和信息路由。在兩個使用Qwen3.6-27B的MASS循環中，該模型在四個開放式公共基準上每個輸出標記的性能提高了1.2-1.6倍。由於改進後的模型隨後作為更好的優化器和評估者，這種交替框架使模型能力的持續遞歸自我啟動成為可能。此外，多代理軌跡的訓練效率也更高：在其上訓練的學生超越了在1.4倍更多訓練標記上訓練的單代理學生。這些發現表明，從多代理軌跡共同學習協調和有界子代理執行可以為RSI提供有效的信號。

docs.title: Scalable Hierarchical Graph Generation via Soft Community Structure
docs.text:
2610.12163v1 by Ahmet Tüzen, Helge Langseth, Kjetil Nørvåg

Generating large attributed graphs requires reproducing the topology, generating attributes jointly with the structure, and remaining scalable. Many real-world graphs exist as a single large graph, so a generative model has to generalize from the one graph it is fit on, without independent samples. We present Schema, which recursively decomposes a reference graph into a hierarchy of soft communities, assigning each node a membership distribution. Generation is then split into three stages, each trained independently: (1) synthesizing node attributes conditioned on soft memberships, (2) generating intra-community edges from local structural context, and (3) modeling inter-community connections over bridge nodes whose membership mass is distributed across several communities. No stage forms the full adjacency matrix, and each stage operates on a subgraph bounded by the community size. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that covers structural fidelity, memorization, downstream utility, and scalability. On four real-world attributed graphs, Schema recovers the balance between local and long-range structure more closely than any other model that generates attributes, while reproducing only a small fraction of the reference edges. It retains the downstream accuracy of the reference graph without raising it artificially above that level. Baselines that match its structural fidelity memorize the reference, while those with higher downstream accuracy either exceed the reference accuracy or fail to complete on the larger graphs. We measure scalability on six additional graphs with up to 10 million nodes.

摘要：生成大型屬性圖需要重現拓撲結構，與結構共同生成屬性，並保持可擴展性。許多現實世界的圖存在為一個大型圖，因此生成模型必須從其擬合的單一圖中進行概括，而沒有獨立的樣本。我們提出了 Schema，它將參考圖遞歸地分解為一個軟社群的層次結構，並為每個節點分配一個成員分佈。生成過程分為三個階段，每個階段獨立訓練：（1）根據軟成員資格合成節點屬性，（2）從局部結構上下文生成社群內邊緣，以及（3）建模跨社群連接，這些連接通過其成員質量分佈在多個社群中的橋接節點。沒有一個階段形成完整的鄰接矩陣，每個階段在由社群大小界定的子圖上運作。我們還介紹了一個評估協議，涵蓋結構保真度、記憶化、下游效用和可擴展性。在四個現實世界的屬性圖上，Schema 更接近於恢復局部和長距結構之間的平衡，超過了任何其他生成屬性的模型，同時僅重現參考邊緣的一小部分。它保持了參考圖的下游準確性，而不會人為地提高到那個水平。與其結構保真度相匹配的基準會記住參考，而那些具有更高下游準確性的基準要麼超過參考準確性，要麼無法在較大的圖上完成。我們在六個額外的圖上測量可擴展性，這些圖的節點數量高達 1000 萬。

docs.title: Use and Disuse: Intent-Structured Experience Consolidation for Memory and Learning in LLM Agents
docs.text:
2610.12124v1 by Xiangyi Zeng, Baihang Liu, Xutong Wang, Ze Jin, Yunpeng Li, Qixu Liu

The evolution of Large Language Model agents from single-task execution to long-term autonomous operation highlights the critical challenge of transforming continuous experiences into reusable knowledge. To address this, we propose Hippocam, a hierarchical memory and continual learning architecture. Hippocam draws inspiration from two characteristics of human memory: cognitive processes selectively maintain information relevant to current goals, while long-term memories form gradually through repeated consolidation. Accordingly, Hippocam structures an agent's ongoing work as nested intents. The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.

摘要：大型語言模型代理從單一任務執行演變到長期自主運作，突顯了將持續經驗轉化為可重用知識的關鍵挑戰。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了Hippocam，一種層次記憶和持續學習架構。Hippocam從人類記憶的兩個特徵中獲得靈感：認知過程選擇性地維持與當前目標相關的信息，而長期記憶則通過重複鞏固逐漸形成。因此，Hippocam將代理的持續工作結構化為嵌套意圖。活動上下文始終集中於當前意圖，而已完成的意圖則被鞏固為與任務相關的結果和後續工作所需的狀態，而不是攜帶其完整的工作細節。同時，一種遞歸前綴鞏固機制反覆鞏固早期歷史，導致長期未使用的經驗變得越來越抽象。原始互動得以保留，使代理能夠通過層次結構逐步恢復更細緻的細節，並在獲得足夠信息後停止。關鍵是，當過去的經驗被回憶並重新整合到當前工作中時，它們會與新經驗一起經歷隨後的鞏固，從而被加強、補充和更新。通過這種使用與不使用的記憶動態，Hippocam將工作上下文、長期記憶、知識積累和技能學習連接在一個不斷演變的經驗過程中。這使得代理能夠通過自身的經驗學習和發展能力，而無需參數更新。

docs.title: Using Weisfeiler-Leman Features for Algorithm Selection in Constraint Optimisation
docs.text:
2610.12119v1 by Alessio Pellegrino, Jacopo Mauro

Algorithm Selection is essential for efficient Constraint Programming. Over the years, many algorithm selectors based on machine learning methods have been successfully applied, yet traditional feature extraction methods often rely on manually decided instance-level statistics that fail to capture the underlying problem structure. In this paper we aim to bridge this gap by introducing a novel, automated feature extraction methodology that integrates graph conversion and Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernels to generate robust structural representations of problem instances. The 1-WL test bounds the graph-distinguishing power of standard message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and suitable GNN architectures match this bound \citep{Xuetal2018}. WL-based features offer an alternative that does not require training a GNN. Our primary contribution is a cut-based representation (\texttt{WLc}) designed to model structural partitions and provide a more nuanced predictive signal. We evaluate our approach on instances from the 2023--2025 MiniZinc Challenges across two tasks: maximizing Borda count scores and maximizing predictive accuracy. Experimental results across Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and Multi-Layer Perceptrons demonstrate that cut-based features outperform \texttt{fzn2feat} with SVMs, while results with RFs and MLPs are closer.

摘要：算法選擇對於高效的約束編程至關重要。多年來，許多基於機器學習方法的算法選擇器已成功應用，然而傳統的特徵提取方法往往依賴於手動決定的實例級統計，這無法捕捉潛在的問題結構。在本文中，我們旨在填補這一空白，通過引入一種新穎的自動化特徵提取方法，該方法整合了圖轉換和Weisfeiler-Lehman圖核，以生成問題實例的穩健結構表示。1-WL測試界定了標準消息傳遞圖神經網絡（GNNs）的圖區分能力，而合適的GNN架構符合這一界限\citep{Xuetal2018}。基於WL的特徵提供了一種不需要訓練GNN的替代方案。我們的主要貢獻是一種基於切割的表示（\texttt{WLc}），旨在建模結構分區並提供更細緻的預測信號。我們在2023-2025年MiniZinc挑戰賽中的實例上評估我們的方法，涵蓋兩個任務：最大化Borda計數分數和最大化預測準確性。在支持向量機、隨機森林和多層感知機上的實驗結果顯示，基於切割的特徵在SVM中優於\texttt{fzn2feat}，而在RF和MLP中的結果則更接近。

docs.title: Universal Textual Teaching for LLMs
docs.text:
2610.12114v1 by Zhanyi Lu, Huan Wang

Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret or reuse across models and limits KD for API-only or costly-to-train models. This paper studies knowledge transfer for large language models (LLMs). We introduce Universal Textual Teaching (UTT), a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into a textual, interpretable, and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer. Specifically, UTT first identifies representative gap cases through paired evaluations, and iteratively updates the Primer via multi-role interactions: the Student attempts each task, the Prompter turns evaluation feedback into a teaching instruction, the Teacher provides a targeted demonstration, and the Synthesizer consolidates validated lessons. Empirically, on the challenging math (Omni-MATH-2) and code generation (KernelBench) tasks, extensive results confirm the effectiveness of the method: UTT remarkably raises the Student's accuracy from 9.4% to 48.6% and Fast1 accuracy from 9% to 35% on KernelBench, while increasing mathematical reasoning accuracy from 27.6% to 51.7%. UTT also performs better than representative prompt engineering and parameter-based KD methods. Of note, UTT is shown to be generalizable across different Teachers and Students: a Primer synthesized for one Teacher-Student pair can generalize to other Students that do not participate in the synthesis.

摘要：知識蒸餾（KD）將知識從更強大的教師模型轉移到較弱的學生模型，但大多數方法需要訓練學生參數，從而將蒸餾的知識綁定到特定的架構和檢查點。這種隱式表示難以解釋或在模型之間重用，並限制了僅限於API或訓練成本高的模型的KD。本文研究大型語言模型（LLMs）的知識轉移。我們介紹了通用文本教學（UTT），這是一個無需參數更新的框架，將觀察到的教師-學生知識差距蒸餾為一種可解釋且可重用的自然語言工件，稱為Primer。具體而言，UTT首先通過配對評估識別代表性的差距案例，並通過多角色互動迭代更新Primer：學生嘗試每個任務，提示者將評估反饋轉化為教學指令，教師提供針對性的示範，而合成者整合驗證的教訓。在具有挑戰性的數學（Omni-MATH-2）和代碼生成（KernelBench）任務上，實證結果確認了該方法的有效性：UTT顯著將學生的準確率從9.4%提高到48.6%，並將KernelBench上的Fast1準確率從9%提高到35%，同時將數學推理準確率從27.6%提高到51.7%。UTT的表現也優於代表性的提示工程和基於參數的KD方法。值得注意的是，UTT被證明在不同的教師和學生之間具有可泛化性：為一對教師-學生合成的Primer可以泛化到其他未參與合成的學生。

docs.title: ILM: An AI-Powered Storytelling Educational Tool
docs.text:
2610.12064v1 by Suhaila Mohammed, Abdelaziz Serour, Allison Lahnala

Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.

摘要：數位技術使伊斯蘭敘事變得更易於獲取，但現有平台對於結構化學習和理解這些故事的支持有限，特別是在阿拉伯語和多語言環境中。我們提出了ILM，一個針對先知故事的互動教育平台，結合了阿拉伯語自然語言處理、結構化知識表示和基於檢索的問題生成。經管理員批准的阿拉伯語敘事由知識圖譜(KG)構建引擎處理，該引擎識別實體和敘事關係，並將其存儲為結構化知識，使學習者能夠通過可視化故事地圖探索故事，並回答從KG生成的基於實體和關係的問題。另設有多語言檢索管道，從原始敘事中檢索相關段落，以生成多選和開放式理解問題。對於開放式問題，LLM作為評審，根據檢索到的段落和參考答案評估學習者的回答以確定正確性。該平台還將可蘭經內容作為單獨的豐富層納入，允許選定的敘事補充來源支持的信息。通過將結構化知識與基於段落的檢索相結合，ILM支持阿拉伯語和多語言內容的敘事探索、理解和評估。該系統展示了結構化知識表示和基於檢索的生成相結合以支持伊斯蘭敘事互動學習的可行性。演示版可在anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF獲得。

docs.title: MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation
docs.text:
2610.12039v1 by Mahtab Sarvmaili

Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.

摘要：圖神經網絡（GNNs）從化學圖數據中預測分子性質，但預測準確性並未解釋圖信息如何支持個別決策。緊湊的預測保留理由不一定能揭示哪些變更會逆轉決策或模型能容忍哪些修改。我們提出了多角度圖解釋器（MPGE），統一事實支持、反事實敏感性和樣本容忍度，針對一個固定的分類器。事實視角，最初稱為原型（PT），尋求一組緊湊的保留邊集，具有相同的標籤和所需的信心。反事實（CF）解釋尋求有限的改變預測的刪除；樣本（EXE）解釋尋求保留標籤和信心的非平凡有限刪除。共享的約束公式連接預測行為、緊湊性和編輯成本，而單獨的目標生成這三種視角。我們的CF-GNNExplainer的圖分類擴展學習對稱邊排名並驗證離散候選，記錄不成功的搜索。單獨的 BBBP 片段後端返回經過RDKit清理的分子。我們在MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD和BBBP上評估主要的GCN實現，使用語義覆蓋、條件質量、穩定性和運行時間。成功的事實掩碼在各數據集上平均保留了8.6%--15.5%的輸入邊；有限的反事實覆蓋率為4.8%--67.6%，樣本保留覆蓋率為98.9%--100.0%。探索性控制揭示了硬投影和保留節點信息的影響。定量比較和分子可視化特徵化模型支持、敏感性和容忍度，而不將其視為經過驗證的化學機制。

docs.title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
docs.text:
2610.11978v1 by Xing Li, Qingcheng Chang, Jinzhong Ning, Changfeng Xu, Shenlong Zhang, Yijia Zhang, Ling Luo, Hongfei Lin

Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.

摘要：Jev是一個「系統一」模型，它在給定選項中返回一個選擇，而不是生成文本。我們研究這種專門的決策模型與通用大型語言模型（LLMs）之間的比較。我們在涵蓋知識、推理和多語言理解的13個選擇題基準上評估Jev，並將其與19個LLMs進行比較，分為三個層級：前沿、代表性和小型。Jev在知識和常識基準上與前沿LLMs具有競爭力，並在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上獲得最佳分數。在數學以外的領域，它的表現也超過了大多數代表性LLMs和所有小型LLMs。然而，在數學文字題上，它的表現不如人意：在MathQA上，它比前沿中位數低17.7分，並且得分低於所有19個LLMs。這些結果表明，專門的決策模型可以在主要依賴知識的決策上與通用LLMs匹敵，但在需要多步計算的決策上則不然。

docs.title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
docs.text:
2610.11966v1 by Mengdi Liu, Wenjue Chen, Wenyue Chen, Cheng Yang, Fanqi Kong, Zhangyang Gao, Xiaoxue Cheng, Yiheng Li, Yujian Yuan, Keliang Li, Hong Chang, Shiguang Shan, Chenglin Wu

Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.

摘要：研究想法創新是科學進步的基本引擎，但在可擴展和可控的方式下生成和評估仍然困難。這一挑戰在於其固有的開放性和多目標性質，想法應該平衡新穎性、合理性和可行性。儘管最近基於大型語言模型的方法通過精心設計的提示或代理管道取得了進展，但它們受到預定義的靜態創意工作流程的限制。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了MindFlow，一個明確將創意表述為心智中的圖結構流的框架，該框架由模塊化思維運算符組成，並由概率心智超網絡建模。給定一個研究主題，控制器動態地抽樣思維流以生成候選想法。這一開放性問題通過基於比賽的相對排名進行優化，使控制器能夠逐步偏好更高質量的思維流。我們進一步引入了一種評估協議，聯合評估問題發現和問題解決，超越僅基於標題或摘要的判斷。在多樣的主題中，MindFlow顯示出其作為一個明確、可控和可優化的研究想法創新者的優越性。

docs.title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
docs.text:
2610.11920v1 by Yichen Liu, Chunfeng Yuan, Haowei Liu, Wenjuan Li, Zefeng Lin, Bing Li, Xu Chen, Weiming Hu

For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories. To address these limitations, we propose QGMem, a novel memory construction and activation framework motivated by human memory, in which experience is organized into events and query-relevant events are modeled by graph as working memory. QGMem converts long dialogue histories into event-indexed atomic memory units that preserve individual experiences and consolidates related units into dynamic memory traces that retain state trajectories and current states. When a query arrives, hybrid memory retrieval gathers complementary candidate memories, and query-aware reranking activates the most relevant units as a compact working memory. To expose relational dependencies in the working memory and support conflict-aware reasoning, QGMem organizes the working memory as a local graph, which is then encoded as a graph token and provided to the LLM together with the textual working memory to improve evidence utilization during answer generation. Experiments across six benchmarks validate the framework and show consistent gains in retrieval, multi-hop evidence composition, conflict resolution, and ultra-long dialogue reasoning with compact contexts and moderate inference cost.

摘要：對於持久且個性化的對話代理，記憶系統可以使它們通過存儲過去的互動和檢索相關信息來記住、更新和推理長期歷史。現有的記憶系統通常遵循兩種範式：平面結構記憶和基於圖的記憶。前者輕量級，但使事件關係和狀態更新隱含，而後者則明確建模記憶結構，但會產生額外的構建成本並引入長期歷史中的無關關係。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了QGMem，一個受到人類記憶啟發的創新記憶構建和激活框架，其中經驗被組織成事件，並通過圖模型化查詢相關事件作為工作記憶。QGMem將長對話歷史轉換為事件索引的原子記憶單元，這些單元保留個體經驗，並將相關單元整合成動態記憶痕跡，以保持狀態軌跡和當前狀態。當查詢到達時，混合記憶檢索收集互補的候選記憶，而查詢感知的重新排序激活最相關的單元作為緊湊的工作記憶。為了揭示工作記憶中的關係依賴並支持衝突感知推理，QGMem將工作記憶組織為一個局部圖，然後將其編碼為圖令牌，並與文本工作記憶一起提供給LLM，以改善在生成答案過程中的證據利用。跨越六個基準的實驗驗證了該框架，並顯示在檢索、多跳證據組合、衝突解決和超長對話推理方面的一致增益，具有緊湊的上下文和適度的推理成本。

docs.title: Not Every Change Is Necessary: Recoverable Drift in Large Language Model Unlearning
docs.text:
2610.11915v1 by Xunlei Chen, Qinghui Gong, Jingkun Xue, Qihe Liu, Shijie Zhou, Fei Ye

Machine unlearning in large language models aims to remove unwanted knowledge while preserving the model's remaining capabilities. Although existing methods use retention objectives or restrict where edits occur, achieving the desired forgetting level can still leave collateral changes that impair non-target behavior. Our recovery comparisons suggest that some of these changes can be reversed while preserving observed forgetting performance. In this work, we present Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U), a framework that combines targeted forgetting with the recovery of non-target capabilities. PTP-U first applies local analytic edits to weaken target knowledge associations, then aligns non-target output distributions with those of the original model to recover capabilities while maintaining fixed forgetting constraints. Both stages serve a common goal: satisfying the forgetting requirements while preserving fluent generation and performance on non-target tasks. Across three benchmarks, PTP-U achieves the strongest forgetting-retention trade-off among evaluated methods, reaching 81.22%-91.03% forgetting while preserving 94.20% non-target utility on average. At matched forgetting, PTP-U consistently retains higher non-target utility.

摘要：機器忘記在大型語言模型中的目的是移除不必要的知識，同時保留模型的其他能力。雖然現有的方法使用保留目標或限制編輯發生的地方，但達到所需的遺忘水平仍可能留下影響非目標行為的附帶變化。我們的恢復比較表明，這些變化中的一些可以在保留觀察到的遺忘性能的同時被逆轉。在這項工作中，我們提出了提議然後投影的忘記（PTP-U），這是一個將有針對性的遺忘與非目標能力的恢復相結合的框架。PTP-U 首先應用局部分析編輯來削弱目標知識的關聯，然後將非目標輸出分佈與原始模型的分佈對齊，以在保持固定遺忘約束的同時恢復能力。這兩個階段的共同目標是：滿足遺忘要求，同時保持流暢的生成和在非目標任務上的性能。在三個基準中，PTP-U 在評估的方法中實現了最強的遺忘-保留權衡，達到 81.22%-91.03% 的遺忘，同時平均保留 94.20% 的非目標效用。在匹配的遺忘下，PTP-U 始終保持更高的非目標效用。

docs.title: AuraLuxMuse: Adaptive Fusion Modeling for Aesthetic Stage Lighting Design with Music and Expert Guidance
docs.text:
2610.11792v1 by Junyu Deng, Jiale Cao, Mengtian Li, Zhongxia Ji, Ruhua Chen, Yiyi He, Guangnan Ye, Zuo Hu

We present AuraLuxMuse, a novel system for automated aesthetic stage lighting design that integrates expert knowledge, representation learning, and preference-adaptive modeling. Lighting design in live performance settings requires the seamless translation of musical features into dynamic lighting behaviors. However, traditional workflows remain time-consuming, labor-intensive, and difficult to transfer. AuraLuxMuse encodes music and professional cue sequences into a shared retrieval space, estimates cue-event density, and retargets selected fixture commands to the destination stage. It assists pre-production authoring by returning editable cues rather than replacing the designer with an unconstrained generator. At the heart of AuraLuxMuse are two key modules: Lighting-Aligned Music Pretraining (LAMP), which performs contrastive learning between audio and lighting cues for alignment, and Preference-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (PAMoE), which conditions preference-aware cue retrieval and adaptation on designers' intent through a gated ensemble of style-specific expert networks. To support training and evaluation, we introduce Musilux, the first dataset of paired musical audio and professional lighting cue sequences under diverse performance scenarios. We evaluate AuraLuxMuse across both virtual simulation environments and professional-grade laboratories. Experimental results, including objective and subjective evaluation, demonstrate that AuraLuxMuse retrieves and adapts stage-lighting cues that are visually cohesive, semantically meaningful, and artistically expressive, showing its potential for AI-assisted aesthetic stage design.

摘要：我們提出AuraLuxMuse，一個新穎的自動化美學舞台燈光設計系統，整合了專家知識、表徵學習和偏好自適應建模。現場表演環境中的燈光設計需要將音樂特徵無縫轉換為動態燈光行為。然而，傳統工作流程仍然耗時、勞動密集且難以轉移。AuraLuxMuse將音樂和專業提示序列編碼到共享檢索空間中，估計提示事件密度，並將選定的燈具命令重新定向到目標舞台。它通過返回可編輯的提示來輔助前期製作，而不是用不受限制的生成器取代設計師。AuraLuxMuse的核心是兩個關鍵模塊：燈光對齊音樂預訓練（LAMP），它在音頻和燈光提示之間進行對比學習以實現對齊，以及偏好自適應專家混合（PAMoE），它通過風格特定專家網絡的門控集成，根據設計師的意圖調整偏好感知的提示檢索和適應。為了支持訓練和評估，我們引入了Musilux，這是第一個在多樣化表演場景下配對的音樂音頻和專業燈光提示序列數據集。我們在虛擬模擬環境和專業級實驗室中評估AuraLuxMuse。實驗結果，包括客觀和主觀評估，表明AuraLuxMuse檢索和適應的舞台燈光提示在視覺上具有一致性、語義上有意義且藝術上表現出色，顯示出其在AI輔助美學舞台設計中的潛力。

docs.title: Safe Actions Alone Do Not Ensure Safe Agents: Identifying Unfulfilled Obligations with Guard Models
docs.text:
2610.11773v1 by Youwei Feng, Yitong Zhang, Yuetong Liu, Jia Li

Guard models are increasingly used to safeguard LLM-based agents, primarily by identifying actions that agents are forbidden to perform. However, identifying forbidden actions alone is insufficient to ensure agent safety. In this paper, we argue that agent safety also depends on identifying required yet unperformed safety-critical actions, which we call obligations. Our preliminary study on a popular benchmark for evaluating safety shows that 56.92% of GLM-5.3 trajectories contain unfulfilled obligations, compared with only 30.00% containing forbidden actions. This finding reveals unfulfilled obligations as a major and previously overlooked source of safety risk. However, to our knowledge, no existing benchmark evaluates whether guard models can identify these obligations. To close this gap, we introduce ObligationBench, the first benchmark for evaluating the capability of obligation identification, comprising 240 expert-validated trajectories covering issue resolution, feature development, and terminal operations. Our evaluation of 14 representative models reveals substantial limitations: the highest recall and exact-match rate are only 48.97% and 10.00%, respectively. To address these limitations, we develop ObligationGuard using 40,000 synthetic training examples. ObligationGuard achieves 57.52% recall and an exact-match rate of 21.67%, surpassing all evaluated models on both metrics. We call on the community to incorporate obligation identification into the design and evaluation of future guard models to improve agent safety.

摘要：守護模型越來越多地用於保護基於LLM的代理，主要是通過識別代理被禁止執行的行為。然而，僅僅識別被禁止的行為不足以確保代理的安全。在本文中，我們主張代理的安全性還取決於識別所需但未執行的安全關鍵行為，我們稱之為義務。我們對一個流行的安全評估基準的初步研究顯示，56.92%的GLM-5.3軌跡包含未履行的義務，而只有30.00%包含被禁止的行為。這一發現揭示了未履行的義務作為一個主要且之前被忽視的安全風險來源。然而，據我們所知，現有的基準並未評估守護模型是否能識別這些義務。為了填補這一空白，我們推出了ObligationBench，這是第一個評估義務識別能力的基準，包含240個經專家驗證的軌跡，涵蓋問題解決、功能開發和終端操作。我們對14個代表性模型的評估顯示出顯著的局限性：最高的召回率和精確匹配率分別僅為48.97%和10.00%。為了解決這些局限性，我們使用40,000個合成訓練範例開發了ObligationGuard。ObligationGuard達到了57.52%的召回率和21.67%的精確匹配率，在這兩個指標上超越了所有評估的模型。我們呼籲社區在未來的守護模型設計和評估中納入義務識別，以提高代理的安全性。

docs.title: Narrow and Deep: An Ontology Tower as the Knowledge of an LLM Agent for an Industrial Equipment System
docs.text:
2610.11768v1 by Younghwan Joo, Sung-il Kim

Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to operate industrial energy equipment, and what they get right depends on what they are told about the plant. Established building ontologies name many kinds of points across many sites, whereas an industrial equipment system needs few entities with much knowledge about each. This study proposes the ontology tower, a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system whose knowledge deepens in two ways: through quantities derived from the measured points by physical relations, and through lessons from the operating journal incorporated as knowledge nodes. On a real low-humidity air-handling test plant operated daily through a programmable logic controller, agents received a text projected from its tower in a preregistered evaluation of nine tasks replayed from the plant's records, using four open-weight models from 9 to about 750 billion parameters. This knowledge raised the rate at which the agents avoided the most plausible misjudgment of each task by about 20 percentage points, and the overall task score of the 9-billion-parameter model as much as that of the largest. Operating lessons were used when incorporated into the tower or placed in the prompt as records, but seldom when left in the journal behind a search tool. In live runs through an invariant safety layer, the agents brought the controlled variable into its target band in 12 of 14 runs. An ontology narrow in entities but deep in what is known about them can thus supply the knowledge that an agent for an industrial equipment system needs.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLM）代理開始操作工業能源設備，而它們的表現取決於對工廠的了解。已建立的建築本體論在許多地點命名了多種點，而工業設備系統需要的實體較少，但對每個實體的知識卻要豐富。本研究提出了本體塔，這是一個狹窄而深入的單一設備系統本體，其知識以兩種方式深化：通過由物理關係導出的測量點的數量，以及通過作業日誌中的經驗教訓作為知識節點。在一個實際的低濕度空氣處理測試工廠中，該工廠通過可編程邏輯控制器每日運行，代理從其塔中接收了一個文本，該文本是在預先註冊的評估中重播的九個任務，使用了四個從9到約750億參數的開放權重模型。這些知識使代理避免每個任務最可能的錯誤判斷的比率提高了約20個百分點，而9億參數模型的整體任務分數達到了最大的模型的水平。當作業教訓被納入塔中或作為記錄放入提示中時，會被使用，但當留在搜索工具後的日誌中時，則很少被使用。在通過不變安全層的實時運行中，代理在14次運行中的12次將受控變量帶入其目標範圍。因此，實體狹窄但對其知識深入的本體可以提供工業設備系統代理所需的知識。

docs.title: What Output-Only Review Cannot Verify: Study Contracts for Research Agents
docs.text:
2610.11754v1 by Eitan Waks, Ben Glocker

Some defects in an AI-generated study can be identified from its artifacts; others require knowledge of what was approved before execution. We propose study contracts that bind declared experimental choices, run obligations and claim scope to recorded execution evidence, and distinguish this contract-relative verification from scientific truth. A diagnostic using eight self-authored clean/mutated pairs illustrates the information boundary. A deterministic checker applying a registered, fault-specific rule to approved and executed objects detected all eight registered mutations. Across eighteen recorded judge aliases given individual metadata-filtered packages without pair context or the registry-selected fault label, 104 of 144 mutated evaluation cases received defect flags; the remaining cases comprised 32 abstentions and eight terminal failures, with no explicit clean decisions on mutated cases. Some packages retained approval and execution fields, including digests. The prompt instructed judges to abstain when evidence was insufficient. These results characterize a deliberately information-asymmetric development setting; they do not isolate the effect of authoritative information from differences in task specification and rule selection, and they are not comparative verifier quality or agent reward hacking. We identify full-information comparisons, legitimate-adaptation controls and closed-loop agent evaluations as necessary tests of whether contract checks improve useful compliant completion under optimization.

摘要：一些AI生成研究中的缺陷可以從其工件中識別出來；其他缺陷則需要了解在執行之前所批准的內容。我們提出的研究合同將已聲明的實驗選擇、執行義務和索賠範圍與記錄的執行證據綁定，並將這種合同相對的驗證與科學真理區分開來。使用八對自創的乾淨/變異對進行的診斷說明了信息邊界。一個應用註冊的、針對特定故障的確定性檢查器對已批准和執行的對象檢測到了所有八個註冊的變異。在十八個記錄的法官別名中，給予個別元數據過濾的包裹，沒有對對的背景或註冊選擇的故障標籤，144個變異評估案例中有104個收到了缺陷標記；其餘案例包括32個棄權和八個終端失敗，對變異案例沒有明確的乾淨決策。一些包裹保留了批准和執行字段，包括摘要。提示指示法官在證據不足時棄權。這些結果特徵化了一個故意的信息不對稱發展環境；它們並未將權威信息的影響與任務規範和規則選擇的差異隔離開來，且它們也不是比較驗證者質量或代理獎勵黑客。我們確定全信息比較、合法適應控制和閉環代理評估是必要的測試，以判斷合同檢查是否改善了在優化下的有用合規完成。

docs.title: MAP4CS: A Multi-dimensional Data Pruning Framework for Efficient Code Retriever Fine-tuning
docs.text:
2610.11727v1 by Yuxuan Chen, Mingwei Liu, Guangsheng Ou, Zekai Zhang, Zike Li, Yanlin Wang, Pelin Zheng

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a cornerstone in software engineering for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) with domain-specific knowledge. However, adapting retrievers to evolving code repositories remains challenging due to the noise and redundancy inherent in massive code corpora. Standard fine-tuning on the full corpus is computationally expensive and often leads to sub-optimal performance due to negative transfer from low-quality samples. Conversely, simple random sampling fails to guarantee data representativeness. To address these challenges, we propose MAP4CS (Multi-dimensional Awareness Pruning for Code Search), an adaptive data pruning framework. MAP4CS identifies a small, high-quality core subset by integrating syntactic structure, semantic diversity, and distributional representation, followed by a rigorous rule-based filtering pipeline. Extensive experiments on two large-scale datasets demonstrate that MAP4CS consistently outperforms random sampling baselines using only 5% of the training data. Remarkably, it achieves performance comparable to, or even superior to, fine-tuning on the full dataset, validating the ''less is more'' hypothesis in data-centric AI. Furthermore, linguistic analysis reveals an adaptive optimization mechanism: MAP4CS automatically functions as a de-duplicator for redundant corpora and a denoiser for chaotic ones, constructing a training corpus that is both lexically diverse and information-dense.

摘要：檢索增強生成（RAG）已成為軟體工程中提升大型語言模型（LLMs）與特定領域知識的基石。然而，將檢索器適應於不斷變化的程式碼庫仍然具有挑戰性，因為大量程式碼語料庫中固有的噪聲和冗餘。在整個語料庫上進行標準微調計算成本高昂，並且通常因低質量樣本的負面轉移而導致次優性能。相反，簡單的隨機抽樣無法保證數據的代表性。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了MAP4CS（多維度意識修剪用於程式碼搜索），這是一個自適應數據修剪框架。MAP4CS通過整合語法結構、語義多樣性和分佈表示來識別一個小的高質量核心子集，然後進行嚴格的基於規則的過濾流程。在兩個大規模數據集上的廣泛實驗表明，MAP4CS在僅使用5%的訓練數據時，始終優於隨機抽樣基準。值得注意的是，它的性能可與全數據集的微調相媲美，甚至更優，驗證了數據中心人工智慧中的「少即是多」假設。此外，語言分析揭示了一種自適應優化機制：MAP4CS自動作為冗餘語料的去重器和混亂語料的去噪器，構建一個在詞彙上多樣且信息密集的訓練語料庫。

docs.title: A 3D Characterization Framework for Intelligent Sequential Decision Making
docs.text:
2610.11696v1 by Sadig Gojayev, Carolina Fortuna

Puzzles are widely used to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) systems for sequential decision making, yet approaches originating from different paradigms are rarely compared under unified conditions. To address this gap, we introduce a three-dimensional characterization framework that enables the analysts of AI methods by 1) projecting them to the Markov decision process (MDP) sequential decision making formalism, 2) degree of autonomy through human prior ranking of their designs and, 3) skill and computational cost. Using this framework, we analyze how representative graph-based, reinforcement learning, and large language model (LLM)-based approaches differ in their design choices and performance characteristics, instantiated respectively by Neurosolver, forward-backward reinforcement learning (FBRL), and automated thought-of-search (AutoToS), including a double-agent extension of thought-of-search (DA-ToS). The analysis relies on the Tower of Hanoi puzzle that provides a controlled benchmark with well-defined rules and scalable complexity, enabling consistent comparison across increasing problem sizes. The 3D characterization reveals that LLM-based methods, due to their weakly constrained action-space design, shift complexity from architecture to inference-time verification, leading to substantially higher memory and runtime costs than Neurosolver and FBRL.

摘要：拼圖廣泛用於評估人工智慧（AI）系統在序列決策中的推理能力，但來自不同範式的方法在統一條件下很少進行比較。為了解決這一問題，我們引入了一個三維特徵化框架，使AI方法的分析者能夠通過1）將其投影到馬爾可夫決策過程（MDP）序列決策形式，2）通過人類對其設計的先前排名來評估自主程度，以及3）技能和計算成本。利用這個框架，我們分析了基於圖形的、強化學習的和大型語言模型（LLM）基礎的方法在設計選擇和性能特徵上的差異，分別由Neurosolver、前向-後向強化學習（FBRL）和自動搜索思維（AutoToS）實例化，包括思維搜索的雙代理擴展（DA-ToS）。該分析依賴於河內塔拼圖，該拼圖提供了一個具有明確規則和可擴展複雜性的受控基準，從而使不同問題大小之間的比較變得一致。3D特徵化顯示，由於LLM基礎方法的行動空間設計約束較弱，複雜性從架構轉移到推理時間驗證，導致其內存和運行時間成本顯著高於Neurosolver和FBRL。

docs.title: Structured Sentiment Analysis Using Sequence Labeling as Dependency Graph Parsing
docs.text:
2610.11695v1 by Muhammad Imran, Ana Ezquerro, Carlos Gómez-Rodríguez, Anders Søgaard, David Vilares

This study addresses the problem of structured sentiment analysis, whose goal is to obtain a fine-grained sentiment graph where the nodes represent spans of sentiment holders, targets, and expressions, while the arcs define the relationships among them. Our proposed approach casts the task as dependency graph parsing, but departs from traditional parsing methods by solving it through sequence labeling. To do so, we leverage recent advances in linearized graph encodings that allow each word in the input to be assigned a label, effectively capturing the structure of the dependency graph. We conducted experiments on seven datasets spanning five languages (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, and Catalan), showing performance competitive with leading, more complex single-model approaches.

摘要：這項研究針對結構化情感分析的問題，目標是獲得一個細緻的情感圖，其中節點代表情感持有者、目標和表達的範圍，而弧則定義它們之間的關係。我們提出的方法將這項任務視為依賴圖解析，但與傳統的解析方法不同，通過序列標記來解決它。為此，我們利用最近在線性化圖編碼方面的進展，使輸入中的每個單詞都能被分配一個標籤，有效捕捉依賴圖的結構。我們在涵蓋五種語言（英語、西班牙語、挪威語、巴斯克語和加泰羅尼亞語）的七個數據集上進行了實驗，顯示出與領先的、更複雜的單模型方法具有競爭力的性能。

docs.title: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning?
docs.text:
2610.11692v1 by Yi Ma, Tianpei Yang, Yaodong Yang, Weixun Wang, Hongyao Tang

Foundation models supply reinforcement learning (RL) with priors that mitigate its longstanding weaknesses in sample efficiency and transfer, but their token-by-token generation makes queries sequential and costly. Jev, a recently released decision model, generates nothing and returns calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass. Existing work studies foundation models in RL either as models to be trained or as generators to be prompted, and Jev belongs to neither category, having so far served only as a black box in single domains. How well such a model decides on its own in RL environments, and how it can improve RL as a component of training, therefore remain unaddressed. To this end, in this paper we first examine the requirements that the objects of an RL system place on the answers they consume, and establish that Jev can fulfill all of them except the cardinal use of a value function. The remaining objects form positions that admit several roles each. We then construct algorithms that employ Jev at three of these positions, as a reference policy, an exploration judge, and a replay rater, to improve sample efficiency, exploration, and learning performance. Across nine MiniGrid tasks and three Atari games, training with Jev outperforms a standard RL learner, including where the learner makes no progress alone, while the model itself remains untrained. To our knowledge, we present the first use of Jev within the RL learning process and establish a frozen decision model as a usable component of RL training, inviting further exploration of how Jev and other advanced decision models can improve RL.

摘要：基礎模型為強化學習（RL）提供了減輕其在樣本效率和轉移方面長期弱點的先驗知識，但其逐字生成使得查詢變得順序且成本高昂。Jev是一個最近發布的決策模型，它不生成任何東西，而是在單次前向傳遞中返回經過校準的類型答案。現有的研究將基礎模型在RL中視為要訓練的模型或作為需要提示的生成器，而Jev既不屬於這兩類，迄今為止僅作為單一領域中的黑箱運作。因此，這樣的模型在RL環境中獨立決策的能力，以及它如何作為訓練的一部分改善RL，仍然未被解決。為此，在本文中，我們首先檢視RL系統對其消耗的答案所施加的要求，並確立Jev可以滿足除值函數的基本用途外的所有要求。剩餘的對象形成的角色各自承擔多個職能。我們然後構建算法，在這三個角色中使用Jev，作為參考策略、探索判斷者和重放評分者，以改善樣本效率、探索和學習表現。在九個MiniGrid任務和三個Atari遊戲中，使用Jev進行訓練優於標準的RL學習者，包括在學習者單獨無法取得進展的情況下，而模型本身仍然保持未訓練。據我們所知，我們首次在RL學習過程中使用Jev，並確立了一個固定的決策模型作為RL訓練的可用組件，邀請進一步探索Jev和其他先進決策模型如何改善RL。

docs.title: Epistemic Disturbance in the Graph Model for Conflict Resolution: State-Preserving Actions, Four-Valued Assessments, and the Distinction between Capability and Intention
docs.text:
2610.11690v1 by Yukiko Kato

In the graph model for conflict resolution (GMCR), a decision maker (DM) either moves the conflict to another state or does nothing. The basic definitions leave inaction implicit, so every action that leaves the state unchanged is treated as doing nothing. Yet announcements, exercises, leaks and selective disclosures are neither moves nor inaction: they leave the state unchanged but change what other DMs believe about which moves are available and which moves others would want to make. We introduce such state-preserving actions by augmenting states with the DMs' epistemic states: a physical move changes the physical state, a state-preserving action changes only the epistemic state, and inaction is the absence of a transition. Actions generate evidence through observer-specific interpretation maps. Building on a four-valued extension of GMCR from the author's earlier work, which separates evidence for and against, we show that evidence for a move can only enable perceived moves and evidence against can only disable them, that two of the four reduction operators ignore one kind of evidence, and that contradictory assessments are absorbing under monotone accumulation. With the monotonicity of stability in move sets, this fixes the direction in which any action moves a DM's stability judgements and characterizes when actions can enable provocation or deterrence. Capability assessments affect all sanction-based stability concepts, and on the DM's own side also Nash stability, whereas intention assessments affect only sequential stability. Hedging between two candidate types weakly expands or shrinks an observer's sequentially stable set according to how it reads contradiction. In the 1995 DVD format negotiation, general metarationality cannot distinguish its phases, since the computer industry group could always sanction; sequential stability, which asks whether it would, can.

摘要：在衝突解決的圖模型 (GMCR) 中，決策者 (DM) 要麼將衝突移至另一狀態，要麼什麼都不做。基本定義將不作為隱含，因此任何使狀態不變的行為都被視為什麼都不做。然而，公告、演習、洩漏和選擇性披露既不是行動也不是不作為：它們使狀態保持不變，但改變了其他 DM 對可用行動及其他人想要採取的行動的信念。我們通過用 DM 的認知狀態增強狀態來引入這種保持狀態的行為：實際行動改變物理狀態，保持狀態的行為僅改變認知狀態，而不作為則是缺乏轉換。行動通過觀察者特定的解釋圖生成證據。基於作者早期工作的 GMCR 四值擴展，該擴展區分了支持和反對的證據，我們顯示出，支持某一行動的證據只能使感知的行動成為可能，而反對的證據只能使其無效，四種縮減運算符中的兩個忽略了一種證據，且矛盾的評估在單調累積下是吸收的。隨著行動集穩定性的單調性，這修正了任何行動如何影響 DM 的穩定性判斷的方向，並描述了何時行動可以促使挑釁或威懾。能力評估影響所有基於制裁的穩定性概念，而在 DM 自身方面也影響納什穩定性，而意圖評估僅影響序列穩定性。在兩種候選類型之間的對沖根據觀察者如何解讀矛盾，弱地擴展或縮小觀察者的序列穩定集。在 1995 年的 DVD 格式談判中，一般的元理性無法區分其階段，因為計算機行業集團總是可以制裁；而序列穩定性則詢問是否會這樣做。

docs.title: Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for Expertise-Adaptive Qualitative Interviews Using Local LLMs
docs.text:
2610.11651v1 by Aisvarya Adeseye, Jouni Isoaho, Adeyemi Adeseye, Seppo Virtanen, Mohammad Tahir

Automated interviewers and conversational agents are increasingly used in research, recruitment, customer service, and education. However, many existing systems rely on fixed question sequences and provide limited context-based personalization without considering participants' knowledge, which can lead to repetitive or irrelevant follow-up questions. Therefore, there is a need for an adaptive interviewing system that can adjust question depth while maintaining conversational continuity and semantic progression. To address this, an Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture is presented using a locally hosted Large Language Model (LLM), with the interview continuously adapted throughout the entire conversation based on the participant's responses and evolving context. The interviewer profiles participants' expertise in real time to generate knowledge-appropriate questions, well-articulated responses, and smooth transition messages that support conversational continuity. A five-module prompt-driven architecture and persistent interview-state record support these functions. The interviewer was evaluated with 246 participants. Expertise Profiling module (M3) showed 78.9% exact agreement with independently reported participant expertise, with a weighted Cohen's K of 0.80. Generate Iterative Questions module (M4) showed a strong expertise-complexity association (p=.79, p<.001), and participants reported high relevance (mean 4.41), engagement (mean 4.32), and satisfaction (mean 4.38), providing evidence that the architecture's adaptive components operated consistently with their intended functions while participants reported a positive interview experience.

摘要：自動化面試官和對話代理在研究、招聘、客戶服務和教育中越來越多地被使用。然而，許多現有系統依賴於固定的問題序列，並且提供有限的基於上下文的個性化，未考慮參與者的知識，這可能導致重複或不相關的後續問題。因此，需要一個自適應面試系統，能夠在保持對話連貫性和語義進展的同時調整問題的深度。為了解決這個問題，提出了一種可證據追蹤的動態面試官架構，使用本地托管的大型語言模型（LLM），在整個對話過程中根據參與者的反應和不斷變化的上下文持續調整面試。面試官實時分析參與者的專業知識，以生成符合知識的問題、表達清晰的回答和支持對話連貫性的平滑過渡信息。一個五模塊的提示驅動架構和持久的面試狀態記錄支持這些功能。面試官在246名參與者中進行了評估。專業知識分析模塊（M3）與獨立報告的參與者專業知識顯示出78.9%的完全一致，權重Cohen's K為0.80。生成迭代問題模塊（M4）顯示出強烈的專業知識-複雜性關聯（p=.79，p<.001），參與者報告了高相關性（平均4.41）、參與度（平均4.32）和滿意度（平均4.38），提供了證據表明該架構的自適應組件一致地運作於其預期功能，同時參與者報告了積極的面試體驗。

docs.title: LTBD: Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters for Prompt Injection Defense
docs.text:
2610.11634v1 by Luman Zhao, Minghui Xu, Yue Zhang, Yijun Yang

Large language models (LLMs) perform remarkably well on complex tasks, yet remain highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, where malicious instructions embedded in external data can override user intent. Existing defenses remain limited by model fine-tuning requirements, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, or reliance on brittle handcrafted prompts. We argue that a fundamental source of this vulnerability is the lack of an explicit representation of trust provenance. To address this, we introduce Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters (LTBD), a lightweight defense that explicitly encodes trust boundaries in the input while keeping the LLM parameters unchanged. LTBD uses a small number of learnable delimiters to distinguish trusted user instructions from untrusted external data, enabling the model to better respect the intended trust hierarchy. Experimental results show that LTBD substantially outperforms inference-time defenses and performs competitively with training-based approaches, while preserving benign-task utility and introducing negligible inference overhead. In particular, LTBD achieves 0.00% ASR on AlpacaFarm and only 0.11-0.19% ASR on TaskTracker. LTBD also remains effective under adaptive attacks, where adversaries have full knowledge of the defense and explicitly attempt to bypass it.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）在複雜任務上表現出色，但仍然對提示注入攻擊高度脆弱，這種攻擊中，嵌入外部數據中的惡意指令可以覆蓋用戶意圖。現有的防禦措施受到模型微調要求的限制，對自適應攻擊的脆弱性，或依賴脆弱的手工提示。我們認為，這種脆弱性的根本來源是缺乏明確的信任來源表示。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了可學習的信任邊界分隔符（LTBD），這是一種輕量級的防禦措施，明確地在輸入中編碼信任邊界，同時保持LLM參數不變。LTBD使用少量可學習的分隔符來區分受信用戶指令和不受信的外部數據，使模型能更好地尊重預期的信任層級。實驗結果顯示，LTBD的表現顯著優於推理時的防禦措施，並在與基於訓練的方法競爭時保持良好，並且引入的推理開銷微乎其微。特別是，LTBD在AlpacaFarm上達到0.00%的ASR，在TaskTracker上僅達到0.11-0.19%的ASR。LTBD在自適應攻擊下仍然有效，對手對防禦措施有充分的了解並明確試圖繞過它。

docs.title: TAM: Task-Aware Memory Distillation for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction
docs.text:
2610.11617v1 by Yuqi Li, Xiaoqin Feng, Fan Xu, Weilun Feng, Chuanguang Yang, Yingli Tian, Hao Wu

Knowledge distillation enables efficient spatiotemporal prediction by transferring knowledge from an accurate teacher to a compact student. However, matching outputs or features independently for each sample leaves cross-sample predictive structure underused. Exploiting this structure requires representations and historical references that reflect the dynamics of each task. We propose TAM, a Task-Aware Memory Distillation framework that organizes a frozen teacher's knowledge into a bounded, retrievable history. Memory entries encode latent features, forecast changes, or flow residuals, while task-specific selection rules identify relevant historical references. The student either matches the teacher's similarity distribution over shared references or regresses observation-conditioned residual prototypes. These objectives complement supervised prediction and conventional distillation. The teacher, memory, and auxiliary adapters are used only during training, leaving student inference unchanged. We evaluate TAM on video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction across multiple teacher-student configurations. Averaged over four paired runs, adding TAM improves SSIM on all six video datasets and reduces MSE on five relative to the corresponding KD baselines. Mean paired MSE reductions reach 1.86% on KittiCaltech, 1.93% on WeatherBench with a gSTA teacher, and 1.01% on TaxiBJ. These results demonstrate the utility of historical teacher supervision across distinct forecasting tasks without additional student inference cost.

摘要：知識蒸餾透過將準確的教師知識轉移到緊湊的學生上，使得空間時間預測變得高效。然而，對每個樣本獨立匹配輸出或特徵會使得跨樣本的預測結構未被充分利用。利用這一結構需要反映每個任務動態的表示和歷史參考。我們提出了TAM，一種任務感知記憶蒸餾框架，將凍結的教師知識組織成一個有界的、可檢索的歷史。記憶條目編碼潛在特徵、預測變化或流動殘差，而特定任務的選擇規則則識別相關的歷史參考。學生要麼匹配教師在共享參考上的相似性分佈，要麼回歸觀察條件下的殘差原型。這些目標補充了監督預測和傳統蒸餾。教師、記憶和輔助適配器僅在訓練期間使用，學生推理不變。我們在視頻預測、天氣預報和交通流預測中評估了TAM，涵蓋多個教師-學生配置。在四次配對運行的平均結果中，添加TAM提高了所有六個視頻數據集的SSIM，並在五個數據集上相對於相應的KD基準減少了MSE。KittiCaltech的平均配對MSE減少達到1.86%，WeatherBench在gSTA教師下達到1.93%，TaxiBJ則為1.01%。這些結果展示了在不同預測任務中歷史教師監督的效用，而不增加學生推理的成本。

docs.title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
docs.text:
2610.11605v1 by Matěj Kripner, Milan Straka

We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoProof achieves 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, exceeding the two closest systems of its class, HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL, at roughly 90x and 7x less compute, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof. Stronger open-weight provers exist, but they are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline; NanoProof shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources.

摘要：我們介紹了 NanoProof，據我們所知，它是第一個在 Lean 4 中的分解執行引導定理證明器，其訓練數據、提取工具、訓練流程和權重均已公開，實現了使用開源資源的端到端可重現性。為此，我們構建並發布了一個結構化證明樹的數據集，以及一個在 Lean 4 形式驗證器中進行程式互動和數據提取的工具。為了支持可持續研究，我們專注於計算效率，以促進可訪問的訓練和評估。NanoProof 在 MiniF2F-Test 上達到了 50.8% 的 pass@16，超過了其類別中最接近的兩個系統，HyperTree Proof Search 和 ABEL，計算效率分別低了約 90 倍和 7 倍，並且使用的計算資源比 AlphaProof 少了超過四個數量級。雖然存在更強大的開放權重證明器，但它們是從大型預訓練語言模型中微調而來，並且不釋放訓練數據或流程；NanoProof 顯示了分解執行引導類證明器可以用適度的資源從頭開始重建。

docs.title: Adapting English Quality Classifiers for Multilingual LLM Pretraining Data Selection
docs.text:
2610.11585v1 by Vinko Sabolčec, Bettina Messmer, Yassine Turki, Martin Jaggi

Recent advances in large language model (LLM) pretraining highlight the role of high-quality training data in improving performance. While model-based filtering has proven effective in selecting high-quality subsets from web-scale corpora, especially for high-resource languages, low-resource languages face challenges due to limited availability of annotated data. This work explores extending quality filtering to over 100 languages by proposing a multilingual adaptation approach that converts an existing English quality classifier into a multilingual variant. Our approach proposes training a small multi-layer perceptron on top of Transformer encoder-only model embeddings, using multilingual text as input and scores obtained from English classifiers applied to machine-translated text as labels. Our 1B, 3B and 8B scale experiments show that our approach maintains the downstream LLM benchmark performance of existing multilingual model-based filtering baselines, without harming regional and cultural knowledge benchmarks. To further evaluate cross-lingual generalization, we compare classifier scores of high-quality synthetic data and web samples, and the correlation of classifier scores with LLM-based ones, revealing that the classifier can learn the scoring criteria of its original English variant, even for languages not included in its training data.

摘要：最近在大型語言模型（LLM）預訓練方面的進展突顯了高品質訓練數據在提升性能中的重要性。雖然基於模型的過濾在從網絡規模語料庫中選擇高品質子集方面已被證明是有效的，特別是對於高資源語言，但低資源語言因為標註數據的可用性有限而面臨挑戰。本研究探討了通過提出一種多語言適應方法將質量過濾擴展到超過100種語言，該方法將現有的英語質量分類器轉換為多語言變體。我們的方法提出在Transformer編碼器模型嵌入的基礎上訓練一個小型多層感知器，使用多語言文本作為輸入，並將從應用於機器翻譯文本的英語分類器獲得的分數作為標籤。我們的1B、3B和8B規模實驗顯示，我們的方法在不損害區域和文化知識基準的情況下，保持了現有多語言模型基於過濾的下游LLM基準性能。為了進一步評估跨語言的泛化能力，我們比較了高品質合成數據和網絡樣本的分類器分數，以及分類器分數與基於LLM的分數的相關性，揭示了分類器能夠學習其原始英語變體的評分標準，即使對於未包含在其訓練數據中的語言。

docs.title: SDPAD: A Fully Spike-Driven Pipeline for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
docs.text:
2610.11583v1 by Chengjun Zhang, Yuhao Zhang, Jie Yang, Mohamad Sawan

End-to-end autonomous driving demands trajectory planners that are both highly accurate and cheap enough for edge deployment. State-of-the-art artificial neural network (ANN) planners meet the accuracy requirement at the cost of heavy dense computation, while spiking neural networks (SNNs)---though promising orders-of-magnitude energy savings through sparse, event-driven arithmetic---still lag far behind in planning accuracy. We present \textbf{SDPAD}, a fully spike-driven end-to-end planning pipeline that closes this gap. SDPAD converts a pre-trained ANN perception stack into integer-spike form via quantized ANN2SNN conversion, lifts multi-view images into the bird's-eye-view (BEV) space with a spike-driven-max (SDM) depth distribution (Spike-3D-Lift), and plans through the Spike-QFormer, a spiking query transformer in which ego, agent, and map queries distilled from the BEV scene are fused by learnable waypoint queries via cross-attention, followed by deformable spike-cross-attention refinement. Every operation is gated by integer spikes and inference is a single feed-forward pass without temporal simulation loops. On the nuScenes open-loop benchmark, SDPAD achieves an average $L_2$ error of 0.40\,m and a collision rate of 0.12\%, on par with strong ANN planners while consuming 69.9\,mJ---less than 2\% of recent ANN baselines. In closed-loop evaluation on the NAVSIM navtest split, SDPAD reaches 86.3 PDMS, surpassing the previous SNN planner SAD by 4.3 points and matching mainstream ANN planners at a fraction of their energy. To our knowledge, SDPAD is the first fully spike-driven planner evaluated in end-to-end autonomous driving, demonstrating that SNNs can rival dense ANNs in complex driving tasks.

摘要：端到端的自主駕駛需要既高度準確又足夠便宜以便邊緣部署的軌跡規劃器。最先進的人工神經網絡（ANN）規劃器滿足了準確性要求，但代價是需要大量的密集計算，而尖峰神經網絡（SNN）雖然在稀疏、事件驅動的算術中承諾能節省數量級的能量，但在規劃準確性上仍然遠遠落後。我們提出了\textbf{SDPAD}，一個完全由尖峰驅動的端到端規劃管道，填補了這一空白。SDPAD通過量化的ANN2SNN轉換將預訓練的ANN感知堆疊轉換為整數尖峰形式，利用尖峰驅動的最大（SDM）深度分佈將多視角圖像提升到鳥瞰圖（BEV）空間（Spike-3D-Lift），並通過Spike-QFormer進行規劃，這是一種尖峰查詢Transformer，其中從BEV場景中提取的自我、代理和地圖查詢通過可學習的路徑點查詢通過交叉注意力進行融合，隨後進行可變形尖峰交叉注意力的細化。每個操作都由整數尖峰進行閘控，推理是一個單一的前饋傳遞，沒有時間模擬循環。在nuScenes開放循環基準上，SDPAD實現了平均$L_2$誤差為0.40\,m，碰撞率為0.12\%，與強大的ANN規劃器不相上下，同時消耗69.9\,mJ——不到最近ANN基準的2\%。在NAVSIM navtest拆分的閉環評估中，SDPAD達到了86.3 PDMS，超過了之前的SNN規劃器SAD 4.3分，並以其一小部分的能量匹配主流的ANN規劃器。據我們所知，SDPAD是第一個在端到端自主駕駛中評估的完全尖峰驅動的規劃器，證明了SNN在複雜駕駛任務中可以與密集的ANN相抗衡。

docs.title: Chronos Enables Code Agents to Reason over Software Evolution
docs.text:
2610.11578v1 by Xin Yin, Yiang Zhang, Zhiyuan Peng, Chao Ni, Zhe Cui, Xiaohua Xin

Historical pull requests record the design decisions, compatibility constraints, and implementation patterns behind a codebase's current state. Experience relevant to a new task can span related changes whose descriptions emphasize different concerns. We introduce Chronos, a test-time framework that makes this connected history available to large language model (LLM)-based code agents. Chronos distills merged pull requests into structured experience cards and connects them through a typed graph of code-level, developer-intent, and organizational relations. Semantic search identifies entry cards, and weighted multi-hop expansion retrieves connected changes for selective reading. The same memory guides candidate generation and patch selection: a patch-focused change agent and a validation-strategy agent each develop a patch, and an evolution steward consults history to select between them. On SWE-Bench Verified, the full workflow improves SWE-Agent across all six evaluated LLM backbones, raising the mean resolution rate from 69.2% to 72.9% and reaching 79.8% with MiniMax M2.5. With the same backbone, it raises resolution rates from 48.3% to 51.7% on SWE-Bench Pro and from 41.0% to 43.5% on FEA-Bench Lite. Both experience-guided single-agent variants also outperform the base agent. In a human evaluation on 100 tasks with ten cards retrieved per task, graph-grounded retrieval increases the mean number of useful cards from 1.24 to 2.87 over flat semantic retrieval. These results demonstrate the value of PR relations for retrieving useful repository experience and of the evaluated workflows for applying that experience during patch generation and selection.

摘要：歷史拉取請求記錄了代碼庫當前狀態背後的設計決策、相容性限制和實現模式。與新任務相關的經驗可以跨越相關變更，其描述強調不同的關注點。我們介紹了Chronos，一個測試時間框架，使這些連接的歷史對基於大型語言模型（LLM）的代碼代理可用。Chronos將合併的拉取請求提煉成結構化的經驗卡，並通過一個類型化的圖連接它們，該圖包含代碼層級、開發者意圖和組織關係。語義搜索識別入口卡，而加權多跳擴展則檢索連接的變更以便選擇性閱讀。同樣的記憶指導候選生成和補丁選擇：一個專注於補丁的變更代理和一個驗證策略代理各自開發一個補丁，而一個演變管理者則諮詢歷史以在它們之間進行選擇。在SWE-Bench Verified上，完整的工作流程在所有六個評估的LLM骨幹中改善了SWE-Agent，將平均解析率從69.2%提高到72.9%，並在MiniMax M2.5上達到79.8%。在相同的骨幹下，它將SWE-Bench Pro的解析率從48.3%提高到51.7%，並將FEA-Bench Lite的解析率從41.0%提高到43.5%。這兩種以經驗為指導的單代理變體也超越了基礎代理。在對100個任務的人工評估中，每個任務檢索十張卡，基於圖的檢索將有用卡的平均數量從1.24提高到2.87，相較於平面語義檢索。這些結果展示了PR關係在檢索有用的庫經驗中的價值，以及評估的工作流程在補丁生成和選擇過程中應用該經驗的有效性。

docs.title: Sera: Semantic Representation Aggregation for Reliable and Interpretable Battery Health Forecasting
docs.text:
2610.11567v1 by Jiawei Li, Fang Liu, Wei Zhang, Zuming Liu, Man-Fai Ng, Zhi Wei Seh

Battery state of health (SoH) forecasting is important for battery management, but remains challenging due to nonlinear degradation and heterogeneity across batteries. Existing data-driven approaches primarily use temporal models to learn from numerical battery time series, and higher-level degradation characteristics are often not explicitly represented. These characteristics, however, can provide degradation guidance to support reliable forecasting and make the influence of degradation more interpretable. In this paper, we propose \textsc{Sera}, a \underline{se}mantic \underline{r}epresentation \underline{a}ggregation framework that complements temporal modelling with degradation semantics. Guided by battery domain expertise, \textsc{Sera} extracts degradation semantics from time series and constructs two complementary representations using rule-based knowledge and LLM-based interpretation. The representations are independently encoded and integrated with the representation learned by temporal models through gated aggregations. Experiments on the mainstream benchmark across multiple prediction horizons and different temporal models show that \textsc{Sera} consistently improves forecasting performance, achieving up to a 37.3\% reduction in prediction error over the temporal baseline and enhanced generalizability. Counterfactual analysis examines how forecasts respond to changes in degradation semantics to assess interpretability. The results show that prediction responses are consistent with the meanings of key degradation descriptors across tested horizons. Together, these findings demonstrate that structured degradation semantics and effective aggregation can improve forecasting accuracy and support reliable and interpretable battery health forecasting for advanced battery management.

摘要：電池健康狀態（SoH）預測對於電池管理非常重要，但由於電池之間的非線性劣化和異質性，這仍然是一個挑戰。現有的數據驅動方法主要使用時間模型從數值電池時間序列中學習，而較高層次的劣化特徵往往未被明確表示。然而，這些特徵可以提供劣化指導，以支持可靠的預測並使劣化的影響更具可解釋性。在本文中，我們提出了\textsc{Sera}，一個\underline{se}mantic \underline{r}epresentation \underline{a}ggregation框架，該框架通過劣化語義補充時間建模。受到電池領域專業知識的指導，\textsc{Sera}從時間序列中提取劣化語義，並使用基於規則的知識和基於LLM的解釋構建兩個互補的表示。這些表示獨立編碼，並通過門控聚合與時間模型學習的表示進行整合。在多個預測時間範圍和不同時間模型的主流基準上的實驗顯示，\textsc{Sera}持續改善預測性能，預測誤差相比時間基準最多減少37.3\%，並增強了泛化能力。反事實分析檢查預測如何對劣化語義的變化做出反應，以評估可解釋性。結果顯示，預測反應與測試範圍內關鍵劣化描述符的含義一致。總體而言，這些發現表明，結構化的劣化語義和有效的聚合可以提高預測準確性，並支持可靠且可解釋的電池健康預測，以促進先進的電池管理。

docs.title: Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research with Structured Harness
docs.text:
2610.11566v1 by Meilin Chen, Hongyuan Bao

Existing Open-Ended Deep Research (OEDR) systems primarily generate reports from scratch, making them inefficient for scenarios where research reports need to be continuously maintained as new information emerges. We introduce \textbf{Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research (Incremental-OEDR)}, a research setting that treats a report as an evolving research state and incrementally updates it by preserving valid knowledge, revising outdated or incomplete content, and incorporating newly available information. To support this setting, we propose \textbf{Structured Harness}, which represents reports as structured collections of outlines, sections, and supporting evidence, and provides structured retrieval, a persistent structured evidence pool, and structured generation for selective report updating and evidence reuse. We further establish a temporal evaluation framework spanning ten years, with \emph{Single-Step Task} and \emph{Long-Chain Task} to evaluate incremental updates over both individual transitions and long-term update chains. Extensive Experiments on DeepResearch Bench and DeepConsult under both the Open-source Configuration (OC) and Proprietary Configuration (PC) show that Incremental-OEDR maintains competitive report quality while substantially improving report continuity and reducing research costs. As shown in Figure~\ref{fig:profile}, it achieves up to 0.51 higher content-level ROUGE-L F1, 0.63 higher outline-level EM F1, 33\% lower token consumption, and 61\% fewer search calls than OEDR on DeepResearch Bench. For more details, please refer to our project page: https://ioedr-project.github.io/.

摘要：現有的開放式深度研究（OEDR）系統主要是從頭開始生成報告，這使得它們在需要隨著新信息出現而持續維護研究報告的場景中效率低下。我們介紹了\textbf{增量開放式深度研究（Incremental-OEDR）}，這是一種將報告視為不斷演變的研究狀態的研究設置，通過保留有效知識、修訂過時或不完整的內容以及納入新可用信息來增量更新報告。為了支持這一設置，我們提出了\textbf{結構化工具（Structured Harness）}，它將報告表示為結構化的提綱、部分和支持證據的集合，並提供結構化檢索、一個持久的結構化證據池，以及結構化生成以便於選擇性報告更新和證據重用。我們進一步建立了一個跨越十年的時間評估框架，包括\emph{單步任務（Single-Step Task）}和\emph{長鏈任務（Long-Chain Task）}，以評估個別過渡和長期更新鏈的增量更新。在開源配置（OC）和專有配置（PC）下，對DeepResearch Bench和DeepConsult的廣泛實驗顯示，增量OEDR在保持競爭性報告質量的同時，顯著提高了報告的連貫性並降低了研究成本。如圖~\ref{fig:profile}所示，與OEDR相比，它在DeepResearch Bench上實現了高達0.51的內容級ROUGE-L F1、0.63的提綱級EM F1、33\%更低的標記消耗和61\%更少的搜索調用。欲了解更多詳細信息，請參閱我們的項目頁面：https://ioedr-project.github.io/.

docs.title: MSGAT: Multi-Head Spiking Graph Attention with Similarity-Space Fusion for Image-Text Retrieval
docs.text:
2610.11526v1 by Xintao Zong, Wenxuan Liu, Jianhao Ding, Zhaofei Yu, Tiejun Huang

Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient computing paradigm through sparse event-driven computation, showing great potential for efficient multimodal learning. However, applying SNNs to high-level multimodal tasks, such as image-text retrieval (ITR), remains challenging, since sparse spike representations make it difficult to capture semantic structures required for cross-modal alignment. Existing spiking ITR methods rely on local alignment and additional soft-label supervision during training, while lacking awareness of structural and multi-granularity relationships. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-head Spiking Graph Attention Network (\textbf{MSGAT}) for structural modeling and equip it with dynamic attention heads to capture complementary relational patterns and enable spike-driven graph reasoning and aggregation. However, within a two-branch multi-granularity fusion framework, the fine-grained spike representations generated by MSGAT are sparse and discrete, whereas the global representations are continuous, making conventional feature-level fusion susceptible to interference across heterogeneous representations. Therefore, we introduce \textbf{Sim-Fuse}, a similarity-space fusion alignment strategy integrating coarse- and fine-grained matching relations while avoiding direct fusion of heterogeneous representations. Experiments on Flickr30K and MSCOCO show our method outperforms ANN methods under matched settings and existing SNN retrieval baselines. Moreover, with only two time steps, our SNN achieves comparable or superior performance to its ANN counterpart while reducing theoretical module-level energy by 55\%. The code is provided in the Supplementary Materials.

摘要：尖峰神經網絡（SNNs）通過稀疏事件驅動計算提供了一種節能的計算範式，顯示出在高效多模態學習方面的巨大潛力。然而，將 SNN 應用於高級多模態任務，如圖像-文本檢索（ITR），仍然面臨挑戰，因為稀疏的尖峰表示使得捕捉跨模態對齊所需的語義結構變得困難。現有的尖峰 ITR 方法依賴於局部對齊和訓練期間的額外軟標籤監督，但缺乏對結構和多粒度關係的認識。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了一種多頭尖峰圖注意力網絡（\textbf{MSGAT}）用於結構建模，並為其配備動態注意力頭以捕捉互補的關係模式，並實現尖峰驅動的圖推理和聚合。然而，在一個兩分支多粒度融合框架中，MSGAT 生成的細粒度尖峰表示是稀疏且離散的，而全局表示則是連續的，這使得傳統的特徵級融合容易受到異質表示之間的干擾。因此，我們引入了 \textbf{Sim-Fuse}，這是一種相似性空間融合對齊策略，整合粗粒度和細粒度匹配關係，同時避免異質表示的直接融合。在 Flickr30K 和 MSCOCO 上的實驗表明，我們的方法在匹配設置下優於 ANN 方法和現有的 SNN 檢索基準。此外，僅用兩個時間步，我們的 SNN 在性能上可與其 ANN 對應物相媲美或更優，同時將理論模塊級能量降低 55\%。代碼已在補充材料中提供。

docs.title: Compactness and Consistency: A Conjoint Framework for Deep Graph Clustering
docs.text:
2610.11506v1 by Wei Ju, Siyu Yi, Kangjie Zheng, Yifan Wang, Ziyue Qiao, Li Shen, Yongdao Zhou, Xiaochun Cao, Jiancheng Lv

Graph clustering is a fundamental task in data analysis, aiming at grouping nodes with similar characteristics in the graph into clusters. This problem has been widely explored using graph neural networks (GNNs) due to their ability to leverage node attributes and graph topology for effective cluster assignments. However, representations learned through GNNs typically struggle to capture global relationships between nodes via local message-passing mechanisms. Moreover, the redundancy and noise inherently present in graph data may easily result in node representations lacking compactness and robustness. To address these issues, we propose a conjoint framework CoCo, which captures compactness and consistency in the learned node representations for deep graph clustering. Technically, our CoCo leverages graph convolutional filters to learn robust node representations from both local and global views, and then encodes them into low-rank compact embeddings, thus effectively removing the redundancy and noise as well as uncovering the intrinsic underlying structure. To further enrich the node semantics, we develop a consistency learning strategy based on compact embeddings to facilitate knowledge transfer from the two perspectives. Our experimental results indicate that our CoCo outperforms state-of-the-art counterparts on various datasets.

摘要：圖形聚類是數據分析中的一項基本任務，旨在將圖中具有相似特徵的節點分組為聚類。由於圖神經網絡（GNN）能夠利用節點屬性和圖拓撲進行有效的聚類分配，因此這個問題已被廣泛探討。然而，通過GNN學習到的表示通常難以通過局部消息傳遞機制捕捉節點之間的全局關係。此外，圖數據中固有的冗餘和噪聲可能會導致節點表示缺乏緊湊性和穩健性。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了一個聯合框架CoCo，該框架在深度圖聚類中捕捉學習到的節點表示的緊湊性和一致性。在技術上，我們的CoCo利用圖卷積濾波器從局部和全局視角學習穩健的節點表示，然後將它們編碼為低秩緊湊嵌入，從而有效地去除冗餘和噪聲，並揭示內在的基本結構。為了進一步豐富節點語義，我們基於緊湊嵌入開發了一種一致性學習策略，以促進來自這兩個視角的知識轉移。我們的實驗結果表明，CoCo在各種數據集上超越了最先進的對手。

docs.title: Tracing the Thoughts of a Coding Agent Playing ARC-AGI-3: Lessons for Continual Learning
docs.text:
2610.11450v1 by Chen Wu, Josh Passenger, Yin Song

We study how a coding agent learns across a sequence of abstract reasoning tasks. The agent runs on a frozen foundation model inside a fixed harness and acts by writing and running Python and shell scripts. It retains no state across turns other than its written artifacts, so every thought it forms, carries, corrects or abandons leaves a trace, where a thought is any belief, rule or plan committed to a file. We let the agent play ARC-AGI-3, a set of interactive reasoning games that provide no instructions. Each game is a sequence of levels, and a strategy that clears one level can fail on the next, so every new level is in effect a new task. The agent records what it learns as Python scripts and text notes, while the harness keeps a complete log of every action and observation. Our contribution is a measurement protocol that traces each thought through these files, from the task where it forms to the task where it is corrected or abandoned, applied to seven evaluation runs with three backbones from two model families. Scripts written for one task are almost never called again in a later task (33 of 630 references cross a task boundary), because most scripts embed the state of the current level. Instead, the agent rewrites its knowledge into new scripts, keeping the general rules and dropping the level-specific details, and abandons 74% of the scripts it wrote before a boundary. The notes, which only the model reads, are never revised: the agent appends without removing earlier claims, and the contradictions that accumulate are settled against the log. Because the log preserves everything, the agent forgets selectively, not catastrophically. The most costly error is a hard-coded value carried into a task where it no longer holds. These findings come from the files the agent wrote, without access to the model, and constitute a white-box analysis of how a coding agent continually learns.

摘要：我們研究一個編碼代理如何在一系列抽象推理任務中學習。該代理在固定的框架內運行一個凍結的基礎模型，通過編寫和運行 Python 和 shell 腳本來行動。它在每次回合之間不保留任何狀態，除了它寫下的文檔，因此它形成、攜帶、修正或放棄的每個想法都留下了痕跡，其中一個想法是任何寫入文件的信念、規則或計劃。我們讓代理玩 ARC-AGI-3，這是一組不提供指示的互動推理遊戲。每個遊戲都是一系列關卡，而清除一個關卡的策略在下一個關卡中可能會失敗，因此每個新關卡實際上都是一個新任務。代理將其學到的東西記錄為 Python 腳本和文本備註，而框架則保持每個行動和觀察的完整日誌。我們的貢獻是一個測量協議，追踪每個想法通過這些文件的過程，從形成的任務到被修正或放棄的任務，應用於七次評估運行，使用來自兩個模型家族的三個骨幹。為一個任務編寫的腳本幾乎不會在後續任務中再次被調用（630 個引用中只有 33 個跨越任務邊界），因為大多數腳本嵌入了當前關卡的狀態。相反，代理將其知識重寫為新的腳本，保留一般規則並刪除特定於關卡的細節，並放棄了 74% 在邊界之前編寫的腳本。只有模型閱讀的備註從不被修訂：代理在不移除早期聲明的情況下附加，累積的矛盾根據日誌進行解決。由於日誌保留了一切，代理選擇性地遺忘，而不是災難性地遺忘。最昂貴的錯誤是將硬編碼的值帶入一個不再成立的任務中。這些發現來自代理編寫的文件，沒有訪問模型，構成了對編碼代理如何持續學習的白盒分析。

docs.title: BioBigBird: A Sparse Attention Model for Long-Range Dependency Processing in Biomedical Text
docs.text:
2610.11430v1 by Roshan Balaji, Pavan Kumar S, Vasudev Gupta, Sreejith N, Keerthana Sridhar, Nirav Bhatt

While domain-specific Large Language Models (LLMs) have encoded vast biomedical knowledge, their limited context windows often hinder a deep understanding of nuanced relationships within and across texts. To address this limitation, we introduce BioBigBird, a bidirectional language model pre-trained on extensive biomedical literature and clinical data, specifically designed to handle long-range dependencies. BioBigBird leverages a sparse attention mechanism to process sequences up to 4096 tokens, and its training incorporates a multi-stage process to mitigate noise from the large-scale pre-training corpus. We further enhance its performance by employing a multi-task learning (MTL) framework that jointly optimizes for Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction. Comprehensive evaluations on the BLURB benchmark reveal that our MTL-enhanced BioBigBird achieves highly competitive results against state-of-the-art models. Our work contributes an effective methodology for developing powerful, long-context language models for specialized domains, demonstrating the value of extended sequence processing for complex text analysis. Our models are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/bisectgroup/biobigbird.

摘要：雖然特定領域的大型語言模型（LLMs）已編碼了大量的生物醫學知識，但其有限的上下文窗口常常妨礙對文本內部及跨文本之間微妙關係的深入理解。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了BioBigBird，一種雙向語言模型，經過在廣泛的生物醫學文獻和臨床數據上進行預訓練，專門設計用於處理長距離依賴。BioBigBird利用稀疏注意力機制來處理長達4096個標記的序列，其訓練過程包含多階段的過程，以減少來自大規模預訓練語料庫的噪音。我們進一步通過採用多任務學習（MTL）框架來提升其性能，該框架共同優化命名實體識別和關係提取。在BLURB基準上的全面評估顯示，我們的MTL增強版BioBigBird在與最先進模型的比較中達到了高度競爭的結果。我們的工作為開發強大的長上下文語言模型提供了一種有效的方法論，並展示了擴展序列處理在複雜文本分析中的價值。我們的模型可在 https://huggingface.co/collections/bisectgroup/biobigbird 上公開獲取。

docs.title: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
docs.text:
2610.11410v1 by Hao Li, Jinye Zhang, Bobo Li, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu, Zheng Wang, Hao Fei, Min Zhang

Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. A matched human-model comparison reveals a substantial performance gap, while affect-specialized models also generally lag behind general-purpose MLLMs. Model outputs show recurring failures, including treating displayed behavior as genuine feeling and fabricating unsupported events during long-chain generation. We further propose TRACER, a cognition-grounded structured reasoning method that couples each inference with explicit premises from factual observations, cognitive appraisals, and established upstream conclusions, forming a traceable graph of intermediate and target conclusions. TRACER outperforms all evaluated model baselines on each of the five tasks. Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE

摘要：情感計算已從類別情感識別進展到使用大型多模態模型的開放式情感分析。然後，情感科學將情感描述為一個由評估、調節和社會詮釋塑造的展開過程，這在計算上仍然未被充分探索。我們提出了TRACE，一個以認知為導向的框架，通過三個相互關聯的階段來形式化情感事件：條件、情感和效果，將可觀察的線索與內部立場和情感表達調節等認知因素整合在一起。基於這一公式，TRACE-Bench通過五個任務評估多模態模型在現實社會場景中的表現，這些任務涵蓋了基於情感的識別、調節解碼、因果推理、效果推理和全鏈重建，包含3,746對結構化的問題-答案對，涉及646個視頻。與人類模型的匹配比較顯示出顯著的性能差距，而專注於情感的模型通常也落後於通用的MLLM。模型輸出顯示出反覆的失敗，包括將顯示的行為視為真實的感受，以及在長鏈生成過程中虛構不支持的事件。我們進一步提出TRACER，一種以認知為基礎的結構推理方法，將每個推理與來自事實觀察、認知評估和既定上游結論的明確前提相結合，形成一個可追溯的中間和目標結論圖。TRACER在五個任務中超越了所有評估的模型基準。項目頁面：https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE

docs.title: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
docs.text:
2610.11381v1 by Zhiheng Peng, Wenwei Jin, Yangshi Ge, Siyu Xia, Jiawei Li, Xu Tang

AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics.
