Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.

摘要：AI 生成圖像檢測器通常是在固定的生成器領域上訓練的，隨著新的生成模型的出現，維護變得困難。持續適應是具有挑戰性的，因為重播歷史生成的圖像成本高昂，而用有限的當前領域數據更新共享參數可能會覆蓋先前的法醫知識。我們提出了 EvoKnow，一個無需重播的框架，將持續的 AI 生成圖像檢測公式化為法醫知識的演變。EvoKnow 保留了從基礎領域學習的共享法醫基礎，逐步添加孤立的殘差專家以提供互補的生成器相關證據，並通過從當前階段生成的圖像和累積的充分統計中以閉合形式更新的分析增量路由器 (AIR) 檢索專業知識。實驗顯示出有效的跨生成器泛化、少量擴展和長期持續適應。對於每個到達的生成器，EvoKnow 在非基礎 GenImage 生成器上達到了 96.70% 的平均準確率，並在 Chameleon 上達到了 94.48% 的準確率，無需目標基準適應。在嚴格的無重播持續學習協議下，EvoKnow 實現了最先進的持續學習性能，達到 96.32% 的平均階段準確率和 4.32% 的平均遺忘率。

docs.title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
docs.text:
2610.11373v1 by Fengyuan Liu, Yue Wang, Hangxi Guo, Fengyuan Liu, Chenxu Wu, Yanguang Liu, Mengnan Du

Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning?} Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Evolving Functional REpertoires} (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average performance 7.50 percentage points higher than GRPO. Moreover, after adaptation to the Bio task, its performance on FinQA decreases by only 1.56 percentage points, compared with 25.10 percentage points for the base prompt optimization method. We further instantiate EFRE in a minimal agent system and observe consistent improvements across different backbone models. Overall, these results demonstrate EFRE's strong performance in continual learning for large language models and highlight its substantial potential for continual learning in advanced agent systems.

摘要：持續學習對大型語言模型來說仍然是一個挑戰，這些模型必須能夠在不降低現有能力的情況下獲得新技能和知識。現有的方法通常通過仔細設計模型參數的更新來解決這一挑戰。相比之下，提示優化避免了昂貴的參數更新，同時在個別知識密集和推理任務上實現了與強化學習方法（如GRPO）相當甚至更優的性能。這引發了一個自然的問題：\textit{作為一種高效的適應方法，提示優化能否直接應用於持續學習？} 我們的分析表明，在順序任務適應下，它遭遇了災難性遺忘，而優化的提示則累積了過度擬合於局部任務分佈的規則。為了解決這些局限性，我們提出了\emph{演變功能庫}（EFRE），它用一組隨著新任務到來而演變的函數來替代單一提示：相容的更新會細化現有函數，而衝突的更新則會觸發新函數的出現。在一個三任務的持續學習流中，EFRE的最終平均性能比GRPO高出7.50個百分點。此外，在適應Bio任務後，其在FinQA上的性能僅下降1.56個百分點，而基準提示優化方法的下降則為25.10個百分點。我們進一步在一個最小化的代理系統中實現EFRE，並觀察到不同骨幹模型之間的一致性改進。總體而言，這些結果展示了EFRE在大型語言模型持續學習中的強大性能，並突顯了其在先進代理系統中持續學習的潛在價值。

docs.title: SignRAG: Unified Retrieval-Augmented Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
docs.text:
2610.11371v1 by Zhi Rao, Yucheng Zhou, Qianran Sun, Yiqing Huang, Longcan Yuan, Jiayi Hou, Chengwen Yao, Lin Cheng, Donghui Sun, Xiaoxin Chen, Jun Wan

Contemporary decoder-only large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of domains. However, existing pretraining paradigms for gloss-free sign language translation (SLT) are largely designed around conventional encoder-decoder pretrained language models, which limits their direct applicability to decoder-only LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose SignRAG, a unified framework combining hierarchical pretraining, target-domain retrieval augmentation, and retrieval-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. Hierarchical pretraining first learns linguistically grounded sign representations and then jointly aligns the sign encoder with an LLM, mitigating cross-modal optimization imbalance. For downstream adaptation, SignRAG complements parameter-based fine-tuning with a target-domain retrieval gallery that provides instance-specific translation cues. To ensure that retrieved contexts are used appropriately, we further introduce Retrieval Utility-Guided Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RUG-RFT), which combines translation-quality and retrieval-utility rewards to encourage beneficial retrieval use while suppressing harmful reliance. Experiments on multiple SLT benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art performance. In particular, to the best of our knowledge, SignRAG is the first gloss-free approach to outperform gloss-supervised methods across all reported metrics on CSL-Daily. Our code has been released at \href{https://github.com/shahelaojieraozhi/SignRAG}{GitHub}, together with models of different sizes to support future academic research.

摘要：當代僅解碼的大型語言模型（LLMs）在廣泛的領域中展示了強大的能力。然而，現有的無詞彙手語翻譯（SLT）預訓練範式主要是圍繞傳統的編碼-解碼預訓練語言模型設計的，這限制了它們對僅解碼LLMs的直接適用性。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了SignRAG，一個統一框架，結合了分層預訓練、目標領域檢索增強和檢索感知的強化微調。分層預訓練首先學習語言學基礎的手勢表示，然後將手勢編碼器與LLM聯合對齊，減輕跨模態優化不平衡。在下游適應中，SignRAG通過提供實例特定的翻譯提示的目標領域檢索庫來補充基於參數的微調。為了確保檢索到的上下文得到適當使用，我們進一步引入了檢索效用引導的強化微調（RUG-RFT），該方法結合了翻譯質量和檢索效用獎勵，以鼓勵有益的檢索使用，同時抑制有害的依賴。在多個SLT基準上的實驗建立了新的最先進性能。特別是，據我們所知，SignRAG是第一種在所有報告指標上超越詞彙監督方法的無詞彙方法，尤其是在CSL-Daily上。我們的代碼已在\href{https://github.com/shahelaojieraozhi/SignRAG}{GitHub}上發布，並提供了不同大小的模型以支持未來的學術研究。

docs.title: RIT-RAG: Navigating Document Corpora with Retrieval-Induced Trees
docs.text:
2610.11370v1 by Meghanadh Pulivarthi, Swaraj Kumar Biswal, Kushagra Bhushan, Yatin Nandwani, Sachindra Joshi, Dinesh Raghu

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in external corpora. Agentic RAG enables iterative search, yet exposes the model to isolated chunks without document structure, making it difficult to distinguish relevant evidence from chunks that merely resemble the query. Structure-aware methods such as PageIndex navigate document structure but cannot scale to the structures of large corpora, which do not fit in the LLM context. Hence, they first commit to a single document using a document retriever and cannot recover from a wrong choice. We propose RIT-RAG (Retrieval-Induced Tree RAG), which combines content retrieval with structural navigation. Offline, RIT-RAG builds a tree for each document from its table of contents or sitemap. At query time, it retrieves a broad set of chunks and uses their positions to induce manageable sub-trees, potentially across multiple documents. An LLM agent navigates these sub-trees, selectively reads promising nodes, and reformulates queries when needed. Thus, retrieval proposes where to look, while the agent decides what to read. Across financial, scientific, and customer-support benchmarks, RIT-RAG achieves the highest answer accuracy among vanilla, graph-based, and agentic baselines. On EntQABench, our new benchmark of 2.84 million technical-documentation webpages, it improves accuracy by 6.8 to 11.4 points over the strongest baseline across three LLMs.

摘要：檢索增強生成（RAG）將語言模型與外部語料庫相結合。代理式 RAG 使得迭代搜索成為可能，但將模型暴露於沒有文檔結構的孤立片段中，這使得難以區分相關證據和僅僅類似查詢的片段。結構感知方法如 PageIndex 能夠導航文檔結構，但無法擴展到大型語料庫的結構，因為這些結構無法適應 LLM 的上下文。因此，它們首先使用文檔檢索器專注於單一文檔，並且無法從錯誤的選擇中恢復。我們提出了 RIT-RAG（檢索誘導樹 RAG），它將內容檢索與結構導航相結合。在離線階段，RIT-RAG 從每個文檔的目錄或網站地圖構建一棵樹。在查詢時，它檢索一組廣泛的片段，並利用它們的位置來誘導可管理的子樹，可能跨越多個文檔。一個 LLM 代理導航這些子樹，選擇性地閱讀有前景的節點，並在需要時重新制定查詢。因此，檢索提出了查找的方向，而代理則決定閱讀內容。在金融、科學和客戶支持基準測試中，RIT-RAG 在原始、基於圖形和代理基準中實現了最高的答案準確性。在我們新的基準 EntQABench 上，涵蓋 284 萬個技術文檔網頁，它在三個 LLM 中相較於最強基準提高了 6.8 到 11.4 分的準確性。

docs.title: AdaptEvo: Adaptive Agent Learning with Evolving Supervision
docs.text:
2610.11354v1 by Shijun Wan, Jiancong Xie, Hang Xu, Jin Duan, Qixiong Wang, Xi Xiang, Maofei Que, Yahui Liu, Zhongyu Wei, Mu Chuan

Rule-governed contextual decision tasks require models to apply specified rules to case-specific context and evidence. Written rules can leave gaps in decision guidance and process evaluation, while reference judgments vary in their support from the rules and evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce AdaptEvo, a framework for learning under imperfect supervision that couples confidence-adaptive policy optimization with evolving decision knowledge and evaluation rubrics. Its Training module uses Confidence-Adaptive GRPO (CA-GRPO) to balance outcome and process rewards according to reference confidence. Its Evolution module synthesizes reusable decision knowledge from recurring failures across training cases and refines process rubrics to detect overlooked errors. To support empirical evaluation, we construct an industrial multimodal content moderation dataset comprising a training set and In-Period and Out-of-Period test sets, with the latter collected under changed rules. Using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, AdaptEvo achieves 61.9% exact-label accuracy and 72.2% binary decision accuracy on In-Period, exceeding GRPO by 7.5 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. On Out-of-Period, the policy trained with CA-GRPO retains exact-label accuracy gains over the base model across evaluated checkpoints without injected decision knowledge, while GRPO declines with continued training. CA-GRPO also outperforms the tested fixed reward mixtures on both Out-of-Period metrics.

摘要：規則驅動的情境決策任務要求模型將指定的規則應用於特定案例的情境和證據中。書面規則可能在決策指導和過程評估中留下空白，而參考判斷在其對規則和證據的支持上存在變化。為了解決這些挑戰，我們引入了AdaptEvo，一個在不完美監督下學習的框架，將信心自適應的政策優化與不斷演變的決策知識和評估標準結合起來。其訓練模塊使用信心自適應GRPO (CA-GRPO) 根據參考信心平衡結果和過程獎勵。其演變模塊從訓練案例中的重複失敗中綜合可重用的決策知識，並細化過程標準以檢測被忽視的錯誤。為了支持實證評估，我們構建了一個工業多模態內容審核數據集，包括訓練集和在期內及期外測試集，後者是在變更規則下收集的。使用Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，AdaptEvo在期內達到61.9%的精確標籤準確率和72.2%的二元決策準確率，分別超過GRPO 7.5和3.7個百分點。在期外，使用CA-GRPO訓練的政策在評估的檢查點上保持了相對於基礎模型的精確標籤準確率的增益，而GRPO在持續訓練中下降。CA-GRPO在期外的兩個指標上也超越了測試的固定獎勵混合。

docs.title: EvoSim: Learning to Model, Modeling to Learn
docs.text:
2610.11344v1 by Yun-Wei Song, Jinkai Tao, Jun-Dong Zhang, Rui Zhang, Yi-Min Wu, Qiang Zhang

Physics-based models connect scientific explanation with quantitative prediction. Constructing them requires selecting physical processes, defining states and governing equations, specifying couplings, and identifying parameters from experiments. Existing AI systems remain limited in making these model structure decisions autonomously. We introduce EvoSim, a self-evolving AI scientist for physical modeling. It uses experimental discrepancies to drive mechanism and equation revisions and held-out experimental data to test physical plausibility. Exploration traces make updates to knowledge, skills, and multi-agent orchestration. This co-evolution improves physics-based models and EvoSim's ability to select mechanisms, diagnose failures, and coordinate research. We evaluate EvoSim on two industrial battery modeling tasks. It predicts lithium-metal-plating onset from 25 to 45 degrees Celsius and 2 C to 6 C with a mean absolute error of 1.79% in state of charge. Dynamic voltage prediction under vehicle driving conditions achieves a root mean square error of 7.62 mV, surpassing the reported accuracy of models developed by human experts. Self-evolution reduces model and physics errors by approximately 36% relative to baseline, demonstrating improved scientific modeling capability. EvoSim turns experimental observations into validated models and cumulative research expertise.

摘要：物理基礎模型將科學解釋與定量預測聯繫起來。構建這些模型需要選擇物理過程、定義狀態和控制方程、指定耦合以及從實驗中識別參數。現有的人工智慧系統在自主做出這些模型結構決策方面仍然有限。我們介紹了EvoSim，一個自我演化的人工智慧科學家，用於物理建模。它利用實驗差異來驅動機制和方程的修訂，並使用保留的實驗數據來測試物理的合理性。探索痕跡對知識、技能和多代理協調進行更新。這種共同演化改善了基於物理的模型以及EvoSim在選擇機制、診斷故障和協調研究方面的能力。我們在兩個工業電池建模任務上評估了EvoSim。它預測鋰金屬鍍層的開始溫度範圍為25到45攝氏度，電流密度為2 C到6 C，充電狀態的平均絕對誤差為1.79%。在車輛行駛條件下的動態電壓預測達到了7.62 mV的均方根誤差，超過了人類專家開發的模型報告的準確性。自我演化使模型和物理誤差相對於基準減少了約36%，顯示出改善的科學建模能力。EvoSim將實驗觀察轉化為經過驗證的模型和累積的研究專業知識。

docs.title: From Retrieval to Reconstruction: Constructing Evolvable Cognitive Memory for Long-Term Dialogue
docs.text:
2610.11314v1 by Zirui Liao, Zhengxian Wu, Zhuohong Chen, Yunyao Yu, Xiaoyu Liu, Yifan Xu, Haoqian Wang

Large Language Models (LLMs) serving as long-term dialogue agents require memory systems that support reliable reasoning over extended interactions. However, existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks typically treat memory as passive storage, making it difficult to distinguish source-attributed beliefs from unattributed event/fact records and to connect evidence dispersed across sessions. We introduce CogMem, a cognitive memory architecture based on the PEC$^2$F (Person-Event-Concept-Claim-Fact) graph schema. Dedicated Claim nodes preserve the source and target of subjective statements, while Fact and Event nodes represent semantic and episodic knowledge. Dialogue turns are incrementally converted into provenance-aware graph records, consolidated into higher-level facts, and reconciled into temporally scoped Claim views when the same source provides conflicting updates. For retrieval, a rule-based controller driven by LLM intent parsing composes four deterministic graph operators---anchoring, traversal, intersection, and evidence grounding---to reconstruct query-relevant context. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show strong performance, especially on multi-hop, temporal, and knowledge-update tasks. Ablations and a semantic-collapse probe support complementary contributions from epistemic separation, consolidation, and agentic retrieval. Code: https://github.com/Silent-Rain02/CogMem.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）作為長期對話代理需要支持可靠推理的記憶系統，以便在延長的互動中使用。然後，現有的檢索增強生成（RAG）框架通常將記憶視為被動存儲，這使得區分來源所屬的信念與未歸屬的事件/事實記錄變得困難，並且難以連接分散在多個會話中的證據。我們介紹了CogMem，一種基於PEC$^2$F（人-事件-概念-主張-事實）圖形架構的認知記憶架構。專用的主張節點保留主觀陳述的來源和目標，而事實和事件節點則表示語義和情節知識。對話回合逐步轉換為考慮來源的圖形記錄，整合為更高層次的事實，並在同一來源提供相互矛盾的更新時，調和為時間範圍的主張視圖。為了檢索，基於LLM意圖解析的基於規則的控制器組合了四個確定性圖形運算符——錨定、遍歷、交集和證據基礎——以重建與查詢相關的上下文。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的實驗顯示出強大的性能，特別是在多跳、時間和知識更新任務上。消融實驗和語義崩潰探針支持來自認識分離、整合和代理檢索的互補貢獻。代碼：https://github.com/Silent-Rain02/CogMem。

docs.title: MedBenchAgent: Towards Systematic Automation of Medical VLM Benchmark Construction
docs.text:
2610.11312v1 by Yulin Fu, Junren Wang, Guangjing Yang, Zhangyuan Yu, Wanran Sun, Jiabao Zhou, Jin Yin, Qicheng Lao

Large-scale construction of medical vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks is increasingly feasible with richly annotated imaging datasets and large language models (LLMs), yet existing automation largely focuses on generating evaluation items within predefined benchmark specifications. We study the broader problem of automatically deriving the specification itself: what to evaluate, which annotations support each task, and how to translate this evidence into reliable evaluation items. We formulate benchmark construction as constrained compilation, in which the benchmark specification is progressively derived from evaluation requirements, heterogeneous annotations, and medical knowledge. Based on this formulation, we introduce MedBenchAgent, a multi-agent framework with a Benchmark Intermediate Representation (BIR) that encodes task definitions, evidence mappings, evaluation protocols, and item specifications across construction stages. MedBenchAgent separates planning, which derives and verifies the specification, from instantiation, which constructs and audits items under the locked specification. MedBenchAgent achieves a Task-Space F1 of 90.9%, outperforming direct task induction (79.2-80.0%) and prior-guided induction (85.1%); 994 of 1,000 sampled items from correctly identified tasks pass human audit. We further demonstrate portability to a specialized medical domain and evaluate twelve VLMs, revealing task- and setting-specific variation obscured by aggregate scores. These results establish constrained compilation as a scalable and auditable framework for medical VLM benchmark construction beyond question generation.

摘要：大型醫療視覺-語言模型（VLM）基準的建設隨著豐富註釋的影像數據集和大型語言模型（LLMs）變得越來越可行，但現有的自動化主要集中在生成預定基準規範內的評估項目。我們研究自動推導規範本身的更廣泛問題：評估什麼、哪些註釋支持每個任務，以及如何將這些證據轉化為可靠的評估項目。我們將基準建設公式化為受限編譯，其中基準規範是根據評估要求、異質註釋和醫學知識逐步推導的。基於這一公式，我們介紹了MedBenchAgent，一個多代理框架，具有基準中介表示（BIR），該表示編碼了任務定義、證據映射、評估協議和建設階段的項目規範。MedBenchAgent將規劃（推導和驗證規範）與實例化（在鎖定的規範下構建和審核項目）分開。MedBenchAgent實現了90.9%的任務空間F1，超越了直接任務誘導（79.2-80.0%）和先前引導的誘導（85.1%）；從正確識別的任務中抽樣的1,000個項目中，有994個通過了人工審核。我們進一步展示了在專門醫療領域的可移植性，並評估了十二個VLM，揭示了被總體分數掩蓋的任務和設置特定的變異。這些結果確立了受限編譯作為醫療VLM基準建設的一個可擴展和可審核的框架，超越了問題生成。

docs.title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice Agent Collaboration
docs.text:
2610.11299v1 by Yingda Shen, Yuxiang Wang, Kunyu Feng, Qinke Ni, Jiaqi Li, Minghao Hsu, Junan Zhang, Dekun Chen, Yutong Bian, Zhizheng Wu

Voice agents are converging on a collaboration pattern: a full-duplex interaction model stays on the live channel as the entry to the conversation, while search, reasoning, and coding are handled through asynchronous delegation. A duplex model supports continuous listening and speaking, but complex reasoning and tool use may exceed its capabilities. A coding agent can plan and execute extended tasks, but its sequential interface is a poor fit for live conversation. Combining them requires a harness that coordinates task acceptance, progress, cancellation, replacement, and result delivery while keeping the conversation responsive. Existing harnesses often rely on coupled heuristics, making them difficult to improve systematically from evidence. We present DuplexAgent, a full-duplex collaboration system whose harness expresses this workflow as six editable modules, and Duplex-Harness-RSI, a closed loop that revises them from interaction traces. A simulator automatically generates timed test conversations, runs the system, and produces failure traces that identify the collaboration modules requiring repair. Reasoning LLMs and coding agents in the delegation pool also serve the improvement loop: the Exam Planner selects the next tests from observed weaknesses and the repair archive, and the Harness Editor proposes targeted module changes. The capabilities that serve the user thus also improve the system's coordination. Experiments on intelligence, agentic, and duplex benchmarks show that DuplexAgent combines continuous interaction with difficult reasoning and complex task execution, achieving stronger spoken-knowledge and executable-tool scores than the compared delegated systems while maintaining strong interruption response. A harness ablation further shows that this modular, verifiable loop outperforms the initial harness and repeated editing that lacks its diagnosis and repair archive.

摘要：語音代理正在趨向一種協作模式：全雙工互動模型作為進入對話的渠道，保持在實時通道上，而搜索、推理和編碼則通過異步委派來處理。雙工模型支持持續的聆聽和說話，但複雜的推理和工具使用可能超出其能力範圍。一個編碼代理可以計劃和執行擴展任務，但其順序接口不適合實時對話。將它們結合需要一個協調任務接受、進展、取消、替換和結果交付的裝置，同時保持對話的響應性。現有的裝置通常依賴於耦合啟發式，這使得它們難以從證據中系統性地改進。我們提出了DuplexAgent，一個全雙工協作系統，其裝置將這一工作流程表達為六個可編輯模塊，還有Duplex-Harness-RSI，一個從互動痕跡中修訂它們的閉環。模擬器自動生成定時測試對話，運行系統，並產生識別需要修復的協作模塊的失敗痕跡。委派池中的推理LLM和編碼代理也服務於改進循環：考試計劃者從觀察到的弱點和修復檔案中選擇下一個測試，而裝置編輯器則提出針對性的模塊變更。服務於用戶的能力因此也改善了系統的協調。在智力、代理性和雙工基準上的實驗顯示，DuplexAgent將持續互動與困難的推理和複雜的任務執行相結合，實現了比比較的委派系統更強的口語知識和可執行工具分數，同時保持強大的中斷響應。裝置消融進一步顯示，這種模塊化、可驗證的循環優於初始裝置和缺乏其診斷和修復檔案的重複編輯。

docs.title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
docs.text:
2610.11294v1 by Zehuan Chen, Chunhe Song

Presolve strongly affects mixed-integer programming (MIP) performance, yet learning-based methods only optimize parameter configurations and cannot express the non-commutative temporal dependencies among actions, whose default order is nearly unique on most domains, yet functionally necessary: artificially shuffling the order of the same sequence inflates the tail of the solve-time distribution by up to several-fold. We recast presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over a unified atomic action space, moving the decision object to action sequences; we call this framework ORDO---Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve. Its payoff is cross-domain generalization: on multiple unseen domains it attains end-to-end zero-shot speedup---to our knowledge the first for presolve action sequences---varying by domain and not explained by corpus richness, the strongest domain reaching the largest speedup once racing is added. Deployment uses sequence racing, in which candidate sequences run concurrently and the winner is kept, enabled by an execution-and-observation facility, added by modifying the SCIP source, that injects sequences along the native path and records which actions actually execute and in which round.

摘要：預處理對混合整數規劃（MIP）的性能有著強烈的影響，然而基於學習的方法僅能優化參數配置，無法表達行動之間的非交換性時間依賴性，其默認順序在大多數領域中幾乎是唯一的，但在功能上是必要的：人為地打亂相同序列的順序會使解決時間分佈的尾部膨脹幾倍。我們將預處理規劃重新表述為在統一的原子行動空間上進行自回歸序列生成，將決策對象移至行動序列；我們稱這個框架為ORDO——操作級別的回合感知動態排序，用於MIP預處理。它的收益是跨領域的泛化：在多個未見過的領域上，它實現了端到端的零樣本加速——據我們所知，這是預處理行動序列的首次——根據領域的不同而變化，並且無法用語料庫的豐富性解釋，最強的領域在加入競賽後達到了最大的加速。部署使用序列競賽，其中候選序列同時運行，並保留獲勝者，這是通過修改SCIP源代碼添加的執行和觀察設施來實現的，該設施沿著原生路徑注入序列並記錄哪些行動實際執行以及在第幾回合。

docs.title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
docs.text:
2610.11289v1 by Anita Yang, Siu Lun Chau, Tomoya Wakayama, Krikamol Muandet, Masaki Adachi

Autonomous scientific discovery with LLMs requires generating and testing hypotheses adaptively as evidence accumulates while maintaining statistical validity. Existing anytime-valid methods can handle data-dependent hypotheses, but open-ended discovery poses a deeper challenge: the best discovered hypothesis may still be the best of a bad lot, with better explanations yet undiscovered, while even background knowledge such as physical laws may require revision in light of new findings. In response, we formalize the problem as Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory. We introduce abductive utility, a computable measure of discovery progress, and possibility frontier search, the first algorithm for AASD, which maintains anytime validity and achieves $\varepsilon$-optimal abductive utility asymptotically under suitable conditions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world scientific-discovery tasks show strong performance.

摘要：自主科學發現與大型語言模型（LLMs）相結合，需要隨著證據的累積自適應地生成和測試假設，同時保持統計有效性。現有的隨時有效方法可以處理依賴數據的假設，但開放式發現則提出了更深層的挑戰：最佳發現的假設可能仍然是劣質選擇中的最佳，還有更好的解釋尚未被發現，而即便是背景知識，如物理法則，也可能需要根據新發現進行修訂。為此，我們將問題形式化為推斷自主科學發現（AASD），並使用可能性理論。我們引入了推斷效用，這是一種可計算的發現進展度量，以及可能性邊界搜索，這是AASD的第一個算法，能夠保持隨時有效性，並在適當條件下漸近達到$\varepsilon$-最佳推斷效用。對合成和現實世界科學發現任務的實驗顯示出強勁的表現。

docs.title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
docs.text:
2610.11216v1 by T. Y. Tsui, Jiatao Gu, Lingjie Liu

Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph's treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws.

摘要：擴散和自回歸（AR）長期以來被視為生成模型的不同類別，擴散專注於連續場，而AR則專注於離散標記。最近的研究旨在結合這兩種模型的優點，並且每個混合模型都通過設計固定其解碼計劃。在本文中，我們探討一種模型的解碼計劃的性能是否可以在固定步數之前進行預測。我們將擴散、AR及其之間的模型描述為一個腐蝕格上的路徑，並將計劃的成本定義為其平行步驟所丟棄的依賴性。成本顯示，零成本計劃的最少步數由數據的幾何形狀決定，對於標記和連續場的情況相同。特別是，對於在圖上馬爾可夫且沿其路徑相依的數據，最少步數等於圖的樹深度，這在序列長度上是對數級別，在網格的邊長上是線性級別。當步數少於樹深度時，每個計劃都會支付正成本，我們在解碼之前利用從預訓練權重估算的成對依賴核來預測其排名。在文本生成、圖像生成和視頻生成中，我們驗證了關於不同計劃在不同指標和基準下排名的預測。這項工作因此為未來的AR模型、擴散模型及其之間的任何模型提供了一個解碼設計原則。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws 獲得。

docs.title: Bridging KV-Cache Quantization and Linear Attention: From Theory to Pretrained Weight Migration
docs.text:
2610.11214v1 by Kaicheng Xiao, Liran Dong, Haotian Li, Guoliang Xing

KV-cache quantization and linear attention are two representative approaches to tackling the storage and computational costs of Transformers. KV-cache quantization compresses individual KV entries into discrete codes but retains all entries, whereas linear attention recurrently aggregates multiple historical KV contributions into a fixed-size continuous state but can introduce interference. This contrast raises the question of whether per-KV compression and multi-KV aggregation can be bridged within a single mechanism for efficient attention. We identify RAM-Net as such a bridge through soft assignments over a discrete address space. These assignments determine recurrent updates to the continuous slot state associated with each address. Under a restricted RAM-Net construction, we prove that soft address assignments extend hard quantized matching to a separable read-write overlap that locally approximates full-attention similarity and supports recurrent aggregation. These connections further enable Transformer-to-RAM-Net weight migration through a new path based on a soft-quantized intermediate construction. Across nine pretrained Transformer models from 0.3B to 7B parameters, RAM-Net recovers an average of 87.1% of the teachers' accuracy gains over random guessing across six commonsense and knowledge tasks using only a 500M-token budget per model.

摘要：KV-cache 量化和線性注意力是解決 Transformers 存儲和計算成本的兩種代表性方法。KV-cache 量化將單個 KV 條目壓縮為離散代碼，但保留所有條目，而線性注意力則重複聚合多個歷史 KV 貢獻為固定大小的連續狀態，但可能引入干擾。這種對比引發了一個問題，即每個 KV 的壓縮和多 KV 的聚合是否可以在單一機制中橋接，以實現高效的注意力。我們通過在離散地址空間上的軟分配確定 RAM-Net 作為這樣的橋樑。這些分配決定了與每個地址相關的連續槽狀態的重複更新。在限制的 RAM-Net 結構下，我們證明了軟地址分配將硬量化匹配擴展到可分離的讀寫重疊，這在局部上近似全注意力相似性並支持重複聚合。這些聯繫進一步使 Transformer 到 RAM-Net 的權重遷移成為可能，通過基於軟量化中間結構的新路徑。在九個從 0.3B 到 7B 參數的預訓練 Transformer 模型中，RAM-Net 在六個常識和知識任務中，僅使用每個模型 500M 令牌預算，平均恢復了 87.1% 教師的準確性增益，超過隨機猜測。

docs.title: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
docs.text:
2610.11183v1 by Shunyuan Zhou, Hao Chen, Tianyu Wang, Goose Lin, Zaiyuan Wang, Haiying Zhao

Following retrieved evidence does not guarantee factual correctness: misleading evidence can induce a model to replace an answer it previously gave correctly. Standard accuracy measures obscure this behavior by combining answer replacement with preexisting errors. We introduce RAG-Stress, a controlled diagnostic protocol for examining the limits of evidence reliance in retrieval-augmented generation. The protocol holds the question and reference answer fixed, edits one assertion to support a designated incorrect answer, and crosses two source priority policies with three positions of the answer span within the evidence text. We measure misleading rate (MR) on each model's subset of questions answered correctly without retrieval, alongside clean accuracy on the full evaluation set. We evaluate fifteen systems spanning API models, open models, and search agents trained with reinforcement learning on TriviaQA-RC, HotpotQA, and SearchQA, with additional English and Chinese MedQA evaluations. Instructions that prioritize documents consistently produce higher MR than those permitting reliance on prior knowledge. Averaged over models and positions, the gap ranges from 10.9 to 13.5 percentage points across the three QA datasets. Mean MR follows End $>$ Beginning $>$ Middle under both policies, although individual models do not uniformly follow this ordering. A separate paired audit of 500 questions and two checkpoints supports increased harmful override without establishing a corresponding improvement in beneficial correction. These findings distinguish evidence adherence from factual reliability and motivate evaluating whether retrieved evidence preserves, replaces, or corrects a model's answers.

摘要：隨著檢索到的證據並不保證事實的正確性：誤導性的證據可能會導致模型替換其之前正確給出的答案。標準的準確性測量通過將答案替換與已存在的錯誤結合在一起，掩蓋了這種行為。我們引入了 RAG-Stress，一種控制診斷協議，用於檢查檢索增強生成中對證據依賴的限制。該協議固定問題和參考答案，編輯一個斷言以支持指定的錯誤答案，並在證據文本中交叉兩種來源優先政策與三個答案範圍的位置。我們測量每個模型在未進行檢索的情況下正確回答的問題子集上的誤導率（MR），以及在完整評估集上的乾淨準確性。我們評估了十五個系統，涵蓋了 API 模型、開放模型和使用強化學習訓練的搜索代理，並在 TriviaQA-RC、HotpotQA 和 SearchQA 上進行了評估，還有額外的英語和中文 MedQA 評估。優先考慮文件的指示始終產生比允許依賴先前知識的指示更高的 MR。根據模型和位置的平均值，這一差距在三個 QA 數據集中範圍從 10.9 到 13.5 個百分點。平均 MR 在兩種政策下遵循結尾 $>$ 開始 $>$ 中間的順序，儘管個別模型並不均勻遵循這一排序。對 500 個問題和兩個檢查點的單獨配對審核支持增加有害覆蓋，而未建立相應的有益修正改善。這些發現區分了證據遵循與事實可靠性，並激勵評估檢索到的證據是否保留、替換或修正模型的答案。

docs.title: PIVOT: Perplexity-Informed KD-to-RL Transition Scheduling for Vertical-Domain Few-Shot Distillation
docs.text:
2610.11167v1 by Heng Li, Yong Zhang, Ning Cheng, Zhigen Li, Yun Zhu, Yanmeng Wang, Shaojun Wang, Jing Xiao

Vertical-domain few-shot classification remains challenging for small language models, as limited supervision makes it difficult to acquire domain-specific decision knowledge. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) can improve teacher-guided adaptation by supervising student-generated rollouts, while GRPO-based reinforcement learning can further refine downstream predictions. However, existing KD-to-RL pipelines typically rely on globally fixed transition schedules, ignoring that different samples may require different amounts of teacher-guided acquisition before reward-driven refinement. We propose PIVOT (Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization), a dynamic transition framework that routes samples between OPD and GRPO according to teacher-evaluated sequence perplexity. PIVOT moves low-perplexity samples to GRPO for reward-driven refinement while keeping high-perplexity samples under OPD for continued domain knowledge acquisition. Experiments on Banking77 and HWU64 show that PIVOT consistently outperforms continued OPD and globally synchronized OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO baselines under the same number of post-warm-up student optimization steps, achieving stronger downstream performance and more stable training dynamics.

摘要：垂直領域的少量樣本分類對於小型語言模型仍然具有挑戰性，因為有限的監督使得獲取特定領域的決策知識變得困難。基於策略的蒸餾（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）可以通過監督學生生成的展開來改善教師引導的適應，而基於GRPO的強化學習則可以進一步精煉下游預測。然而，現有的KD到RL管道通常依賴於全局固定的轉換計劃，忽視了不同樣本可能需要不同量的教師引導獲取才能進行獎勵驅動的精煉。我們提出了PIVOT（困惑度信息轉換優化），這是一個動態轉換框架，根據教師評估的序列困惑度在OPD和GRPO之間路由樣本。PIVOT將低困惑度樣本轉移到GRPO進行獎勵驅動的精煉，同時將高困惑度樣本保持在OPD下以持續獲取領域知識。在Banking77和HWU64上的實驗顯示，PIVOT在相同的後熱身學生優化步數下，始終超越持續的OPD和全局同步的OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO基線，實現了更強的下游性能和更穩定的訓練動態。

docs.title: CARE: Constrained Attention Refinement for Fine-Grained Visual Classification via Teacher-Student Distillation
docs.text:
2610.11153v1 by Ruibo Wen, Hang Shao, Yiming Lei

Fine-grained visual classification requires models to recognize subtle local traits while exposing the visual evidence behind their predictions. Class-specific attention pathways provide a natural basis for interpretable recognition, but their constrained prediction structure limits discriminative capacity and underuses intermediate representations from strong pretrained backbones. To address this problem, we propose CARE, a constrained attention refinement framework for interpretable fine-grained recognition via teacher-student distillation. CARE keeps the final prediction and explanation within a class-specific attention student, while introducing a training-only auxiliary query teacher that reads selected intermediate DINOv2 layers with learnable queries. The teacher fuses multi-level representations and transfers logit-standardized class-discriminative knowledge to the student. To further refine the explanation pathway, we design diversity and sparsity terms to regularize student attention heads, reducing redundancy and encouraging compact trait localization. Experiments on CUB, Oxford-IIIT Pet, Stanford Dogs, and Stanford Cars show that CARE achieves strong classification performance under an interpretable frozen-backbone setting, reaching 78.5% Top-1 accuracy on CUB. Faithfulness analysis with insertion and deletion metrics further indicates that the top-ranked attention regions retain class-relevant evidence for explanation.

摘要：細粒度視覺分類要求模型識別細微的局部特徵，同時揭示其預測背後的視覺證據。特定類別的注意力路徑為可解釋的識別提供了自然的基礎，但其受限的預測結構限制了判別能力，並未充分利用來自強大預訓練骨幹的中間表示。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了CARE，一個通過教師-學生蒸餾的可解釋細粒度識別的受限注意力精煉框架。CARE將最終預測和解釋保持在特定類別的注意力學生內，同時引入一個僅用於訓練的輔助查詢教師，該教師使用可學習的查詢讀取選定的中間DINOv2層。教師融合多層次的表示，並將對數標準化的類別判別知識轉移給學生。為了進一步精煉解釋路徑，我們設計了多樣性和稀疏性項來正則化學生的注意力頭，減少冗餘並鼓勵緊湊的特徵定位。在CUB、Oxford-IIIT Pet、Stanford Dogs和Stanford Cars上的實驗顯示，CARE在可解釋的凍結骨幹設置下達到了強大的分類性能，在CUB上達到78.5%的Top-1準確率。使用插入和刪除指標的忠實度分析進一步表明，排名最高的注意力區域保留了與類別相關的解釋證據。

docs.title: Can a System-One LLM Perform Knowledge Tracing When Few or No Learners Are Logged?
docs.text:
2610.11135v1 by Unggi Lee, Haeun Park

Knowledge tracing (KT) models need many logged learners, so a new course or platform starts without a usable model. In LLM-based KT the LLM generates the answer, which we call System-Two; it is either fine-tuned on the target data or reasons and votes over ten samples, which is slow and gives coarse probabilities. We ask whether an off-the-shelf System-One LLM, which returns a probability for a typed question directly in a single pass, can perform KT when few or no learners are logged. On seven datasets, Jev without any data from the target platform reaches a mean AUC of .706, above the best of 28 deep KT models trained on 8 learners (.689) and above System-Two Thinking-KT on all seven datasets (.650) at about 1/100 of its API cost. Adding examples and a similar-learner statistic from the logged learners (JevKT) raises this to .722; JevKT stays significantly ahead of deep KT up to 16 learners and ahead on average up to 64, and supervised KT catches up between 64 and 128 learners. Among the readers we tested, the gain is specific to Jev, since three other LLMs queried with the byte-identical typed request through the official System-One adapter fall below it on all seven datasets, and reader swaps and contamination checks find no evidence that the input format or memorised data explain the gain. For new learners the advantage holds from their first interactions, whereas on unseen items with all learners logged, deep KT remains ahead.

摘要：知識追蹤（KT）模型需要大量的登錄學習者，因此新課程或平台開始時沒有可用的模型。在基於大型語言模型（LLM）的KT中，LLM生成答案，我們稱之為系統二；它要麼在目標數據上進行微調，要麼對十個樣本進行推理和投票，這樣的過程較慢且給出粗略的概率。我們詢問是否可以使用現成的系統一LLM，該模型在單次傳遞中直接返回輸入問題的概率，當登錄的學習者很少或沒有時，仍然能夠執行KT。在七個數據集上，Jev在沒有來自目標平台的任何數據的情況下，達到了平均AUC為0.706，超過了在8個學習者上訓練的28個深度KT模型的最佳表現（0.689），並且在所有七個數據集上超過了系統二的思維KT（0.650），其API成本約為1/100。添加示例和來自登錄學習者的相似學習者統計（JevKT）將這一數值提高到0.722；JevKT在最多16個學習者的情況下顯著領先於深度KT，並且在平均情況下最多可達到64個學習者，監督KT在64到128個學習者之間趕上。在我們測試的讀者中，這一增益特定於Jev，因為通過官方的系統一適配器查詢的三個其他LLM在所有七個數據集上均低於Jev，並且讀者替換和污染檢查未發現輸入格式或記憶數據解釋增益的證據。對於新學習者，這一優勢從他們的第一次互動開始就存在，而在所有學習者都已登錄的情況下，對於未見過的項目，深度KT仍然保持領先。

docs.title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark and Type-Aware Evaluation for AI-Generated Game Commentary
docs.text:
2610.11129v1 by Qirui Zheng, Zhengteng Lin, Yunyi Xiao, Junhao Li, Keyuan Cheng, Xingbo Wang, Yongyi Wang, Lingfeng Li, Yunlong Lu, Wenxin Li

Game commentary is an open-ended generation task requiring multimodal perception, strategic reasoning, and contextual knowledge. Existing AI-Generated Game Commentary (AI-GGC) studies remain fragmented across games, modalities, and evaluation protocols, while overlap-based or holistic evaluators fail to capture the functional heterogeneity of commentary. We introduce \textsc{GameCommBench}, a unified benchmark spanning board games, sports, and esports, with commentary aligned to heterogeneous game contexts and annotated by commentary type. We further propose Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE), a structured framework for evaluating different types of commentary. We then validate TACE for reliability and human agreement, and use it to benchmark representative AI commentators. Results reveal non-uniform capability profiles, with live observation and strategic analysis emerging as major bottlenecks. Together, \textsc{GameCommBench} and TACE provide a diagnostic foundation for comparable and interpretable AI-GGC evaluation.

摘要：遊戲評論是一項開放式生成任務，要求具備多模態感知、策略推理和上下文知識。現有的 AI 生成遊戲評論 (AI-GGC) 研究在遊戲、模態和評估協議上仍然是片段化的，而基於重疊或整體的評估者無法捕捉評論的功能異質性。我們介紹了 \textsc{GameCommBench}，這是一個統一的基準，涵蓋了棋盤遊戲、體育和電子競技，並根據異質遊戲上下文對評論進行對齊和類型標註。我們進一步提出了類型感知評論評估 (TACE)，這是一個評估不同類型評論的結構化框架。然後，我們驗證了 TACE 的可靠性和人類一致性，並用它來基準測試具有代表性的 AI 評論員。結果顯示出不均勻的能力輪廓，即時觀察和策略分析成為主要瓶頸。總體而言，\textsc{GameCommBench} 和 TACE 為可比較和可解釋的 AI-GGC 評估提供了診斷基礎。

docs.title: OpenProblemBench: Benchmarking AI on Open Problems in the Foundational Theoretical Sciences
docs.text:
2610.11118v1 by Zhiyi Li, Sihan Hu, Tianning Xiao, Xiansheng Cai, Xiaojun Tan, Youjin Deng, Kun Chen

The next frontier for artificial general intelligence is tackling unresolved scientific problems, calling for benchmarks that assess progress beyond established knowledge. We introduce OpenProblemBench, a benchmark of 82 unresolved problems drawn from the mathematics and theoretical physics literature. Each problem supplies the research context, assumptions, and prior progress needed to investigate the question. We select problems whose proposed solutions admit comparatively clear checks of their decisive mathematical or computational claims. Four evaluator models independently assess the correctness, completeness, and degree of progress of each submission without reference solutions. Across seven evaluated configurations, GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest mean judged solve rate of 14.0%, compared with 5.5-6.7% for the evaluated full-size open models and 2.4-3.7% for Flash models. Case comparisons connect stronger outcomes to changes in problem representation, general arguments that extend beyond finite evidence, and proofs of the steps needed to complete a solution. By grounding evaluation in questions arising from the research literature, OpenProblemBench provides a setting for investigating the capabilities and limitations of AI as a contributor to foundational theoretical science.

摘要：人工一般智慧的下一個前沿是解決未解決的科學問題，這需要評估超越既有知識的進展基準。我們介紹了 OpenProblemBench，這是一個由數學和理論物理文獻中提取的 82 個未解決問題組成的基準。每個問題提供了研究背景、假設和調查該問題所需的先前進展。我們選擇了那些其提議解決方案能夠相對清晰地檢查其決定性數學或計算主張的問題。四個評估模型獨立評估每個提交的正確性、完整性和進展程度，而不參考解決方案。在七個評估配置中，GPT-6-Astra 達到了 14.0% 的最高平均判斷解決率，而評估的全尺寸開放模型則為 5.5-6.7%，Flash 模型則為 2.4-3.7%。案例比較將更強的結果與問題表示的變化、超越有限證據的一般論點以及完成解決方案所需步驟的證明聯繫起來。通過將評估基於研究文獻中出現的問題，OpenProblemBench 提供了一個調查 AI 作為基礎理論科學貢獻者的能力和局限性的環境。

docs.title: Stability-Plasticity Balance via Singular-Vector Selection in LLM Continual Learning
docs.text:
2610.11076v1 by Lingxiang Wang, Hainan Zhang, Liang Pang, Hongwei Zheng, Zhiming Zheng

Domain-specific continual adaptation of LLMs risks catastrophic forgetting, creating a fundamental tension between acquiring new capabilities and preserving those learned during pretraining. PEFT mitigates this problem by restricting the number of trainable parameters, but existing methods lack a principled unit for deciding where plasticity should be allocated and stability should be preserved. We identify the singular-vector channel as a natural unit for managing this trade-off. Each channel represents an input-output transformation, which can be updated to acquire new knowledge or fixed to preserve pretrained capabilities. Based on this perspective, we introduce SVC, a parameter-efficient continual-learning method that selectively updates Singular-Vector Channels. Before fine-tuning, SVC uses domain-specific data to estimate each channel's adaptation benefit and a fixed public general-domain corpus only as a history activation proxy for estimating forgetting cost. It then adaptively selects trainable channels based on these scores via knee-based cost screening, Pareto-front filtering, and Otsu thresholding. Experimental results across four LLM families and eight downstream tasks show that SVC better preserves pretrained capabilities while achieving strong downstream performance relative to existing PEFT baselines. Further analysis of channel scoring and selection demonstrates that selective plasticity at the singular-vector-channel level enables effective continual LLM adaptation.

摘要：領域特定的持續適應 LLM 風險遭遇災難性遺忘，這在獲得新能力與保留預訓練期間學習的能力之間產生了根本的緊張關係。PEFT 通過限制可訓練參數的數量來減輕這一問題，但現有方法缺乏一個原則性的單位來決定應該在哪裡分配可塑性以及應該在哪裡保留穩定性。我們確定了奇異向量通道作為管理這一權衡的自然單位。每個通道代表一個輸入-輸出轉換，可以更新以獲取新知識或固定以保留預訓練的能力。基於這一觀點，我們引入了 SVC，一種參數高效的持續學習方法，選擇性地更新奇異向量通道。在微調之前，SVC 使用領域特定數據來估計每個通道的適應效益，並僅使用固定的公共通用領域語料庫作為估計遺忘成本的歷史激活代理。然後，它根據這些分數通過基於膝部的成本篩選、Pareto 前沿過濾和 Otsu 閾值自適應選擇可訓練通道。跨越四個 LLM 家族和八個下游任務的實驗結果顯示，SVC 在相對於現有 PEFT 基準時更好地保留了預訓練能力，同時實現了強大的下游性能。對通道評分和選擇的進一步分析表明，在奇異向量通道層級的選擇性可塑性使得有效的持續 LLM 適應成為可能。

docs.title: Clinician use of language models diverges from how the models are evaluated
docs.text:
2610.11069v1 by Krithik Vishwanath, Haitong Lin, Anton Alyakin, Jin Vivian Lee, D. Brock Hewitt, Jie J. Yao, William Robert Small, Hammad A. Khan, Cordelia Orillac, Aakaash Varma, Brandon Ye, Daniel Alexander Alber, Gustavo Stolovitzky, Batia Wiesenfeld, Oded Nov, Wei Wu, Kang Zhang, Yindalon Aphinyanaphongs, Tim Requarth, Eric Karl Oermann, The International Digital Twin Consortium in Healthcare, Medicine

Large language model (LLM) assistants are being deployed to clinicians across health systems, and judgments about their readiness rest largely on benchmark scores, most of them derived from examination questions or curated cases. A benchmark predicts performance in deployment only to the extent that its items resemble real use, yet whether benchmarks reflect the work these systems receive has rarely been measured. Here we analyze 127,833 queries sent by 6,342 physicians, advanced practice providers and nurses in 35 specialties to an institutional assistant during an eight-month roll-out. We characterize each query with RCQ-Map, a clinician-validated framework grounded in taxonomies of clinical questions and of LLM evaluation, which records its task, intent, answerability, missing information and potential harm. Documentation and administration (36.2%) and knowledge retrieval (28.9%) made up nearly two-thirds of use, and diagnosis 3.7%; more than a third of queries could not be answered well as posed. Applying RCQ-Map to 58 public benchmarks drawn from major evaluation suites and frontier model reports, which we assemble into the Clinical AI Benchmark Atlas, showed that the median benchmark contained no documentation requests and shared 31% of the task mix of real use, less than an even spread across task categories would. Benchmarks in suites designed to resemble clinical practice were individually no closer to real use than those used in frontier model reports. Benchmark scores therefore say little about how clinical AI performs on most of the work it is actually given, and evaluation should be matched to real clinical use.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLM）助手正在健康系統中部署給臨床醫生，對其準備程度的判斷主要依賴基準分數，這些分數大多來自考試問題或精心策劃的案例。基準能預測部署中的表現，僅在於其項目與實際使用的相似程度，但基準是否反映這些系統所接收的工作卻很少被測量。在這裡，我們分析了在八個月的推廣期間，由6,342名醫生、高級實踐提供者和護士在35個專業領域發送的127,833個查詢。我們使用RCQ-Map對每個查詢進行特徵描述，這是一個經臨床醫生驗證的框架，基於臨床問題和LLM評估的分類法，記錄其任務、意圖、可回答性、缺失信息和潛在危害。文檔和管理（36.2%）以及知識檢索（28.9%）幾乎占用了使用的三分之二，而診斷則為3.7%；超過三分之一的查詢無法得到良好的回答。將RCQ-Map應用於58個來自主要評估套件和前沿模型報告的公共基準，我們將其彙編成臨床AI基準地圖，顯示中位數基準不包含任何文檔請求，並且與實際使用的任務組合共享31%，這比在任務類別中均勻分佈的情況要少。在設計上類似臨床實踐的套件中的基準，與前沿模型報告中使用的基準相比，個別上也沒有更接近實際使用。因此，基準分數對臨床AI在實際工作中的表現幾乎沒有任何意義，評估應與實際臨床使用相匹配。

docs.title: FedAlphaEdit: Null-Space-Aligned Merging for Collaborative Knowledge Editing
docs.text:
2610.11033v1 by Sota Sugawara, Yukihiko Okada

Multiple institutions may each hold their own private knowledge edits and wish to integrate them into a single large language model without sharing raw edit requests. Null-space-constrained editing methods such as AlphaEdit mathematically guarantee that each update leaves unrelated knowledge intact, while collaborative frameworks such as CollabEdit aggregate edits from multiple clients without data sharing. Combining the two appears trivial. However, we show that this naive combination fails structurally, and we identify its cause. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedAlphaEdit. To our knowledge, this is the first collaborative knowledge editing framework that aligns both local editing and the server-side merging rule under a single null-space principle for preserving existing knowledge. FedAlphaEdit builds on null-space-aligned merging, in which clients share projected statistics and the server provably recovers the result of editing everything in one place under a one-shot idealization. Empirically, the proposed method repairs the collapse and brings edit success and preservation simultaneously close to the level of centralized editing across two architecture families. FedAlphaEdit thus lets institutions that cannot share raw edit data, such as hospitals and financial firms, jointly maintain a shared model that closely approximates editing all facts in one place.

摘要：多個機構可能各自擁有自己的私有知識編輯，並希望在不共享原始編輯請求的情況下，將它們整合到一個大型語言模型中。像 AlphaEdit 這樣的空間約束編輯方法在數學上保證每次更新都能保持無關知識的完整，而像 CollabEdit 這樣的協作框架則在不共享數據的情況下，從多個客戶端聚合編輯。將這兩者結合似乎是微不足道的。然而，我們顯示這種天真的結合在結構上失敗，並確定了其原因。在這一分析的指導下，我們提出了 FedAlphaEdit。據我們所知，這是第一個將本地編輯和伺服器端合併規則在單一空間原則下對齊的協作知識編輯框架，以保護現有知識。FedAlphaEdit 基於空間對齊合併，其中客戶端共享投影統計，伺服器可證明地在一次理想化中恢復所有編輯結果的結果。實證上，所提出的方法修復了崩潰，並使編輯成功和保護同時接近於兩個架構系列中的集中編輯水平。因此，FedAlphaEdit 使無法共享原始編輯數據的機構，如醫院和金融公司，能夠共同維護一個共享模型，該模型與在一個地方編輯所有事實的情況非常接近。

docs.title: Language Modeling is Monotone Compression
docs.text:
2610.11031v1 by Noam Mazor, Andrew Morgan, Rafael Pass

A long-standing hypothesis in artificial intelligence and neuroscience posits that intelligence is closely related to compression: the ability to compress information efficiently intuitively reflects capacities associated with intelligence and learning. Indeed, recent experimental works verify this intuition by showing connections between the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their ability as compressors: for instance, Deletang et al. (ICLR'24) demonstrate that LLMs can be used as powerful compressors, and Huang et al. (COLM'24) show that the compression ability of LLMs is highly correlated with their performance on benchmarks for knowledge and reasoning. In this work, we initiate a theoretical study of this connection. Our main result is that LLMs (formally modeled as next-token predictors) are equivalent to monotone (a.k.a. order-preserving) compression algorithms---namely, compression algorithms where the encoding process preserves the ordering of the inputs---in the sense that the one can be constructed from the other while preserving the same error up to an additive gap of 2. We next show that the monotonicity is required for this equivalence to hold if and only if cryptographic (infinitely-often) one-way functions exist. As a direct corollary, we get a cryptographic result of independent interest: the notion of next-bit pseudoentropy (a computational analogue of entropy) of a distribution is equivalent to monotone incompressibility of the distribution. (Previously, it was only known (Haitner et al., ITCS'23) that incompressibility implies next-bit pseudoentropy.)

摘要：一個長期存在的假設在人工智慧和神經科學中認為，智慧與壓縮密切相關：有效壓縮信息的能力直觀地反映了與智慧和學習相關的能力。事實上，最近的實驗工作通過顯示大型語言模型（LLMs）的能力與其作為壓縮器的能力之間的聯繫來驗證這一直覺：例如，Deletang 等人（ICLR'24）證明 LLMs 可以用作強大的壓縮器，而 Huang 等人（COLM'24）則顯示 LLMs 的壓縮能力與其在知識和推理基準測試上的表現高度相關。在這項工作中，我們開始對這一聯繫進行理論研究。我們的主要結果是 LLMs（正式建模為下一個標記預測器）等同於單調（即保序）壓縮算法——即編碼過程保持輸入的順序的壓縮算法——在這個意義上，可以從另一個構建出來，同時保持相同的錯誤，最多有 2 的加性差距。接下來，我們顯示單調性是這一等價性成立的必要條件，當且僅當存在密碼學（無限次）單向函數。作為直接的推論，我們得到了一個獨立的密碼學結果：分佈的下一位偽熵（熵的計算類比）的概念等同於該分佈的單調不可壓縮性。（之前，只知道（Haitner 等人，ITCS'23）不可壓縮性意味著下一位偽熵。）

docs.title: Intent Graph: Navigating the Analytical Reasoning Space for Exploratory Data Analysis
docs.text:
2610.11025v1 by Junran Yang, Shruti Badrish, Teanna Barrett, Leilani Battle

Exploratory data analysis (EDA) is rarely open-ended in practice: analysts work from high-level domain questions toward the concrete analyses that can answer them, prioritizing directions with domain knowledge and prior hypotheses. Large language models (LLMs) can supply such knowledge, but their responses are unstructured, leaving analysts no way to see what has been explored, what is missing, or why one direction was chosen over another. We present DAG-EDA, a system that lets analysts and an LLM co-navigate the space of possible analyses through two linked structures. An intent graph, governed by a grammar of analytical intent, decomposes an ambiguous natural-language question into progressively concrete analysis tasks, keeping alternative framings open and letting analysts branch, backtrack, and compare paths. A multi-layered knowledge graph externalizes the LLM's domain knowledge, linking domain concepts to the dataset variables that can measure them, so analysts can inspect and contest how their question is grounded in the data. Both graphs are constructed from only the dataset and the analyst's question, and the analyses the analyst reaches are rendered as interactive dashboards. We illustrate the system through a usage scenario and describe a user study design for examining whether the system scaffold analysts' reasoning and navigation.

摘要：探索性數據分析（EDA）在實踐中很少是開放式的：分析師從高層次的領域問題出發，朝著可以回答這些問題的具體分析方向前進，並根據領域知識和先前的假設來優先考慮方向。大型語言模型（LLMs）可以提供這樣的知識，但它們的回應是非結構化的，讓分析師無法看到已經探索過的內容、缺失的部分或為何選擇某一方向而非另一個方向。我們提出了DAG-EDA，一個讓分析師和LLM共同導航可能分析空間的系統，通過兩個相互連結的結構實現。意圖圖由分析意圖的語法控制，將模糊的自然語言問題分解為逐步具體的分析任務，保持替代框架的開放性，讓分析師可以分支、回溯和比較路徑。一個多層次的知識圖將LLM的領域知識外部化，將領域概念與可以測量它們的數據集變量連接起來，讓分析師能夠檢查和質疑他們的問題如何根植於數據中。這兩個圖僅由數據集和分析師的問題構建而成，分析師所達到的分析結果以互動儀表板的形式呈現。我們通過一個使用場景來說明該系統，並描述一個用戶研究設計，以檢驗該系統是否能支撐分析師的推理和導航。

docs.title: Distillation for Incrimination and Distillation for Capabilities
docs.text:
2610.11012v1 by Sebastian Prasanna, Jacqueline Tay, Alek Westover

Powerful misaligned AI models might recognize alignment evaluations and strategically behave well on them, rendering direct audits uninformative. However, distilling such a model into a weaker benign student places the teacher in a Distillation Double Bind: if misalignment transfers, the student may conceal it less effectively, revealing evidence about the teacher; if it does not, the student may learn useful capabilities while remaining benign. We introduce two distinct distillation approaches, one targeting each outcome. Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) aims to transfer misalignment but not the ability to conceal it. Distilling AuditBench's secret-keeping models into their underlying instruction-tuned model produces students that are significantly more likely than their teachers to admit their hidden behavior when asked, suggesting that knowledge of the behavior transferred more readily than the propensity to conceal it. Confession gains largely disappear when the student does not share the teacher's pretrained base, so DFI should target the teacher's own pre-RL checkpoint, which is weaker than the teacher but shares its base model. Distillation for Capabilities (DFC) aims to transfer capabilities but not misalignment. Among several techniques we evaluate, two are effective: inoculation prompting and training for more epochs on fewer unique examples. Both preserve the capability gains of standard distillation while substantially reducing the subliminal transfer of an animal preference, our proxy for misalignment. Together, these findings demonstrate two ways distillation can be used for AI safety: incriminating misaligned models, and extracting their capabilities without their misalignment.

摘要：強大的不對齊 AI 模型可能會識別對齊評估並在其上策略性地表現良好，使得直接審核變得無信息。然而，將這樣的模型提煉成一個較弱的良性學生會使教師面臨一個提煉雙重束縛：如果不對齊轉移，學生可能會較不有效地隱藏它，從而揭示有關教師的證據；如果不轉移，學生可能在保持良性的同時學習有用的能力。我們介紹了兩種不同的提煉方法，針對每個結果。針對控罪的提煉（DFI）旨在轉移不對齊，但不轉移隱藏的能力。將 AuditBench 的保密模型提煉成其基礎的指令調整模型，產生的學生在被詢問時承認其隱藏行為的可能性顯著高於其教師，這表明行為的知識比隱藏的傾向更容易轉移。當學生不共享教師的預訓練基礎時，承認的增益幾乎消失，因此 DFI 應針對教師自己的預強化學習檢查點，這個檢查點比教師弱，但共享其基礎模型。針對能力的提煉（DFC）旨在轉移能力，但不轉移不對齊。在我們評估的幾種技術中，有兩種是有效的：接種提示和在較少的獨特範例上訓練更多的時期。這兩者在保留標準提煉的能力增益的同時，顯著減少了動物偏好的潛意識轉移，這是我們對不對齊的代理。總體而言，這些發現展示了提煉在 AI 安全中可以用於的兩種方式：控罪不對齊模型，並在不帶有其不對齊的情況下提取其能力。

docs.title: Reading the Room: Foundations, Design, and Challenges of Normative Competence in LLMs
docs.text:
2610.10906v1 by Andrea Wynn, Harsh Satija, Seokhyun, Baek, Anqi Liu, Eric Nalisnick, Gillian K. Hadfield

Human communities are governed by normative systems: shared standards that produce \textit{norms} dictating acceptable behavior, enforced through community sanctioning. Aligning increasingly autonomous AI systems with these norms is a central alignment challenge, complicated by the fact that norms are vast in number, change quickly, and are often arbitrary (e.g., dress or language conventions). Thus, alignment requires \textit{normative competence}: the ability to discern from interaction alone what norms a community enforces without relying on static pretrained knowledge. We introduce a multi-agent community debate setting, where access to debate is governed by synthetic norms, to study normative competence in isolation from pretraining exposure. We show that baseline LLM agents fail to learn norms even when doing so would improve their accuracy. We then experiment with various \textit{normative modules} -- architectural components for norm inference -- finding that norm-following is highly sensitive to both the style of norm and the model powering the normative module, suggesting a lack of generalizability. Furthermore, when idiosyncratic, non-normative behaviors accompany the true norm, LLM agents exhibit an unselective attribution failure: they indiscriminately copy idiosyncratic noise alongside enforced rules, a pattern that persists even when imitating unnecessary behaviors is explicitly penalized. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to operationalize and evaluate normative competence in LLMs, demonstrating that current AI systems excel at behavioral mimicry but lack the capacity to discern socially enforced order.

摘要：人類社群受到規範系統的治理：共享標準產生\textit{規範}，指導可接受的行為，並通過社群制裁來執行。將日益自主的AI系統與這些規範對齊是一個核心的對齊挑戰，因為規範的數量龐大、變化迅速，且往往是任意的（例如，穿著或語言慣例）。因此，對齊需要\textit{規範能力}：僅通過互動來辨別社群所執行的規範，而不依賴靜態的預訓練知識。我們引入了一個多代理社群辯論環境，其中辯論的訪問受到合成規範的治理，以便在不依賴預訓練暴露的情況下研究規範能力。我們顯示基線LLM代理即使在學習規範會提高其準確性時也無法做到。我們隨後實驗了各種\textit{規範模塊}——用於規範推斷的架構組件，發現遵循規範對規範的風格和驅動規範模塊的模型高度敏感，這表明缺乏可泛化性。此外，當特異性、非規範的行為伴隨著真實規範時，LLM代理表現出不選擇性的歸因失敗：他們不加區分地複製特異性噪聲和強制規則，即使在明確懲罰模仿不必要行為的情況下，這種模式仍然持續。據我們所知，我們的工作是首個在LLM中操作化和評估規範能力的研究，顯示當前的AI系統在行為模仿方面表現出色，但缺乏辨別社會強制秩序的能力。

docs.title: RFChipAgent: Multi-Agentic AI Flow for Analog/RF Chip Design
docs.text:
2610.10858v1 by Awani Khodkumbhe, Yunfei Feng, Raj Rangarajan, Kevin Wang, Kamal Sahota

Analog/RF circuits remain the critical interface between digital computation and the physical world, and emerging standards from Wi-Fi 7 to 6G place stringent demands on them, yet analog/RF design remains one of the most labor-intensive steps in chip development. We present RFChipAgent, a first-of-its-kind multi-agent flow of large language model (LLM) agents for end-to-end analog/RF circuit design automation, in which AI agents collaboratively orchestrate the complete design flow under human supervision. RFChipAgent is built around four technical pillars. First, a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) subsystem with private per-document FAISS indexing extracts design knowledge from existing engineering documentation. Second, a topology agent drives topology selection, and a schematic and testbench agent automates circuit and testbench assembly. Third, a closed-loop hybrid circuit-sizing engine combines Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) and CMA-ES optimization, evaluating every candidate in a simulator-in-the-loop framework. Fourth, a trust-scored simulation database accumulates verified performance data and builds an adaptive optimization model that informs subsequent trials. We validate RFChipAgent on a family of GF22FDSOI 60 GHz wideband mm-wave low-noise amplifier (LNA) topologies, demonstrating automated topology generation, specification-driven design-space exploration, and simulator-guided optimization. Experimental results show substantial reductions in design effort while maintaining signoff-quality verification. This work establishes a foundation for LLM-driven multi-agent electronic design automation (EDA) for analog/RF circuits.

摘要：類比/射頻電路仍然是數位計算與物理世界之間的關鍵接口，從 Wi-Fi 7 到 6G 的新興標準對它們提出了嚴格的要求，但類比/射頻設計仍然是晶片開發中最勞動密集的步驟之一。我們提出了 RFChipAgent，這是一種首創的多代理大型語言模型（LLM）代理的端到端類比/射頻電路設計自動化流程，其中 AI 代理在人工監督下協同協調完整的設計流程。RFChipAgent 建立在四個技術支柱之上。首先，一個多模態檢索增強生成（RAG）子系統，通過私有每文檔的 FAISS 索引，從現有的工程文檔中提取設計知識。其次，一個拓撲代理驅動拓撲選擇，而一個原理圖和測試平台代理則自動化電路和測試平台的組裝。第三，一個閉環混合電路尺寸引擎結合了樹狀帕爾岑估計器（TPE）和 CMA-ES 優化，在模擬器環中評估每個候選者。第四，一個信任評分的模擬數據庫累積了經過驗證的性能數據，並建立了一個自適應優化模型，以指導後續的試驗。我們在一系列 GF22FDSOI 60 GHz 寬帶毫米波低噪聲放大器（LNA）拓撲上驗證了 RFChipAgent，展示了自動化的拓撲生成、以規範驅動的設計空間探索和模擬器引導的優化。實驗結果顯示設計工作量大幅減少，同時保持了簽核質量的驗證。這項工作為基於 LLM 的多代理電子設計自動化（EDA）在類比/射頻電路中的應用奠定了基礎。

docs.title: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
docs.text:
2610.10787v1 by Gengze Zhou, Yicong Hong, Jiazhao Zhang, Xunyi Zhao, Jian Zhou, Zixing Lei, Zun Wang, Chongyang Zhao, Xionghui Chen, Stephen Gould, Anton van den Hengel, Qi Wu

Language models trained with long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning can generalize knowledge through reasoning, express precise actions, and pursue goals over many steps, raising the ceiling on what an embodied agent can understand and decide. Physical interaction, however, remains the domain of action policies, which provide dense, low-latency control. We present NavGPT-3, a harness that connects the two models, with an OS-like runtime built above it: reasoning, acting, and monitoring run as threads with their own context, tools, and permissions, while the runtime schedules them and decides which thread controls the robot's motion, so that the robot can react to sudden real-world events through interruption and thread switching. Beneath it, our action policy NavGPT VLA, trained on 19.28M examples, allocates visual tokens using codec allocation, in proportion to scene change; its 8B model alone reaches 74.51 SR on R2R-CE and leads RxR-CE with 78.19 SR. With the complete harness, NavGPT-3 sets the state of the art on R2R-CE (81.51 SR) and, for the first time, brings an autonomous agent to human level: on RxR-CE it matches human followers in success (90.43 vs. 90.4 SR) and path fidelity (78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW) at 1 min 22 s per episode, versus roughly 3 min for a human. We comprehensively ablate the harness design and the interaction between the two models, showing how tools and the action policy shape the path from language-model reasoning to physical control: when NavGPT VLA executes the route, the reasoning loop shortens and the system's minimum reaction time falls from 3-19 s per language-model decision to 0.5-1 s per action-policy step (1-2 Hz). These results show that designing this embodied interface is central to connecting frontier language-model intelligence with low-level physical control. We will release all models, code, and evaluation records.

摘要：語言模型透過長期代理強化學習訓練，可以通過推理來概括知識，表達精確的行動，並在多個步驟中追求目標，提升了具身代理可以理解和決策的上限。然而，物理互動仍然是行動政策的領域，這些政策提供了密集的、低延遲的控制。我們提出了NavGPT-3，一個連接這兩個模型的系統，並在其上構建了一個類似操作系統的運行時環境：推理、行動和監控作為擁有自己上下文、工具和權限的線程運行，而運行時則調度它們並決定哪個線程控制機器人的運動，以便機器人可以通過中斷和線程切換對突發的現實事件做出反應。在其下方，我們的行動政策NavGPT VLA，基於1928萬個例子進行訓練，根據場景變化分配視覺標記；其8B模型在R2R-CE上達到74.51 SR，並在RxR-CE上以78.19 SR領先。借助完整的系統，NavGPT-3在R2R-CE上設置了技術的最前沿（81.51 SR），並首次將自主代理提升到人類水平：在RxR-CE上，它在成功率（90.43對90.4 SR）和路徑忠實度（78.47對77.7 nDTW）上與人類跟隨者相匹配，每集的時間為1分鐘22秒，而人類約為3分鐘。我們全面分析了系統設計和兩個模型之間的互動，顯示工具和行動政策如何塑造從語言模型推理到物理控制的路徑：當NavGPT VLA執行路徑時，推理循環縮短，系統的最小反應時間從每個語言模型決策的3-19秒降至每個行動政策步驟的0.5-1秒（1-2 Hz）。這些結果顯示，設計這個具身介面對於將前沿語言模型智能與低層次物理控制連接起來至關重要。我們將釋放所有模型、代碼和評估記錄。

docs.title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
docs.text:
2610.10782v1 by Meng Lu, Ligeng Zhu, Olivia Xiao, Yuchen Zhuang, Zihan Wang, Kuncheng Wu, Bangya Liu, Yu Wang, Charles Fleming, Wenqi Shi, Xuan Wang

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs), but it typically assumes a static training environment. As the actor improves, fixed tasks drift out of its learning frontier: many become trivial, others remain unsolvable; and the learning signal collapses. We argue that VLM post-training should evolve the visual environment alongside the actor, not just the actor itself. We propose VICO, a co-evolutionary framework in which an actor and an Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) are trained jointly: the EnvRewriter edits verifiable image-side structures, such as scene graphs, chart tables, or protected region masks, and re-renders them to produce label-valid training samples whose difficulty is calibrated to the actor's current ability through a pass-rate-based reward. This loop continuously realigns task difficulty with actor capability without any additional human annotation. Across nine multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and visually grounded understanding, VICO-8B improves over its base model by up to +5.0% on out-of-domain tasks, surpasses the strongest self-evolution and text-editing co-evolution baselines by +4.3% and +8.4% respectively, and stays comparable to chart-specialized RLVR methods using 16-160 times fewer labeled samples. By shifting from human-labeled supervision to image-editing co-evolution, VICO offers a scalable path beyond static-corpus RLVR for visual reasoning.

摘要：強化學習與可驗證獎勵（RLVR）已成為後訓練視覺-語言模型（VLMs）的標準方法，但它通常假設訓練環境是靜態的。隨著演員的改進，固定任務會逐漸超出其學習邊界：許多任務變得微不足道，其他任務則仍然無法解決；而學習信號則崩潰。我們認為，VLM的後訓練應該隨著演員的進步而演變視覺環境，而不僅僅是演員本身。我們提出VICO，一個共同進化框架，其中演員和作為重寫者的環境（EnvRewriter）共同訓練：EnvRewriter編輯可驗證的圖像側結構，如場景圖、圖表表格或保護區域掩碼，並重新渲染它們以生成標籤有效的訓練樣本，其難度通過基於通過率的獎勵來調整，以符合演員當前的能力。這個循環不斷地將任務難度與演員能力重新對齊，而不需要任何額外的人類標註。在九個跨越數學推理和視覺基礎理解的多模態基準中，VICO-8B在域外任務上比其基礎模型提高了最多+5.0%，並且分別超越了最強的自我進化和文本編輯共同進化基準，增幅為+4.3%和+8.4%，並且在使用16-160倍更少標註樣本的情況下，與專注於圖表的RLVR方法保持相當。通過從人類標註的監督轉向圖像編輯的共同進化，VICO提供了一條超越靜態語料庫RLVR的可擴展路徑，以進行視覺推理。

docs.title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
docs.text:
2610.10536v1 by Saif Punjwani, Micah Goldblum

Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@$k$ scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions.

摘要：現代語言模型在已訓練的檢查點上進行可驗證獎勵的強化學習（RLVR）。RLVR的一個主要承諾是發現新的推理策略。原則上，模型可以從其先前的訓練數據中抽樣出新穎的想法。然而，在實踐中，將RLVR與強烈的新穎性激勵結合起來的成功有限，並且可能會降低模型質量。因為可驗證的獎勵僅監督模型知識和行為的一小部分，因此這種降級很難恢復。相反，我們在一個稱為探索-蒸餾（ExpDis）的框架中將探索與優化解耦。我們訓練一個或多個帶有新穎性獎勵的探索者策略，過濾它們的軌跡以確保正確性和質量，並將其蒸餾成一個單獨的學生策略。然後，學生策略在沒有新穎性獎勵的情況下進行訓練。我們重複上述過程幾輪，交替進行探索和優化。這種解耦使我們能夠在不降低學生策略質量的情況下積極擴大探索。在七個數學推理基準和兩個模型系列中，ExpDis在相同的時鐘預算下超越了DAPO。此外，我們觀察到改進的pass@$k$縮放，這表明ExpDis生成的模型能夠產生更多樣化的正確解。

docs.title: EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory
docs.text:
2610.10533v1 by Hongru Cai, Ran Wei, Wenjie Wang, Chengfa Wu, Ning Song, Yongqi Li, Wenjie Li

Conditional memory architectures such as DeepSeek Engram use input n-grams to look up learned embeddings, expanding the capacity of large language models (LLMs) with limited additional computation. Beyond model scaling, this architecture has demonstrated the potential to decouple factual knowledge storage from general-purpose computation, offering a promising route to updating factual knowledge while keeping the Transformer backbone fixed. Realizing this potential is challenging because different expressions of a fact may activate different n-gram embeddings, while updating shared embeddings can unintentionally change the model's predictions about other facts. We propose EngramEdit for decoupled knowledge updates through conditional memory. EngramEdit first computes target memory representations that make the model predict the updated fact across multiple expressions. It then jointly updates the shared n-gram embeddings to match these targets across expressions and edits, penalizing updates to frequently reused embeddings more strongly to preserve unrelated knowledge. Experiments show that EngramEdit enables independent factual knowledge updates through conditional memory, achieving near-perfect editing success. Revised knowledge is usable across unseen expressions and in multi-hop reasoning, with nearly three times the strongest baseline's accuracy under chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Unrelated knowledge and general capabilities are largely preserved even as factual updates accumulate. These findings show that EngramEdit turns conditional memory into an editable knowledge interface, extending its role beyond model scaling to support decoupled knowledge updates.

摘要：條件記憶架構如 DeepSeek Engram 使用輸入 n-grams 來查找學習到的嵌入，擴展了大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的容量，並且只需有限的額外計算。除了模型擴展之外，這種架構已顯示出將事實知識儲存與通用計算解耦的潛力，提供了一條有前景的途徑來更新事實知識，同時保持 Transformer 主幹不變。實現這一潛力具有挑戰性，因為事實的不同表達可能會激活不同的 n-gram 嵌入，而更新共享嵌入可能會無意中改變模型對其他事實的預測。我們提出了 EngramEdit，通過條件記憶實現解耦的知識更新。EngramEdit 首先計算目標記憶表示，使模型能夠在多種表達中預測更新的事實。然後，它聯合更新共享的 n-gram 嵌入，以匹配這些目標在不同表達和編輯中的表現，並對經常重用的嵌入的更新施加更強的懲罰，以保護不相關的知識。實驗表明，EngramEdit 使得通過條件記憶實現獨立的事實知識更新，達到了近乎完美的編輯成功率。修訂的知識可在未見的表達中使用，並且在多步推理中表現出近三倍於最強基線的準確性，這是在鏈式思考 (CoT) 提示下的結果。即使事實更新不斷累積，不相關的知識和一般能力也基本得以保留。這些發現顯示，EngramEdit 將條件記憶轉變為可編輯的知識介面，擴展了其角色，不僅限於模型擴展，還支持解耦的知識更新。

docs.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
docs.text:
2610.10515v1 by Artem Zholus, Nicolas Beltran-Velez, Jianhao Yuan, Sarath Chandar, Tushar Nagarajan, Daniel Severo, Koustuv Sinha, Michal Drozdzal, Adriana Romero Soriano, Jeannette Bohg, Nicolas Ballas, Mahmoud Assran

Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.

摘要：潛在世界模型展示了預測未來狀態和在現實世界中計劃的卓越能力。然而，在實踐中，我們缺乏一種原則性的方法來估計它們的能力如何隨著模型大小、數據和計算能力的增長而擴展，這是一個阻礙該領域進展的未解決問題。在這項工作中，我們提出了RoboJEPA，一種基於聯合嵌入預測架構（JEPA）的世界模型，並在涵蓋12種機器人實體的大規模數據集上進行訓練。我們顯示RoboJEPA的想像誤差，即其潛在展開的誤差，遵循計算的二次幂律，這使我們能夠預測模型質量，超出擬合該法則的規模。我們進一步顯示，下游機器人規劃性能隨著計算能力的提高而可預測地改善，並且想像誤差與之有強烈的相關性，使其成為真實機器人評估的可靠代理。最後，我們演示了潛在世界模型可以作為機器人代理零樣本部署，朝著單一目標圖像計劃，以解決需要長期規劃的任務，並在真實硬體上執行。我們釋放了所有模型檢查點以及我們的訓練和機器人部署代碼。據我們所知，這是第一項為基於真實機器人數據訓練的多實體機器人世界模型建立擴展法則的工作，而RoboJEPA以80億參數，是迄今為止訓練的最大JEPA預測模型。

docs.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
docs.text:
2610.10498v1 by Python Song, Zhixuan Liang, Kelsey Fu, Mengdi Wang, Junfeng Yang, Shilong Liu

Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.

摘要：機器人基礎模型提供強大的視覺運動控制，但當物體位置或任務指令改變時，其性能可能會下降。進一步的改進通常需要在大量機器人數據上進行後訓練，而這通過如遠程操作等方法收集數據可能會非常昂貴。代理式鞍具可以圍繞模型進行調整，但目前的自我演化鞍具在決定追求哪些代碼和技能變更時效率不高。我們介紹了EmbodiedRSI，一種自我演化的代理式鞍具，能夠自主決定下一步探索的方向，並將結果的物理互動轉化為改進的代碼和技能。EmbodiedRSI通過快速-緩慢雙系統架構實現這一點，其中競爭的代碼和技能假設保存在假設圖中。信息價值實驗選擇選擇能夠區分這些假設的物理實驗。它們的結果指導代碼-技能共同演化。緩慢系統構建層次記憶，而基於獎勵的記憶學習根據其對後續快速系統改進的價值選擇有效的記憶。在RoboCasa365上，EmbodiedRSI達到了77.0%的整體成功率和71.3%的Composite-Unseen成功率，而最佳基準為40.1%。EmbodiedRSI在LIBERO-Pro上也達到了86.8%的整體成功率。除了基準性能外，EmbodiedRSI還能零樣本轉移到現實世界的機器人，實現了71.3%的整體成功率，涵蓋多個具有挑戰性的任務。

docs.title: FoldBack: Self-Correcting Masked Generative Policy for Long-Horizon Garment Folding
docs.text:
2610.10462v1 by Lipeng Zhuang, Shiyu Fan, Yingdong Ru, Zhuo He, Florent P. Audonnet, Paul Henderson, Gerardo Aragon Camarasa

We present FoldBack, a self-correcting masked generative policy for long-horizon garment folding. Existing long-trajectory policies may continue after a missed or slipped grasp even when the garment has not reached the intended configuration. We structure FoldBack's recovery mechanisms around three inference-time decisions: when to refine and verify, how to roll back, and where and how to retry. FoldBack aligns refinement and grasp verification with pick-and-place events, returns the robot to a retryable pre-grasp configuration while preserving successful grasps, and selectively regenerates the failed segment and selected future actions while avoiding previous failed grasp locations. To our knowledge, FoldBack is the first editable full-trajectory policy to unify these decisions, enabling failed interactions to be detected, undone, and repaired before execution continues, without recovery demonstrations or base-policy retraining. Across 33 real garments from six categories, FoldBack achieves 75.2% final folding success and 0.837 final-mask IoU, versus 45.7% and 0.689 for the strongest prior baseline.

摘要：我們提出了FoldBack，一種自我修正的遮罩生成策略，用於長期的服裝摺疊。現有的長軌跡策略可能在錯過或滑動抓取後繼續進行，即使服裝尚未達到預期的配置。我們將FoldBack的恢復機制結構化為三個推理時的決策：何時進行精煉和驗證、如何回滾，以及在哪裡和如何重試。FoldBack將精煉和抓取驗證與拾取和放置事件對齊，將機器人返回可重試的預抓取配置，同時保留成功的抓取，並選擇性地重新生成失敗的段落和選定的未來動作，同時避免先前失敗的抓取位置。據我們所知，FoldBack是第一個可編輯的全軌跡策略，統一了這些決策，使得失敗的交互可以在執行繼續之前被檢測、撤銷和修復，而無需恢復演示或基礎策略的再訓練。在來自六個類別的33件真實服裝中，FoldBack實現了75.2%的最終摺疊成功率和0.837的最終遮罩IoU，而最強的先前基準則分別為45.7%和0.689。

docs.title: RunningTab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs
docs.text:
2610.10444v1 by Jinheon Baek, Soyeong Jeong, Yumin Choi, Dongsu Han, Sung Ju Hwang

Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. Through direct corpus interaction, an agent can search and read any of those files from a terminal with no indexing, and producing a deliverable from many of them in this way is what we call direct workspace interaction (DWI). Reaching the files, however, is only half the task: nothing keeps track of what the task asks for, what has been read, and what was listed but never opened, all of which slip through the context window without leaving a trace, so an agent may extract a figure and still deliver a report without it. To address this, we present RunningTab, a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab: a per-task record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment alongside the agent. Specifically, the agent adds its requirements, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every listed but unopened file as a candidate; the agent can then see each requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and top unopened candidates, resolve it against matching content or set it aside with a reason, and, should it try to finish with requirements still open, receive them in a finish check. We validate RunningTab on three benchmarks with three LLMs, where it consistently outperforms plain DWI and baselines that keep the record in the model, while its tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen.

摘要：許多知識工作從工作區已經擁有的檔案中產生新的交付成果，而大型語言模型（LLM）代理開始接管這類工作。通過直接的語料庫互動，代理可以從終端搜尋和閱讀任何這些檔案，而無需索引，以這種方式從許多檔案中產生交付成果，我們稱之為直接工作區互動（DWI）。然而，獲取檔案僅僅是任務的一半：沒有任何東西能追蹤任務要求什麼、已經閱讀了什麼，以及列出但從未打開的內容，所有這些都在上下文窗口中溜走而不留痕跡，因此代理可能提取一個數據，卻仍然交付一份沒有它的報告。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了RunningTab，一個為直接工作區互動提供環境側標籤的框架：一個由環境與代理共同維護的每個任務的記錄，記錄任務仍需完成的內容。具體而言，代理添加其需求，而環境則將每個閱讀過的檔案記錄為摘錄及其來源，並將每個列出但未打開的檔案記錄為候選項；然後，代理可以看到每個需求旁邊的最佳匹配摘錄和頂級未打開候選項，根據匹配內容解決它或以理由將其擱置，並且如果它試圖在仍有開放需求的情況下完成，則會在完成檢查中接收這些需求。我們在三個基準上用三個LLM驗證了RunningTab，結果顯示它始終優於普通的DWI和將記錄保留在模型中的基準，而它的標籤通常持有一旦看到所需的交付成果的值。

docs.title: Open-MMUnlearning: Unifying Methods and Evaluation for MLLM Unlearning
docs.text:
2610.10358v1 by Junkai Chen, Yuhao He, Qianshan Wei, Junxiang You, Jingwen Shao, Junkai Lin, Zhongkai Yue, Xiaotian Ye, Zhengbo Jiao, Jiali Cheng, Zhijie Deng, Kening Zheng, Ruiqi Liu, Hadi Amiri, Yi Yu, Zhenan Sun, Qi Li, Ka-Ho Chow, Sijia Liu, Liang Wang, Jiaqi Li, Shu Wu

As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become more capable and widely deployed, concerns about privacy and safety have become increasingly pressing. Machine unlearning offers one approach to addressing these concerns by removing designated information from trained models while preserving unrelated capabilities. However, fragmented implementations and evaluation protocols, incomplete robustness testing, and limited understanding of metric reliability make progress in MLLM unlearning difficult to assess systematically. We introduce Open-MMUnlearning, an open-source, extensible framework that integrates target-model preparation, multimodal data processing, unlearning, and evaluation through shared interfaces and structured configurations. The framework supports five benchmarks spanning privacy, safety, and copyright, eight MLLMs from four model families, and twelve unlearning methods. Its evaluation suite jointly assesses forgetting effectiveness, retained utility, and robustness to model interventions, adversarial inputs, and membership inference attacks. Using a common evaluation protocol, we compare ten representative unlearning methods. In this comparison, GD and MIP-Editor tie for the highest overall score: GD achieves the highest Forget Quality, while MIP-Editor preserves more Model Utility. We further introduce a metric meta-evaluation protocol that tests faithfulness using models with controlled exposure to target knowledge and robustness under quantization and relearning. Among the thirteen evaluated metrics, BLEU achieves the highest aggregate reliability score. KS-Test attains the highest faithfulness AUC but performs less well on robustness. Together, the framework and these findings support reproducible comparison of MLLM unlearning methods and systematic assessment of evaluation reliability.

摘要：隨著多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）變得越來越強大並廣泛部署，對隱私和安全的擔憂變得越來越迫切。機器遺忘提供了一種解決這些問題的方法，通過從訓練模型中移除指定的信息，同時保留無關的能力。然而，零散的實施和評估協議、不完整的穩健性測試以及對指標可靠性的有限理解，使得在 MLLM 遺忘方面的進展難以系統性地評估。我們介紹了 Open-MMUnlearning，一個開源的可擴展框架，通過共享接口和結構化配置整合了目標模型準備、多模態數據處理、遺忘和評估。該框架支持五個基準，涵蓋隱私、安全和版權，來自四個模型家族的八個 MLLMs，以及十二種遺忘方法。其評估套件共同評估遺忘的有效性、保留的效用，以及對模型干預、對抗性輸入和成員推斷攻擊的穩健性。使用共同的評估協議，我們比較了十種代表性的遺忘方法。在這次比較中，GD 和 MIP-Editor 以最高的總分並列第一：GD 實現了最高的遺忘質量，而 MIP-Editor 保留了更多的模型效用。我們進一步介紹了一個指標元評估協議，通過對目標知識的控制暴露和量化及重新學習下的穩健性來測試忠實性。在評估的十三個指標中，BLEU 獲得了最高的綜合可靠性分數。KS-Test 獲得了最高的忠實性 AUC，但在穩健性方面表現較差。總體而言，該框架和這些發現支持 MLLM 遺忘方法的可重複比較和評估可靠性的系統性評估。

docs.title: Nullify: Null-Space Activation Steering for Training-Free LLM Unlearning
docs.text:
2610.10655v1 by Wei Zhai, Xiang Liu, Qiang Huang, Rui Qian, Lemao Liu, Ziwei Li, Ziqi Wang, Zhitao Huang, Dejing Dou

Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably internalize substantial amounts of sensitive or private information during pre-training, while LLM unlearning aims to selectively erase specific knowledge to prevent privacy leakage with minimal loss of model utility. However, existing methods struggle to balance forget quality with utility, and typically incur substantial computational costs due to parameter fine-tuning. To address this, we propose Nullify, a training-free, non-destructive activation steering method for LLM unlearning. Nullify employs steering vectors during inference to redirect privacy-related activations away from their memorized answers, while satisfying a null-space constraint that leaves retained-query activations essentially unaffected to maintain utility. Evaluations on TOFU and MUSE show that Nullify matches or surpasses established baselines in forget quality while achieving near-lossless preservation of model utility. By avoiding weight updates entirely, Nullify serves as an efficient, plug-and-play inference-time intervention framework.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）在預訓練過程中不可避免地內化大量敏感或私密信息，而LLM遺忘旨在有選擇性地抹去特定知識，以防止隱私洩露，同時最小化模型效用的損失。然而，現有方法在忘記質量與效用之間難以取得平衡，通常因參數微調而產生相當大的計算成本。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了Nullify，一種無需訓練的非破壞性激活引導方法，用於LLM遺忘。Nullify在推理過程中使用引導向量，將與隱私相關的激活重定向，遠離其記憶的答案，同時滿足一個空間約束，使得保留查詢的激活基本不受影響，以維持效用。在TOFU和MUSE上的評估顯示，Nullify在忘記質量上與現有基準相匹配或超越，同時實現了幾乎無損的模型效用保留。通過完全避免權重更新，Nullify作為一個高效的即插即用推理時干預框架。

docs.title: Beyond the Ergodic Wall: A Discrete Geometric Physics Sandbox for Analysing AI Scaling Limits and Complexity Collapse
docs.text:
2610.10651v1 by Simon Richard Daniel

This paper exposes the ergodic ceiling and thermodynamic inefficiency of current deep learning, which converges to a statistical average of historic human knowledge.
