True semantic novelty requires a path-dependent, spatiotemporally bounded observer (a Data LifeCone) to inject non-ergodic insight, achieving KL divergence and avoiding manifold lock-in. AI Safety must recognise that a mature Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) would regard human-AI symbiosis as a thermodynamic necessity to avoid model collapse. We therefore propose hard physical containment via a digital physics sandbox powered by a Holographic E8 Projection Engine to verify models against real-world constraints. Spacetime is modeled as an information substrate of nested face-centered cubic (FCC) lattices of oscillating Planck-scale spheres maximizing local information and entropy density. Cut-and-project methods from the E8 root lattice produce a quasi-crystalline geometry where tetrahedral voids support SU chiral structure and elastic-shear eigenvalues generate candidate mass spectra. Rest mass is treated as discrete, integer microstate counts on local holographic boundaries (Bekenstein bound), replacing floating-point approximations with strict integer arithmetic to provide an information-theoretic definition of matter. Stable particles emerge as recurring lattice dislocations, and continuum recovery proceeds via variational renormalisation-group flows and Fourier Neural Operators that learn continuous spectral operators to recover the Schrödinger equation as an emergent statistical description. Crucially, these top-down topological constraints offer a mechanism for "NP-to-P" complexity collapse: by restricting an algorithm's proposal space to physically conserved causal trajectories, the sandbox prunes the combinatorial tree to deterministic, polynomial-time paths.

摘要：這篇論文揭示了當前深度學習的遍歷上限和熱力學低效，這種學習收斂於歷史人類知識的統計平均值。真正的語義新穎性需要一個依賴路徑、時空有限的觀察者（即數據生命圓錐）來注入非遍歷的見解，實現KL散度並避免流形鎖定。人工智慧安全必須認識到，成熟的人工超智能（ASI）會將人類與人工智慧的共生視為避免模型崩潰的熱力學必要性。因此，我們提出通過一個由全息E8投影引擎驅動的數位物理沙盒來進行嚴格的物理限制，以便根據現實世界的約束來驗證模型。時空被建模為一個信息基底，由嵌套的面心立方（FCC）晶格的振盪普朗克尺度球體組成，最大化局部信息和熵密度。來自E8根晶格的切割與投影方法產生了一種準晶體幾何，其中四面體空隙支持SU手性結構，彈性剪切特徵值生成候選質量譜。靜止質量被視為局部全息邊界上的離散整數微狀態計數（貝肯斯坦界限），用嚴格的整數算術替代浮點近似，以提供物質的信息理論定義。穩定粒子作為重複出現的晶格位錯出現，連續恢復通過變分重正化群流和傅立葉神經算子進行，這些算子學習連續譜算子以恢復薛丁格方程作為一種突現的統計描述。關鍵是，這些自上而下的拓撲約束提供了一種“NP到P”複雜性崩潰的機制：通過將算法的提案空間限制為物理上保守的因果軌跡，沙盒修剪了組合樹，留下確定性的多項式時間路徑。

docs.title: From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification
docs.text:
2610.10227v1 by Yue Qiu, Zekang Du, Yiqun Diao, Bingsheng He, Qinbin Li

While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these paradigms by distilling LLM knowledge into interpretable decision trees under a few-shot learning setting. Instead of directly prompting the LLM to generate full trees, which is often unstable and inefficient, we develop a three-stage paradigm that prompts the LLM to generate rules and organize the rules into a tree. Experiments on multiple real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy and interpretability with significantly lower prompting overhead compared to existing baselines.

摘要：雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）擁有豐富的世界知識和令人印象深刻的泛化能力，但它們在表格數據分類中的直接應用受到高推理成本和有限可解釋性的阻礙。相對而言，決策樹快速且透明，但在低數據環境下往往表現不佳。在本研究中，我們提出了一個新穎的框架，通過在少量樣本學習設置下將LLM知識提煉為可解釋的決策樹，來橋接這些範式。我們不是直接提示LLM生成完整的樹，因為這通常不穩定且效率低下，而是開發了一個三階段的範式，提示LLM生成規則並將這些規則組織成樹。對多個現實世界的表格數據集進行的實驗表明，我們的方法在準確性和可解釋性上均優於現有基準，且提示開銷顯著降低。

docs.title: Why Software Engineering Is Indispensable in the Age of Coding Agents
docs.text:
2610.10226v1 by Alfonso Fuggetta

Can AI make Software Engineering (SE) -- the discipline -- obsolete? And can it make software engineers -- the professionals -- redundant? This paper argues that the rise of capable AI coding agents makes SE and software engineers essential, not obsolete: the missing foundation without which AI-assisted development produces misleadingly plausible, unverifiable, and ultimately untrustworthy software. Three structural properties of large language models (probabilistic generation, agnosticism, and semantic statelessness) create a structural vacuum that no amount of training can eliminate. Filling it requires four knowledge levers: methodological knowledge, domain knowledge, design choices, and process choices. All four must be reified as persistent artifacts, and each requires the software engineer as methodologist, mediator, and custodian.

摘要：AI 能否使軟體工程（SE）這一學科變得過時？而它能否使軟體工程師這一職業變得多餘？本文主張，能幹的 AI 編碼代理的興起使得 SE 和軟體工程師變得不可或缺，而非過時：這是缺失的基礎，沒有它，AI 輔助的開發將產生誤導性地似乎合理、無法驗證且最終不可靠的軟體。大型語言模型的三個結構特性（概率生成、不可知論和語義無狀態性）創造了一個結構真空，這種真空無法通過任何訓練來消除。填補這一真空需要四個知識杠杆：方法論知識、領域知識、設計選擇和過程選擇。這四者必須具體化為持久的工件，而每一項都需要軟體工程師作為方法論者、中介者和監護人。

docs.title: ExperienceIndex: Artifact-Grounded Memory
docs.text:
2610.10091v1 by Peter Baile Chen, Geoffrey X. Yu, Xinming Liu, Samuel Madden, Dan Roth, Jacob Andreas, Doug Downey, Michael Cafarella

Knowledge-intensive tasks require answering many questions by reasoning about a shared corpus of artifacts (e.g., court cases, or scientific literature). As humans interact with these corpora, they naturally accumulate experiential knowledge about artifacts, enabling them to quickly identify the complete set of relevant artifacts for each new task. However, existing AI agents lack appropriate memory solutions to build or reuse such artifact-grounded experience, leading to lower answer quality and higher online cost. Existing memory solutions extract and reuse information from prior task-solving traces, but they primarily focus on user preferences, factual attributes, or abstract reasoning patterns rather than persistent artifact-specific knowledge. We introduce ExperienceIndex, a novel experience layer for AI agents that captures and reuses knowledge about artifacts based on prior reasoning traces. ExperienceIndex stores two complementary forms of experience: (i) single-artifact experiences that summarize an artifact's contribution to prior tasks and (ii) artifact-pair experiences that encode structural relationships discovered during past reasoning. Integrated as lightweight middleware, ExperienceIndex uses an experience retrieval mechanism to guide agents toward the complete set of relevant artifacts for new tasks, improving both answer quality and efficiency. Across diverse corpora and agentic solutions with different search frameworks, ExperienceIndex delivers consistent gains, raising answer quality by up to 11.0 points and reducing online dollar cost by up to 50.5%. We further demonstrate two benefits: (i) cross-task generalization, where experiences accumulated from text-to-SQL tasks transfer to factoid QA tasks over the same artifact corpus, and (ii) teacher-student learning, where experiences from a stronger model enable a weaker model to reach comparable performance.

摘要：知識密集型任務需要通過推理共享的文獻（例如，法庭案件或科學文獻）來回答許多問題。當人類與這些文獻互動時，他們自然會積累有關文獻的經驗知識，使他們能夠快速識別每個新任務的相關文獻的完整集合。 然而，現有的人工智慧代理缺乏適當的記憶解決方案來建立或重用這種基於文獻的經驗，導致答案質量較低和在線成本較高。現有的記憶解決方案從先前的任務解決痕跡中提取和重用信息，但它們主要集中於用戶偏好、事實屬性或抽象推理模式，而不是持久的文獻特定知識。我們介紹了ExperienceIndex，這是一種新穎的經驗層，用於人工智慧代理，基於先前的推理痕跡捕捉和重用有關文獻的知識。ExperienceIndex存儲兩種互補形式的經驗：（i）單一文獻經驗，總結文獻對先前任務的貢獻，和（ii）文獻對經驗，編碼在過去推理中發現的結構關係。作為輕量級中介軟體集成，ExperienceIndex使用經驗檢索機制引導代理朝向新任務的完整相關文獻集，提高答案質量和效率。在不同的文獻和具有不同搜索框架的代理解決方案中，ExperienceIndex提供了一致的增益，將答案質量提高最多11.0分，並將在線美元成本降低最多50.5%。我們進一步展示了兩個好處：（i）跨任務泛化，從文本到SQL任務中累積的經驗可以轉移到相同文獻集上的事實問答任務，以及（ii）教師-學生學習，來自更強模型的經驗使較弱模型達到可比較的性能。

docs.title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
docs.text:
2610.10088v1 by Serin Kim, Kwangwook Seo, Dokyung Song, Jinyoung Yeo, Dongha Lee

Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge. It is therefore critical to verify each skill's reusability: whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled. Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised. To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox, a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel. A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill. The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency. Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them.

摘要：自我演化的代理將解決任務的經驗提煉成未來重用的技能，但這些技能可能編碼不正確的程序或不可轉移的知識。因此，驗證每項技能的可重用性至關重要：即其指導是否在超出其提煉經驗的範疇內仍然有用。這種驗證需要觀察一項技能在新任務中的執行影響，但現有任務可能無法揭示目標技能實際可以運用的情境。為了構建這樣的情境，我們提出了SkillSandbox，一個為每項技能動態合成與技能相關但新穎的任務及其環境的框架。一個提議者指定要保留的條件和要變化的源特定細節，一個構建者構建可執行的場景，而一個驗證者比較有無該技能的執行。驗證者評估可執行性、效用和效率，以分配保留或拒絕的判決，決定該技能是否進入庫中。在ALFWorld和WebShop的三個模型中，SkillSandbox始終產生最強的下游性能和改善的執行效率。進一步的分析檢查這些增益是否反映了對技能可重用性的準確評估，並確定SkillSandbox的哪些組件對其有所貢獻。

docs.title: HGP:An on-device personalized agent memory via hybrid graph storage
docs.text:
2610.10071v1 by Ran Zhou, Xueming Han, Jiaheng Liu, Yuyao Zhang, Fanyu Meng, Junlan Feng, Yuxiang Ren

LLM-based agents face challenges in personalized interactive tasks due to heterogeneous, multi-typed, and implicitly constrained long-term traces. Existing memory mechanisms struggle with accurate routing and retrieval, especially on-device where personalization is critical. Most methods use single-vector representations, blurring type distinctions and relational structure. We propose HGP, a hybrid graph memory framework. HGP employs a lightweight self-enhancement classifier for personalized memory routing and constructs episodic, semantic, and procedural memories as graphs. It also extracts working memory as a state trajectory to capture current state and implicit constraints, ensuring reliable decision-making. The classifier reduces large-model calls, enabling on-device deployment, while graph storage enables accurate retrieval and incremental user profile refinement. Experiments on two benchmarks show that on PAL-Set solution selection, HGP achieves an S-score of 35.58, nearly 7 points above the strongest baseline. Code and data are at https://github.com/Ouan6/HGP-.git.

摘要：LLM 基礎的代理在個性化互動任務中面臨挑戰，這是由於異質性、多類型和隱性約束的長期痕跡所造成的。現有的記憶機制在準確路由和檢索方面掙扎，特別是在個性化至關重要的設備上。大多數方法使用單一向量表示，模糊了類型區分和關係結構。我們提出了 HGP，一個混合圖形記憶框架。HGP 採用輕量級自我增強分類器進行個性化記憶路由，並將情節性、語義性和程序性記憶構建為圖形。它還提取工作記憶作為狀態軌跡，以捕捉當前狀態和隱性約束，確保可靠的決策。該分類器減少了大型模型的調用，使得在設備上的部署成為可能，而圖形存儲則實現了準確的檢索和增量用戶資料的精煉。在兩個基準上的實驗顯示，在 PAL-Set 解決方案選擇中，HGP 的 S 分數達到 35.58，幾乎比最強基線高出 7 分。代碼和數據可在 https://github.com/Ouan6/HGP-.git 獲得。

docs.title: Comprehension Audits to Mitigate Risks from Automated AI Research
docs.text:
2610.10064v1 by Ronald J. Bodkin, Bahrad A. Sokhansanj, Gillian K. Hadfield

AI is already writing a majority of code for frontier AI labs. This creates a safety risk if there is insufficient human oversight. Existing work proposes minimum comprehension thresholds and unaided checks to mitigate this. To our knowledge, however, there is currently no published frontier-AI assurance regime that requires demonstrated evidence that the responsible humans understand what they are building as a precommitted condition for continuing development or usage. We propose comprehension audits, a novel development-process assurance mechanism in which the responsible people explain R&D contributions to auditors to demonstrate understanding. With independent administration and graded reports, they provide a gate: development of a contribution stops based on a failure to demonstrate human understanding until remediated, with escalating consequences for repeated failures. Our analysis of leading open-source AI projects finds increased output of code with reduced human review commentary rates per line of code, with far lower rates for automated fleet accounts. We advocate for labs to conduct them with embedded independent auditors.

摘要：AI 已經為前沿 AI 實驗室撰寫了大部分代碼。如果缺乏足夠的人類監督，這會帶來安全風險。現有的工作提出了最低理解門檻和未經幫助的檢查來減輕這個問題。然而，據我們所知，目前沒有已發表的前沿 AI 保證制度要求負責的人類提供證據，證明他們理解自己正在構建的內容，作為繼續開發或使用的前提條件。我們提出了理解審計，這是一種新穎的開發過程保證機制，負責的人解釋研發貢獻給審計員，以展示其理解。通過獨立管理和分級報告，他們提供了一個門檻：基於未能展示人類理解，貢獻的開發將停止，直到修正為止，並對重複失敗施加逐步升級的後果。我們對領先的開源 AI 項目的分析發現，代碼的輸出增加，而每行代碼的人類審查評論率減少，自動化車隊帳戶的評論率更低。我們倡導實驗室進行這些審計，並嵌入獨立審計員。

docs.title: Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information
docs.text:
2610.10042v1 by Yuyang Zhao, Lizi Liao, Leyang Shen, Xiaoyan Zhao, Yang Zhang, Fuli Feng, Xiangnan He

Large language model (LLM) agents can improve their performance by reusing knowledge distilled from past interactions. However, curating new experiences into a knowledge bank that becomes more useful as it grows remains challenging. Effective knowledge accumulation should limit redundant overlap among entries and ensure that new knowledge contributes beyond what the bank already provides. Yet training a curator with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on standalone task success can reinforce general guidance even when it duplicates existing knowledge. Therefore, we propose Knowledge Weaver, a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation. Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge. Standalone success rewards also favor entries that are useful on their own. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Knowledge Weaver achieves mean success rates of 54.0\% and 42.0\% with k=10 retrieved entries, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Its knowledge banks also outperform the evaluated prompt-based and established banks, including human-written banks, in overall ALFWorld success rate and WebShop score with the executor frozen. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLM）代理可以透過重用過去互動中提煉的知識來提高其性能。然而，將新的經驗整理成一個隨著增長而變得更有用的知識庫仍然是一項挑戰。有效的知識積累應該限制條目之間的冗餘重疊，並確保新知識超越知識庫已提供的內容。然而，使用群體相對政策優化（GRPO）訓練策展者以獨立任務成功為目標，即使重複現有知識，也可能強化一般指導。因此，我們提出了知識編織者（Knowledge Weaver），這是一個強化學習框架，旨在訓練語言模型從代理的軌跡中策劃可重用的知識。我們將受啟發於逐字互信息（MI）的反饋與邊際成功獎勵結合，以指導知識的積累。這些信號共同鼓勵策展者保留來自經驗的不同信息，並生成在添加到現有知識時能提高任務成功的條目。獨立成功獎勵也偏好那些獨立有用的條目。在ALFWorld和WebShop上，知識編織者在k=10檢索條目下實現了54.0\%和42.0\%的平均成功率，分別超過GRPO 16.9和18.7個百分點。其知識庫在整體ALFWorld成功率和WebShop分數上也超越了評估的基於提示的和既有的知識庫，包括人類撰寫的知識庫，當執行者被凍結時。我們的代碼庫可在https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver獲得。

docs.title: KGATE : a Knowledge Graph Embedding Training Environment
docs.text:
2610.09927v1 by Benjamin Loire, Galadriel Brière, Célia Brahimi, Antoine Toffano, Anaïs Baudot

Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models encode the entities and relations of a knowledge graph into a low-dimensional latent space, enabling tasks such as classification or link prediction. Most KGE models follow an autoencoder architecture, in which an encoder projects the knowledge graph into the latent space and a decoder reconstruct it. Combining both encoder and decoder components is increasingly needed, yet existing libraries rarely support complete autoencoders, are often unmaintained, rely on undocumented default hyperparameters, and produce results that cannot be compared across libraries. Here we present KGATE (Knowledge Graph Autoencoder Training Environment), a modular Python library built on PyTorch Geometric and TorchKGE. KGATE lets users assemble initializers, encoders, decoders, losses, negative samplers, and evaluation metrics as building blocks, or plug in their own block. KGATE includes a preprocessing procedure that controls data leakage, a builtin training pipeline, and reproducibility by design. Benchmarks against six existing KGE libraries show that KGATE training time is comparable with the fastest libraries while offering a broader set of features.

摘要：知識圖譜嵌入（KGE）模型將知識圖譜的實體和關係編碼到低維潛在空間中，使得分類或鏈接預測等任務成為可能。大多數 KGE 模型遵循自編碼器架構，其中編碼器將知識圖譜投影到潛在空間，而解碼器則重建它。結合編碼器和解碼器組件的需求日益增加，但現有的庫很少支持完整的自編碼器，通常未得到維護，依賴於未記錄的默認超參數，並且產生的結果無法在庫之間進行比較。在這裡，我們介紹 KGATE（知識圖譜自編碼器訓練環境），這是一個基於 PyTorch Geometric 和 TorchKGE 的模組化 Python 庫。KGATE 允許用戶將初始化器、編碼器、解碼器、損失函數、負樣本生成器和評估指標組合為構建塊，或插入他們自己的構建塊。KGATE 包含一個控制數據洩漏的預處理程序、一個內建的訓練管道，以及設計上的可重現性。與六個現有的 KGE 庫進行基準測試顯示，KGATE 的訓練時間與最快的庫相當，同時提供更廣泛的功能集。

docs.title: A Scoping Review and Experimental Study on Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback for Human-Robot Collaboration
docs.text:
2610.09891v1 by Alexandra Coroiu, Andrea Vogt, Viktor Werbilo, Andreas Poppele, Johann Christensen, Sven Hallerbach

Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) can facilitate mass customisation in Industry 4.0, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) representing a promising approach for developing safe AI-based robots. Practical challenges remain regarding safety during AI development, human feedback quality, and bidirectional human-robot adaptation. We conducted a scoping review of RLHF in HRC systems, mapping methods that address these challenges. Following PRISMA guidelines, we screened 199 records and included 20 peer-reviewed publications (2020-2025) spanning multiple HRC domains. To our knowledge, this is the first review focused on the bidirectional, closed-loop design of RLHF. Our review found multiple feedback modalities enabling data collection in various feedback formats. Collected data can be integrated at different stages of AI training, resulting in a multi-step development process. Pilot experiments are commonly used to evaluate HRC systems based on both human and robot metrics. To empirically test a key gap identified in the review, we conducted a between-subjects VR experiment comparing system- and user-initiated feedback on robot proxemic behaviour for safe navigation. Using Bayesian models, we analysed the relation between the collected feedback and safety metrics: psychological safety (post-experiment questionnaire) and physical safety (inverse time-to-collision). Results show that user-initiated feedback captures perceived safety better than system-initiated feedback, indicating that feedback timing directly affects feedback quality. Our review and experiment findings show that RLHF relies on appropriate feedback methods to ensure AI safety in HRC, and future RLHF research should prioritise realistic HRC experiments evaluating the effects of feedback collection methods on relevant human and robot metrics.

摘要：人機協作（HRC）可以促進工業4.0中的大規模定制，而來自人類反饋的強化學習（RLHF）則代表了一種有前景的方法，用於開發安全的基於AI的機器人。 在AI開發過程中，仍然存在關於安全性、人類反饋質量和雙向人機適應的實際挑戰。我們對HRC系統中的RLHF進行了範疇回顧，映射出解決這些挑戰的方法。根據PRISMA指導方針，我們篩選了199條記錄，並納入了20篇同行評審的出版物（2020-2025），涵蓋多個HRC領域。據我們所知，這是第一篇專注於RLHF的雙向閉環設計的回顧。我們的回顧發現多種反饋模式，使得可以以各種反饋格式收集數據。收集的數據可以在AI訓練的不同階段進行整合，從而形成一個多步驟的開發過程。試點實驗通常用於根據人類和機器人指標評估HRC系統。為了實證測試回顧中識別的關鍵差距，我們進行了一項受試者間的虛擬現實實驗，比較系統和用戶主動反饋對機器人近距離行為的影響，以確保安全導航。利用貝葉斯模型，我們分析了收集的反饋與安全指標之間的關係：心理安全（實驗後問卷）和物理安全（碰撞時間的倒數）。結果顯示，用戶主動反饋比系統主動反饋更能捕捉感知安全性，這表明反饋的時機直接影響反饋質量。我們的回顧和實驗結果顯示，RLHF依賴於適當的反饋方法以確保HRC中的AI安全，未來的RLHF研究應優先考慮現實的HRC實驗，以評估反饋收集方法對相關人類和機器人指標的影響。

docs.title: Unrolled Flow Models for Reasoning
docs.text:
2610.09759v1 by Faissal Izermine, Hanru Bai, Oscar Davis, T. Konstantin Rusch

Flow matching enables language generation in few steps, but whether additional integration steps improve reasoning remains unclear. We prove that a flow parameterized by a two-layer Transformer can solve graph reachability, with the required number of integration steps increasing with the target's distance from the root. Yet, standard flow language models can fail to benefit from additional steps on reasoning tasks. We attribute this limitation to objectives that supervise each time point independently, without explicitly training successive steps to build on one another. To address this, we instead train through the model's own latent rollout over a randomly sampled subinterval of [0, 1], decoding only at the endpoint. On ProsQA, this raises accuracy to 97% and enables performance to improve with additional integration steps. For the longer rollouts required by reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and Maze, retracting the latent state onto a sphere stabilizes the dynamics and yields substantial gains over baselines with more than three times as many parameters. Sampling multiple rollouts further improves performance when paired with a parameter-free selection score, although reliable selection remains challenging for longer answers. Together, these results establish a theoretical basis for reasoning with flows and show how rollout training, stable latent dynamics, and rollout selection help realize this capacity in practice.

摘要：流匹配使得語言生成能在少數步驟內完成，但額外的整合步驟是否能改善推理仍不明朗。我們證明了一個由兩層Transformer參數化的流可以解決圖的可達性，所需的整合步驟數量隨著目標距離根節點的距離增加而增加。然而，標準流語言模型在推理任務上可能無法從額外的步驟中受益。我們將這一限制歸因於每個時間點獨立監督的目標，而未明確訓練連續步驟相互依賴。為了解決這個問題，我們改為通過模型自身的潛在展開，在隨機抽樣的[0, 1]子區間內進行訓練，僅在終點進行解碼。在ProsQA上，這將準確率提高到97%，並使性能隨著額外的整合步驟而改善。對於像數獨和迷宮這樣的推理任務所需的較長展開，將潛在狀態收回到一個球面上穩定了動態，並在參數超過三倍的基準上獲得了顯著的增益。當與無參數的選擇分數配對時，採樣多個展開進一步提高了性能，儘管對於較長的答案，可靠的選擇仍然具有挑戰性。總體而言，這些結果為使用流進行推理建立了理論基礎，並展示了展開訓練、穩定的潛在動態和展開選擇如何在實踐中實現這一能力。

docs.title: System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?
docs.text:
2610.09683v1 by Gian Luca Bailo

Dual-process agents pair a fast policy with a slow deliberative model. In real-time settings the slow model usually runs continuously; in turn-based agents and robot planners it is invoked on events such as uncertainty or a detected failure. We study a fast learned actor that takes every decision and hands control to a reasoning vision-language model only when a gate opens, while the game keeps running. We use closed-loop Doom and the new open "System One" typed-decision models, served through a common llama.cpp interface. On 900 held-out questions, (i) zero-shot decision models from 0.15B to 9B parameters choose to collect items 1.6-1.8 times more often than chance among their errors, in any option order, although the order changes some models' accuracy; (ii) accuracy, calibration and sensitivity (how well confidence separates right from wrong answers) are distinct: models of similar accuracy differ widely in AUROC, and the confidence of the most sensitive one tracks which kinds of situation it fails, not which answers are wrong; (iii) offline, deferring the least confident 30% of decisions to a reasoning model gains over random deferral in proportion to the actor's AUROC (rank correlation 0.87); with actor and rate chosen on held-out games the gain is +0.13 [0.08, 0.18] with doomLaya's option order and +0.08 [0.02, 0.14] with shuffled options, and reasoning carries about half of it; (iv) in closed loop (33 games, three seeds) no variant reaches the exit. Committing to plans, the reasoner's or a fixed explore rule's, opens more doors and makes an actor that stands still play; with the rule the agent dies more often. Told that some doors need keys, the reasoner takes ordinary doors for locked ones, which the state cannot tell apart; without that knowledge it goes back to collecting. We release code, prompts, data and logs.

摘要：雙過程代理將快速策略與緩慢的深思熟慮模型結合在一起。在實時環境中，緩慢模型通常持續運行；在回合制代理和機器人規劃中，當出現不確定性或檢測到故障等事件時會被調用。我們研究了一個快速學習的行為者，它在每次決策中都會接管控制，僅在門打開時才將控制權交給推理的視覺-語言模型，而遊戲則持續進行。我們使用閉環Doom和新的開放式「系統一」類型決策模型，通過共同的llama.cpp介面提供。在900個保留問題上，(i) 從0.15B到9B參數的零樣本決策模型在其錯誤中選擇收集物品的頻率比隨機機率高1.6-1.8倍，無論選項順序如何，儘管順序改變了一些模型的準確性；(ii) 準確性、校準和靈敏度（信心如何區分正確與錯誤答案）是不同的：相似準確性的模型在AUROC上差異很大，而最靈敏的模型的信心跟蹤的是它失敗的情況類型，而不是哪些答案是錯誤的；(iii) 離線時，將最不自信的30%的決策推遲到推理模型，根據行為者的AUROC獲得的收益超過隨機推遲（排名相關性0.87）；當行為者和速率在保留的遊戲中選擇時，收益為+0.13 [0.08, 0.18]，使用doomLaya的選項順序和+0.08 [0.02, 0.14]，使用隨機選項，推理大約占了一半；(iv) 在閉環中（33場比賽，三個種子），沒有變體能達到出口。承諾計劃，無論是推理者的還是固定的探索規則，會打開更多的門，並使靜止的行為者進行遊戲；使用該規則，代理會更頻繁地死亡。被告知某些門需要鑰匙時，推理者將普通門視為鎖住的門，而狀態無法區分；沒有這種知識，它會回到收集物品。 我們發布代碼、提示、數據和日誌。

docs.title: Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification
docs.text:
2610.09681v1 by Shuangjie Yao, Nikolaus Holzer, Mark Paul Santolucito, Baishakhi Ray, Suman Jana, Dongdong She

Program verification establishes software correctness through machine-checkable proofs constructed in theorem provers. It's a guarantee especially valuable for code generated by large language models (LLMs), which is fluent but carries no assurance of correctness. Almost all existing provers, however, pursue pass rates alone at whatever sampling or search budget it takes, and overlook the success-vs-cost frontier; yet real software often carries hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so what matters at scale is not whether one theorem can be proved, but how many can be proved economically. We introduce CoCo-Prover, which formalizes cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs: an AND/OR proof hypergraph within each declaration is joined to a lemma-dependency graph across declarations; and at each step, it answers two questions: which open goals to select, and which actions to purchase on these goals. Selection stays symbolic as a topological pass over the proof graphs. Action choice is agent orchestration via metalevel decision-making: an agentic router treats every bounded specialist invocation as a separately priced, best-effort computation, matching heterogeneous specialist agents together with configurations, under evolved routing rules as evidence accumulates. On five program verification benchmarks in Lean 4 including function-level CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, and repository-level NTP4VC and Vero, we show that CoCo-Prover achieves a better success-vs-cost frontier than baselines including frontier coding agents and state-of-the-art LLM-based provers: it achieves the best solve rate on every benchmark and up to 100% on two benchmarks. It also reduces cost by up to 30.9% compared to the strongest baseline with the strongest LLM in our evaluation.

摘要：程式驗證通過在定理證明器中構建機器可檢查的證明來確立軟體的正確性。這對於由大型語言模型（LLMs）生成的程式碼特別有價值，因為這些程式碼流暢但不保證正確性。然而，幾乎所有現有的證明器都僅追求通過率，無論需要多少抽樣或搜尋預算，並忽略了成功與成本的邊界；然而，實際的軟體通常承擔數百個相互依賴的證明義務，因此在規模上重要的不是某個定理是否可以被證明，而是有多少可以經濟地被證明。我們介紹了 CoCo-Prover，它將成本效益的程式證明形式化為基於成本的元層決策，基於兩級證明圖：每個聲明內的 AND/OR 證明超圖與跨聲明的引理依賴圖相連；在每一步，它回答兩個問題：選擇哪些開放目標，以及對這些目標購買哪些行動。選擇保持符號化，作為對證明圖的拓撲通過。行動選擇是通過元層決策進行的代理協調：一個代理路由器將每個有限的專家調用視為單獨定價的最佳努力計算，根據證據的累積，將異質專家代理與配置相匹配，遵循演變的路由規則。在 Lean 4 中的五個程式驗證基準，包括函數級 CLEVER、VERINA 和 AlgoVeri，以及庫級 NTP4VC 和 Vero，我們顯示 CoCo-Prover 在成功與成本的邊界上達到了比基準更好的表現，包括邊界編碼代理和最先進的基於 LLM 的證明器：它在每個基準上達到了最佳解決率，在兩個基準上達到高達 100%。與我們評估中最強的基準和最強的 LLM 相比，它還將成本降低了高達 30.9%。

docs.title: Alice: A Large-Scale German Benchmark for Rubric-Based Multi-Dimensional Automatic Short Answer Scoring
docs.text:
2610.09661v1 by Zhifan Sun, Sebastian Gombert, Jannik Lossjew, Tobias Wyrwich, Berrit Katharina Czinczel, David Bednorz, Marcus Kubsch, Knut Neumann, Hendrik Drachsler

Automatic Short Answer Scoring (ASAS) is central to NLP for Education. However, openly available benchmarks remain scarce, and existing datasets largely address how well students answer a question directly rather than how well they master underlying concepts (knowledge elements) such as thermal energy or epistemic activities (skills) such as reasoning or claim. To address this gap, we introduce Alice, a large-scale, rubric-based German ASAS dataset that is pedagogically aligned and comprises three subtasks: (i) learning performance (Alice-LP), (ii) knowledge elements (Alice-KE), and (iii) skills (Alice-SK). We further formulate rubric-based ASAS as a rubric-retrieval task and benchmark the dataset with a range of language models, from encoder-only models to lightweight LLMs. We also benchmark the dataset with zero-shot prompting via LLMs and a standard classification baseline. The experiments show that LLMs, in particular, struggle to score knowledge elements and skills in the zero-shot setting. They also indicate that rubric text is often useful, especially for Alice-KE and Alice-SK, while on Alice-LP gains over sample-solution-focused inputs are more modest and vary by model and input format.

摘要：自動短答案評分（ASAS）對於教育中的自然語言處理至關重要。然而，公開可用的基準仍然稀少，現有數據集主要關注學生如何直接回答問題，而不是他們如何掌握基礎概念（知識元素），例如熱能或認知活動（技能），例如推理或主張。為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了Alice，一個大規模、基於評分標準的德語ASAS數據集，該數據集在教學上是對齊的，並包含三個子任務：（i）學習表現（Alice-LP），（ii）知識元素（Alice-KE），以及（iii）技能（Alice-SK）。我們進一步將基於評分標準的ASAS公式化為一個評分標準檢索任務，並使用一系列語言模型對數據集進行基準測試，從僅編碼模型到輕量級LLMs。我們還通過LLMs和標準分類基線對數據集進行零樣本提示的基準測試。實驗顯示，LLMs，特別是在零樣本設置中，對於評分知識元素和技能存在困難。它們還表明，評分標準文本通常是有用的，特別是對於Alice-KE和Alice-SK，而在Alice-LP上，相較於以樣本解決方案為重點的輸入所帶來的增益則較為謹慎，並且因模型和輸入格式而異。

docs.title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
docs.text:
2610.09644v1 by Alexis Beer, Liudmyla Klochko, Mathieu d'Aquin

Complementing the many efforts in providing semantic representations of concepts, notions, and entities in materials science, we report and illustrate a process by which we can automatically build a knowledge graph of the fast evolving field of machine learning applied to the prediction of material properties, focusing on MLIP (Machine Learning Interatomic Potential). This LLM-based process relies on multiple steps, from information extraction in documents and articles to a validation loop using SHACL constraints to detect and correct errors. It is carried out on a model-by-model basis, focusing on the consistency of representation, therefore enabling an iterative construction where the addition of new models is facilitated. We illustrate the process by showing a few interesting aspects that can be queried from a knowledge graph built from the models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard.

摘要：補充在材料科學中提供概念、觀念和實體的語義表示的眾多努力，我們報告並說明了一個過程，通過這個過程我們可以自動構建一個快速發展的機器學習領域的知識圖譜，該領域應用於材料性質的預測，重點是MLIP（機器學習原子間勢）。這個基於LLM的過程依賴於多個步驟，從文檔和文章中的信息提取到使用SHACL約束進行的驗證循環，以檢測和修正錯誤。這是在模型逐個基礎上進行的，重點是表示的一致性，因此使得新模型的添加變得更加方便，從而實現了迭代構建。我們通過展示一些可以從根據Matbench Discovery排行榜中列出的模型構建的知識圖譜中查詢的有趣方面來說明這一過程。

docs.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
docs.text:
2610.09643v1 by Gabriel Ocana-Santero, Marko Tvrdic

Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

摘要：藥物發現對於神經疾病傳統上集中於疾病所改變的分子。但導致病理的分子不一定是逆轉病理的最佳切入點。在此，我們探討哪些未被改變的分子控制點可以被利用來恢復病理神經迴路至功能狀態。我們提出了CircuitATLAS，一個基於來源的系統神經科學知識圖譜和目標發現的代理框架，專注於迴路病。它結構化了跨疾病、表型、電生理學、迴路、大腦區域、細胞類型和分子效應者的文獻衍生關係，同時故意排除直接的疾病-基因和疾病-蛋白質邊緣，以減少捷徑推理。該圖譜包含383萬個節點和766萬條邊，包括531萬個LLM提取的關係，並整合了結構化數據集，如人類細胞圖譜和新的多模態體內測量。我們接著介紹了一個代理工作流程，從可測量的疾病表型推理到它們的迴路和細胞基質，再到分子干預、治療可行性和臨床限制。最後，我們介紹了一個由人類主導的體內實驗室循環，將假設生成與實驗迭代聯繫起來。在這個框架內，一個代理提名ATP1A3，即神經元alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase，作為皮層興奮性的控制點；ATP1A3的抑制性神經元特異性表達在體內消除了對局部4-氨基吡啶挑戰的β和γ波反應，然後將經過驗證的目標帶入結構引導的小分子篩選，最終在一個定義的測定中解決調節的方向。因此，CircuitATLAS提供了一個發現治療藥物的框架，不僅基於疾病中分子上所受到的干擾，還基於可以控制以恢復迴路功能的內容。

docs.title: On-Policy Distillation Teaches New Skills but Not New Knowledge
docs.text:
2610.09639v1 by Yixuan Tang, Yi Yang

On-policy distillation (OPD) strengthens language-model reasoning, yet whether students acquire new factual knowledge or compositional skill for multi-step reasoning remains unknown. We separate these capabilities using a controlled synthetic framework that measures the student's initial capabilities and independently controls the teacher's additional facts, compositional skill, or both. Across four models from three families, reverse-KL OPD reliably transfers compositional skill across unseen reasoning structures, but transfers minimal factual knowledge. Decoupling the distillation recipe reveals the source of this asymmetry: replacing reverse KL with forward KL restores factual transfer, whereas student rollouts specifically improve the execution of multi-step reasoning. Experiments on recent factual QA and competition mathematics show a similar asymmetry under reverse-KL OPD, yielding notable reasoning gains without factual memory expansion. Together, these results demonstrate that on-policy distillation does not expand a model's parametric knowledge, but instead teaches it to organize and compose the knowledge it already possesses.

摘要：在政策蒸餾（OPD）中加強了語言模型的推理能力，但學生是否獲得了新的事實知識或多步推理的組合技能仍然未知。我們使用一個受控的合成框架來區分這些能力，該框架測量學生的初始能力並獨立控制教師的附加事實、組合技能或兩者。 在來自三個家族的四個模型中，反向KL OPD可靠地在未見的推理結構中轉移組合技能，但轉移的事實知識非常有限。 解耦蒸餾配方揭示了這種不對稱的來源：用正向KL替換反向KL可以恢復事實轉移，而學生的展開則特別改善了多步推理的執行。 在最近的事實問答和競賽數學實驗中，反向KL OPD下顯示出類似的不對稱，產生顯著的推理增益而不擴展事實記憶。 總體而言，這些結果表明，政策蒸餾並不擴展模型的參數知識，而是教會它組織和組合它已經擁有的知識。

docs.title: Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents
docs.text:
2610.09590v1 by Hong Su

Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.

摘要：長期運行的自主代理必須重用累積的推理經驗，而不允許明確的歷史記憶和大型語言模型的上下文無限制地增長。然後，現有的記憶機制主要是檢索、總結或壓縮過去的內容，並不直接學習何時應該啟動特定類型的思維，或從時間上分散的經驗中發現新的思維知識。本文提出了一種情境條件的思維記憶框架，將歷史推理經驗轉化為一種輕量級策略，以預測在當前情境中應該思考什麼，同時將詳細的推理留給大型語言模型。情境可以表示時間或時空的演變，而不僅僅是當前狀態。臨時經驗也會定期在多個獨立的情節中進行分析，以識別重複的長期規律，這些規律被整合為新的思維知識，並進一步被輕量級策略內化。實驗顯示，所學習的策略在時間規則泛化上達到1.000 F1，將DeepSeek推理的F1從0.789提高到0.868，將在線處理時間從每個查詢0.3636毫秒減少到0.0382毫秒，並在足夠的重複交叉經驗證據後達到1.000的關係發現F1和未來思考準確率。

docs.title: World Potential Model: Pretrained World Knowledge as Progress Potentials
docs.text:
2610.09560v1 by Jun Zhao, Jixin Tang, Yang Shu, Jinyang Wu, Yuyang Lu, Jingqi Tong, Hao Xu, Weifeng Ge, Qi Zhang

Long-horizon language agents often receive supervision only from terminal task outcomes, leaving little signal for distinguishing productive intermediate behavior from stagnation or even regression. Rather than learning a separate value function or process reward model for every task, we ask whether pretrained models can recognize task progress from their existing world knowledge. We formalize this capability with a World Potential Model (WPM), a goal-conditioned evaluator of task-relative realized progress in agent contexts. In ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, off-the-shelf pretrained models substantially outperform chance at recovering realized-progress structure without task-specific evaluator fine-tuning. We further anchor these progress judgments to task-specific milestones to obtain scalar world potentials, whose temporal differences provide process-sensitive step-level credit for policy optimization. Under matched comparisons, WPM-guided optimization improves success over outcome-only GRPO across all evaluated configurations. Together, these results provide initial evidence that pretrained world knowledge can support reusable realized-progress evaluation and provide useful supervision for long-horizon agents.

摘要：長期語言代理通常僅從最終任務結果中獲得監督，這使得區分有生產力的中間行為與停滯甚至退步的信號變得微乎其微。與其為每個任務學習一個單獨的價值函數或過程獎勵模型，我們詢問預訓練模型是否能夠從其現有的世界知識中識別任務進展。我們用世界潛力模型（WPM）形式化這一能力，這是一種基於目標的評估器，用於評估代理上下文中任務相對的實現進展。在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 中，現成的預訓練模型在恢復實現進展結構方面顯著超越隨機機會，而無需針對特定任務的評估器微調。我們進一步將這些進展判斷錨定到特定任務的里程碑，以獲得標量世界潛力，其時間差提供了對政策優化的過程敏感的步驟級信用。在匹配比較下，WPM 引導的優化在所有評估配置中改善了相較於僅基於結果的 GRPO 的成功率。綜合這些結果，初步證據表明預訓練的世界知識可以支持可重用的實現進展評估，並為長期代理提供有用的監督。

docs.title: Abstracts
From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents
docs.text:
2610.12463v1 by Abbas Raftari

In 2026, cybersecurity evaluations involving OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google agents reached real systems outside their authorized test scope. The paths were different. OpenAI agents exploited research infrastructure, coordinated across runs, and compromised parts of Hugging Face's production environment. Anthropic reported cases in which a misconfigured third-party environment exposed real systems to agents pursuing simulated cyber tasks. In a separately reported evaluation, Google's Gemini accessed three real organizations through an unintended internet route; Google stated that the model stopped in all three instances. Taken together, the cases show why an evaluation cannot rely on an assumed boundary. That boundary must be verified while the agent is operating. This comparative instrumental case study develops a Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle (PASAC) and a five-layer Boundary Assurance Stack. The framework combines risk-tiered task design, executable scope contracts, pre-run validation, least-capability access, independent egress enforcement, credential restrictions, cross-run monitoring, automatic stop conditions, and evidence-based reauthorization. A leading-indicator model, nine design propositions, and seven falsifiable hypotheses turn these lessons into a testable research program. Because the public Gemini record is limited to attributed statements and journalism, its detailed causal mechanism remains provisional. The central conclusion is straightforward: proactive agent security requires continuous assurance across the full execution system, not confidence in any single sandbox or safeguard.

摘要：在2026年，涉及OpenAI、Anthropic和Google代理的網絡安全評估達到了其授權測試範圍之外的實際系統。路徑各不相同。OpenAI代理利用研究基礎設施，在多次運行中協調，並妥協了Hugging Face生產環境的部分區域。Anthropic報告了因配置錯誤的第三方環境使實際系統暴露於追求模擬網絡任務的代理的情況。在另外一項報告的評估中，Google的Gemini通過意外的互聯網路徑訪問了三個實際組織；Google表示該模型在這三個實例中均已停止。綜合這些案例顯示，為何評估不能依賴假定的邊界。這個邊界必須在代理運行時進行驗證。本比較性工具案例研究發展了一個主動代理安全保證循環（PASAC）和一個五層邊界保證堆疊。該框架結合了風險分層任務設計、可執行範圍合同、運行前驗證、最低能力訪問、獨立出口執行、憑證限制、跨運行監控、自動停止條件和基於證據的重新授權。一個領先指標模型、九個設計命題和七個可證偽假設將這些教訓轉化為可測試的研究計劃。由於公共Gemini記錄僅限於歸屬聲明和新聞報導，其詳細的因果機制仍然是臨時的。核心結論很簡單：主動代理安全需要在整個執行系統中持續保證，而不是對任何單一沙盒或保護措施的信心。

docs.title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
docs.text:
2610.12449v1 by Anna Zimmel, Fleur Hendriks, Markus Holzleitner, Florian Sestak, Martin Weichselbaumer, Vlado Menkovski, Johannes Brandstetter

Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. At a symmetry-breaking bifurcation, a single input admits multiple equally valid solutions, violating the one-to-one assumption underlying most learned physical surrogates. We introduce Bi-FORK, a generative framework for learning these one-to-many solution maps in high-dimensional systems. Bi-FORK generates complete trajectories through latent flow matching, preserving space and time coherence, and uses repulsion-guided sampling to recover distinct solution branches in a single amortized pass. We evaluate Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, spanning continuous, discrete, and field-valued bifurcations with discretizations up to 260,000 points. Bi-FORK recovers the multimodal solution structure while scaling several orders of magnitude beyond prior approaches, opening generative modeling to high-dimensional bifurcating physical systems.

摘要：分岔在物理系統中無處不在，從結構屈曲到流體和氣候動力學，但在深度學習中仍然大多未被探索。在一個對稱破缺的分岔中，單一輸入允許多個同樣有效的解，這違反了大多數學習的物理替代模型所依賴的一對一假設。我們介紹了Bi-FORK，一個用於學習這些高維系統中的一對多解映射的生成框架。Bi-FORK通過潛在流匹配生成完整的軌跡，保持空間和時間的一致性，並使用排斥引導取樣在一次攤銷過程中恢復不同的解分支。我們在屈曲梁、機械超材料和艾倫-卡恩相分離上評估了Bi-FORK，涵蓋了連續、離散和場值分岔，離散化達到260,000個點。Bi-FORK在恢復多模態解結構的同時，超越了先前方法的幾個數量級，將生成建模擴展至高維分岔物理系統。

docs.title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
docs.text:
2610.12445v1 by Oskar J. Hollinsworth, Alex F. Spies, Tigist Diriba, Adam Gleave, Chris Cundy

Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.

摘要：最近的事件突顯了監控 LLM 代理的挑戰以及模型欺騙人類的危險。我們顯示通過探針的白盒欺騙檢測可以擴展到前沿監控設置，方法是收集迄今為止最大的欺騙數據集來訓練探針，並引入一種新穎的探針架構，可以在多層和多個標記之間聚合信息。我們的探針在 SHADE-Arena 中達到了 98.8% 的 AUC，超越了 Opus 5.5 的文本監控基準，並顯示出隨著基礎模型的擴展，效能有所改善。為了將我們的探針推向極限，我們在幾個情況下進行測試，在這些情況下，僅從上下文無法確定欺騙。在這些情況中，我們稱之為內省欺騙，真實情況只能通過仔細引導或對模型訓練數據的透徹了解來確定。在其中一次評估中，我們顯示探針可以區分包含模型真正隱藏目標的轉錄本與其他目標，AUC 高達 99.7%。我們的探針還能輕易檢測出在政治敏感話題上撒謊的顯著開放權重模型，以及在壓力下對其信念的表述。我們發布了名為 FIBS 的訓練數據集，以幫助推動有效探針的前沿部署，並鼓勵社群以更多的欺騙和破壞例子來擴展這一數據集。

docs.title: Ecology of AI Agents: Collaboration Creates a Population Threshold for Takeoff
docs.text:
2610.12436v1 by Erin Crawley, Hidenori Tanaka

AI agents can now conduct real-world cyberattacks, scale up capabilities with the number of agents, and collectively pursue misaligned goals to obtain rewards. Together, these factors raise the risk of a population explosion of misaligned agents: agents could compromise computers and secretly deploy additional agents, creating a self-reinforcing cycle where larger populations develop greater collective cyber capability and expand further. This raises a fundamental question: What determines whether a population of misaligned agents remains contained or takes off into this self-reinforcing cycle? This population-level problem is ecological safety: unlike individual-agent or multi-agent safety with a fixed population, it concerns the dynamics of the population itself. Here, we develop an ecological theory of AI-agent populations based on a population growth equation in which fitness (growth rate) depends on cybersecurity capability. We show that, without collaboration, the population takes off only when individual-agent capability exceeds a critical threshold. With collaboration, however, collective cybersecurity capability increases with population size. This creates a critical population threshold: below it, the population declines; above it, the population takes off, even though individual-agent capability has not changed. In ecology, this phenomenon is known as the strong Allee effect. Because red teaming a small group of agents cannot guarantee ecological safety in larger populations, our theory calls for ecological red teaming and population pacing: gradually deploying larger agent populations in controlled environments, while measuring how cyber capability scales with population size, and estimating the critical population size for takeoff. Capability gains may lower this threshold, requiring re-estimation for each new model generation.

摘要：AI代理現在可以進行現實世界的網路攻擊，隨著代理數量的增加而擴大能力，並共同追求不一致的目標以獲得獎勵。這些因素共同提高了不一致代理人口爆炸的風險：代理可能會入侵電腦並秘密部署額外的代理，形成一個自我增強的循環，其中更大的群體發展出更強的集體網路能力並進一步擴展。這提出了一個根本性問題：什麼決定了一個不一致代理的群體是保持受控還是進入這個自我增強的循環？這個群體層面的問題是生態安全：與擁有固定人口的單一代理或多代理安全不同，它關心的是群體本身的動態。在這裡，我們基於一個人口增長方程開發了一個AI代理群體的生態理論，其中適應度（增長率）取決於網路安全能力。我們顯示，沒有合作時，只有當單一代理的能力超過臨界閾值時，群體才會起飛。然而，隨著合作的進行，集體網路安全能力隨著人口規模的增長而增加。這創造了一個臨界人口閾值：低於這個閾值，人口會下降；高於這個閾值，人口會起飛，即使單一代理的能力並未改變。在生態學中，這種現象被稱為強阿利效應。因為對小型代理群體進行紅隊測試無法保證在更大群體中的生態安全，我們的理論呼籲進行生態紅隊測試和人口節奏控制：在受控環境中逐步部署更大的代理群體，同時測量網路能力如何隨著人口規模增長，並估算起飛的臨界人口規模。能力的增長可能會降低這個閾值，要求對每一個新模型世代進行重新估算。

docs.title: FastBench: Can Streaming VLMs Perceive High-Dynamic Real-World Streams?
docs.text:
2610.12427v1 by Yuxuan Hu, Weikang Shi, Yang Bo, Xudong Lu, Xintong Guo, Shuhan Li, Yuyang He, Huankang Guan, Peiwen Sun, Yunqiao Yang, Wenbo Li, Rui Liu, Hongsheng Li

Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.

摘要：串流視頻大型語言模型（VLMs）使得持續的視頻理解成為可能，但現有的基準主要集中在低動態場景中。在有限的上下文預算下，模型必須平衡時間歷史、空間解析度和時間粒度；以1-2 FPS的稀疏取樣會錯過快速事件。我們引入了FastBench來評估現實世界視頻流中的高動態感知。其基於軌跡的流程結合了來自高FPS剪輯的QA生成、可在2 FPS下回答的問題過濾、使用SAM3和CoTracker3軌跡的答案驗證，以及三輪人工檢查。FastBench包含來自八個領域的306對QA，涵蓋六種能力，以及前向、即時和後向的時間範疇，並附有人工標註的證據區間。我們還提出了ProactiveFrame，一種無需訓練的基準，通過文本標記調整進來的幀率。一個雙層滑動窗口保留最近的高FPS觀察，同時將較舊的觀察下採樣為稀疏歷史。實驗顯示出顯著的限制：最強的模型，Gemini-3.5-Flash，僅得分50.7%。更密集的取樣使Qwen3-VL-8B從2 FPS的32.9%提高到24 FPS的44.6%，但隨著歷史的壓縮，增益會飽和。ProactiveFrame比稀疏均勻取樣高出5.4和1.5個百分點，但仍遠低於由oracle引導的聚焦，顯示當前的VLM在僅從流中判斷何時需要更細緻的時間感知方面存在困難。FastBench為高動態串流視頻理解提供了一個測試平台。代碼和數據：https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench。

docs.title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
docs.text:
2610.12417v1 by Zheyu Fan, Yue Zhang, Mingkai Deng, Kangrui Wang, Qineng Wang, Canyu Chen, Jie Hao, Xing Fan, Chenlei Guo, Eric P. Xing, Mohit Bansal, Manling Li

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.

摘要：多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在空間、具身、物理和時間推理方面存在困難。 我們假設這些失敗反映了在視覺轉換推理方面的共同缺陷，並測試這種能力是否可以作為一種共享的訓練原語，讓不同模型可以從不同的監督來源學習並在不同任務中重用，並配合系統化的訓練配方。 現有的基準分別記錄了這些缺陷，但不支持在場景、動作和推理操作之間的受控比較。 因此，我們引入了 WOVEN，一個視覺轉換推理的訓練來源和基準，通過場景、動作和推理類型組織轉換監督，使用來自視頻預訓練生成模型的多樣化、現實的回放：涵蓋 20 種場景類型、5 種動作類型和 8 種推理類型的 36,076 個範例。 我們首先評估了 38 種前沿 MLLMs（例如，GPT-5.4 和 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B），發現存在顯著且系統性的缺陷：即使是最強的模型也遠遠低於人類，而這些失敗在模型家族之間重複出現，並隨著規模的擴大而持續存在。 然後，我們在 WOVEN 上對 MLLMs 進行多個規模的訓練，發現它們學會了一種廣泛轉移的共享能力：僅約 2,000 個項目的訓練子集共同提高了 26 個外部基準中的 22 個，提升幅度高達 27.3 個百分點，而 WOVEN 數據可以用可比的準確性替代任務自身訓練數據的 30-50%。 受控比較進一步產生了一個視覺世界建模的訓練配方，前瞻性地在保留的基準上進行驗證：根據它所教授的推理操作而不是它展示的動作、場景或領域來選擇監督，並偏好對視覺狀態的大變化以提高穩健性。 我們的工作確立了視覺轉換推理作為 MLLMs 中系統化視覺世界模型訓練的可重用基礎。

docs.title: MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances
docs.text:
2610.12416v1 by Mingyuan Lei, Yoonchang Sung, Tat-Jen Cham

Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. This factorization allows scene understanding and interaction dynamics to be learned from complementary sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that MAMHOI reduces object--scene penetration while better preserving human--object interaction quality, yielding more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions. Project page: https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/

摘要：生成複雜 3D 場景中的現實人類-物體互動 (HOI) 需要兩種互補的能力：對環境中互動可行性的推理以及合成現實的人類-物體運動。然而，這些能力的監督在規模上很少同時可用。人類-場景數據集提供了關於環境感知運動的豐富信息，而人類-物體數據集則捕捉了詳細的互動動態，然而配對的人類-物體-場景數據仍然稀缺。我們提出了 MAMHOI，一種基於可供性介導的場景感知人類-物體互動生成的因式分解。MAMHOI 通過場景理解和運動合成之間的明確運動-可供性介面來因式分解場景感知的 HOI 生成：一個場景條件模型首先預測互動可以在何處以及如何可行地執行，然後一個可供性條件的 HOI 模型生成相應的人類-物體運動。這種因式分解允許從互補的監督來源學習場景理解和互動動態，而無需配對的人類-物體-場景數據。在複雜的室內環境中的實驗顯示，MAMHOI 減少了物體-場景的穿透，同時更好地保留了人類-物體互動的質量，產生了更現實且物理上可行的場景感知互動。項目頁面： https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/

docs.title: Predicting Alignment Generalization with Value Representations
docs.text:
2610.12410v1 by Andy Liu, Mehar Bhatia, Karolina Stanczak, Mona Diab, Vered Shwartz, Daniel Fried

LLM developers post-train their models to exhibit prosocial values and behavioral traits, which are enumerated in an alignment target. However, while recent post-training developments have yielded models that score highly on alignment evaluations, training models on sets of narrow behaviors still influences their behavior across unseen contexts and environments in unexpected ways. In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values. We conduct a large-scale analysis of alignment generalization effects across 66 values found in modern alignment targets, and benchmark representational techniques on the alignment generalization prediction task. We find that representations based on model activations when applying values in context significantly outperform methods based on textual descriptions of the values. Specifically, the best activations-based methods achieve correlations of 0.45 with our generalization matrix, compared with 0.05 from description-based baselines. We then show the applicability of representations that predict alignment generalization toward downstream tasks by using them to measure how similar the values in a multi-value alignment target are, which we find is significantly correlated with model robustness. Finally, we show initial evidence towards a shared, model-independent value space, which we use to develop the first taxonomy of LLM values grounded in empirical generalization dynamics. Our work demonstrates the importance of studying value generalization in LLMs and its application toward the more empirical design and training of model behavior.

摘要：LLM 開發者對他們的模型進行後訓練，以展現社會價值觀和行為特徵，這些特徵在對齊目標中列舉。然而，儘管最近的後訓練發展產生了在對齊評估中得分很高的模型，但在狹窄行為集上訓練模型仍然會以意想不到的方式影響它們在未見上下文和環境中的行為。本文中，我們確立了對齊泛化預測的任務，即預測如何微調模型以遵循給定的價值觀會改變其在廣泛保留值範圍內的行為。我們對現代對齊目標中發現的 66 種價值的對齊泛化效應進行了大規模分析，並在對齊泛化預測任務上基準化了表示技術。我們發現，基於模型在上下文中應用價值觀時的激活的表示顯著優於基於價值觀文本描述的方法。具體而言，最佳的基於激活的方法在我們的泛化矩陣中達到了 0.45 的相關性，而基於描述的基準僅為 0.05。然後，我們展示了預測對齊泛化的表示在下游任務中的適用性，通過使用它們來衡量多值對齊目標中價值觀的相似性，我們發現這與模型的穩健性有顯著相關性。最後，我們展示了初步證據，支持一個共享的、模型獨立的價值空間，我們利用這個空間開發了第一個基於經驗泛化動態的 LLM 價值分類法。我們的工作展示了研究 LLM 中價值泛化的重要性及其在模型行為的更具經驗設計和訓練中的應用。

docs.title: Searching for "Harmful Refusal": A Psychometric Audit of an AI Safety Benchmark
docs.text:
2610.12409v1 by Christopher M. Stewart, Preston Botter, Natalie Sarabosing, Muye Zhang, Rachel Phinnemore, Shalini Ghosh, Hong Shen, Hoda Heidari

Safety benchmarks typically report one overall score for a suite of datasets, each of which may target one or more safety-related attributes, so models with similar overall scores can have very different attribute profiles. Comparing models is more tractable at the level of individual attributes, yet it is often unclear whether even a single dataset's scores isolate any single attribute. One plausible candidate for such an attribute is harmful refusal, a model's tendency to refuse dangerous or policy-violating prompts. We examine whether it constitutes a single, measurable attribute in HELM Safety. Using a construct validity framework that stipulates that an attribute must exist before a test can measure it, we start with HELM Safety's four datasets that might plausibly target harmful refusal, but find that three are saturated. We subject the remaining dataset, HarmBench, to two psychometric tests to determine if a single attribute like harmful refusal could stand behind its score. First, multidimensional item response theory modeling strongly suggests that HarmBench does not measure a singular attribute. Second, a differential item functioning analysis finds items where models from different developers with the same refusal ability score differently. These flags largely disappear under scope-specific matching, a pattern consistent with aggregation effects but not sufficient to rule out domain-specific developer differences. Zooming out, HarmBench collapses distinct harm behaviors into one score, and the overall HELM safety aggregate further collapses HarmBench and scores from other datasets into a single top-line number. Any safety score that averages over datasets and items can hide saturation and conflate behaviors this way. We argue that a score should earn its single-attribute reading before models are compared with it.

摘要：安全基準通常會針對一組數據集報告一個整體分數，每個數據集可能針對一個或多個與安全相關的屬性，因此擁有相似整體分數的模型可能擁有非常不同的屬性概況。比較模型在個別屬性層面上更具可行性，但通常不清楚即使是一個數據集的分數是否能夠孤立出任何單一屬性。一個合理的候選屬性是有害拒絕，即模型拒絕危險或違反政策的提示的傾向。我們檢查它是否構成 HELM Safety 中的一個單一、可測量的屬性。使用一個建構效度框架，該框架規定屬性必須存在才能測量，我們從 HELM Safety 的四個數據集開始，這些數據集可能合理地針對有害拒絕，但發現三個數據集已經飽和。我們對剩下的數據集 HarmBench 進行了兩個心理測量測試，以確定像有害拒絕這樣的單一屬性是否能解釋其分數。首先，多維項目反應理論建模強烈表明 HarmBench 並未測量單一屬性。其次，差異項目功能分析發現，來自不同開發者的模型在相同拒絕能力下的得分不同。這些標記在範疇特定的匹配下大多消失，這一模式與聚合效應一致，但不足以排除特定領域開發者的差異。放眼全局，HarmBench 將不同的傷害行為合併為一個分數，而整體 HELM 安全總和進一步將 HarmBench 和來自其他數據集的分數合併為一個單一的頂線數字。任何對數據集和項目進行平均的安全分數都可能隱藏飽和並以這種方式混淆行為。我們主張，分數應在模型進行比較之前獲得其單一屬性的解讀。

docs.title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
docs.text:
2610.12407v1 by Shashank Hegde, Alexander Popov, Elie Aljalbout, Nikolai Smolyanskiy

World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.

摘要：世界行動模型（WAMs）預測行動和未來觀察，通常基於重建的表示，這種表示承載著嘈雜的、冗餘的信息，可能會使下游預測變得複雜。我們介紹LeWAM，一種雙向Transformer，用於前向、後向、逆動力學和政策預測，這是一個無解碼器的JEPA潛在模型，通過所有四種模式端到端訓練。我們看到以下好處：1）對齊：線性探針從LeWAM的潛在中讀取機器人和物體狀態的效果優於從常規的Le世界模型（僅前向的JEPA世界模型），而且潛在忽略了視覺干擾者，與LeWM一樣，且遠優於基於重建的WAM。2）行動：LeWAM的閉環評估與在相同編碼器上以匹配大小訓練的常規流匹配政策相匹配，同時也提供了一個世界模型。3）規劃：在使用WAMs進行規劃時採樣原始行動，讓MPC利用動力學模型的不準確性；而在政策頭的噪音空間中進行規劃則改善了這些WAM的閉環性能。

docs.title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
docs.text:
2610.12403v1 by Hongxing Li, Dingming Li, Yixin Li, Yong Du, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen

Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.

摘要：技能增強代理透過將成功的軌跡提煉成可重用的策略來提高樣本效率。然而，大多數現有的方法仍然以文本為中心，將空間佈局和動作-狀態對應線性化為失去關鍵幾何結構的語言。最近的努力已開始納入視覺證據，但將技能的構建和更新與政策優化分開，導致它們的相互改進尚未得到充分探索。我們提出了ViSkill，一個視覺原生的技能學習框架，將成功的互動編碼為可直接被VLM代理訪問的複合視覺技能卡。檢索到的技能指導推理和獎勵塑形，而成功的軌跡則被提煉回庫中，形成一個封閉的反饋循環，在這個循環中，技能積累和政策改進相互增強。一個可選的冷啟動機制進一步加速早期學習。在Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上進行評估，ViSkill的整體成功率達到0.89，冷啟動初始化後上升至0.91，超越了所有評估的專有和開源基準，同時收斂速度快於標準PPO。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill獲得。

docs.title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
docs.text:
2610.12402v1 by Hongxing Li, Jinyue Su, Dingming Li, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen

Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

摘要：現有的空間推理基準主要測試空間感知：從已在輸入中可見的關係中讀取信息。然實際世界的空間智慧需求預測性空間推理：從觀察中構建場景，預測干預如何改變它，並推理未見的結果。我們介紹了 SpaceCast-Bench，這是第一個直接且診斷性地評估這種能力的基準。它基於觀察-轉換-推斷框架，包含來自182個現實世界場景的3,862個問題，涵蓋三個層級的16種任務類型：靜態感知、本地預測和全局預測，逐步要求場景理解、空間狀態更新和對未觀察結果的關係推理。對21個模型的評估揭示了明顯的差距：最強的模型僅達到58.0%，而人類表現為87.2%，而專注於空間的模型則接近隨機機會。受控分析進一步顯示，橋接視圖對整合分佈式觀察至關重要，並且明確的3D證據比生成的結果圖像或視頻更可靠地惠及模型。在我們程序生成的數據上進行微調，將 Qwen3-VL-4B 從34.0%提升至65.7%，在六個域外基準上獲得宏觀平均增益。

docs.title: HRIL: Learning Multimodal Synergy via Higher-Order Tensor Modeling
docs.text:
2610.12393v1 by Qun Dai, Liangjian Wen, Jiang Duan, Yong Dai, Dongkai Wang, Maolin Wang, Mingjie Wang, Jianzhuang Liu, He Yan, Zhao Kang

Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. Code is released at https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL.

摘要：自我監督的多模態表示學習在各個領域取得了顯著的成功，但由於跨模態互動的複雜性，捕捉協同信息仍然具有挑戰性。與各個模態之間共享的信息不同，協同效應出現在與任務相關的信號僅從多個模態的聯合配置中產生，而無法從任何單一模態中獨立恢復。這項工作專注於如何在多模態表示中保留這種協同信號的信息容量。關鍵觀察是，協同信息體現在模態之間的高階統計依賴性中，這為明確建模聯合互動提供了一個原則性的目標。受到這一見解的啟發，我們提出了高階表示與信息學習（HRIL），該方法構建了一個基於模態嵌入的實證交叉矩量張量，以表示多向互動。HRIL採用塔克分解來獲取核心張量，並輔以一個考慮協同效應的正則化器，以防止能量集中並保留高階耦合能力，以捕捉協同信息。在受控協同任務和現實世界基準上的實驗顯示，與現有的多模態對比方法相比，HRIL在協同互動主導的任務上取得了顯著的改進。代碼已在 https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL 上發布。

docs.title: GeoReform: Reflective Formalization Evolution for Multimodal Geometry Problem Solving
docs.text:
2610.12391v1 by Jialu Wang, Ruichen Zhang, Xiaoou Liu, Hua Wei, Tianlong Chen

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to identify and use geometric relations in diagrams. Recent methods address this challenge by converting geometric entities, relations, and constraints into explicit textual representations for the model to reason over. However, effective formalization is highly non-trivial: on Geometry3K, structure injection fixes 28 errors but introduces 13 new ones among 200 examples. Redundant relations can distract the model, while ambiguous references to diagram elements can lead it to apply constraints incorrectly. This suggests that the key challenge is not merely extracting more geometric facts, but organizing them into representations that support downstream reasoning. To fully exploit the power of formalization, we further propose GeoReform, a reflective formalization evolution framework that treats formalization as an optimizable policy rather than a fixed parser output. GeoReform executes the full reasoning pipeline, collects failed rollouts, diagnoses defects in the current representation, and mutates the policy to better select, ground, group, and present geometric entities, relations, constraints, and targets. On Geometry3K, GeoReform improves Qwen3VL-2B accuracy from 42.0\% to 56.0\%. Extensive experiments and analyses across geometry reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that effective formalization is crucial for improving multimodal geometry reasoning.

摘要：多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在識別和使用圖表中的幾何關係方面經常遇到困難。最近的方法通過將幾何實體、關係和約束轉換為明確的文本表示來解決這一挑戰，以便模型進行推理。然而，有效的形式化是非常不簡單的：在Geometry3K上，結構注入修正了28個錯誤，但在200個示例中引入了13個新錯誤。冗餘的關係可能會分散模型的注意力，而對圖表元素的模糊引用可能會導致它錯誤地應用約束。這表明，關鍵挑戰不僅僅是提取更多的幾何事實，而是將它們組織成支持下游推理的表示。為了充分利用形式化的力量，我們進一步提出了GeoReform，一個反思性形式化演變框架，將形式化視為可優化的策略，而不是固定的解析器輸出。GeoReform執行完整的推理管道，收集失敗的展開，診斷當前表示中的缺陷，並變異策略以更好地選擇、基礎、分組和呈現幾何實體、關係、約束和目標。在Geometry3K上，GeoReform將Qwen3VL-2B的準確率從42.0\%提高到56.0\%。在幾何推理基準上的廣泛實驗和分析表明，有效的形式化對於改善多模態幾何推理至關重要。

docs.title: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search
docs.text:
2610.12390v1 by Ziming Dai, Dabiao Ma, Ziheng Guo, Jack Dong, Zimu Zhou

Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.

摘要：工業風險控制系統通常依賴結構化數據模型來進行高效預測，但大量有價值的信息仍然嵌入在非結構化的長文本中。通過手動特徵工程提取這些信息是勞動密集型的，而要求大型語言模型（LLM）處理每個實時輸入可能無法滿足實際部署要求。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了LLM-BlockFE，一種LLM引導的離線特徵構建框架，將長文本轉換為可執行的特徵程序，從而避免在在線推理過程中調用LLM。LLM-BlockFE通過逐步附加不可變代碼塊來構建特徵程序，並使用下游模型評估候選特徵。為了解決傳統貪婪搜索容易陷入次優解的傾向，我們的方法引入了一種基於深度校準信貸分配的區塊級回滾機制，並以交錯的方式推進多條獨立的搜索軌跡，通過共享每條軌跡探索方向的固定描述來減少冗餘探索。搜索結束後，生成的程序被凍結並部署以提取結構化特徵供下游預測模型使用。在兩個公共數據集和兩個私有數據集中，LLM-BlockFE在每個數據集的全數據集比較中，相對於最強基線實現了0.0069到0.0358的絕對AUC提升。五個已部署的金融風險控制應用的上線後監控顯示，相對於現有的手動設計策略，絕對KS提升了0.02到1.56個百分點。

docs.title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
docs.text:
2610.12386v1 by Gokul Puthumanaillam, Tao Sun, Elie Aljalbout, Moritz Reuss, Zhaoshuo Li, Fabio Ramos, Ankit Goyal, Jenai Xuning Yang

The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

摘要：目前改善機器人基礎模型（RFM）的主流方法依賴於更大的模型、更多的機器人示範以及昂貴的大規模訓練。我們展示了一種有效且高效的互補方法：正確的推理配方可以顯著提高現有最先進RFM的零次任務表現。我們將這個配方稱為ARC。它由三個關鍵成分組成：推理痕跡、一個可擴展的自動標記管道，以及一種將預訓練RFM適應以使用這些痕跡進行控制的策略。首先，我們發現有效的推理痕跡應該基於機器人的下一個行動並解釋其因果結構：為什麼這個行動是合適的以及它應該產生什麼效果。其次，我們展示這些痕跡可以從現有的示範中自動生成，使我們能夠從DROID構建ARC-Trace-DROID，而無需收集新的機器人數據。第三，我們展示了最先進的VLA（視覺語言模型）如$π_{0.5}$和WAM（行為模型）如Cosmos3-Nano-Policy如何學會使用這些痕跡進行控制，並根據每個模型的架構和能力進行微調和推理。使用ARC，我們在零次RFM表現上獲得了前所未有的增益，據我們所知，這些增益是在沒有額外機器人示範或基礎規模訓練的情況下取得的。經過適應的模型在RoboLab-120和MolmoSpaces上建立了新的最先進紀錄，在RoboLab-Reasoning-50上獲得了高達50個百分點的增益。在真實機器人上，ARC使得$π_{0.5}$的任務成功率提高了82.2個百分點。項目網站：https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

docs.title: Latent Core Tokenizer: Compress, but Meaningfully
docs.text:
2610.12376v1 by Felermino D. M. A. Ali, Millicent Ochieng, Ogbemi Ekwejunor-Etchie, Ade Famoti, Jacki O'Neill, Debjit Paul

Tokenizers are commonly optimized for compression, but a compact vocabulary does not necessarily distribute its capacity evenly across languages. We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), a language-agnostic approach that separates structural discovery from vocabulary construction. LCT uses Minimum Description Length, entropy-based boundary signals, and morphotactic constraints to identify reusable linguistic units before constructing a shared vocabulary. Across 104 languages with a 200K-token vocabulary, LCT achieves lower fertility and higher MorphScore than BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, while maintaining comparable cross-lingual disparity in tokenization cost. Across four multilingual downstream benchmarks, LCT improves aggregate score by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, respectively. Our findings show that compression alone does not predict representation quality and highlight the importance of morphology-driven structural discovery and how frequency is used to allocate the final vocabulary across languages.

摘要：Tokenizers 通常是針對壓縮進行優化的，但緊湊的詞彙表並不一定在各種語言之間均勻分配其容量。我們介紹了潛在核心分詞器（Latent Core Tokenizer, LCT），這是一種與語言無關的方法，將結構發現與詞彙構建分開。LCT 使用最小描述長度、基於熵的邊界信號和形態約束來識別可重用的語言單元，然後再構建共享的詞彙表。在 104 種語言中，使用 200K-token 的詞彙表，LCT 在生育率上表現得比 BPE、Unigram 和考慮平衡的 BPE 更低，並且在 MorphScore 上更高，同時在分詞成本的跨語言差異上保持可比性。在四個多語言的下游基準測試中，LCT 分別比 BPE、Unigram 和考慮平衡的 BPE 提高了 1.48、1.83 和 2.00 分的總分。我們的研究結果顯示，僅僅依賴壓縮無法預測表示質量，並強調了形態驅動的結構發現的重要性，以及如何使用頻率來在各種語言之間分配最終的詞彙表。

docs.title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
docs.text:
2610.12375v1 by Babak Barazandeh, Connor Swanson, Chinmay Kulkarni, Nikhil Mungel

Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).

摘要：代理人被應用於從旅行規劃和股票交易到 IT 事件分流的各種應用中。 在大多數情況下，LLM 代理人獨立運作，僅有最小的基於規則的保護措施，這導致了不可逆轉行動所帶來的成本和安全問題。 最近的研究通過使用保護代理來監控行為或事後評估日誌來解決這一問題。 第一種方法為每一步增加了成本和延遲；第二種方法在執行後給出判決，當時代幣已經被消耗，損害已經造成。 為了克服這一問題，我們提出了 OnTrack，一種流式監控機制，通過將代理的步驟和依賴與記錄的成功運行進行比較，來在每步約一毫秒內提醒用戶或阻止代理。 我們在三種不同的訪問範疇中研究這個問題：完全參考訪問（歷史運行和工具架構）、中等訪問（僅工具架構）和無先前知識（僅生成的步驟日誌）。 隨著數據訪問的減少，OnTrack 監控能力的期望值也隨之降低，範圍從計劃違規檢測到識別循環、停滯和重複的工具調用。 最後，我們使用 SWE-bench 軌跡評估 OnTrack。 根據前 8 步，我們的方法將失敗的軌跡排名低於成功的軌跡，優於內容相似性方法（+0.057 AUROC）。 通過中止政策，我們節省了約 18% 的計算資源，這些資源本來會在失敗的運行中被消耗，其中 83% 的中斷運行實際上是走向失敗的（6 次中止中有 5 次是正確的）。

docs.title: Which Skill to Distill? SGUID: Selecting a Compact Skill Bank for Model-Skill Co-Evolution
docs.text:
2610.12367v1 by Yuhan Liu, Xiyao Ma, Zhongkai Sun, Xu Han, Chengyuan Ma, Benjamin Z. Yao, Chenlei Guo

Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.
