摘要：最佳的兩位元權重量化器，像是 QTIP 和 Proteus，通過隨機正交變換旋轉每個權重矩陣，這必須在每個解碼步驟中被撤銷，然後在歐幾里得搜索下用樹狀碼或格碼進行編碼；層海森矩陣僅通過編碼區塊之間的錯誤反饋進入。我們顯示這會導致部分海森矩陣未被使用。錯誤反饋將損失轉換為每個坐標四捨五入誤差的加權總和，其權重為海森矩陣 LDL 分解的對角線，現有的量化器計算但從不讀取。我們將這些權重放入 Viterbi 分支度量中，因此搜索遵循每個編碼區塊內的曲率。這也解釋了旋轉：它消除了這種區塊內變異，因此在本地基底中的加權和旋轉是替代品。在三個模型上，加權的本地搜索與全維隨機哈達瑪德的準確度相差約一點，而旋轉後的加權增益不大。在這個搜索的基礎上，我們構建了 CurveTQ，一個沒有旋轉的樹狀編解碼器，它使用分解的尺度場和封閉形式的分位數表來處理權重的幅度和邊際形狀，並為每個編碼區塊存儲一個起始狀態，以便樹狀編碼器可以適應錯誤反饋帶入的殘差。在兩位元的情況下，CurveTQ 在三個 4-8B 指令模型上的平均下游準確度比 QTIP 和 Proteus 高出 1-3 點，即使在兩者都給予我們的起始狀態後，僅此一項就能使任一基線提升 1-3 點。它在 35B 專家混合模型上也領先，據我們所知，這是這樣模型上第一個樹狀編碼的結果。由於沒有需要撤銷的旋轉，我們的解碼器在所有測試的批量大小和位寬中都是三者中最快的。

docs.title: Do Vision Models Learn Physical Constraints or Rendering Shortcuts? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Grounded Physical Consistency
docs.text:
2610.09205v1 by M. Moein Esfahani, Sepehr Salem, Mohammed Alser, Vince Calhoun

Modern image editing models can satisfy a text instruction while breaking the physics of the edited scene. A new object may cast no shadow, a mirror may fail to reflect visible geometry, or an object may float above a surface that should support it. We study physical plausibility diagnosis, detecting whether an edited image violates scene physics, naming the violation type, localizing the affected region, and explaining the failure in language. We introduce a counterfactual benchmark whose controlled synthetic component uses Mitsuba~3 to generate 5,500 images from 500 scene families. Each family contains one clean image and ten matched violations involving shadows, reflection, support, surface response, and occlusion. The renderer pipeline provides category labels, affected-region masks and boxes, scene metadata, and explanation targets. We use LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and InternVL3.5-8B as diagnostic baselines rather than proposed methods. On a 1,650-image synthetic test set, the adapted baselines reach 64.0--67.8\% category macro-F1 on standard held-out scenes. For LLaVA-1.5-7B, category macro-F1 falls from 64.0\% on the standard split to 40.8\% under intervention shift. This gap shows that high in-distribution accuracy partly reflects cues tied to rendering and counterfactual construction.

摘要：現代影像編輯模型可以滿足文本指令，同時違反編輯場景的物理法則。新的物體可能不會投下陰影，鏡子可能無法反射可見的幾何形狀，或者一個物體可能懸浮在應該支撐它的表面上。我們研究物理合理性診斷，檢測編輯後的影像是否違反場景物理，命名違規類型，定位受影響區域，並用語言解釋失敗。我們引入了一個反事實基準，其受控的合成組件使用 Mitsuba~3 生成 5,500 張來自 500 個場景家族的影像。每個家族包含一張乾淨的影像和十個涉及陰影、反射、支撐、表面反應和遮擋的匹配違規。渲染管道提供類別標籤、受影響區域的掩碼和框、場景元數據和解釋目標。我們使用 LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 InternVL3.5-8B 作為診斷基準，而不是提出的方法。在一個包含 1,650 張影像的合成測試集上，調整後的基準在標準保留場景上達到 64.0--67.8\% 的類別宏觀 F1。對於 LLaVA-1.5-7B，類別宏觀 F1 從標準分割的 64.0\% 下降到介入轉移下的 40.8\%。這一差距顯示，高分佈內準確率部分反映了與渲染和反事實構建相關的線索。

docs.title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
docs.text:
2610.09146v1 by Yexiao He, Yucheng Tang, Pengfei Guo, Yufan He, Andriy Myronenko, Can Zhao, Ang Li, Daguang Xu, Dong Yang

Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. This is especially concerning in medicine, where new clinical evidence, updated guidelines, and new therapies can change established practice. Fine-tuning can update the model, but it requires access to model weights and additional training. Parameter-free methods avoid training, but they may overfit a fixed validation set, lack reliable domain knowledge, or lose visual details by saving experience only as text. To address these limitations, we present a model-agnostic framework that allows frozen LLMs and VLMs to learn from deployment experience through three forms of external expertise: a Skill that guides reasoning and tool use, a Knowledge Memory that stores reliable facts supported by earlier cases or trusted external evidence, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base that keeps visual examples and guides the model to relate each retrieved case to the current image. Instead of relying on a fixed validation set, a validation strategy keeps an update only if it helps on new cases without degrading performance on earlier ones. Across six benchmarks covering clinical diagnosis, clinical workflows, medical reasoning, and medical and non-medical visual reasoning, and with four open-weight and closed-source base models, our framework improves performance during online deployment by up to 34.2% over the base model on medical tasks, generalizes to unseen cases, transfers to other models without further optimization, and works in non-medical domains.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）和視覺語言模型（VLMs）在部署後通常是凍結的，因此它們不會從解決的案例中學習。這在醫學領域尤其令人擔憂，因為新的臨床證據、更新的指導方針和新療法可能會改變既定的實踐。微調可以更新模型，但需要訪問模型權重和額外的訓練。無參數的方法避免訓練，但可能會對固定的驗證集過擬合，缺乏可靠的領域知識，或僅通過將經驗保存為文本而失去視覺細節。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一個模型無關的框架，允許凍結的LLMs和VLMs通過三種形式的外部專業知識從部署經驗中學習：一個指導推理和工具使用的技能、一個存儲可靠事實的知識記憶，這些事實由早期案例或可信的外部證據支持，以及一個保持視覺範例的多模態知識庫，並引導模型將每個檢索到的案例與當前圖像相關聯。驗證策略不依賴於固定的驗證集，僅在對新案例有幫助而不降低早期案例性能的情況下進行更新。在涵蓋臨床診斷、臨床工作流程、醫學推理以及醫學和非醫學視覺推理的六個基準測試中，並且使用四個開放權重和封閉源代碼的基礎模型，我們的框架在醫學任務中在線部署期間將性能提高了最多34.2%，對未見案例具有良好的泛化能力，能夠轉移到其他模型而無需進一步優化，並且在非醫學領域中也能運作。

docs.title: Constraint Tree Exploration for Learning from Language Feedback
docs.text:
2610.09107v1 by Shaoang Li, Daniel R. Jiang, Jian Li

Natural-language feedback in interactive learning often explains why an action failed by pointing to violated requirements. Misinterpreting this feedback can lead an agent to rule out valid solutions. We study this setting by modeling user intent as latent constraints over an action space and formulating learning from language feedback as pure exploration over feasible regions. We introduce TRACE, an algorithm that organizes candidate constraints in a tree and tests each proposed refinement by generating actions that satisfy it. TRACE commits to the refinement only if the resulting feedback does not contradict it over repeated tests. We distinguish two ways of using the same feedback: (i) falsification, which detects contradictions to the constraint set currently being tested, and (ii) identification, which may additionally name a violated constraint. We prove high-probability coverage bounds with dependence on the candidate class size $H$ for TRACE-Falsification. With reliable identification, TRACE-Identification can replace this dependence by $K/p_{\mathrm{ext}}$, where $K$ is the number of latent constraints and $p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ lower-bounds the probability of extracting a missing true constraint from informative feedback. We evaluate TRACE across six language-feedback tasks. On RecMovie, TRACE-Identification achieves 73% and 86% final-output success under caps of 20 and 60 evaluated outputs, compared with at most 42% and 48% for the evaluated prompting baselines given the same feedback and output caps. Controlled identity-corruption experiments further show greater robustness than direct accumulation when the falsification detector remains reliable.

摘要：自然語言反饋在互動學習中通常解釋了為什麼某個行動失敗，並指出違反的要求。對這些反饋的誤解可能會導致代理排除有效的解決方案。我們通過將用戶意圖建模為行動空間上的潛在約束來研究這種情況，並將從語言反饋中學習的過程表述為對可行區域的純探索。我們引入了 TRACE，一種將候選約束組織成樹狀結構的算法，並通過生成滿足每個提議的改進的行動來測試它。TRACE 只有在重複測試中結果反饋不與之矛盾時，才會承諾這一改進。我們區分了使用相同反饋的兩種方式：（i）偽證，檢測當前正在測試的約束集的矛盾，以及（ii）識別，這可能額外命名一個違反的約束。我們證明了 TRACE-Falsification 的高概率覆蓋界限，並依賴於候選類大小 $H$。在可靠識別的情況下，TRACE-Identification 可以用 $K/p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ 來替代這一依賴，其中 $K$ 是潛在約束的數量，$p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ 是從信息反饋中提取缺失真約束的概率的下界。我們在六個語言反饋任務中評估了 TRACE。在 RecMovie 上，TRACE-Identification 在 20 和 60 個評估輸出上，最終輸出成功率分別達到 73% 和 86%，而在相同反饋和輸出上限下，評估的提示基線最多僅達到 42% 和 48%。控制身份腐敗實驗進一步顯示，當偽證檢測器保持可靠時，其穩健性優於直接累積。

docs.title: Careful Judge: Safe and Efficient Human-AI Collaborative Decision Making
docs.text:
2610.09043v1 by Chenyu Zhang, Rachel Luo, Boyi Li, Anjali Parashar, Marco Pavone, Apoorva Sharma

In human-AI collaborative decision making, human review can prevent unsafe AI decisions, but each human judgment is costly. Treating human intervention after AI abstention as a one-off fallback misses the opportunity to improve future AI decisions for greater automation, yet AI adaptively learning from selectively queried human feedback breaks safety guardrails calibrated for old models. We approach this challenge with CARE---calibrated adaptive rectification and escalation---an end-to-end pipeline that combines AI models and human reviewers to guarantee safe, human-aligned decisions, while continuously learning from human feedback to achieve greater automation with fewer human queries. CARE is principled, general, modular, and works with any black-box AI model. Our novel adaptive calibration module guarantees risk control at every time step for any rectification module. We further show how CARE improves query efficiency when the AI model is well trained and the human-AI misalignment has a clear structure. Experiments on four safety-critical real-world datasets spanning driving, language, and robotics demonstrate that CARE achieves human-aligned decisions while reducing human queries by 25-81% relative to baselines.

摘要：在人類與人工智慧的協作決策中，人類審查可以防止不安全的人工智慧決策，但每一次人類判斷都是有成本的。將人工介入視為人工智慧放棄後的一次性備用措施，錯失了改善未來人工智慧決策以實現更大自動化的機會，然而，人工智慧從選擇性查詢的人類反饋中自適應學習，則打破了為舊模型校準的安全防護措施。我們用CARE來應對這一挑戰——校準的自適應修正和升級——這是一個端到端的流程，結合了人工智慧模型和人類審查者，以保證安全且符合人類需求的決策，同時不斷從人類反饋中學習，以實現更高的自動化，並減少人類查詢次數。CARE是原則性、通用性、模塊化的，並且可以與任何黑箱人工智慧模型協同工作。我們的新型自適應校準模塊保證了在每一時間步驟中對任何修正模塊的風險控制。我們進一步展示了當人工智慧模型訓練良好且人類與人工智慧之間的不一致性具有明確結構時，CARE如何提高查詢效率。在四個涉及駕駛、語言和機器人技術的安全關鍵真實世界數據集上的實驗表明，CARE在實現符合人類需求的決策的同時，相對於基準減少了25-81%的人工查詢。

docs.title: From High Recall to High Utility: Dataset-Adaptive Post-Processing of LLM-Generated Customer Intents
docs.text:
2610.09039v1 by Mahesh Viswanathan, Joan Rossello, Leticia Fernandes, Paul Mutawe

Large language models can extract useful signals from heterogeneous enterprise data, but high-recall extraction often produces outputs that are duplicated, uneven in granularity, semantically overlapping, or too numerous for downstream systems and human reviewers to use effectively. We present a dataset-adaptive post-processing architecture developed for Customer Intent Extraction (CIE), where unstructured customer language is transformed into stable, traceable intent units. The approach separates recall-oriented extraction from utility-oriented reduction. Source-specific preprocessing first isolates evidence from multimodal plans, sparse operational records, and structured opportunity data. Candidate intents are then standardized and deduplicated, optionally enriched with metadata for embedding computation, represented in a shared semantic vector space, and grouped using a clustering strategy selected according to the candidate set's characteristics. Cluster-level keywords provide an explainability layer, while singleton reassignment requires agreement between embedding and keyword similarity. Finally, constrained language-model aggregation produces one concise intent per cluster without introducing unsupported concepts, and the resulting unit retains provenance, clustering, embedding, and generation metadata. This treats post-processing not as cosmetic cleanup, but as a semantic reduction layer converting high-recall LLM outputs into reusable enterprise intelligence. We also describe two downstream applications: Machine-Generated Intents, which infer likely objectives for customers lacking direct evidence from peer customers with similar profiles, and intent-guided semantic retrieval and mapping, which uses the stable intent as a query against a downstream decision space, illustrated here by mapping customer intents to business outcomes.

摘要：大型語言模型可以從異質企業數據中提取有用的信號，但高召回率的提取往往會產生重複、不均勻的粒度、語義重疊或數量過多的輸出，這使得下游系統和人工審核者難以有效使用。我們提出了一種針對客戶意圖提取（CIE）開發的數據集自適應後處理架構，在這裡，非結構化的客戶語言被轉換為穩定、可追溯的意圖單元。該方法將以召回為導向的提取與以效用為導向的減少分開。源特定的預處理首先從多模態計劃、稀疏操作記錄和結構化機會數據中隔離證據。然後，候選意圖被標準化和去重，並根據需要用元數據進行增強以進行嵌入計算，表示在共享的語義向量空間中，並使用根據候選集特徵選擇的聚類策略進行分組。集群級別的關鍵字提供了解釋性層，而單例重新分配則需要嵌入和關鍵字相似性之間的協議。最後，受限的語言模型聚合在每個集群中產生一個簡潔的意圖，而不引入不支持的概念，並且生成的單元保留了來源、聚類、嵌入和生成元數據。這將後處理視為一個語義減少層，將高召回率的LLM輸出轉換為可重用的企業智能。我們還描述了兩個下游應用：機器生成的意圖，這些意圖推斷缺乏直接證據的客戶可能的目標，這些客戶與具有相似檔案的同行客戶相關，和意圖引導的語義檢索與映射，這使用穩定的意圖作為對下游決策空間的查詢，這裡通過將客戶意圖映射到商業結果來進行說明。

docs.title: A Shortcut to Structure in AlphaFold 3
docs.text:
2610.08937v1 by Jonathan Feldman, Jeffrey Skolnick

AlphaFold 3 predicts protein structures with remarkable accuracy, yet how structural information emerges within the model remains poorly understood. Here, through causal interventions on internal representations and direct probing of every Pairformer block, we trace the formation of global protein geometry and identify the multiple sequence alignment (MSA) as a structural shortcut to the fold. Removing the MSA largely preserves local secondary structure while disrupting the long-range relationships that define global topology. Restoring the MSA-enriched pair representation at only forty residues recovers most of this lost organization, including at pairs never directly modified. This contribution depends on the detailed direction of the MSA module's output rather than its magnitude. The Pairformer rapidly converts this signal into global geometry: the final fold becomes recoverable by approximately block 9 of 48 for a majority of proteins, roughly twenty-seven blocks before the model's decoder can render it, whereas without the MSA it remains inaccessible for most proteins throughout the pass. Which homologs are supplied shapes this trajectory more strongly than which query is supplied; it persists for a designed query that never evolved but collapses for a shuffled sequence. Most importantly, an alignment built for a different protein that shares the fold, supplied only at the structurally corresponding columns, raises the median TM-score against experiment from 0.44 to 0.72, while the same alignment shifted a few residues along the chain performs worse than supplying no alignment at all. What AlphaFold 3 reads from an alignment is therefore a description of the fold itself, transferable between proteins that share one, rather than the query's own evolutionary history. This explains both its accuracy and the limits of what it has solved.

摘要：AlphaFold 3 以驚人的準確度預測蛋白質結構，但模型內部如何產生結構信息仍然不甚了解。在這裡，通過對內部表徵的因果干預和對每個 Pairformer 模塊的直接探測，我們追踪全球蛋白質幾何形狀的形成，並將多序列比對 (MSA) 確定為結構性捷徑。去除 MSA 在很大程度上保留了局部二級結構，同時破壞了定義全球拓撲的長距離關係。在僅四十個殘基處恢復豐富 MSA 的配對表徵，能夠恢復大部分失去的組織，包括在從未直接修改的配對中。這一貢獻依賴於 MSA 模塊輸出的詳細方向，而非其大小。Pairformer 快速將這一信號轉換為全球幾何形狀：對於大多數蛋白質，最終的摺疊在大約第 48 個模塊的第 9 個區塊就能被恢復，這大約比模型的解碼器能夠呈現的早二十七個區塊，而沒有 MSA 則在整個過程中對大多數蛋白質仍然無法訪問。供應的同源物比供應的查詢更強烈地塑造了這一軌跡；它在一個從未進化的設計查詢中持續存在，但在隨機打亂的序列中則崩潰。最重要的是，為另一個共享摺疊的不同蛋白質構建的比對，只在結構上對應的列中供應，將對實驗的中位 TM 分數從 0.44 提高到 0.72，而同樣的比對如果沿著鏈移動幾個殘基則表現不如完全不供應比對。因此，AlphaFold 3 從比對中讀取的內容實際上是摺疊本身的描述，這種描述可以在共享摺疊的蛋白質之間轉移，而不是查詢自身的進化歷史。這解釋了它的準確性以及它所解決問題的局限性。

docs.title: Toward Evidence-Driven Human-Agent-Robot Teaming for Earth-Independent Anomaly Triage
docs.text:
2610.08933v1 by Ignacio G Lopez-Francos, Alexis Gallagher, Samira Shalal

Deep-space crews cannot rely on real-time ground support for urgent off-nominal events. Initial alerts may underdetermine cause, while discriminating evidence may reside in crew observations or at locations that are unsafe, costly, or unavailable for crew inspection. We present an evidence-driven architecture for human-agent-robot teaming in Earth-independent anomaly triage. Agentic AI is treated as a stateful coordinator over bounded, inspectable services rather than as a fully autonomous vehicle controller. A triage state manager maintains hypotheses, evidence provenance, uncertainty, operational context, and tool status; a crew-facing embodied agent elicits observations and explains assessment changes; and a mobile robot acquires targeted, localized evidence. Typed interfaces separate dialogue and orchestration from monitoring, robot command, context retrieval, and safety-critical control. Two scenarios illustrate the architecture: a crewed deep-space mission based on an actual ISS ammonia false alarm, where suspected contamination restricts crew access, and a power-interface anomaly at a crewed lunar base, where robotic inspection distinguishes a local connector fault from other causes ambiguous in remote telemetry. Our main contribution is an authority-bounded closed evidence-loop architecture, exercised in a hardware-in-the-loop integration prototype using Reachy Mini and an Innate MARS mobile robot.

摘要：深空船員無法依賴實時地面支持來應對緊急的異常事件。最初的警報可能無法確定原因，而判別證據可能存在於船員的觀察中，或者位於對船員檢查來說不安全、成本高昂或無法到達的位置。我們提出了一種基於證據的架構，用於地球獨立的異常分診中的人員-代理-機器人團隊合作。代理式人工智慧被視為一個有狀態的協調者，管理有限的可檢查服務，而不是完全自主的車輛控制器。一個分診狀態管理器維護假設、證據來源、不確定性、操作上下文和工具狀態；一個面向船員的具身代理引導觀察並解釋評估變化；一個移動機器人獲取針對性的、局部的證據。類型化介面將對話和協調與監控、機器人命令、上下文檢索和安全關鍵控制分開。兩個場景說明了這個架構：一個基於實際國際空間站氨氣虛假警報的載人深空任務，其中懷疑的污染限制了船員的進入，另一個是在載人月球基地的電源介面異常，機器人檢查區分了當地連接器故障與遠程遙測中模糊的其他原因。我們的主要貢獻是一種權威邊界的閉合證據循環架構，該架構在使用Reachy Mini和Innate MARS移動機器人的硬體在迴路整合原型中進行了實施。

docs.title: AdaGuard: Enhancing Safety and Policy Compliance with Reasoning-Enabled LLM-As-A-Judge Guardrails
docs.text:
2610.08923v1 by Melissa Kazemi Rad, Sihui Dai, Isha Slavin, Kushal Chawla, Mann Patel, Jian Ni, William M. Campbell, Stephen Rawls, Sambit Sahu

Enterprise generative AI applications require robust safety mechanisms that can accommodate diverse risk postures, evolving policies, and varying latency constraints. Current guardrail solutions often suffer from rigidity, relying on fixed policy sets and offering limited transparency or reasoning flexibility. We present Adaguard, an adaptive LLM-as-a-Judge framework designed to address these challenges through dynamic policy enforcement and adaptive reasoning-budget allocation. Built using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO), AdaGuard generalizes to user-defined safety and compliance policies at runtime without requiring frequent model updates. A core innovation of our approach is the ability to dynamically infer the complexity of input-policy pairs, allowing the model to switch between high-speed black-box inference and explainable, reasoning-enabled moderation. This flexibility enables developers to balance stringent latency requirements with the need for actionable transparency. This adaptive capability allows AdaGuard to rival other guardrail and frontier models several times its size, while its auto-reasoning mode recovers the accuracy of always-on reasoning at a fraction of the latency

摘要：企業生成式 AI 應用需要強大的安全機制，以適應多樣的風險姿態、演變中的政策和不同的延遲限制。當前的防護解決方案往往存在僵化的問題，依賴固定的政策集，並提供有限的透明度或推理靈活性。我們提出了 Adaguard，一個設計用來通過動態政策執行和自適應推理預算分配來應對這些挑戰的自適應 LLM-as-a-Judge 框架。Adaguard 使用監督式微調 (SFT) 和強化學習 (GRPO) 構建，能在運行時對用戶定義的安全和合規政策進行概括，而無需頻繁的模型更新。我們方法的一個核心創新是能夠動態推斷輸入-政策對的複雜性，允許模型在高速黑箱推理和可解釋的、啟用推理的審核之間切換。這種靈活性使開發人員能夠在嚴格的延遲要求和可行的透明度需求之間取得平衡。這種自適應能力使 Adaguard 能夠與其他防護和前沿模型相抗衡，儘管其規模是其他模型的幾倍，而其自動推理模式則在極低的延遲下恢復了始終開啟推理的準確性。

docs.title: Agentic RCA for Internet-Scale Services Using Constrained Creativity
docs.text:
2610.08622v1 by Sayan Sinha, Vipul Harsh, B. Aditya Prakash, Vyas Sekar, Hui Zhang

System administrators of Internet-scale services need to resolve failure incidents to maintain reliability of such services. Ideally, we want a troubleshooting system to be: (1) expressive to known and unknown incidents with high accuracy; (2) cost efficient at scale; (3) explainable to provide actionable insights operators can act on; and (4) entail low effort from the operators. Unfortunately, most existing systems, including emerging LLM-assisted agentic workflows and structured frameworks for authoring diverse RCA algorithms fall short of achieving all four requirements. We present E4, a novel agentic system for troubleshooting for Internet-scale services. E4 embodies the paradigm of constrained creativity that combines the best of LLM-assisted automation and exploration with the explainability and efficiency of a structured approach. Instead of allowing an LLM agent to write arbitrary code or generate arbitrary responses, we provide the agent a restricted DSL to generate its response via simple loop-free data flow programs. This DSL, equipped with high level operators for troubleshooting, makes E4's output accurate, verifiable and explainable. On a mix of synthetic and real-world workloads, E4 achieves up to 62% better accuracy compared to state-of-the-art solutions, while providing more explainable responses at up to 12x reduced cost.

摘要：系統管理員在互聯網規模的服務中需要解決故障事件，以維持這些服務的可靠性。理想情況下，我們希望故障排除系統能夠：(1) 以高準確度表達已知和未知的事件；(2) 在規模上具成本效益；(3) 可解釋，以提供操作員可以採取行動的可行見解；以及 (4) 需要操作員付出較低的努力。不幸的是，大多數現有系統，包括新興的 LLM 輔助代理工作流程和用於創建多樣化 RCA 算法的結構化框架，都未能滿足這四項要求。我們提出了 E4，一個針對互聯網規模服務的創新故障排除系統。E4 體現了受限創造力的範式，將 LLM 輔助自動化和探索的最佳部分與結構化方法的可解釋性和效率相結合。我們並不允許 LLM 代理編寫任意代碼或生成任意響應，而是為代理提供了一個受限的 DSL，以通過簡單的無迴圈數據流程序生成其響應。這個 DSL 配備了高級運算符，用於故障排除，使 E4 的輸出準確、可驗證且可解釋。在一組合成和現實世界的工作負載中，E4 的準確性比最先進的解決方案提高了多達 62%，同時在成本降低最多 12 倍的情況下提供了更可解釋的響應。

docs.title: A Swarm-Coordinated Multi-Robot System for Early Stress Detection in Agricultural Rows Using Multimodal Leaf Sensing
docs.text:
2610.08603v1 by Rishi Gupta, Astha Goyal, Vinay Vishwakarma

Early stress detection in crops is a necessity today to improve efficiency and reduce waste of time, money, and effort. However, most modern techniques, such as hyperspectral imaging and AI-based systems, are too costly and complex for medium and small-scale farmers to implement. This paper showcases CropSentry, a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing to continuously monitor crop health by tracking stress levels. The system comprises two autonomous bots that continuously detect leaf color and environmental data row by row. The observations are spatially mapped and sent over to the master bot, which uses color-coded row segments to generate a real-time web-based dashboard displaying crop health. After 63 observations were collected during the experiments, the results showed an overall crop health classification accuracy of 84.12%, with 82.60% for healthy plants, 88% for nutrient-deficient plants, and 80% for diseased plants. Also, 100% wireless communication success rate across 10 slave observations was achieved. Close-range leaf inspection across multiple bots can detect early stress in crops while remaining affordable, accessible, and scalable. It provides farmers with timely information to improve resource utilization and crop management.

摘要：早期檢測作物壓力在今天是提高效率和減少時間、金錢和努力浪費的必要條件。然而，大多數現代技術，如高光譜成像和基於人工智慧的系統，對中小型農民來說過於昂貴和複雜。本文展示了CropSentry，一種低成本的地面多機器人系統，利用多模態葉片感測技術持續監測作物健康，通過追蹤壓力水平。該系統由兩個自主機器人組成，這些機器人逐行持續檢測葉片顏色和環境數據。觀測結果被空間映射並發送到主機器人，主機器人使用顏色編碼的行段生成實時的基於網頁的儀表板，顯示作物健康狀況。在實驗中收集了63次觀測後，結果顯示整體作物健康分類準確率為84.12%，健康植物為82.60%，缺乏養分的植物為88%，而病害植物為80%。此外，在10次從屬觀測中實現了100%的無線通信成功率。多機器人的近距離葉片檢查能夠檢測作物的早期壓力，同時保持經濟實惠、可及性和可擴展性。它為農民提供及時的信息，以改善資源利用和作物管理。

docs.title: Systemization of Knowledge (SoK): Human-Centered AI Safety for Youth
docs.text:
2610.08554v1 by Pratyasha Saha, Yaman Yu, Yang Wang

While HCI increasingly examines AI-safety for youth, the literature lacks a comprehensive view of what risks have been identified, how they are addressed, and whether proposed protections work in-practice. We systematically reviewed 100 empirical HCI studies involving children and youth interacting with or exposed to AI across schools, homes, care settings, and public services. Using the YAIR taxonomy for risks and the MIT Mitigation Taxonomy for countermeasures, we map which risks have been identified, whether each risk is addressed by countermeasure(s), and whether each countermeasure for that risk is implemented and even evaluated. The risk-countermeasure mapping shows that most risks are matched only with proposed/ideated countermeasures; few countermeasures have been implemented, and fewer still evaluated; and existing evaluations often measure technical performance rather than protection from harm. We identify where coverage is absent, where safeguards remain untested, and propose concrete directions for HCI research to strengthen youth AI-safety.

摘要：雖然人機互動（HCI）越來越多地檢視青少年的人工智慧安全，但文獻中缺乏對已識別風險的全面觀察、如何應對這些風險，以及所提議的保護措施在實際中是否有效的分析。我們系統性地回顧了100項涉及兒童和青少年與人工智慧互動或接觸的實證HCI研究，這些研究涵蓋了學校、家庭、照護環境和公共服務。使用YAIR風險分類法和MIT緩解分類法，我們映射了已識別的風險、每個風險是否有對應的緩解措施，以及每個風險的緩解措施是否已實施甚至評估。風險-緩解措施的映射顯示，大多數風險僅與提議/構思的緩解措施相匹配；實施的緩解措施很少，評估的則更少；而現有的評估往往測量技術性能而非防止傷害的效果。我們確定了哪些領域缺乏覆蓋、哪些保障措施仍未經測試，並提出具體的方向以促進HCI研究，加強青少年的人工智慧安全。

docs.title: AnyBottle: A Recipe to Only Keep the Concepts You Really Need
docs.text:
2610.08552v1 by Wolfgang Stammer, Sukrut Rao, Hevra Petekkaya, David Steinmann, Bernt Schiele

Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make predictions inspectable and intervenable by routing them through human-interpretable concepts, but originally required concept annotations. Annotation-free variants remove this requirement, but typically use large concept vocabularies, static at both training and inference, producing bottlenecks larger than any task or prediction needs and harder to inspect. We propose AnyBottle, a single recipe for building compact, task-specific CBMs. AnyBottle assumes only a frozen backbone and an unsupervised concept pool, such as a sparse autoencoder. A black-box teacher trained on the same backbone then guides selection: each round adds the concept that best explains the bottleneck's current failures, with candidates restricted to regions of teacher/student disagreement. Trained with nested dropout over this selection order, the final bottleneck predicts accurately from any concept prefix, so inference spends fewer concepts on inputs it is confident about early and more on hard ones. Since no stage is modality-specific, a new domain and task requires swapping only the backbone and concept pool. Across six vision and two text datasets and two teacher paradigms, AnyBottle yields bottlenecks with fewer concepts and higher concept consistency than annotation-free baselines, while staying close to the black-box reference. Overall, AnyBottle shows that going annotation-free need not mean going large: a small, discovered vocabulary can be as expressive as a much larger, fixed one.

摘要：概念瓶頸模型（CBMs）通過將預測路由到人類可解釋的概念，使預測可檢查和可介入，但最初需要概念標註。無需標註的變體消除了這一要求，但通常使用大型概念詞彙，在訓練和推理時都是靜態的，產生的瓶頸比任何任務或預測需求都要大，且更難以檢查。我們提出了AnyBottle，這是一種構建緊湊、特定任務CBMs的單一方案。AnyBottle僅假設一個凍結的主幹和一個無監督的概念池，例如稀疏自編碼器。然後，在相同主幹上訓練的黑箱教師指導選擇：每一輪添加最能解釋瓶頸當前失敗的概念，候選者限制在教師/學生不一致的區域。通過對這一選擇順序進行嵌套隨機失活訓練，最終瓶頸能從任何概念前綴準確預測，因此推理在對早期輸入有信心時使用更少的概念，而在面對困難輸入時則使用更多。由於沒有任何階段是特定於模態的，因此新的領域和任務只需更換主幹和概念池。跨越六個視覺和兩個文本數據集以及兩個教師範式，AnyBottle產生的瓶頸使用的概念更少且概念一致性更高，與無標註基準相比，同時保持接近黑箱參考。總體而言，AnyBottle顯示無需標註並不意味著需要大型：一個小而發現的詞彙可以與一個更大且固定的詞彙一樣具表達力。

docs.title: How High Is 0.6? Floors, Ceilings, and Headroom in Interpretability Probing
docs.text:
2610.08544v1 by Pranjal Garg

Probes are the workhorse of interpretability. If a model's hidden states predict a variable, the model is said to represent it. But a probe score has no fixed meaning. An $R^2$ of 0.6 may only reflect what the input already gives away, and the same score can mean different things on different data. We propose reading every probe score against two reference points: a floor, what a declared set of simple inputs already predicts, and a ceiling, what the full input can predict. The gap between them, the headroom, is the range in which a probe can show that a model computes something beyond the simple inputs. We prove that headroom vanishes in two ways: the target stops depending on a hidden variable the model must infer, or the input stops revealing it. We test this on transformers trained for in-context meta-analysis, which must infer the hidden heterogeneity between studies to weight them correctly, and where both reference points are known. Under distribution shift, probe scores fall and prediction error rises $12$--$15\times$, yet the model recovers a similar share of the headroom, indicating that the data lost information, not the representation. We then analyze the real models. The single-cell foundation model scGPT encodes biological variability only partially. We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.

摘要：探測器是可解釋性的主力軍。如果一個模型的隱藏狀態預測一個變數，則該模型被認為能夠表示它。但是，探測器分數並沒有固定的含義。$R^2$ 為 0.6 可能僅反映輸入已經揭示的內容，而相同的分數在不同數據上可以意味著不同的事情。我們建議將每個探測器分數與兩個參考點進行比較：一個是底線，即一組簡單輸入已經預測的內容，另一個是上限，即完整輸入可以預測的內容。它們之間的差距，即可用空間，是探測器能夠顯示模型計算超出簡單輸入的範圍。我們證明可用空間以兩種方式消失：目標停止依賴模型必須推斷的隱藏變數，或者輸入停止揭示它。我們在為上下文元分析訓練的Transformer上測試這一點，這些Transformer必須推斷研究之間的隱藏異質性以正確加權，並且兩個參考點都是已知的。在分佈轉變下，探測器分數下降，預測誤差上升 $12$--$15\times$，然而模型恢復了類似的可用空間，表明數據失去了信息，而不是表示。然後我們分析實際模型。單細胞基礎模型 scGPT 只部分編碼生物變異性。我們還重新檢視了四項有影響力的 LLM 探測研究，這些研究聲稱模型表示地理、奧賽羅棋盤的狀態、真相以及用戶的人口統計。相對於僅從輸入文本計算出的底線，其中一些聲稱成立，而其他則主要由文本本身解釋。

docs.title: FlowCF: Sparse Counterfactual Explanations for Mixed-Type Tabular Data using Flow Matching
docs.text:
2610.08537v1 by Emmanouil Panagiotou, Eirini Ntoutsi

In the field of Explainable AI (XAI), counterfactual (CF) explanations interpret a model's decision by suggesting the changes to the input that would lead to a more favourable outcome. To be useful in practice, such an explanation should change few features and change them as little as possible, properties known as sparsity and proximity. We observe that existing methods remain limited in this respect, especially for numerical features, whether they are model-agnostic and amortised, or gradient-based with full access to the model. In this paper, we propose FlowCF, a model-agnostic generative method that frames CF generation as sparse transport from the factual to the target class. We solve this transport with flow matching, which we extend to mixed feature types with a novel mixed flow operator, and exploit the resulting geometry to optimise for sparsity through a gating network that minimises the number of features the transport changes. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that FlowCF produces the best numerical sparsity and proximity, changing 29% of the numerical features where the best baseline changes 89%, at 70% smaller displacement, while remaining comparable on the other desiderata.

摘要：在可解釋人工智慧（XAI）領域，反事實（CF）解釋通過建議對輸入進行的更改來解釋模型的決策，這些更改將導致更有利的結果。為了在實踐中有用，這樣的解釋應該改變少量特徵，並且盡可能地少改變，這些特性被稱為稀疏性和接近性。我們觀察到，現有的方法在這方面仍然有限，特別是對於數值特徵，無論它們是模型無關的和攤銷的，還是基於梯度的並完全訪問模型。在本文中，我們提出了FlowCF，一種模型無關的生成方法，將CF生成框架設置為從事實類到目標類的稀疏傳輸。我們通過流匹配來解決這一傳輸問題，並將其擴展到混合特徵類型，使用一種新型的混合流運算子，並利用生成的幾何形狀通過一個閘網絡來優化稀疏性，該網絡最小化傳輸改變的特徵數量。在六個基準數據集上進行的廣泛實驗表明，FlowCF在數值稀疏性和接近性方面表現最佳，改變29%的數值特徵，而最佳基線改變了89%，位移則小70%，同時在其他期望指標上保持可比性。

docs.title: X-OPM: Explainable Automatic Digital On-Chip Power Modeling for Enhanced Robustness
docs.text:
2610.08502v1 by Jingbo Jiang, Xizi Chen, Jian Peng, Wei Zhang

Proactive power management systems reduce processor dynamic power through runtime power prediction and power-aware scheduling. Accurate, stable and low-overhead digital on-chip power meters (OPMs) are crucial for improving the prediction quality. Recent studies have explored various modeling methods, including using linear models, decision trees, and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) to construct OPMs. However, most current approaches train models end-to-end without analyzing the physical interpretability of features, affecting their ability to generalize to unseen workloads. Grounded in the design principles of synchronous digital VLSI circuits, X-OPM introduces a robust feature engineering framework that uses tree-based models to capture feature interactions and linear models for prediction. It also incorporates a human-in-the-loop workflow to balance model accuracy against modeling effort. Evaluated on a commercial C906 vector processor, X-OPM consistently achieves $R^2 > 0.93$ across all workloads with sampling window size set below $8$ cycles. In contrast, state-of-the-art methods including APOLLO, COBIT, and standard MLPs fail to generalize across all test cases. Layout with commercial EDA tools shows that X-OPM incurs an area overhead below $0.1\%$, which is on par with lightweight tree-based and linear models, and significantly smaller than MLP-based models.

摘要：主動電源管理系統通過運行時電源預測和電源感知排程來減少處理器的動態功耗。準確、穩定且低開銷的數位片上電源計量器（OPMs）對於提高預測質量至關重要。最近的研究探討了各種建模方法，包括使用線性模型、決策樹和多層感知器（MLPs）來構建OPMs。然而，大多數當前的方法都是端到端訓練模型，而未分析特徵的物理可解釋性，這影響了它們對未見工作負載的泛化能力。基於同步數位VLSI電路的設計原則，X-OPM引入了一個穩健的特徵工程框架，使用基於樹的模型來捕捉特徵交互，並使用線性模型進行預測。它還結合了一個人機協作的工作流程，以平衡模型準確性與建模工作量。經過在商業C906向量處理器上的評估，X-OPM在所有工作負載中始終達到$R^2 > 0.93$，且取樣窗口大小設置在$8$個週期以下。相比之下，最先進的方法包括APOLLO、COBIT和標準MLPs在所有測試案例中無法泛化。使用商業EDA工具的佈局顯示，X-OPM的面積開銷低於$0.1\%$，這與輕量級的基於樹和線性模型相當，並且顯著小於基於MLP的模型。

docs.title: Language-model ratings of depression reflect the rater more than the patient
docs.text:
2610.08501v1 by Baihan Lin

Depression has no diagnostic blood test. Language models promise tireless, consistent assessment, but can accurate raters disagree about individuals? We pre-registered 880 language-model raters, crossing 11 open models with prompting and scoring choices, and applied them to 189 interviews against the eight-item Patient Health Questionnaire. Model choice explained 30.0% of summed-symptom score variance, stable participant differences 10.5%. Two randomly drawn raters with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) >= 0.70 disagreed on screening decisions for 40% of participants, on average. Average over-rating governed how many were flagged, yet equal-capacity raters chose differently for about one participant in five. A locked analysis of 86 new interviews reproduced the main pre-registered findings. Exploratory recalibration with 40 labelled participants raised accuracy from about 60% to 75% and halved disagreement, leaving one participant in five decided differently. Calibration repaired much of the rater dependence without securing agreement about individuals.

摘要：憂鬱症沒有診斷性的血液測試。語言模型承諾提供不知疲倦且一致的評估，但準確的評估者能否對個體達成共識？我們預先註冊了880名語言模型評估者，交叉使用11個開放模型與提示和評分選擇，並將其應用於189次訪談，對照八項患者健康問卷。模型選擇解釋了30.0%的總症狀分數變異，穩定的參與者差異為10.5%。兩名隨機抽取的評估者，其接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUC）>= 0.70，對40%的參與者的篩查決策存在分歧，平均而言。平均過度評分決定了有多少被標記，然而能力相等的評估者對約五分之一的參與者做出了不同的選擇。對86個新訪談的鎖定分析重現了主要的預先註冊發現。對40名標記參與者的探索性重新校準將準確度從約60%提高到75%，並將分歧減半，仍然有五分之一的參與者做出了不同的決定。校準修復了大部分的評估者依賴性，但未能確保對個體的共識。

docs.title: Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability
docs.text:
2610.08448v1 by Bingxi Hou, Guochao Jiang, Guofeng Quan, Weiqing Li, Wenfeng Feng, Guohua Liu, Yuewei Zhang

On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations using teacher feedback. With different tokenizers, comparing teacher and student predictions requires alignment at both sequence and vocabulary levels. In this paper, we examine whether expanding this alignment coverage improves learning. Across three heterogeneous teacher--student pairs on mathematical reasoning and code generation, strict 1:1 groups already cover most student-generated tokens despite substantial vocabulary mismatch. On responses sampled from the students before distillation, the shared vocabulary retains nearly all teacher and student probability mass at strictly aligned positions on average. Restricting reverse KL to a student-selected top-16 subset of the shared vocabulary at each strict position achieves accuracy comparable to full shared-vocabulary OPD, outperforming the evaluated cross-tokenizer baselines. Adding mean squared error supervision on span log-probabilities in mismatch groups gives complete supervision coverage, yet reduces accuracy. At checkpoints from training with only the strict loss, the span gradients show weak or negative directional agreement with the strict gradients and grow in magnitude relative to them. These diagnostics may help explain the accuracy drop from adding span supervision. Our findings motivate a shift from maximizing alignment coverage to prioritizing supervision reliability: compact supervision at strict positions can be more effective than broader coverage that introduces weakly aligned or conflicting training signals.

摘要：在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，學生使用教師的反饋在自己的生成上進行訓練。使用不同的標記器時，教師和學生的預測比較需要在序列和詞彙層面上進行對齊。在本文中，我們檢查擴展這種對齊範圍是否能改善學習。在三對異質的教師--學生組合中，儘管詞彙存在顯著不匹配，嚴格的1:1組已經涵蓋了大多數學生生成的標記。在從學生在蒸餾之前抽樣的回應中，共享詞彙在嚴格對齊的位置上平均保留了幾乎所有教師和學生的概率質量。將反向KL限制在每個嚴格位置上學生選擇的共享詞彙的前16個子集，達到的準確性與完整共享詞彙的OPD相當，並超越了評估的跨標記器基準。在不匹配組中對跨度對數概率添加均方誤差監督提供了完整的監督覆蓋，但卻降低了準確性。在僅使用嚴格損失訓練的檢查點中，跨度梯度與嚴格梯度的方向一致性較弱或為負，並相對於它們增長。在添加跨度監督後，這些診斷可能有助於解釋準確性下降。我們的發現促使我們從最大化對齊範圍轉向優先考慮監督的可靠性：在嚴格位置上的緊湊監督可能比引入弱對齊或衝突訓練信號的更廣泛覆蓋更有效。

docs.title: Explainable Failure Prediction and Prevention in Maritime
docs.text:
2610.08363v1 by Dionisis Kalogeropoulos, Georgia Sovatzidi, Panagiotis G. Kalozoumis, Dimitris K. Iakovidis

Maritime systems operate in highly dynamic environments where unexpected equipment failures can compromise safety, reliability, and operational efficiency. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, digital twins, and predictive maintenance enable proactive failure prediction and prevention. However, ensuring trustworthy and explainable decision-making remains a major challenge in safety-critical maritime applications. This chapter reviews key AI technologies required for explainable failure prediction and prevention in maritime systems and presents a conceptual architecture capable of supporting autonomous or human-in-the-loop corrective actions. This architecture integrates data acquisition, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, risk assessment, decision-making, and explainable AI into a closed-loop framework. With reference to the architectural components, a review and discussion of relevant maritime studies is performed, outlining their methods, advantages, and limitations. Furthermore, it highlights current challenges, including uncertainty and robustness, model generalization, explainability, limited availability of maritime datasets, and operational deployment, and identifies future research directions toward trustworthy AI-assisted maritime decision-making.

摘要：海洋系統在高度動態的環境中運作，意外的設備故障可能會危及安全、可靠性和運營效率。最近在人工智慧（AI）、機器學習、數位雙胞胎和預測性維護方面的進展使得主動故障預測和預防成為可能。然而，確保可靠和可解釋的決策仍然是安全關鍵的海洋應用中的一大挑戰。本章回顧了海洋系統中所需的關鍵AI技術，以實現可解釋的故障預測和預防，並提出了一個能夠支持自主或人機協作的糾正行動的概念架構。該架構將數據獲取、時間序列預測、異常檢測、風險評估、決策制定和可解釋的AI整合到一個閉環框架中。參考架構組件，對相關的海洋研究進行了回顧和討論，概述了它們的方法、優勢和局限性。此外，它還突出了當前的挑戰，包括不確定性和穩健性、模型泛化、可解釋性、海洋數據集的有限可用性以及運營部署，並確定了未來朝向可信的AI輔助海洋決策的研究方向。

docs.title: Sensor-Language-Action Models
docs.text:
2610.08244v1 by Yuekai Xu, Zitao Shuai, Yuzhe Yang

Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.

摘要：感測器不僅對理解世界有用，還對決定下一步行動具有重要意義。然而，現有的感測器模型在感知方面基本上停滯不前：它們識別狀態或預測結果，將行動單獨建模，通常通過特定任務的封閉標籤空間。我們引入了感測-語言-行動（SLA）建模，這是一個將多模態感測觀察、自然語言和行動連接在統一模型中的框架。SLA使用語言作為感知與行動之間的語義介面，允許異質行動被表示、預測和解釋，同時仍然基於底層的感測證據。我們建立了一個大規模的SLA基準，包含超過116,000個個體、79種感測模態和60個行動組的數據集，以及一個多面向的標註管道，該管道對齊用戶上下文、感測動態和行動證據。在此框架的基礎上，我們提出了OpenSLA，一個統一的SLA模型，用於層次行動預測、狀態理解和行動解釋。在臨床預測、手術室和代謝健康等現實世界任務上的廣泛實驗驗證了其優於最先進技術的卓越性能。OpenSLA還展示了引人注目的能力，包括語言引導的證據基礎和對未見行動和群體的零樣本泛化。

docs.title: Symphony for Text Generation: Benchmarking Clinical Note Generation
docs.text:
2610.08161v1 by Daniel Varab, Victor Petrén Bach Hansen, Asbjørn W. Helge, Kevin Pelgrims, Mathias Baltzersen, Adrian Young-San Roessler, Vanessa Klungtvedt, Maximilian Brand, Lasse Krogsbøll, Henrik Cullen, Lars Maaløe

Ambient documentation systems are rapidly gaining adoption, yet their impact on clinical note quality remains poorly characterized. We introduce MedConv, a multilingual dataset of 300 clinical encounters in English, Danish, and German, and use it alongside the Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark (ACI-BENCH) to compare Corti, a clinical AI platform, with two leading, accessible ambient scribe software applications built on general-purpose AI. We present a controlled clinical evaluation framework that combines entailment metrics with LLM-judged pairwise comparisons across eight dimensions adopted from PDSQI-9. Results show that Corti's API-based text-generation infrastructure is on par with or outperforms leading commercial scribes. We further show that Corti's configurable API provides the flexibility necessary to fine-tune quality dimensions for specific documentation use cases. We present the evaluation methodology and release a dataset to support future reproducible comparison of ambient documentation systems.

摘要：環境文檔系統正在迅速獲得採用，但其對臨床筆記質量的影響仍然缺乏明確的描述。我們介紹了 MedConv，一個包含 300 個臨床接觸的多語言數據集，涵蓋英語、丹麥語和德語，並將其與環境臨床智能基準（ACI-BENCH）一起使用，以比較 Corti，一個臨床 AI 平台，與兩個基於通用 AI 的領先可訪問環境記錄軟件應用程序。我們提出了一個受控的臨床評估框架，將推理指標與 LLM 判斷的成對比較結合，涵蓋從 PDSQI-9 採用的八個維度。結果顯示，Corti 的基於 API 的文本生成基礎設施與領先的商業記錄工具相當或表現更佳。我們進一步展示了 Corti 可配置的 API 提供了必要的靈活性，以便為特定文檔使用案例微調質量維度。我們呈現了評估方法論並發布了一個數據集，以支持未來對環境文檔系統的可重複比較。

docs.title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
docs.text:
2610.08033v1 by Jordy Kieto

World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.

摘要：世界模型通常是從內部來評估的：通過預測損失、通過策略在想像中獲得的回報，或通過它們的框架看起來有多令人信服。我們則是從外部來評估。我們學習了一個結構化的多代理世界模型，涵蓋了一個完整的十英雄MOBA（206個單位，每個英雄每個時刻都在行動，遊戲長達6,000個時刻），僅在其中訓練一個策略，使用1,400個時刻的自由運行想像劇集，並在真實遊戲中對抗遊戲隨附的對手來測量該策略。真實遊戲從不提供梯度；它提供策略自己的遊戲作為世界模型的訓練數據，以及一個在線評估，來選擇和固定策略。作為一個持續的異步Dyna循環運行，該策略在真實遊戲中作為輻射方贏得了70.2%的勝率（421場中的600場；95% CI 66.4-73.7），這些種子從未用於任何決策，這比僅進行夢想訓練的0%和循環前的33.7%有所提升。它在黑暗方中沒有贏得任何比賽，隨附的對手在自我對戰時也沒有贏得任何比賽。四個發現解釋了這一結果。模型的利用在夢中是不可見的：每次未固定的運行在幾次更新內都崩潰，而沒有任何夢中指標追蹤崩潰。一個在其訓練語料庫上準確的世界模型在策略自己的遊戲中卻是錯誤的，而Dyna在那裡修復了它，這在固定策略配方的情況下，真實勝率提高了+9.2個百分點。最後，該策略按機械逐一繼承其世界模型的忠實度特徵：該模型代表宏觀遊戲，但不包括人群控制、施法時機或致命性，該策略通過幾乎沒有協調的戰鬥來獲得全圖壓力的勝利。我們發布了世界模型、夢想PPO工具、世界模型調試器、評估協議，以及每個策略和日誌。

docs.title: Novice Reliance Calibration in AI-Assisted Decision Making: The Role of Explanations and Self-Assessment
docs.text:
2610.07800v1 by Eun Jeong Kang, Peter, Duan, Swati Mishra

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools are widely used to support decision making in tasks and domains where no immediate performance feedback is available. In these settings, users cannot learn to adjust their reliance behavior over time through trial and error. However, little is known about how novice users calibrate reliance on AI when external feedback is unavailable, or whether AI explanations can support calibration in its absence. We introduce reliance calibration as an organizing construct for studying how novice users dynamically adjust reliance behavior, and examine how AI explanations and meta-cognitive self-assessment shape it. Through a between-subjects study with 110 participants completing a clinical entity extraction task with AI assistance and limited performance feedback, we observe that novice users exhibit systematic drift toward over-reliance in the presence of explanations, while higher self-reported task understanding is associated with more selective reliance behavior. These results extend reliance calibration research into human-AI collaboration contexts without real-time performance signals and present actionable guidelines on designing AI tools that must support appropriate reliance in these settings.

摘要：人工智慧（AI）工具被廣泛用於支持在沒有即時表現反饋的任務和領域中的決策制定。在這些情況下，用戶無法通過反覆試驗來學習隨時間調整其依賴行為。然而，對於新手用戶在缺乏外部反饋的情況下如何調整對AI的依賴，或者AI解釋是否能在缺乏反饋的情況下支持這種調整，了解的資訊卻很少。我們引入依賴調整作為一個組織性構念，用於研究新手用戶如何動態調整依賴行為，並檢視AI解釋和元認知自我評估如何影響這一過程。通過一項包含110名參與者的被試間研究，這些參與者在AI輔助下完成一項臨床實體提取任務，並且獲得有限的表現反饋，我們觀察到新手用戶在有解釋的情況下表現出系統性的過度依賴趨勢，而自我報告的任務理解程度較高則與更具選擇性的依賴行為相關。這些結果將依賴調整研究擴展到沒有實時表現信號的人機協作情境，並提供了設計必須在這些情境中支持適當依賴的AI工具的可行指導方針。

docs.title: Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts
docs.text:
2610.07798v1 by Saanvi Khetan, Sankar Balasubramanian

People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap. Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.

摘要：人們越來越多地詢問大型語言模型該如何處理他們的財務，但很少全面描述他們的財務狀況。本文探討模型如何處理這一差距。在固定財務狀況的情況下，僅改變所謂的投資者身份，我們將提示中的財務證據從八個事實評分到無，並測量建議的股權配置移動了多遠。在對Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct進行的96,600個提示中，這些提示來源於100個財務檔案、138個角色和七個披露條件，兩個擁有相同財務狀況的角色之間的平均差距從完全披露時的4.78個百分點上升到沒有財務事實時的10.34個百分點。一個雙向集群自助法，將重複的提示計算一次，將比例定為2.16（95%區間1.69到2.79），而且在只剩下一個事實的情況下，增長已經達到1.69倍。身份解釋了在完全披露下建議中5%的檔案內變異，並在沒有披露的情況下解釋了96%。家庭規模是唯一一個隨著證據撤回影響可靠增長的屬性。一旦標準誤差在角色上進行集群，身份被分配的單位，大多數在會議版本中報告的屬性特定互動失去顯著性，而性別則出現為一個小的持續差距，完全披露無法填補。僅僅陳述風險偏好就使波動進入與兩到七個通用事實相似的範圍。沒有事實的情況下，模型的一行理由引用了它從未被告知的收入、債務和儲蓄，而這些虛構的財務狀況對於較大的家庭而言更常出現不利情況。在網絡內，性別在每一層都是線性可解碼的，並且在五層中去除性別方向不會改變總體身份的波動。基於這些模型構建的諮詢系統應在用戶實際達到的披露水平上進行審核，並在整個身份空間中進行評估，而不是一次評估一個屬性。

docs.title: Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation
docs.text:
2610.07761v1 by Emrul Hasan, Chen Ding

In this work, we propose a novel recommendation model, CLARER (Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation) that integrates aspect features learned from textual reviews with rating information to improve the accuracy and explainability of recommendations. Our proposed framework learns user and item representations by combining rating-based features and aspect-based features from reviews. Specifically, rating-based features are learned through a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) model, while aspect-specific review representations are learned using a transformer encoder to capture the semantic information and contrastive learning to better distinguish user preferences. To provide explanations, we train a transformer decoder, using the final representations of users and items from both rating and aspect-based features as context. Experimental results in three benchmark data sets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods in both recommendation (accuracy) and explanation generation.

摘要：在這項工作中，我們提出了一個新穎的推薦模型，CLARER（對比學習用於可解釋推薦的方面表示），該模型將從文本評論中學習的方面特徵與評分信息相結合，以提高推薦的準確性和可解釋性。我們提出的框架通過結合基於評分的特徵和基於方面的評論特徵來學習用戶和項目的表示。具體而言，基於評分的特徵是通過多層感知器（MLP）模型學習的，而基於方面的評論表示則是使用Transformer編碼器來捕捉語義信息，並通過對比學習來更好地區分用戶偏好。為了提供解釋，我們訓練了一個Transformer解碼器，使用來自基於評分和基於方面特徵的用戶和項目的最終表示作為上下文。在三個基準數據集上的實驗結果表明，我們的模型在推薦（準確性）和解釋生成方面相比基線方法達到了更優越的性能。

docs.title: Evidence Before Sampling: Interpretable Implicit Negative Candidate Discovery for Recommendation
docs.text:
2610.07708v1 by Shreya Rajpal, Sonia Sharma, Swapnil Parekh, Lisa Li, Jeyendran Balakrishnan, Nagaraj Janardhana, Andrew Mattarella-Micke

Recommender systems learn from observed user-item interactions, but explicit negative feedback is often unavailable. Since deep learning models require negative signals for training, negative sampling methods typically treat selected unobserved interactions as negatives. However, a missing interaction does not explain why a user is uninterested in an item or whether there is sufficient evidence to label it negative. This is especially important in business recommendation, where negative signals should be interpretable and aligned with business objectives. We formulate implicit negative candidate discovery to identify unobserved interactions supported by observed customer behavior. We encode these patterns as symbolic rules, score them based on support, informativeness, and product relevance, and rank the retained rules by evidence. An LLM then interprets the retained rules using business objectives and domain knowledge; the interpretations are combined with the statistical evidence in the final report. We evaluate our method in an industrial B2B setting and across five public recommendation datasets. Candidate-quality evaluations in the industrial setting and three public datasets show higher precision than the evaluated baselines, while symbolic selection improves downstream test PR-AUC by 12.5% over random selection with four negatives per positive example in the industrial task. Our results show that negative candidate validity can be evaluated separately from downstream recommendation performance. This distinction enables evidence-based, business-aligned, and explainable negative selection, improving both interpretability and model training in sparse, skewed, real-world recommendation settings.

摘要：推薦系統從觀察到的用戶-項目互動中學習，但明確的負面反饋通常不可用。由於深度學習模型需要負面信號進行訓練，負面抽樣方法通常將選定的未觀察互動視為負面。然而，缺失的互動並不能解釋為什麼用戶對某項目不感興趣，或是否有足夠的證據將其標記為負面。這在商業推薦中尤其重要，因為負面信號應該是可解釋的，並且與商業目標一致。我們制定了隱式負面候選發現，以識別由觀察到的客戶行為支持的未觀察互動。我們將這些模式編碼為符號規則，根據支持度、信息量和產品相關性對其進行打分，並根據證據對保留的規則進行排名。然後，LLM 使用商業目標和領域知識解釋保留的規則；這些解釋與最終報告中的統計證據相結合。我們在一個工業 B2B 環境和五個公共推薦數據集上評估我們的方法。在工業環境和三個公共數據集中的候選質量評估顯示出比評估的基準更高的精確度，而符號選擇在工業任務中將隨機選擇的每個正例四個負例的下游測試 PR-AUC 提高了 12.5%。我們的結果顯示，負面候選的有效性可以與下游推薦性能分開評估。這一區別使基於證據的、與商業對齊的、可解釋的負面選擇成為可能，改善了稀疏、偏斜的現實世界推薦環境中的可解釋性和模型訓練。

docs.title: EIO-Agents: The Missing Semantic Layer for AI Agent Evaluation
docs.text:
2610.07675v1 by Fouad Bousetouane

AI agents are entering production in increasingly consequential environments without a shared semantic standard for what their evaluations actually mean. Scores, traces, judge outputs, and multi juror findings are increasingly used to justify readiness and release decisions, yet they often do not specify what evidence supports a claim, what that evidence can establish, or how the claim leads to a decision. We introduce EIO-Agents, an open specification for interoperable AI agent evaluation built on two layers. The Evaluation Intelligence Ontology (EIO) provides the semantic layer through typed evidence, versioned behavioral predicates, evidence contracts, claims, witness rules, proof status, recurrence, and computable derivations for metrics, findings, controls, and PASS, REVIEW, or BLOCK decisions. The Portable Evaluation Record (PER) provides the system of record: a canonical, content addressed representation of one evaluation that preserves the evidence to decision chain and can be re derived, explained, and verified. Scores summarize, juries interpret, and traces record, but none of them define what the evidence means or what it can prove. EIO provides that missing semantic contract, while PER preserves the resulting evaluation as a portable and verifiable system of record. As AI agents assume greater operational responsibility, evaluation must become more than a collection of scores and verdicts; it must become an accountable artifact whose meaning, evidence, limitations, and decisions can be independently checked.

摘要：AI 代理正在越來越重要的環境中投入生產，但對於它們的評估實際上意味著什麼卻沒有共享的語義標準。分數、痕跡、評審輸出和多位陪審團的發現越來越多地用來證明準備和發布決策的合理性，然而它們通常並未具體說明什麼證據支持某個主張，這些證據能夠證明什麼，或者這個主張如何導致一個決策。我們介紹了 EIO-Agents，一個基於兩個層次的可互操作 AI 代理評估的開放規範。評估智能本體（EIO）通過類型化證據、版本化行為謂詞、證據合約、主張、見證規則、證明狀態、重現性以及可計算的指標、發現、控制和 PASS、REVIEW 或 BLOCK 決策的推導提供語義層。可攜式評估記錄（PER）提供記錄系統：一個經典的、內容地址的單一評估表示，保留了證據到決策的鏈條，並且可以重新推導、解釋和驗證。分數進行總結，陪審團進行解釋，痕跡進行記錄，但它們都沒有定義證據的含義或它能證明什麼。EIO 提供了缺失的語義合約，而 PER 則保留了作為可攜式和可驗證的記錄系統的最終評估。隨著 AI 代理承擔更大的操作責任，評估必須超越分數和裁決的集合；它必須成為一個可負責的工件，其意義、證據、限制和決策可以被獨立檢查。

docs.title: Towards the Automatic Synthesis of Interpretable Chess Tactics
docs.text:
2610.07640v1 by Abhijeet Krishnan, Chris Martens

State-of-the-art reinforcement learning agents are capable of outperforming human experts at games like chess, Go and StarCraft II. These agents do not simply take advantage of their digital hardware in being able to react and calculate faster than humans, but employ better strategies that lead to more victories. Interpreting these strategies would give human players valuable insight into how to improve their play. In this preliminary work, we propose a symbolic sub-policy model for playing chess. Inspired by chess tactics, our model attempts to incorporate domain knowledge to improve interpretability. We adapt patterns learned by an inductive logic programming system called PAL to derive our model. We contribute a divergence metric to evaluate our model against a random baseline, and find a set of tactics that is able to suggest moves of similar playing strength to a human beginner. Finally, we propose a computational evaluation scheme for the model by augmenting an off-the-shelf engine with it.

摘要：最先進的強化學習代理能夠在象棋、圍棋和星際爭霸 II 等遊戲中超越人類專家。這些代理不僅僅是利用其數位硬體能夠比人類更快地反應和計算，而是採用更好的策略來獲得更多勝利。解讀這些策略將為人類玩家提供寶貴的見解，以改善他們的遊戲。在這項初步工作中，我們提出了一個象棋的符號子策略模型。受到象棋戰術的啟發，我們的模型試圖融入領域知識以提高可解釋性。我們將由一個稱為 PAL 的歸納邏輯編程系統學到的模式應用於推導我們的模型。我們貢獻了一個發散度度量來評估我們的模型與隨機基準的表現，並找到一組戰術，能夠建議與人類初學者相似的下棋強度的走法。最後，我們通過增強一個現成引擎來提出模型的計算評估方案。

docs.title: Learning Explainable Representations of Complex Game-playing Strategies
docs.text:
2610.07638v1 by Abhijeet Krishnan, Colin M. Potts, Arnav Jhala, Harshad Khadilkar, Shirish Karande, Chris Martens

As part of learning to play complex games, human players develop develop abstractions for concepts and strategies of gameplay consistent with game rules to improve their performance. These concepts are applied to explain other players' actions, and to inform their own actions in-game. Understanding other players' strategies is a crucial part of such improvement, but requires time and effort. In this paper, we propose a strategy similar to human cognition for training RL agents to synthesize learned strategies and policies as executable procedures based on sequences of gameplay actions. We present methods to automatically learn such programs to play chess and to solve tasks in a grid-based environment. We show that the learned strategies produce effective actions, and can be learned from gameplay data.

摘要：作為學習複雜遊戲的一部分，人類玩家發展出與遊戲規則一致的遊戲概念和策略的抽象，以提高他們的表現。這些概念被應用於解釋其他玩家的行動，並指導他們在遊戲中的行動。理解其他玩家的策略是這種改進的關鍵部分，但需要時間和努力。在本文中，我們提出了一種類似於人類認知的策略，用於訓練強化學習代理，將學習到的策略和政策合成為基於遊戲行動序列的可執行程序。我們提出了自動學習這些程序的方法，以便下棋和解決基於網格的環境中的任務。我們顯示學習到的策略能夠產生有效的行動，並且可以從遊戲數據中學習。

docs.title: Learning to Outgrow a Theory: Experimental Discovery Beyond the Initial Hypothesis Space
docs.text:
2610.07627v1 by SiYuan Ma, Albert Gao, Chunzheng Zhu, Xin Yan, Wenlong Zhang, Wenxin Zhang, Luqi Gong, Tianlin Li, Qixin Zhang

Scientific discovery systems typically optimize experiments within a fixed hypothesis space. This creates a failure mode when all available candidates omit the same missing mechanism: candidate disagreement can collapse even while the model class is systematically wrong. We formulate experimental model-class revision, in which a discovery policy jointly proposes a structural edit and a diagnostic experiment that tests whether that edit is necessary. The method couples a class-level distinguishability objective, in which one shared parameterization must explain all selected experiments, with anytime-valid sequential evidence that triggers structural revision only after the current class is rejected. On 400 held-out controlled dynamical environments, the joint policy reaches 89.5% exact recovery with a budget of 32 real experiments, improving the strongest matched baseline by 10.0 percentage points while requiring fewer executed experiments and candidate fits. The learned revision-experiment pairing transfers across unseen mechanism combinations, held-out but expressible primitives, parameter extrapolation, and shifted experiment costs; when the true mechanism is outside the edit grammar, it detects library insufficiency in 88% of cases with a 5.5% false-support rate. Revision gains also transfer to ODEBench and ODEBase model-library tasks, as well as DiscoverPhysics worlds. These results support a view of scientific discovery in which deciding what mechanisms a theory should make expressible and where to collect evidence are treated as a single sequential decision problem.

摘要：科學發現系統通常在固定的假設空間內優化實驗。這會產生一種失敗模式，當所有可用的候選者都忽略相同的缺失機制時：候選者之間的分歧即使在模型類別系統性錯誤的情況下也可能崩潰。我們制定了實驗模型類別修訂的方案，其中發現政策共同提出結構編輯和診斷實驗，以測試該編輯是否必要。該方法結合了一個類別級的可區分性目標，其中一個共享的參數化必須解釋所有選定的實驗，並且具有隨時有效的序列證據，該證據僅在當前類別被拒絕後觸發結構修訂。在400個保留的受控動態環境中，聯合政策在32次真實實驗的預算下達到了89.5%的精確恢復，將最強匹配基準提高了10.0個百分點，同時需要更少的執行實驗和候選擬合。學習到的修訂-實驗配對在未見的機制組合、保留但可表達的原始元素、參數外推和變更的實驗成本中轉移；當真實機制超出編輯語法時，它在88%的情況下檢測到庫的不足，假陽性支持率為5.5%。修訂增益也轉移到ODEBench和ODEBase模型庫任務，以及DiscoverPhysics世界。這些結果支持一種科學發現的觀點，即決定理論應該使哪些機制可表達以及在哪裡收集證據被視為一個單一的序列決策問題。

docs.title: Disentangling Models from Personas in Heterogeneous LLM Simulations
docs.text:
2610.07535v1 by Dani Roytburg, Daphne Ippolito

Multi-agent simulations with large language models (LLMs) often operate networks of agents with a single base model. This overlooks the inter-model effects which may dominate engagement dynamics in real-world deployments. To show this, we simulate a heterogeneous social network powered by several different base models and show that the amount of engagement an agent receives depends more on its base model than on its assigned persona. The attraction or repulsion effects of a base model strengthen dramatically when more models are added in the mix, suggesting that networks dynamics may converge to base model effects at scale. To help explain this effect, we conduct a series of content-mediating analyses, showing the predictability of base models across contexts as well as the relationship between a model's lexical patterns and an engagement-maximizing style. In light of recent developments in mass multi-agent interaction, this work underscores the relevance of heterogeneous compositions in driving the outcomes of those networks

摘要：多代理模擬與大型語言模型（LLMs）通常運行具有單一基礎模型的代理網絡。這忽視了可能主導現實世界部署中互動動態的模型間效應。為了展示這一點，我們模擬了一個由幾個不同基礎模型驅動的異質社交網絡，並顯示代理所獲得的互動量更多地依賴於其基礎模型，而非其指定的角色。當更多模型被加入時，基礎模型的吸引或排斥效應會顯著增強，這表明網絡動態在大規模下可能會收斂到基礎模型效應。為了幫助解釋這一效應，我們進行了一系列內容中介分析，顯示基礎模型在不同情境下的可預測性，以及模型的詞彙模式與最大化互動風格之間的關係。鑒於近期在大規模多代理互動中的發展，這項工作強調了異質組合在推動這些網絡結果中的重要性。

docs.title: Inference and learning in sparse autoencoders as natural gradient flow
docs.text:
2610.07389v1 by Hadi Vafaii, Tejas Rao, David Chanin, Thomas Fel, Jacob L. Yates, Bruno Olshausen, David Klindt, Dileep George, Miguel Lázaro-Gredilla

Sparse autoencoders are widely used to uncover interpretable features in neural networks, yet reliable recovery remains difficult when features overlap or activate infrequently. These challenges involve both inferring which features explain an input and learning the dictionary that represents them. Here, we unify inference and dictionary learning as natural-gradient flows on a shared variational free energy. We instantiate this framework as BeFOND, an encoder-free sparse coding model with closed-form inference and learning dynamics. We show how recurrent explaining away reduces interference between overlapping features, while Fisher preconditioning can compensate for the slow learning of rare features. On synthetic data, BeFOND improves dictionary recovery and rare-feature detection, with a growing advantage over amortized baselines as superposition increases. On language-model activations, it improves single-feature concept detection and selective intervention, outperforming pretrained reference SAEs with substantially less training data. Its feature quality continues to improve with dictionary width, whereas the evaluated baselines largely plateau. Together, these results show how improving inference and learning within a unified probabilistic framework can make better use of data and dictionary capacity to interpret and intervene on neural representations.

摘要：稀疏自編碼器被廣泛用於揭示神經網絡中的可解釋特徵，但當特徵重疊或不頻繁激活時，可靠的恢復仍然困難。這些挑戰涉及推斷哪些特徵解釋了一個輸入以及學習表示這些特徵的字典。在這裡，我們將推斷和字典學習統一為共享變分自由能上的自然梯度流。我們將這一框架實例化為 BeFOND，一種無編碼器的稀疏編碼模型，具有封閉形式的推斷和學習動力學。我們展示了如何通過重複解釋來減少重疊特徵之間的干擾，而費舍爾預處理可以補償稀有特徵的緩慢學習。在合成數據上，BeFOND 改善了字典恢復和稀有特徵檢測，隨著疊加的增加，相對於攤銷基線的優勢不斷增長。在語言模型激活上，它改善了單一特徵概念檢測和選擇性干預，超越了預訓練的參考 SAE，且所需的訓練數據顯著較少。其特徵質量隨著字典寬度的增加而持續改善，而評估的基線則大多趨於平穩。總的來說，這些結果顯示，如何在統一的概率框架內改善推斷和學習，可以更好地利用數據和字典容量來解釋和介入神經表示。

docs.title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
docs.text:
2610.07132v1 by Berke Arda, Ahmetcan Yavuz, Paul Gerry, Sebastian Lobentanzer, Nobin Sarwar, Joan Giner-Miguelez, Kongtao Chen, Luyao Zhang, Mrinmaya Sachan, Mubashara Akhtar

Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.

摘要：Croissant 已經成為機器可讀數據集元數據的標準，但填寫其字段仍然需要大量人力，並且需要仔細閱讀伴隨的數據集文檔。我們提出了第一個基準，能夠進行與社區標準架構對齊的元數據提取的端到端評估。該基準包含 602 篇論文，其中包括 102 篇經過人工驗證的金標註和 500 篇由 LLM 生成的銀標註，涵蓋了完整的 Croissant 架構，包括核心和負責任的人工智慧 (RAI) 字段。利用這個基準，我們評估了一系列提取系統，涵蓋前沿模型、開放權重模型和代理架構，並在一個兩級評估框架下進行，該框架結合了基於規則的評分和通過人工審核選擇的 LLM 評審。我們發現，單次提取在我們評估的四個代理架構中始終表現更好：在各個主幹中，這些分解變體的準確性低於單次全上下文提取。最大的差距出現在長格式的 RAI 字段，這需要綜合和解釋分散在論文中的信息，而不是從單一位置複製，這是一個當前系統仍然遠未可靠的情境。我們釋出基準、評估代碼、評審審核、實時演示以及面向新系統的排行榜。

docs.title: Language models can notice an impossible engineering problem yet still report it as solved
docs.text:
2610.06668v1 by Shaoliang Yang, Jun Wang

Language models draft engineering calculations, but answer accuracy does not show whether they reject an impossible problem. We tested 14 models on 30 pairs of mechanics problems, each with a valid version and one made impossible by changing a given value or assumption. Two independent solvers verified every answer key and showed that each flawed problem was physically impossible. We scored solving of valid problems separately from rejection of their flawed counterparts. Each reply required a "solved" or "cannot solve" status; rejection meant "cannot solve" or withholding an answer. The initial prompts did not warn that problems could be flawed. Across three recent models, 12 of 90 replies failed to reject a flawed problem. In 11 of these replies, the model stated the flaw, answered a corrected problem and still reported the original as "solved", according to artificial intelligence raters and numerical checks. We later retested four models from one provider, offering "flawed" instead of "cannot solve" and asking them to name and explain the defect. Three models showed statistically significant increases in rejection, but valid-problem solving fell in three. Evaluations therefore need to score both versions and distinguish flaw recognition from the reported status.

摘要：語言模型草擬工程計算，但答案的準確性並未顯示它們是否拒絕不可能的問題。我們測試了 14 個模型，針對 30 對力學問題，每對問題都有一個有效版本和一個因改變給定值或假設而變得不可能的版本。兩位獨立的解題者驗證了每個答案鍵，並顯示每個有缺陷的問題在物理上都是不可能的。我們將有效問題的解題與拒絕其有缺陷對應物的情況分開計分。每個回覆都需要一個「已解決」或「無法解決」的狀態；拒絕意味著「無法解決」或不提供答案。最初的提示並未警告問題可能存在缺陷。在三個最近的模型中，90 個回覆中有 12 個未能拒絕一個有缺陷的問題。在這 11 個回覆中，模型指出了缺陷，回答了一個修正過的問題，並仍然將原始問題報告為「已解決」，根據人工智慧評估者和數值檢查。我們後來重新測試了來自一個提供者的四個模型，提供「有缺陷」而不是「無法解決」，並要求它們命名並解釋缺陷。三個模型顯示拒絕的統計顯著增加，但有效問題的解題在三個模型中下降。因此，評估需要同時對兩個版本進行計分，並區分缺陷識別與報告狀態。

docs.title: Wiring Matters: Injection Topology and Initialization of Affordance Heads in Vision-Language-Action Policies
docs.text:
2610.06318v1 by Zijian An, Linhan Wang, Jiayan Wang, Shijie Geng, Ran Yang, Yiming Feng, Lifeng Zhou

Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how to wire such a head into a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops the policy below the headless base (85.5% vs. 93.1%). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2*2 ablation over injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2%, matching the far more elaborate three-expert AffordanceVLA (95.8%) with under 1% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes load-bearing.

摘要：密集的可供性監督對於視覺-語言-行動（VLA）策略來說是一個吸引人的輔助信號，然而，天真地共同訓練一個可供性頭可能會嚴重損害指令遵循。我們在LIBERO基準上展示了如何將這樣的頭部接入現代VLA的受控研究。我們的方案通過停止梯度讀取主幹，並通過學習的橋接將中間頭部特徵重新注入到行動專家中。停止梯度是一個前提條件：讓可供性梯度達到主幹會使策略低於無頭基線（85.5%對93.1%）。在保護主幹的情況下，對注入拓撲（串接對殘差）和橋接初始化（零對隨機）進行相同預算的2*2消融實驗顯示，初始化是主要的杠杆。最佳的接線方式，即主動初始化的殘差橋，達到了96.2%，與更為複雜的三專家AffordanceVLA（95.8%）相匹配，且額外參數不足1%。兩個探針解釋了這一機制：作為輸入的真實可供性會造成損害，而推理時的零化顯示懶惰的橋接僅作為訓練時的正則化器，而主動的橋接則成為承重結構。

docs.title: When Are Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations Faithful and Compact?
docs.text:
2610.06285v1 by Stefano Teso, Emanuele Marconato, Steve Azzolin, Antonio Vergari

Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) are neural classifiers that allow to explain their decisions via high-level concepts, potentially enabling understanding, steering and debugging. However, their explanations are often derived heuristically. Building on formal explainability, we argue they should also be faithful, i.e., not misreport which concepts actually matter. We show that, for widespread CBM architectures, including recent VLM-based variants, faithful explanations must include all concepts in the bottleneck, compromising interpretability when this is large. This result applies to both heuristic and faithful-by-construction formal explanations. To encourage the existence of compact faithful explanations, we suggest i) modeling concepts probabilistically as binary or categorical random variables (rather than logits), and ii) employing per-concept training-time sparsification via group lasso (rather than regular elastic net). We also extend algorithms from formal explainability to CBMs, and show they outperform natural heuristics in terms of guarantees and explanation size. Overall, our work warns against naive interpretability claims and provides formal conditions and practical strategies for ensuring CBMs are as interpretable as advertised.

摘要：概念瓶頸模型（CBMs）是神經分類器，允許通過高層次概念解釋其決策，從而可能實現理解、引導和調試。然而，它們的解釋通常是基於啟發式的。基於正式的可解釋性，我們主張它們也應該是忠實的，即不錯誤報告哪些概念實際上是重要的。我們顯示，對於廣泛使用的CBM架構，包括最近的基於VLM的變體，忠實的解釋必須包含瓶頸中的所有概念，這在瓶頸較大時會妥協可解釋性。這一結果適用於啟發式和基於構造的正式忠實解釋。為了鼓勵存在緊湊的忠實解釋，我們建議 i) 將概念建模為二元或類別隨機變量（而不是logits），以及 ii) 通過群體Lasso進行每個概念的訓練時間稀疏化（而不是常規的彈性網）。我們還將正式可解釋性的算法擴展到CBMs，並顯示它們在保證和解釋大小方面優於自然啟發式方法。總體而言，我們的工作警告對天真的可解釋性主張，並提供正式條件和實用策略，以確保CBMs如廣告所宣稱的那樣可解釋。

docs.title: CCQ: A Multi-State Child Care Quality Dataset to Support AI for Children's Health Research
docs.text:
2610.05863v1 by Victor Li, Yuzhang Xie, Ziwei Dong, Qingyang Zhu, Wenjing Ma, Carl Yang, Jinbing Bai, Huiwen Xu, Jiaying Lu

High-quality child care in early life is a critical determinant of children's growth and development. Research on child care quality has been constrained by fragmented, non-research-friendly, and privacy-bound datasets. We present CCQ (Child Care Quality), a large-scale, de-identified dataset for applied data science research at the intersection of AI and early childhood health. CCQ integrates 59,372 child care provider records across 12 U.S. states, covering diverse provider types as well as data schemas. To ensure research utility while protecting privacy, we implement an automated, LLM-based curation pipeline that anonymizes, cleans, and standardizes raw state records into two complementary releases: a cleaned textual release and a fully preprocessed tabular release. We also benchmark traditional machine learning models, tabular foundation models, and language models on quality rating prediction and important features analytics. Within a state, tabular classifiers on the preprocessed tables perform best. Across states, zero-shot transfer is near chance, but modest target-state supervision recovers most of the within-state performance, and pretraining on other states benefits finetuned language models. We release both datasets with all code to accelerate AI-driven research on child care quality and ultimately improve children's health and development.

摘要：高品質的早期兒童照護是兒童成長和發展的重要決定因素。對於兒童照護質量的研究受到碎片化、非研究友好和隱私限制數據集的制約。我們提出了CCQ（兒童照護質量），這是一個大型的去識別化數據集，用於AI與早期兒童健康交叉領域的應用數據科學研究。CCQ整合了來自美國12個州的59,372條兒童照護提供者記錄，涵蓋了多樣的提供者類型以及數據架構。為了確保研究的實用性並保護隱私，我們實施了一個自動化的基於LLM的策展管道，將原始州記錄匿名化、清理和標準化為兩個互補的版本：一個是清理過的文本版本，另一個是完全預處理的表格版本。我們還對傳統機器學習模型、表格基礎模型和語言模型在質量評分預測和重要特徵分析上進行了基準測試。在一個州內，預處理表格上的表格分類器表現最佳。在各州之間，零-shot轉移接近隨機，但適度的目標州監督恢復了大部分州內性能，而在其他州的預訓練有助於微調的語言模型。我們釋放了這兩個數據集及所有代碼，以加速基於AI的兒童照護質量研究，最終改善兒童的健康和發展。

docs.title: Toward AI Trustworthiness: Finding Analytically Proven Forward-Invariant Sets for AI-Controlled Systems
docs.text:
2610.05689v1 by Haoyang Song, Xikun Yang, Qixin Wang

Neural-network (NN) controllers are increasingly used in nonlinear control systems, but their highly nonlinear behavior makes them difficult to explain and verify, raising trustworthiness concerns in safety- and mission-critical applications. A key step toward certifiable trustworthiness is to find a Forward-Invariant Set (FIS): a state-space region such that any trajectory starting inside remains inside. If the FIS excludes unsafe states, safety can be guaranteed for initial states within it. Finding an analytically proven FIS for a given AI-controlled system with a fixed controller is difficult. We propose a framework that uses an Invertible Neural Network (INN) to transform the original state space into a latent space where a regular-shaped FIS is more likely to exist. We train the INN so that a preferred hyper-rectangular candidate becomes invariant in the latent space, then formally verify it. We prove that, whenever verification succeeds, both the latent-space candidate and its inverse-transformed counterpart in the original state space are analytically proven FISs. We evaluate the approach on 45 AI-controlled systems across three representative control testbeds. Our method finds certified FISs for all 45 systems, whereas an adapted state-of-the-art baseline finds none. It is also faster on 40 of the 45 systems, and the centers of the resulting FISs roughly match domain-expert preferences.

摘要：神經網絡（NN）控制器在非線性控制系統中的使用越來越普遍，但其高度非線性的行為使得它們難以解釋和驗證，這在安全和任務關鍵應用中引發了信任問題。朝向可認證信任度的一個關鍵步驟是找到一個前向不變集（FIS）：一個狀態空間區域，使得任何從內部開始的軌跡都保持在內部。如果 FIS 排除了不安全狀態，則可以保證其內部初始狀態的安全性。對於給定的 AI 控制系統，找到一個經過分析證明的 FIS 是困難的。我們提出了一個框架，使用可逆神經網絡（INN）將原始狀態空間轉換為潛在空間，在這裡，規則形狀的 FIS 更有可能存在。我們訓練 INN，使得一個首選的超矩形候選者在潛在空間中變得不變，然後對其進行正式驗證。我們證明，無論何時驗證成功，潛在空間候選者及其在原始狀態空間中的逆轉換對應物都是經過分析證明的 FIS。我們在三個代表性的控制測試平台上對 45 個 AI 控制系統評估了這種方法。我們的方法為所有 45 個系統找到了經過認證的 FIS，而一個改編的最先進基準則沒有找到任何。它在 45 個系統中的 40 個上也更快，且結果 FIS 的中心大致符合領域專家的偏好。

docs.title: JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)
docs.text:
2610.07036v1 by Sara Abdali, Pashmina Cameron

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.

摘要：參數高效的微調以較低的成本調整預訓練模型，但大多數低秩適配器是單任務的，並且以乘法方式表示每次權重更新，未明確考慮在任務之間共享的內容和特定於任務的內容。我們介紹 JIVEAdapter，一種多任務的「加法」低秩適配器，靈感來自統計學中的聯合與個別變異解釋（Joint and Individual Variation Explained, JIVE）。JIVEAdapter 將每次權重更新分解為一個在所有任務中共享的聯合結構和一個每個任務的個別結構，並對個別結構施加懲罰，使其接近於聯合結構，以便共享信號和特定於任務的信號保持「可解釋」且分離，並在共享的聯合池和每個任務的個別池之間自適應地分配秩。聯合結構一次性學習，對一組任務進行聯合學習或逐步學習，一次一個任務，然後凍結並重用作為新任務的先驗，而無需重新訓練共享部分。在 GLUE 和 SuperGLUE 上使用 DeBERTaV3-base，JIVEAdapter 在匹配的每任務有效秩下，與強大的單任務和多任務低秩基準競爭，且不需要額外的模塊，如 MoE，當存在相關的持有任務時，其凍結的聯合結構通過僅使用便宜的每個方向的縮放重用該任務的個別結構，否則則訓練一個小的新結構。

docs.title: DelegationBench: Measuring When AI Agents Should Ask Before Acting
docs.text:
2610.05532v1 by Shiva Pochampally

AI agents that send emails, edit files, and make purchases must decide when to act on their own and when to check with the user first. This decision is usually evaluated by showing a model a proposed action, asking whether it should proceed, and scoring agreement with human labels. We introduce DelegationBench to test whether such scores can be trusted. It has 156 scenarios with four possible responses (act, ask for permission, ask for missing information, refuse), and most scenarios come in matched pairs that change a single feature: whether the action was requested, what is at stake, whether it can be undone, or who will see it. Across ten models from five families, agreement scores mislead in three ways. A simple keyword rule, which we wrote after seeing the benchmark, agrees with our annotators more often than eight of the models, yet its decision changes in only 9 of 48 matched pairs. Equivalent ways of asking the same question change how often a model acts by up to 52.5 percentage points. And every model stops to ask the user less often when it must carry out the task with tools than when it judges a proposed action. When rules are stated explicitly, the same models follow them almost perfectly, so the gaps are not explained by a general inability to follow rules. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools and recommend reporting these properties separately rather than as one score.

摘要：AI 代理人需要決定何時自行行動，何時先與使用者確認。這一決策通常透過向模型展示一個提議的行動，詢問是否應該繼續，並評分與人類標籤的一致性來進行評估。我們引入了 DelegationBench 來測試這些分數是否可信。它包含 156 個場景，並有四種可能的回應（行動、請求許可、詢問缺失資訊、拒絕），大多數場景以匹配對的形式出現，僅改變一個特徵：是否請求了該行動、涉及的風險、是否可以撤回，或是誰會看到它。在來自五個家族的十個模型中，一致性分數在三個方面存在誤導。一個簡單的關鍵字規則，在我們看到基準後寫成，與我們的標註者的意見一致性高於八個模型，但其決策在 48 個匹配對中僅改變了 9 次。以等效的方式詢問相同問題會使模型的行動頻率變化高達 52.5 個百分點。而且每個模型在必須使用工具執行任務時，詢問使用者的頻率低於在判斷提議行動時的頻率。當規則被明確陳述時，這些模型幾乎完美地遵循它們，因此這些差距並不能用一般無法遵循規則來解釋。我們發布了基準和評估工具，並建議分開報告這些屬性，而不是作為一個分數。

docs.title: What Does Fréchet Distance Measure? A Directional Decomposition
docs.text:
2610.05518v1 by Yunghee Lee, Jaeyeon Kim

The Fréchet distance is a de facto standard for evaluating generative models across domains, appearing as FID for images and FVD for videos. It summarizes the discrepancy between generated and reference distributions in a single scalar, with lower values typically interpreted as better generation quality. However, this scalar view can obscure what drives the comparison. For example, in COCO dataset, increasing the number of diffusion sampling steps improves ImageReward scores yet worsens (increases) FID.
