Motivated by this mismatch, we seek to make the Fréchet distance more interpretable by uncovering where the discrepancy lies. To this end, we introduce directional Fréchet distance, the expected squared projection of the optimal transport displacement onto a given direction. Across our image, video, and protein case studies, we find that a small number of interpretable directions account for much of the distance. We use these directions to explain the FID increase in terms of semantic concepts represented by CLIP embeddings, quantify FVD's bias toward per-frame appearance, and revisit the interpretation of Protein FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/yhlee-add/directional-fd.

摘要：弗雷歇距離是評估跨領域生成模型的事實標準，對於圖像來說以FID表示，對於視頻則以FVD表示。它將生成分佈和參考分佈之間的差異總結為一個標量，較低的值通常被解釋為更好的生成質量。然而，這種標量視角可能會掩蓋比較的驅動因素。例如，在COCO數據集中，增加擴散採樣步驟的數量會提高ImageReward分數，但卻惡化（增加）FID。受到這種不匹配的啟發，我們希望通過揭示差異所在，使弗雷歇距離更加可解釋。為此，我們引入了方向性弗雷歇距離，即最佳運輸位移在給定方向上的期望平方投影。在我們的圖像、視頻和蛋白質案例研究中，我們發現少數可解釋的方向佔據了大部分距離。我們利用這些方向來解釋FID的增加，涉及由CLIP嵌入表示的語義概念，量化FVD對每幀外觀的偏見，並重新審視蛋白質FID的解釋。我們在https://github.com/yhlee-add/directional-fd上開源了我們的代碼庫。

docs.title: Does Explainability Survive Data Drift?
docs.text:
2610.05379v1 by Samuel Ozechi

Model performance monitoring is a standard practice in machine learning deployments. Detection performance is tracked continuously, and model decay is expected as the relationship between the feature and target variables degrades, a phenomenon known as concept drift. Explanation fidelity, however, is rarely monitored with the same discipline, even in domains such as financial systems, healthcare, and other regulated environments where explanations are required for governance purposes. This paper investigates whether explanations can decay under data drift, even when the feature-target relationship remains stable, and whether explanations produced before drift occurs remain faithful to the decisions of the model that replaces them. Using the IEEE-CIS Transaction Fraud Detection dataset, we find statistically significant covariate shift but no statistically significant evidence of concept drift under the implemented conditional-drift tests, thereby providing an empirical setting in which input distributional change can be studied separately from detectable changes in the feature-target relationship. Local explanations are generated with ExIFFI and evaluated at three levels: path validity, structural behaviour, and fidelity under controlled intervention. Results show that while prior explanations retain substantial decision relevance to a retrained model, they are consistently less faithful than newly generated explanations, with no evidence of a systematically widening gap across the evaluated windows. The study shows that explanation fidelity requires its own monitoring, that structural stability of explanations does not guarantee functional fidelity, and that explanations should be treated as artifacts tied to the model that produced them.

摘要：模型性能監控是機器學習部署中的標準做法。檢測性能持續被追蹤，隨著特徵與目標變數之間的關係惡化，模型衰退是可以預期的，這一現象稱為概念漂移。然而，解釋的可靠性卻很少以相同的嚴謹度進行監控，即使在金融系統、醫療保健及其他需要解釋以滿足治理目的的受規範環境中也是如此。本文探討在數據漂移下，解釋是否會衰退，即使特徵與目標之間的關係保持穩定，以及在漂移發生之前生成的解釋是否仍然忠實於取代它們的模型的決策。使用IEEE-CIS交易詐騙檢測數據集，我們發現統計上顯著的協變量變化，但在實施的條件漂移測試下沒有統計上顯著的概念漂移證據，從而提供了一個可以將輸入分佈變化與特徵-目標關係中的可檢測變化分開研究的實證環境。使用ExIFFI生成局部解釋，並在三個層面進行評估：路徑有效性、結構行為和在控制干預下的可靠性。結果顯示，雖然先前的解釋對重新訓練的模型仍然保持相當的決策相關性，但它們的忠實度始終低於新生成的解釋，且在評估窗口中沒有證據顯示差距系統性擴大。研究表明，解釋的可靠性需要自身的監控，解釋的結構穩定性並不保證功能的忠實度，且解釋應被視為與生成它們的模型相關的工件。

docs.title: Characterizing Parallelism Strategies in LLM Inference: Fundamental Compute-Communication Trade-offs
docs.text:
2610.05305v1 by Javad Mirzaei, Jeebak Mitra

Large Language Model (LLM) inference has become the dominant workload in modern AI systems, requiring serving infrastructures to maximize throughput while meeting strict latency Service-Level Objectives (SLOs). Since state-of-the-art LLMs exceed the compute and memory capacity of a single GPU, inference is commonly distributed across multiple GPUs using tensor parallelism (TP), pipeline parallelism (PP), or hybrid parallelism (HB). However, selecting the most effective parallelism strategy remains challenging due to complex interactions among computation, communication, pipeline utilization, sequence length, batch size, and model architecture. Existing approaches largely rely on empirical evaluation and provide limited analytical insight into the trade-offs among these strategies, particularly across the distinct prefill and decoding phases of inference. In this paper, we present a unified analytical framework for modeling distributed LLM inference under TP, PP, and HB. The framework decomposes end-to-end latency into computation, inter-GPU communication, and pipeline bubble overhead, and derives analytical models that capture TP collective communication, PP point-to-point communication, and pipeline utilization as functions of hardware, model, and workload characteristics. The model further characterizes the differing execution behavior of prefill and decoding, explaining why PP-oriented configurations favor compute-intensive prefill while TP-oriented configurations reduce decoding latency by eliminating pipeline bubbles. Experiments with modern LLMs on multi-GPU platforms validate the model and confirm the fundamental compute-communication trade-off across parallelism strategies. The framework provides practical guidance for parallelism selection, capacity planning, and optimization of future LLM serving systems.

摘要：大型語言模型 (LLM) 推論已成為現代 AI 系統中的主導工作負載，要求服務基礎設施在滿足嚴格的延遲服務水平目標 (SLO) 的同時最大化吞吐量。由於最先進的 LLM 超過了單個 GPU 的計算和記憶體容量，因此推論通常使用張量並行 (TP)、管道並行 (PP) 或混合並行 (HB) 在多個 GPU 之間分配。然而，選擇最有效的並行策略仍然具有挑戰性，因為計算、通信、管道利用率、序列長度、批次大小和模型架構之間存在複雜的相互作用。現有的方法在很大程度上依賴於經驗評估，並對這些策略之間的權衡提供有限的分析洞見，特別是在推論的不同預填充和解碼階段之間。在本文中，我們提出了一個統一的分析框架，用於建模在 TP、PP 和 HB 下的分佈式 LLM 推論。該框架將端到端延遲分解為計算、GPU 之間的通信和管道氣泡開銷，並推導出捕捉 TP 集體通信、PP 點對點通信和管道利用率的分析模型，這些模型是硬體、模型和工作負載特徵的函數。該模型進一步描述了預填充和解碼的不同執行行為，解釋了為什麼以 PP 為導向的配置偏向於計算密集型的預填充，而以 TP 為導向的配置則通過消除管道氣泡來減少解碼延遲。在多 GPU 平台上對現代 LLM 的實驗驗證了該模型，並確認了並行策略之間的基本計算-通信權衡。該框架為並行性選擇、容量規劃和未來 LLM 服務系統的優化提供了實用指導。

docs.title: GFGE: Unifying Explainable AI Methods through an Interpretation Framework
docs.text:
2610.05225v1 by Jinfeng Zhong

Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) encompasses methods that draw on different sources of information and address different explanatory needs. A common framework is needed to describe how this information becomes evidence and is communicated as an explanation for a particular recipient. We propose the General Framework for Generating Explanations (GFGE), grounded in interpretative frameworks and the complementary activities of \emph{sense-reading} and \emph{sense-giving}. Its conceptual foundation is the Interpret/Explain Schema (IES), which connects an analyst's interpretation of system evidence, the communication of a selected account, and the recipient's interpretation of that account. GFGE operationalises this schema through five roles: data interpretation, model interpretation, output interpretation, optional post-hoc analysis, and aggregation. A role-typed operation graph records method-specific dependencies, while evidence records retain the sources, assumptions, and limitations of explanatory claims. The explanatory question, audience, and context guide the procedure. We instantiate GFGE for attribution, surrogate, counterfactual, concept and prototype, intrinsic rule, argumentation, and language-model methods. These instantiations show how intrinsic, post-hoc, and hybrid workflows can be represented through the same roles while preserving their distinct evidential requirements. GFGE provides a common basis for analysing explanation workflows, tracing communicated claims to their evidence, and identifying unresolved explanatory dependencies.

摘要：可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）涵蓋了基於不同信息來源並滿足不同解釋需求的方法。需要一個共同的框架來描述這些信息如何成為證據並被傳達為特定接收者的解釋。我們提出了生成解釋的一般框架（GFGE），該框架基於詮釋框架以及\emph{sense-reading}和\emph{sense-giving}的互補活動。其概念基礎是詮釋/解釋架構（IES），該架構連接分析師對系統證據的詮釋、選定說明的傳達以及接收者對該說明的詮釋。GFGE通過五個角色來具體化這一架構：數據詮釋、模型詮釋、輸出詮釋、可選的事後分析和聚合。角色類型的操作圖記錄方法特定的依賴關係，而證據記錄保留了解釋性主張的來源、假設和限制。解釋問題、受眾和背景指導著這一過程。我們為歸因、代理、反事實、概念和原型、內在規則、論證和語言模型方法實例化GFGE。這些實例顯示了內在、事後和混合工作流程如何通過相同的角色來表示，同時保留其獨特的證據要求。GFGE為分析解釋工作流程提供了共同的基礎，追溯傳達的主張到其證據，並識別未解決的解釋依賴關係。

docs.title: From Scientific Observations to Mechanisms: Benchmarking Hypothesis Generation by AI Scientists
docs.text:
2610.05197v1 by Xiaxun Xie, Qingqing Long, Meng Xiao, Wei Ju, Yuanchun Zhou, Xuezhi Wang, Hengshu Zhu

Data-driven mechanistic hypotheses are essential to scientific discovery because they explain how underlying processes produce observed phenomena. AI agents and AI scientists increasingly support scientific data analysis. However, their ability to turn empirical findings into mechanistic hypotheses remains insufficiently examined. To address this gap, we introduce MechHypoBench, the first benchmark for evaluating whether AI agents and AI scientists can generate such hypotheses from empirical data. It combines paper-derived mechanisms from 14 scientific fields with real-world datasets containing 17.98 million records. The construction retains the observational complexity of empirical data while providing a specified underlying mechanism. Agents analyze the observations and propose open-form hypotheses. We develop an evaluation framework that assesses open-form mechanistic hypotheses through their consequences under withheld conditions. Experiments with general agents and AI scientists reveal a substantial gap between generated hypotheses and the underlying mechanisms.

摘要：數據驅動的機制假說對於科學發現至關重要，因為它們解釋了潛在過程如何產生觀察到的現象。AI代理和AI科學家越來越多地支持科學數據分析。 然而，它們將實證發現轉化為機制假說的能力仍然不足以進行檢驗。 為了解決這一空白，我們介紹了MechHypoBench，這是第一個評估AI代理和AI科學家是否能夠從實證數據生成此類假說的基準。 它結合了來自14個科學領域的論文衍生機制和包含1798萬條記錄的現實世界數據集。 這一構建保留了實證數據的觀察複雜性，同時提供了一個特定的潛在機制。 代理分析觀察結果並提出開放形式的假說。 我們開發了一個評估框架，通過在保留條件下的後果來評估開放形式的機制假說。 對一般代理和AI科學家的實驗顯示，生成的假說與潛在機制之間存在顯著差距。

docs.title: Tracing a Sparse Emotion-Control Circuit in LLM-Based Text-to-Speech
docs.text:
2610.05080v1 by Hongfei Du, Jiacheng Shi, Yanfu Zhang, Ye Gao

LLM-based text-to-speech (TTS) models can generate emotionally expressive speech, but how reference emotion is routed through the model and realized in decoded speech remains unclear. We introduce two emotion-sensitive metrics for matched neutral and emotional syntheses---a codec trajectory score and a late residual direction score---and use them to score activation-patching interventions. Under controlled matched-reference conditions, this analysis identifies a sparse source-to-readout component-level circuit: 23--27 attention heads and MLPs per emotion, roughly 5% of the components considered, recover or suppress 74--88% of the late emotion-readout shift on held-out cases. The circuit combines a shared component backbone with emotion-specific components; cross-emotion activation swaps reduce the target readout in 47 of 48 cases. In decoded speech, the same intervention produces consistent changes in pitch, energy, and spectral brightness over 24 matched pairs per emotion. A readout-matched residual-direction baseline produces only 17--27% of the intervention's pitch effect, showing that internal readout movement alone does not explain the decoded acoustic changes. These results trace a compact causal route from reference-derived prefix information to emotion-relevant properties of generated speech.

摘要：LLM 基於文本到語音 (TTS) 模型可以生成情感表達豐富的語音，但參考情感如何在模型中傳遞並體現在解碼語音中仍然不清楚。我們引入了兩個情感敏感的指標，用於匹配中性和情感合成——編解碼軌跡分數和延遲殘差方向分數——並用它們來評分激活修補干預。在受控的匹配參考條件下，這項分析識別出一個稀疏的源到讀出組件級電路：每種情感 23-27 個注意力頭和 MLP，約佔考慮組件的 5%，在保留案例中恢復或抑制 74-88% 的晚期情感讀出轉變。該電路結合了共享組件骨架和情感特定組件；跨情感激活交換在 48 個案例中有 47 個減少了目標讀出。在解碼語音中，相同的干預在每種情感的 24 對匹配樣本中產生了一致的音高、能量和光譜亮度變化。一個讀出匹配的殘差方向基線僅產生了干預音高效果的 17-27%，顯示僅靠內部讀出運動無法解釋解碼的聲學變化。這些結果描繪了一條從參考派生前綴信息到生成語音的情感相關特性的緊湊因果路徑。

docs.title: CrystalJev: thinking fast and slow with atomistic foundation models for materials discovery
docs.text:
2610.06985v1 by Peng Kang, Zhen Li, Yu Liu, Lei Zheng, Huibin Xu

Atomistic foundation models triage millions of hypothetical materials but are used as slow simulators, their thresholded energies taken at face value. They are better read as fast decision-makers. CrystalJev queries a frozen interatomic potential once per unrelaxed structure and answers typed questions with calibrated probabilities, finite-sample guarantees and a rule for when to think slowly. Across 65 Matbench Discovery models, a 'stable' call is a probability in disguise, explained by a model's errors and the candidate population. Once trained, one forward pass decides nearly as well as a relaxation at a thirtieth of its cost, and a value-of-information theory sends slower computation only where decisions can change. The same layer answers electronic, mechanical and molecular questions. In a registered prospective test with 700 new density-functional calculations, single-pass forecasts calibrated only on existing data over-stated the stable fraction of unseen candidates (5.8%) by at most 2.1 percentage points.

摘要：原子基礎模型篩選數百萬種假設材料，但作為緩慢的模擬器使用，其閾值能量被視為表面價值。它們更應被視為快速決策者。CrystalJev 每次對未放鬆的結構查詢一次凍結的原子間勢，並以經過校準的概率、有限樣本保證以及何時慢思考的規則回答輸入的問題。在 65 個 Matbench Discovery 模型中，'穩定'的呼叫實際上是一種偽裝的概率，由模型的誤差和候選人群體解釋。一旦訓練完成，一次前向傳遞的決策幾乎能與以三十分之一成本的放鬆效果相當，而信息價值理論則僅在決策可能改變的地方發送較慢的計算。同一層回答電子、機械和分子問題。在一項註冊的前瞻性測試中，使用 700 個新的密度泛函計算，僅基於現有數據的單次預測將未見候選者的穩定比例（5.8%）高估了最多 2.1 個百分點。

docs.title: A Unified Dynamics Framework for Reinforcement Learning and Classical Control of a Six-DOF Pipeline-Tracking ROV in NVIDIA Isaac Sim
docs.text:
2610.04949v1 by Cheng Siong Chin, M. Venkateshkumar, Jianhua Zhang

Reinforcement learning controllers for underwater vehicles are usually trained against one physics representation and deployed against another, so reported performance does not always describe behavior outside training. This paper presents a pipeline-tracking architecture for a six-degree-of-freedom remotely operated vehicle (ROV) in which one Universal Scene Description (USD) scene supplies the real BlueROV2-Heavy mass, added-mass, damping, buoyancy, and thruster parameters to both halves of the system: a vectorized NumPy implementation of Fossen's marine-craft equations, and an interactive NVIDIA Isaac Sim deployment applying the identical equations as PhysX forces at every step. The Coriolis-centripetal term is the primary dynamics model in both branches; a controlled ablation on PPO and TRPO shows that including it does not destabilize either algorithm and modestly improves tracking, about 19 percent lower standoff RMS error for TRPO. Five reinforcement learning algorithms, PPO, soft actor-critic, TD3, DDPG, and TRPO, are trained against one environment, reward, and randomized evaluation harness through a checkpoint-compatibility layer scoring any policy with the same code. The pipeline is extended with six classical baselines, PID, sliding-mode, fuzzy logic, feedback linearization, model predictive control, and an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system, driven by the same guidance geometry and thruster allocation as the learned policies. Under Coriolis-enabled dynamics, PPO, TRPO, and feedback linearization reach the strongest combination of 100 percent success and competitive accuracy; PID, fuzzy control, and the neuro-fuzzy baseline also reach 100 percent success with looser tracking; DDPG and TD3 each show a specific, explainable failure mode rather than a general weakness of off-policy learning; and classical control remains a strong baseline against the best learned policies.

摘要：水下車輛的強化學習控制器通常是在一種物理表示下訓練，而在另一種物理表示下部署，因此報告的性能並不總是能描述訓練之外的行為。本文提出了一種六自由度遙控車輛（ROV）的管道跟蹤架構，其中一個通用場景描述（USD）場景提供了實際的 BlueROV2-Heavy 質量、附加質量、阻尼、浮力和推進器參數，供系統的兩個部分使用：Fossen 的海洋工藝方程的向量化 NumPy 實現，以及一個互動式 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 部署，在每一步應用相同的方程作為 PhysX 力。科里奧利-向心項是兩個分支中的主要動力學模型；對 PPO 和 TRPO 進行的控制性消融顯示，包含該項不會使任何算法不穩定，並且適度改善跟蹤，TRPO 的靜態均方根誤差降低約 19%。五種強化學習算法，PPO、軟演員-評論家、TD3、DDPG 和 TRPO，都是在同一環境、獎勵和隨機評估裝置下訓練的，通過檢查點兼容層對任何使用相同代碼的策略進行評分。該管道擴展了六個經典基線，PID、滑模、模糊邏輯、反饋線性化、模型預測控制和自適應神經模糊推理系統，這些系統由與學習策略相同的引導幾何和推進器分配驅動。在科里奧利啟用的動力學下，PPO、TRPO 和反饋線性化達到了 100% 的成功率和競爭性的準確性；PID、模糊控制和神經模糊基線也達到 100% 的成功率，但跟蹤較為寬鬆；DDPG 和 TD3 各自顯示出一種特定的、可解釋的失敗模式，而不是離政策學習的一般弱點；經典控制仍然是對最佳學習策略的一個強基線。

docs.title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
docs.text:
2610.04907v1 by Luoyu Chen, Xiaoyu Ding, Weiqi Wang, Chenhan Zhang, Zhiyi Tian, Jianhuan Huang, Shui Yu

Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

摘要：潛意識學習讓學生從語義上無關的數據中繼承教師的行為特徵，但已發表的實驗通常需要數萬個載體範例。我們詢問這種數據需求的來源。我們的測試平台是潛意識引導：教師特徵是一個已知的殘餘流向量 $Δ_T$，因此可以直接測量轉移作為參數恢復。在相同的載體前綴上，我們比較了標記級別（硬）NLL 監督與全分佈（軟）KL 監督。在初始化時，這兩個目標給出了幾乎共線的梯度，並且兩者都與 $Δ_T$ 的對齊度較差。然而，在迭代優化下，它們卻發生了分歧：軟監督幾乎完全從幾百個載體中恢復 $Δ_T$，而硬監督即使在數萬個載體下也遠低於它。我們通過將引導向量蒸餾視為一個噪聲線性逆問題來解釋這一差距。在局部，載體任務通過其費舍爾矩陣 $F$ 將特徵映射，因此梯度指向 $FΔ_T$ 而不是 $Δ_T$。然後，梯度下降作為 $F$ 的逐漸減少的逆向作用。對於軟目標，這個逆向恢復了低曲率方向。對於硬標籤，它也在這些相同方向上放大了取樣噪聲。結果是最佳的反演深度隨著獨立載體的數量而增長。在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Gemma-2-9B 上的實驗確認了四個預測：初始梯度的費舍爾扭曲、從陡峭到平坦方向的恢復排序、隨著數據規模變化的最佳深度，以及從固定提示池重新取樣完成的效果與添加新提示一樣好。在這種情況下，所需的大型載體數據集不僅是為了揭示特徵，更是為了抑制費舍爾反演放大的標籤噪聲。代碼可在 \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data} 獲得。

docs.title: Invisible Ink, Visible Lies: How Production Watermarking Causes LLMs to Hallucinate
docs.text:
2610.04860v1 by Haocheng Ye, Aoting Hu, Xinwei Zhang, Xunzhu Tang, Shuchao Pang, Jason Xue

Text watermarking helps identify AI-generated content, but its effect on factual reliability remains underexplored. In this paper, we study watermarking hallucination: factual errors induced or amplified by watermarking even when the required evidence is present in the context and the unwatermarked model can answer correctly. Using a controlled retrieval-augmented generation setting, we compare unwatermarked and watermarked generations under the same context, query, and decoding configuration, and quantify their factual accuracy decrease. Across six representative watermarking methods, including KGW, SWEET, DiPmark, GumbelSoft, Gumbel-Max, and SynthID watermarking, we consistently observe watermark-induced hallucination. Watermarked outputs can remain fluent while introducing factual errors. We attribute this failure mode to two mechanisms: (1) token perturbations in the current-step arising from method-specific reweighting or keyed sampling, and (2) prefix-induced attention drift, which accumulates through autoregressive decoding and weakens later attention to the factual context. Motivated by this analysis, we propose two plug-in interventions at the token and attention levels that can be integrated into existing watermarking methods to improve factuality. At a matched TPR of 0.90 at 1% FPR, combining the two interventions reduces factual errors by approximately 90% relative to watermark-only decoding while preserving fluency and comparable decoding efficiency. Overall, this work highlights factuality as a first-class criterion in watermark evaluation, alongside detectability and robustness, and calls for careful factuality validation before deploying watermarks in fact-critical applications.

摘要：文本水印有助於識別 AI 生成的內容，但其對事實可靠性的影響仍然未被充分探討。在本文中，我們研究水印幻覺：即使在上下文中存在所需證據且未水印模型可以正確回答的情況下，水印所引起或放大的事實錯誤。使用受控的檢索增強生成設置，我們在相同的上下文、查詢和解碼配置下比較了未水印和水印生成，並量化了它們的事實準確性下降。在六種具有代表性的水印方法中，包括 KGW、SWEET、DiPmark、GumbelSoft、Gumbel-Max 和 SynthID 水印，我們始終觀察到水印引起的幻覺。水印輸出在引入事實錯誤的同時仍然可以保持流暢性。我們將這種失效模式歸因於兩個機制：（1）當前步驟中的標記擾動，源於方法特定的重加權或鍵控取樣，以及（2）前綴引起的注意力漂移，這在自回歸解碼過程中累積並削弱了對事實上下文的後續注意力。受到這一分析的啟發，我們提出了兩個可以集成到現有水印方法中的標記和注意力層級的插件干預，以改善事實性。在 1% 假陽性率下達到 0.90 的匹配真陽性率時，結合這兩個干預措施相對於僅水印解碼將事實錯誤減少了約 90%，同時保持流暢性和可比的解碼效率。總體而言，這項工作突出了事實性作為水印評估中的一級標準，與可檢測性和穩健性並列，並呼籲在將水印應用於事實關鍵的應用之前進行仔細的事實性驗證。

docs.title: VoCa: Designing Speech-Canvas Interaction for Voice-Based Conversational Agents
docs.text:
2610.04706v1 by Yate Ge, Run Yuan, Yueran Qi, Wenjie He, Jiaqi Mo, Yangshuo Chen, Wenbin Zuo, Xiaohua Sun, Weiwei Guo, Qi Wang

People write and sketch while speaking to explain, organize, and develop content together. Inspired by these practices, we investigate how voice agents can use a canvas alongside speech in multi-turn conversations with users. We conducted a two-part formative study: an observational study of how pairs coordinated speech and boardwork, followed by a design workshop that informed a design space for speech-canvas interaction with voice agents. Building on these insights, we developed VoCa, a voice agent that coordinates speech with visual object creation, annotation, and attention guidance. A five-day deployment with 18 participants examined usability, experiences of speech-canvas interaction, patterns of use, and desired improvements. Participants' experiences highlighted opportunities for speech-canvas interaction in learning, work, and daily life, alongside challenges in coordinating what agents say and show in ways users can follow and influence. These findings inform how voice agents can use a canvas alongside speech in conversation.

摘要：人們在說話時寫作和素描，以解釋、組織和共同發展內容。受到這些實踐的啟發，我們研究了語音代理如何在與用戶的多輪對話中，將畫布與語音結合使用。我們進行了一項兩部分的形成性研究：首先是觀察研究，了解配對如何協調語音和板面工作，然後是設計工作坊，為語音-畫布互動的設計空間提供了信息。在這些見解的基礎上，我們開發了VoCa，一個將語音與視覺物體創建、註釋和注意力引導協調的語音代理。為期五天的部署與18名參與者一起檢查了可用性、語音-畫布互動的體驗、使用模式和期望的改進。參與者的體驗突顯了在學習、工作和日常生活中進行語音-畫布互動的機會，以及在協調代理所說和所示的內容，使得用戶能夠跟隨和影響的挑戰。這些發現為語音代理如何在對話中將畫布與語音結合使用提供了信息。

docs.title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
docs.text:
2610.04693v1 by Anthony Rhodes

Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.

摘要：代理人正在進入金融、醫療和法律等領域，在這些領域中，違規行為不會留下詞彙簽名，並且會帶來實際的懲罰。是否遺漏是重大，或披露是否足夠，取決於回應中遺漏了什麼。探討這種義務意味著尋找一個最小編輯即可顛覆合規性的回應，而每次探查都需要一代人和兩次裁決的成本，因此對於監管紅隊的約束條件是樣本效率，而不是數量。我們引入了Penumbra，這是一種對抗性搜索，從經過驗證的錨點出發，在擴展的編輯預算下行走，直到兩位評估委員會改變其裁決，並發出兩個相鄰的回應，這些回應跨越了變化。分配是自適應的，目標是覆蓋失敗面：每個候選人解決的不同（義務 x 失敗模式）單元。在匹配預算的情況下，自適應分配在59%的候選人中達到了均勻分配的全預算覆蓋；在相等記錄下，它覆蓋了天真的枚舉的1.43倍失敗模式，並且增益僅限於其目標軸。在60個篩選的金融諮詢憲法義務中，Penumbra返回144對，每對都是一個合規和一個違規的回應，委員會將其置於邊界的兩側，僅在幾個詞上有所不同，而模型要求兩者時，直接生成的文本幾乎沒有共享內容。第二部憲法，針對臨床分診，對18個義務重複了這一過程：49對在同樣的緊密度下，具有相同的最困難模式。這些對顯示了義務自身條款停止決策的地方，這正是根據其部署的代理人必須進行測試的地方，而搜索以與邊界相關的成本找到它們，而不是文本。

docs.title: Bounds, Decompositions and Null Behaviour of KRATOS: A Mathematical Specification of a Recognition-Comparability Diagnostic
docs.text:
2610.04592v1 by Maria Dolores Gonzalez, Alberto Barbado

KRATOS is a group-structured bibliometric diagnostic that compares the distribution of documents (participation) with the distribution of citation weight (recognition) over a fixed, finite universe of analytical groups. This note gives its complete mathematical specification and derives the properties that govern its interpretation. Beyond bounds and equality conditions for each component, we show that the recognition-alignment score depends on citation data only through ratios of group mean citation rates to the corpus mean; that the composition ceiling of the participation--recognition factor is an affine function of the total variation distance to the uniform reference; and that the factor itself satisfies Fréchet-type bounds in terms of this ceiling and a participation-weighted recognition score. We establish an exact logarithmic decomposition of the composite index, an ordering between the primary and a reciprocal-symmetric recognition score, invariance properties, and closed-form first and second moments of the recognition ratios under global and stratified permutation nulls. These results explain why composite orderings can be sensitive to small groups, heavy-tailed citation distributions and metadata reassignment. All results are verified numerically with an accompanying script. The specification concerns measurement structure only; it does not define a measure of epistemic change or justice.

摘要：KRATOS 是一種群體結構的文獻計量診斷工具，它將文檔的分佈（參與度）與固定有限的分析群體中的引用權重分佈（認可度）進行比較。這篇說明提供了其完整的數學規範並推導出支配其解釋的性質。除了每個組件的界限和相等條件外，我們顯示認可對齊分數僅通過群體平均引用率與語料庫平均值的比率來依賴引用數據；參與度-認可度因子的組成上限是與均勻參考的總變異距離的仿射函數；而該因子本身在這個上限和參與加權的認可分數方面滿足 Fréchet 類型的界限。我們建立了複合指數的精確對數分解，主要和對稱互反的認可分數之間的排序，不變性質，以及在全球和分層置換虛無下的認可比率的封閉形式的第一和第二矩。這些結果解釋了為什麼複合排序可能對小群體、重尾引用分佈和元數據重新分配敏感。所有結果都通過附帶的腳本進行了數值驗證。該規範僅涉及測量結構；它並不定義認識變化或正義的度量。

docs.title: $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$: Guiding Agent Evolution from Pattern Recognition to Solution Invention
docs.text:
2610.04555v1 by Wenyin Liu, Yiheng Huang, Kai Wang

We propose $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$ (TRIZ exponentiated by an agent), a general R\&D automation paradigm that combines TRIZ inventive theory with LLM-driven agent evolutionary search. TRIZ's 40 inventive principles and contradiction matrix provide structured, explainable directions for solution generation, replacing random or untyped mutation with theory-guided ideation. Functional information (FI), operationalized under a frozen reference contract, is combined with TRIZ Ideality to measure useful and harmful function on a commensurable information scale, while hard gates keep promotion distinct from metric improvement. We validate $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$ in cybersecurity--an adversarial and rapidly evolving domain--on PowerDuck GOOSE, CICIoT2023, and CIC-DDoS2019. Under paired-rerun protocols with protocol fingerprinting and hard-gate validation, the legacy experiments yield absolute F1 improvements of $+2.88$, $+4.23$, and $+0.15$ percentage points, respectively. A completed 45-activity CICIoT2023 campaign further increases macro-F1 from $0.8325$ to $0.8483$, but does not pass its frozen promotion gate. Every result remains traceable from contradiction identification and TRIZ principle selection to code transformation, evaluation metrics, and promotion decision.

摘要：我們提出 $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$（由代理人指數化的TRIZ），這是一種將TRIZ創新理論與LLM驅動的代理進化搜尋相結合的一般研發自動化範式。TRIZ的40條創新原則和矛盾矩陣為解決方案生成提供了結構化、可解釋的指導，取代了隨機或未標記的變異，並以理論引導的創意代替。功能信息（FI）在凍結的參考合同下進行操作，並與TRIZ理想性相結合，以在可比的信息尺度上衡量有用和有害功能，而硬性閘門則使促進與度量改進區分開來。我們在網絡安全這一對抗性且快速演變的領域中驗證了 $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$，使用PowerDuck GOOSE、CICIoT2023和CIC-DDoS2019。在帶有協議指紋識別和硬閘驗證的配對重跑協議下，傳統實驗分別產生了 $+2.88$、$+4.23$ 和 $+0.15$ 百分點的絕對F1改進。完成的45項CICIoT2023活動進一步將宏觀F1從 $0.8325$ 提高到 $0.8483$，但未通過其凍結的促進閘門。每個結果均可追溯，從矛盾識別和TRIZ原則選擇到代碼轉換、評估指標和促進決策。

docs.title: Specific Algorithmic Interpretability of Neural Networks: A Case Study on Textures
docs.text:
2610.04413v1 by Yanglin Zhang, Anneke von Seeger, Gilad Lerman, Ron Levie

We develop a principled framework for constructing neural networks whose specific parameter realizations admit an explicit algorithmic interpretation. Existing algorithm-inspired architectures can explain the computational structure of a network, yet after standard training the learned parameters need not retain a clear relation to the motivating algorithm. We address this gap as follows. First, we model each data point as a sample of a class-dependent stochastic process and assume that statistics of this process can be estimated from a single sample and these statistics are sufficient to distinguish the classes. We then construct a neural network whose initial parameters exactly implement an algorithm for estimating these statistics, making the network fully interpretable. To account for mismatch between the idealized model and real data, we fine-tune this network while controlling its deviation from the algorithmic initialization. The trained network hence roughly retains the interpretation of the initial network. A PAC-Bayesian analysis yields a uniform generalization bound whose complexity term scales with the fine-tuning radius, providing a statistical motivation for our approach. We instantiate the framework for texture classification using the scattering transform to estimate the discriminative statistics.

摘要：我們開發了一個原則性框架，用於構建神經網絡，其特定的參數實現允許明確的算法解釋。現有的算法啟發架構可以解釋網絡的計算結構，但在標準訓練後，學習到的參數不一定能與激勵算法保持明確的關係。我們如下解決這一差距。首先，我們將每個數據點建模為一個類依賴的隨機過程的樣本，並假設可以從單個樣本中估計該過程的統計量，這些統計量足以區分各類。我們接著構建一個神經網絡，其初始參數完全實現了一個估計這些統計量的算法，使得該網絡完全可解釋。為了考慮理想化模型與實際數據之間的差異，我們在控制其偏離算法初始化的情況下對該網絡進行微調。因此，訓練後的網絡大致保留了初始網絡的解釋。PAC-Bayesian分析產生了一個均勻的泛化界限，其複雜性項隨著微調半徑的增長而增長，為我們的方法提供了統計動機。我們使用散射變換來估計區分性統計量，為紋理分類實現了該框架。

docs.title: CyTReX: Explainable AI-Based Cybersecurity Threat Reasoning Framework for DER Networks
docs.text:
2610.04286v1 by Damilola Popoola, Souradeep Bhattacharya, Manimaran Govindarasu

Distributed Energy Resource (DER) environments rely on network communication protocols to coordinate control commands, measurements, and device states across edge assets and cloud systems. Edge anomaly detection systems (ADS) monitor this traffic to identify deviations from normal communication behavior, flagging suspicious flows for further investigation. When the ADS flags abnormal network traffic, a single attack label is often insufficient for operational response: the label reports the detector's selected class but does not expose alternative threat interpretations that may warrant investigation. This paper presents Cybersecurity Threat Reasoning with Explainable Artificial Intelligence (CyTReX), an evidence-grounded threat reasoning framework for DER security that transforms network-level anomaly alerts into ranked, analyst-facing threat hypotheses designed to support Security Operations Center (SOC) triage and investigation. CyTReX constrains large language model (LLM) reasoning through a structured evidence packet, defined as a consolidated record of detection outputs, model explanations, and cyber threat intelligence (CTI) context. The evidence packet integrates edge-layer anomaly detection evidence, cloud reasoning layer attack interpretation, Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) network-feature attributions, surrogate decision rules, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-enabled CTI enrichment. This ensures that every ranked hypothesis and attack-tree branch is traceable to explicit evidence rather than free-form LLM inference, and that incomplete or conflicting evidence is communicated rather than suppressed. Evaluation across five configurations shows that additional reasoning components improve hypothesis specificity, evidence traceability, and analytical grounding, with the complete pipeline providing the richest evidence-grounded reasoning context.

摘要：分散能源資源（DER）環境依賴網絡通信協議來協調邊緣資產和雲系統之間的控制命令、測量和設備狀態。邊緣異常檢測系統（ADS）監控這些流量，以識別正常通信行為的偏差，並標記可疑流量以供進一步調查。當ADS標記異常網絡流量時，單一的攻擊標籤通常不足以作為操作回應：該標籤報告檢測器選擇的類別，但不揭示可能需要調查的其他威脅解釋。本文提出了帶有可解釋人工智慧的網絡安全威脅推理（CyTReX），這是一個基於證據的威脅推理框架，旨在增強DER安全性，將網絡級異常警報轉化為排名的、面向分析師的威脅假設，旨在支持安全運營中心（SOC）的分類和調查。CyTReX通過結構化的證據包來約束大型語言模型（LLM）推理，該證據包被定義為檢測輸出、模型解釋和網絡威脅情報（CTI）上下文的綜合記錄。證據包整合了邊緣層異常檢測證據、雲推理層攻擊解釋、Shapley加法解釋（SHAP）網絡特徵歸因、替代決策規則和模型上下文協議（MCP）啟用的CTI增強。這確保每個排名的假設和攻擊樹分支都可以追溯到明確的證據，而不是自由形式的LLM推理，並且不完整或矛盾的證據會被傳達而不是壓制。對五個配置的評估顯示，額外的推理組件提高了假設的具體性、證據的可追溯性和分析的基礎，完整的管道提供了最豐富的基於證據的推理上下文。

docs.title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
docs.text:
2610.04156v1 by Mincheol Daniel Song, Joshua Ward, Jake Jung, Guang Cheng

LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. We introduce Sentinel, a trajectory-derived, classifier-based confidence layer that analyzes an agent's reasoning, code and database outputs to decide at three points whether to stop: refusing unanswerable questions before the agent runs, halting doomed trajectories mid-run, and withholding untrustworthy answers at delivery. Here, utilizing Chow's rule, we optimize decisions under the EHRSQL shared task's Reliability Score, which penalizes incorrect answers given a utility weighting, and find on the benchmark EHRSQL that Sentinel raises this score from +0.08 to +0.24 when mistakes have a low utility weighting, well above the +0.03 earned by refusing every question, with delivered-answer accuracy rising from 54% to 69% as coverage falls from 84% to 55%. At higher stakes the agents we test rarely answer reliably enough to deliver, and Sentinel detects this on its own, abstaining to that same +0.03 where the unmonitored agent scores -3.02. The same stopping decisions cut computation: at low stakes, where the system still answers, Sentinel eliminates 13-28% of agent steps at little or no reliability cost.

摘要：LLM 代理在臨床文本轉 SQL 應用中能夠自主推理多個步驟，但無法評估自己的推理或輸出是否可信。在醫療等高槓桿應用中，這帶來了關鍵風險，因為系統錯誤可能代價高昂。這些可靠性失敗也是資源失敗：不正確的推理軌跡會消耗計算預算在必須被丟棄的輸出上。我們介紹了 Sentinel，一種基於軌跡派生的分類器信心層，它分析代理的推理、代碼和數據庫輸出，以在三個點決定是否停止：在代理運行之前拒絕無法回答的問題、中途停止注定失敗的軌跡，以及在交付時不提供不可信的答案。在這裡，利用 Chow 的法則，我們在 EHRSQL 共享任務的可靠性分數下優化決策，該分數對給定效用權重的不正確答案進行懲罰，並發現在基準 EHRSQL 上，當錯誤具有低效用權重時，Sentinel 將此分數從 +0.08 提升至 +0.24，遠高於拒絕每個問題所獲得的 +0.03，交付答案的準確率從 54% 上升至 69%，而覆蓋率從 84% 下降至 55%。在更高風險的情況下，我們測試的代理很少能夠可靠地回答問題，Sentinel 自行檢測到這一點，保持在同樣的 +0.03，而未監控的代理得分為 -3.02。相同的停止決策減少了計算：在低風險下，系統仍然能回答問題，Sentinel 在幾乎沒有可靠性成本的情況下消除了 13-28% 的代理步驟。

docs.title: RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway
docs.text:
2610.06923v1 by Caiwen Jiang, Shuoyang Wei, Songlin Zhao, Junyu Li, Jingyuan Chen, Wei Liu

Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.

摘要：人工智慧已經推進了個別的放射治療任務，然而這些能力仍然在臨床階段、軟體環境和數據模式之間分散。這種碎片化與從治療決策到隨訪的縱向放射治療工作流程形成對比。在此，我們介紹 RadOnc-Agent，一個代理型人工智慧框架，將放射治療正式化為四個臨床階段，並通過對話介面提供 26 個可調用的功能。一個大型語言模型控制器將臨床意圖映射到架構約束的調用，保留患者和工作流程的上下文，並將請求路由到專業服務。我們使用 2,600 個單功能請求（7,800 次重複執行）、200 個預先指定的合成跨階段場景（涵蓋四個階段，600 次執行），以及來自 60 個去識別患者記錄的 120 個工作流程實例（360 次清潔執行）來評估系統執行。RadOnc-Agent 在 98.79% 的單功能執行中選擇了預期功能，完成了 96.50% 的腳本化跨階段工作流程，並完成了 96.67% 的真實患者工作流程執行。在比較消融中，移除縱向狀態使跨階段完成率從 96.50% 降至 84.00%，而禁用架構和身份驗證則使後端調度不匹配的情況從 0% 增加至 95.28% 在重播/測試評估中。這些發現確立了由 LLM 協調的架構在協調異質放射治療能力和信息跨縱向工作流程中的技術可行性；它們並未確立臨床正確性、臨床效用或前瞻性利益。

docs.title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
docs.text:
2610.03872v1 by Peter Chen, Wotao Yin

AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.

摘要：AI代理變得越來越能夠生成科學代碼，但生成代碼並不等同於改善其背後的算法。對於數值求解器來說，執行反饋可以揭示性能不佳，但很少揭示其根本原因以及如何解決它。我們介紹自動診斷與技能發現（ADSD），這是一個將數值診斷與可重用求解器自我改善聯繫起來的框架。ADSD遵循診斷優先的模式，首先解釋為什麼求解器表現不佳，然後利用這一診斷來指導適當數值方法的發現。所產生的知識被打包成可重用的求解器技能，將求解器的改進從試錯編輯轉變為診斷、發現和實施的結構化過程。在四個具有挑戰性的數值領域——功率流方程、交流最佳功率流控制、剛性常微分方程和異質擴散偏微分方程中——ADSD始終提高了求解器的準確性、穩健性和效率。例如，在GOC-500功率流上，ADSD將平均求解器誤差減少了近$71\times$，並且改進進一步轉移到未見的網格拓撲和操作模式。

docs.title: Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies
docs.text:
2610.03693v1 by Jungkyu Park, Dhruva Biswas, Joseph Cappadona, Cerise Tang, Ken G. Zeng, Bartosz Machura, Chuwen Liu, Paolo Tarantino, Coral Omene, Francisco J. Esteva, Rohit Bhargava, Marcin Braun, Kamila Paździerz, Jakub Czerwiński, Hanna Romańska-Knight, Albert Grinshpun, Bareket Daniel, Michele Buchinger, Frederick Howard, Piotr Wysocki, Brie Chun, Freya Schnabel, Rich Caruana, Jan Witowski, Krzysztof J. Geras

Scarcity of labeled data limits development of deep learning biomarkers in oncology. We develop a two-stage AI model predicting pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant therapy in breast cancer. The first stage learns the transcriptome from histopathology using 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types, corroborated by pathologist review and spatial agreement with measured expression. This simplifies the second stage to predicting pCR from inferred expression and clinical variables. Developed using 1,080 patients (five cohorts) and evaluated in 1,412 patients (nine cohorts), the model achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.79 (95% CI, 0.73-0.85), discriminating responders within molecular subtypes. It outperforms histopathological biomarkers, remaining stable across intratumoral sampling and with minimal biopsy tissue. Ablations show transcriptome-wide inference improves discrimination over clinical variables alone or one-stage pathology models, and robustness by avoiding genomic assays' gene selection constraints. These results indicate that biologically informed compression may generalize to data-sparse applications in precision oncology.

摘要：標記數據的稀缺限制了深度學習生物標記在腫瘤學中的發展。我們開發了一個兩階段的人工智慧模型，預測乳腺癌對新輔助療法的病理完全反應（pCR）。第一階段從32種癌症類型的8,742名患者的組織病理學中學習轉錄組，並經病理學家審查及與測量表達的空間一致性進行驗證。這簡化了第二階段，從推斷的表達和臨床變數中預測pCR。該模型使用1,080名患者（五個隊列）開發，並在1,412名患者（九個隊列）中進行評估，達到0.79的合併AUROC（95% CI, 0.73-0.85），能夠在分子亞型中區分反應者。它的表現優於組織病理學生物標記，並在腫瘤內取樣和最小活檢組織中保持穩定。消融結果顯示，轉錄組範圍的推斷在區分方面優於僅依賴臨床變數或單階段病理模型，並通過避免基因組檢測的基因選擇限制來提高穩健性。這些結果表明，生物學知識驅動的壓縮可能對精準腫瘤學中的數據稀缺應用具有普遍性。

docs.title: Beyond Trained Models: Compiling GNNs for a Sound Explainer Benchmark
docs.text:
2610.03526v1 by Steve Azzolin, Francesco Paolo Nerini, Stefano Teso, Francesco Bonchi, Bruno Lepri, André Panisson, Andrea Passerini

Explainers for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are commonly evaluated by their plausibility, i.e., how well their explanations recover a predefined ground truth, such as a motif planted in the data. This protocol implicitly assumes that a GNN trained on such data relies on the intended motif. Although prior work has questioned this assumption, plausibility remains widespread. First, we show that the assumption is violated on several widely used benchmarks, where, e.g., degree statistics alone suffice to solve the task. Then, we remove this confounder by replacing training with compilation. We achieve this by introducing $\mathsf{Gracr}$, the first compiler translating graded modal logic formulas into GNN weights, yielding models that replicate the behaviour of the corresponding formulas. Since the behaviour of the model is now known by construction, we can define its ground truth explanation formally and compute it exactly. Building on this, we introduce $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$, a benchmark of compiled GNNs for the evaluation of explainers against this exact ground truth. Experiments on eleven explainers across six tasks show its effectiveness for fine-grained diagnostic evaluation: notably, we discover that most explainers are not robust to indirect influences or alternative implementations of the same formula. These results position $\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$ as a novel, rigorous evaluation setting for graph post-hoc explainability.

摘要：解釋圖神經網絡（GNNs）通常通過其可信度進行評估，即它們的解釋在多大程度上恢復了預定的真實情況，例如數據中植入的主題。這一協議隱含地假設，基於這類數據訓練的GNN依賴於預期的主題。儘管之前的研究對這一假設提出了質疑，但可信度仍然廣泛存在。首先，我們展示了這一假設在幾個廣泛使用的基準上被違反，例如，僅僅依賴度數統計就足以解決該任務。然後，我們通過用編譯替代訓練來消除這一混淆因素。我們通過引入$\mathsf{Gracr}$來實現這一點，這是第一個將分級模態邏輯公式轉換為GNN權重的編譯器，從而產生能夠複製相應公式行為的模型。由於模型的行為現在是通過構造來確定的，我們可以正式定義其真實解釋並準確計算。基於此，我們引入了$\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$，這是一個編譯GNN的基準，用於根據這一精確真實情況對解釋器進行評估。在六個任務上對十一個解釋器的實驗顯示了其在細粒度診斷評估中的有效性：值得注意的是，我們發現大多數解釋器對間接影響或同一公式的替代實現並不穩健。這些結果使得$\mathsf{Gracr}\mathsf{Bench}$成為一個新穎而嚴謹的圖後驗可解釋性評估環境。

docs.title: Efficient Reasoning Training Does Not Always Harm CoT Faithfulness and Monitorability
docs.text:
2610.03509v1 by Samuel Lewis-Lim, Xingwei Tan, Mario Sanger, Zhixue Zhao, Nikolaos Aletras

Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning allows humans to inspect how large language models reach their answers, and oversee model behaviour. This reasoning comes at an increased inference cost, motivating efficient methods that train models to solve tasks using fewer tokens. However, a common concern is that such training may cause models to skip important reasoning steps, so the CoT no longer faithfully reflects the model's decision. It is unclear whether or when this occurs in practice, since different efficiency methods apply length pressure to models' CoT in distinct ways, and faithfully explaining a model's decision takes more tokens on some tasks than others. To understand these dynamics, we fine-tune a variety of models with three methods that apply length pressure differently, namely a fixed generation budget, a per-example length target, and a group-relative length reward. We evaluate how efficient reasoning affects CoT faithfulness (i.e., how well the CoT reflects model decisions on related inputs) and monitorability (i.e., whether the CoT reveals when input interventions alter the output). We find that it affects faithfulness and monitorability differently. Faithfulness falls in most settings, primarily because the trained models are less consistent. Monitorability is more robust, as models keep acknowledging the influence on their answer even when the CoT is much shorter.

摘要：Chain-of-thought (CoT) 推理使人類能夠檢查大型語言模型如何得出答案，並監控模型行為。這種推理帶來了更高的推理成本，促使開發高效的方法來訓練模型以使用更少的標記解決任務。然而，一個常見的擔憂是這種訓練可能導致模型跳過重要的推理步驟，因此 CoT 不再忠實地反映模型的決策。目前尚不清楚這是否會在實踐中發生，以及何時發生，因為不同的效率方法以不同的方式對模型的 CoT 施加長度壓力，而忠實地解釋模型的決策在某些任務上需要的標記比其他任務多。為了理解這些動態，我們使用三種以不同方式施加長度壓力的方法對多種模型進行微調，這些方法分別是固定生成預算、每個示例的長度目標和群體相對長度獎勵。我們評估高效推理如何影響 CoT 的忠實性（即 CoT 在相關輸入上反映模型決策的程度）和可監控性（即 CoT 是否顯示當輸入干預改變輸出時）。我們發現它對忠實性和可監控性有不同的影響。在大多數設置中，忠實性下降，主要是因為訓練後的模型一致性較差。可監控性則更為穩健，因為即使 CoT 短得多，模型仍然保持承認其答案受影響。

docs.title: Certified Mechanistic Edits: Behavioral Guarantees for Skill Removal and Preservation
docs.text:
2610.03502v1 by Md Sazid Uddin, Md. Khairul Alam Mazumder, M. F. Mridha

Mechanistic edits (ablations, weight edits, activation steering) are the standard tools for unlearning a harmful capability from a neural network while preserving useful ones. Current approaches validate their effects only by testing, which can never cover an entire continuous region of inputs. Prior work at the interpretability-verification boundary certifies descriptions of a model: what a circuit computes, or whether it faithfully explains the whole. We instead certify the behavioral effect of an edit: that disabling a circuit removes one skill and provably preserves another, for every input in a region; a feature non-interference guarantee in the information-flow-security sense. We demonstrate such certified edits from toy ReLU networks up to a standard softmax + LayerNorm transformer, proving removal and preservation over continuous embedding-space regions and reaching roughly 9x the input-perturbation dimension an exact solver can handle by switching to sound bound propagation. Furthermore, we prove that no finite deterministic black-box test can certify removal, exhibiting an edit that passes exhaustive testing yet provably fails on a survivor pocket that can be made arbitrarily small. Guarantees hold on small, standard-architecture networks and, like any removal claim, presuppose that the target skill admits a decidable specification, a property which real-world harms may not have.

摘要：機制編輯（去除、權重編輯、激活引導）是從神經網絡中去除有害能力的標準工具，同時保留有用的能力。當前的方法僅通過測試來驗證其效果，這永遠無法覆蓋整個連續的輸入區域。先前在可解釋性驗證邊界的工作認證了模型的描述：一個電路計算了什麼，或者它是否忠實地解釋了整個模型。我們則認證編輯的行為效果：禁用一個電路會去除一項技能，並且在一個區域內對每個輸入可證明保留另一項技能；這在信息流安全的意義上是一種特徵非干擾保證。我們展示了從玩具 ReLU 網絡到標準 softmax + LayerNorm Transformer的這種認證編輯，證明了在連續嵌入空間區域內的去除和保留，並達到了大約 9 倍於精確求解器可以處理的輸入擾動維度，通過切換到聲音邊界傳播。此外，我們證明沒有有限的確定性黑箱測試可以認證去除，展示了一個通過全面測試卻在可以任意縮小的生存口袋上可證明失敗的編輯。保證適用於小型標準架構網絡，並且像任何去除聲明一樣，假設目標技能允許可決定的規範，這一特性在現實世界的危害中可能不存在。

docs.title: Becoming Suspicious Across Borders: Algorithmic Extraterritoriality and AI-Driven Financial Surveillance
docs.text:
2610.03425v1 by Georgios Pavlidis, Savvas Chatzichristofis, Eleni Gavriil

Suspicion is an important, yet elusive concept in anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CFT), which allows for intervention below the threshold of proof. In its traditional form, suspicion can be understood as a situated legal judgement by human actors within identifiable jurisdictions. It is argued that this understanding is no longer adequate. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes an integral part of financial surveillance, suspicion is increasingly produced through data-driven processes. This transformation is epistemic, but also spatial. Since AI-driven financial surveillance operates through transnational data infrastructures, regulatory reach is less a matter of where conduct occurs than a question of whether such conduct becomes visible within data systems. This article develops the concept of algorithmic extraterritoriality, understood as a form of regulatory power mediated by data infrastructures rather than formal assertions of jurisdiction. Moreover, since individuals are increasingly constituted as datafied subjects of suspicion, they are rendered governable through dispersed and opaque processes of evaluation. This constitutes a challenge for accountability and contestability because suspicion becomes more difficult to locate, explain or contest.

摘要：懷疑是一個重要但難以捉摸的概念，在反洗錢和反恐怖主義融資（AML/CFT）中，它允許在證據門檻以下進行干預。在其傳統形式中，懷疑可以理解為人類行為者在可識別的司法管轄區內的情境法律判斷。有人認為這種理解已不再足夠。隨著人工智慧（AI）成為金融監控的重要組成部分，懷疑越來越多地通過數據驅動的過程產生。這一轉變是認識論上的，但也是空間上的。由於AI驅動的金融監控通過跨國數據基礎設施運作，監管的範圍不再僅僅取決於行為發生的地點，而是成為一個問題，即這種行為是否在數據系統中變得可見。本文發展了算法領土外性（algorithmic extraterritoriality）的概念，理解為一種通過數據基礎設施中介的監管權力形式，而非正式的管轄權主張。此外，由於個體越來越多地被構成為數據化的懷疑主體，他們通過分散且不透明的評估過程被賦予可治理性。這對問責制和可爭議性構成了挑戰，因為懷疑變得更難以定位、解釋或質疑。

docs.title: Multilingual GSM-Symbolic: What determines capability transfer across languages?
docs.text:
2610.03367v2 by Kenneth Enevoldsen, Riley Herchert, Sofie Mosegaard, Dan Saattrup Smart, Simon Enni, Isaac Chung, Sofie Bruun, Ayush Sunil Munot, Max Müller-Eberstein, Adnan El-Assadi, Elisa Bassignana, Gianluca Barmina, Hafsteinn Einarsson, Iben Nyholm Debess, Linda Freienthal, Lukas Galke Poech, Mike Zhang, Nicolas Legrand, Vladimir Salnikov, Yevhen Kostiuk, Zafar Hussain, Sagandeep Kaur, Agnes Toftgård, Marie Mattson, Kristoffer Nielbo

We understand little about how capabilities acquired in one language carry over to another, or what governs this transfer: evaluations rely on incomparable, saturation-prone datasets and rarely examine its determinants jointly. Identifying what predicts transfer would let us avoid exhaustive evaluation across all language pairs and let developers target the factors that limit performance in low-resource languages. To evaluate cross-lingual capability transfer, we introduce Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, an extensible multilingual mathematical dataset covering 30,000 item-matched question-answer pairs and spanning 15 languages. It utilises symbolic templates to prevent overfitting and ensure generalisation by allowing generation of millions of high-quality variations from a single sample. Using Multilingual GSM-Symbolic, we quantify the largest determinants of capability as model size ($β= 1.77$), language resource level ($β= 0.77$), reasoning ($β= 0.67$) and typological distance ($β= -0.25$). This joint estimation allows these determinants to be expressed in terms of one another: a 32B model evaluated in Marathi performs like a 10B model in English. Our findings have important implications for model developers, showing that model size and reasoning narrow the performance gap between low- and high-resource languages ($β= -0.27$ and $β= -0.20$, respectively), while similar levers have little or no effect on typologically distant languages. Overall, our analysis framework explains 92% of between-language variation, but only 23% of the model-by-language variation, and predicts a model's performance on an unseen language within 6.0pp (r=.96). Incorporating measurements from just 10 templates in the target language reduces this to 4.19pp, enabling reasonable estimates of performance with little or no downstream dataset.

摘要：我們對於在一種語言中獲得的能力如何轉移到另一種語言，或是什麼因素主導這種轉移了解甚少：評估依賴於不可比擬、易於飽和的數據集，並且很少共同檢查其決定因素。識別出預測轉移的因素將使我們能夠避免對所有語言對進行耗時的評估，並讓開發者針對限制低資源語言表現的因素進行調整。為了評估跨語言能力轉移，我們引入了多語言GSM-符號，這是一個可擴展的多語言數學數據集，涵蓋了30,000個項目匹配的問答對，並涵蓋15種語言。它利用符號模板來防止過擬合，並確保通用性，通過允許從單一樣本生成數百萬個高質量變體。使用多語言GSM-符號，我們量化了能力的最大決定因素，包括模型大小（$β= 1.77$）、語言資源水平（$β= 0.77$）、推理（$β= 0.67$）和類型距離（$β= -0.25$）。這種聯合估計使得這些決定因素可以相互表達：一個在馬拉地語中評估的32B模型表現得像一個在英語中評估的10B模型。我們的發現對模型開發者具有重要意義，顯示模型大小和推理縮小了低資源語言和高資源語言之間的性能差距（分別為$β= -0.27$和$β= -0.20$），而類似的因素對於類型上相距遙遠的語言幾乎沒有影響。總體而言，我們的分析框架解釋了92%的語言間變異，但僅解釋了23%的模型與語言變異，並在6.0pp內預測模型在未見語言上的表現（r=.96）。僅從目標語言的10個模板中納入測量，便將此數字降低至4.19pp，使得在幾乎沒有下游數據集的情況下能夠合理估算性能。

docs.title: Gains and Collapse in On-Policy Distillation:A Reinforcement Learning Perspective
docs.text:
2610.03185v1 by Han Cui, Jianhao Yan, Yun Luo, Hongbo Zhang, Zhizhang Fu, Yue Zhang

On-policy distillation (OPD) has become an important approach to language model post-training. However, despite its performance gains, OPD can also collapse into excessively long and repetitive generation, and the mechanism underlying these divergent outcomes remains poorly understood. We explain these outcomes through a reinforcement learning perspective: the teacher implicitly rewards student behaviors, even those it rarely exhibits itself. From this perspective, our experiments show that OPD improves performance without expanding the student's capabilities. When the implicit reward model is reliable, OPD makes correct responses easier to sample. In contrast, when the preference misaligns with quality, reward hacking happens: the implicit reward model amplifies overlong, repetitive student rollouts, even though it rarely generates such text itself. Guided by this diagnosis, we find that masking unhealthy responses during training and using SFT initialization can each effectively mitigate the collapse. Together, these findings show that OPD amplifies student behaviors favored by the teacher's implicit feedback, shifting the focus from how well the teacher generates to how reliably it evaluates student rollouts. Our code is available at https://github.com/HancCui/opd_hacking.

摘要：在政策蒸餾（OPD）已成為語言模型後訓練的一個重要方法。然而，儘管其性能有所提升，OPD 也可能陷入過於冗長和重複的生成，這些不同結果背後的機制仍然不太明瞭。我們通過強化學習的角度來解釋這些結果：教師隱性地獎勵學生行為，即使是那些它自己很少表現的行為。從這個角度來看，我們的實驗顯示 OPD 在不擴展學生能力的情況下提高了性能。當隱性獎勵模型可靠時，OPD 使得正確的反應更容易被抽樣。相反，當偏好與質量不一致時，獎勵黑客行為就會發生：隱性獎勵模型放大了過長、重複的學生生成，即使它自己很少生成這樣的文本。根據這一診斷，我們發現，在訓練期間屏蔽不健康的反應和使用 SFT 初始化都可以有效減輕崩潰。綜合這些發現顯示，OPD 放大了教師隱性反饋所偏好的學生行為，將重點從教師生成的質量轉移到教師對學生生成的評估的可靠性上。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/HancCui/opd_hacking 獲得。

docs.title: OncoNoteBERT: A Foundation Representation Model for Natural Language Processing of Real-World Outpatient Oncology Notes
docs.text:
2610.03829v1 by Wuraola Oyewusi, Eliana Vasquez Osorio, Goran Nenadic, Gareth Price

Real-world outpatient oncology notes contain specialised terminology, tumour staging expressions, treatment names, toxicity descriptions, and institution-specific de-identification markers that may not be represented efficiently by general biomedical or adjacent clinical language models. We developed and evaluated oncology-specific BERT-style encoders using a governed UK outpatient oncology corpus comprising 290,026 notes from 21,564 patients treated for lung and head-and-neck cancer. We compared RadBERT and PathologyBERT with two local strategies: OncoNote-RadBERT, produced by continued masked language model pretraining, and OncoNoteBERT, trained from scratch with an oncology WordPiece tokenizer. Models were evaluated using masked language modelling loss and perplexity on the validation set, tokenizer fragmentation metrics, clinical term tokenisation, masked-token probes, and exploratory representation analysis. Both external encoders fit the oncology corpus poorly in zero-shot evaluation (perplexity 113.04 for RadBERT; 2035.03 for PathologyBERT), while continued pretraining produced the strongest fit (2.10 for OncoNote-RadBERT). OncoNoteBERT achieved perplexity 2.83 but produced the most efficient tokenisation, with lower subword fertility and shorter normalised sequence length. It also returned a clinically acceptable prediction for 12 of 13 masked-token probes, compared with 7 of 13 for OncoNote-RadBERT. This divergence between corpus-level fit and masked-token performance was partly attributable to tokenizer fragmentation rather than learned semantics alone. Both locally developed models represented the institutional placeholder as a single learnable token. These findings show that continued adaptation and bespoke tokenisation provide complementary benefits, and that representation-layer design matters before adjacent-domain encoders are applied to oncology NLP.

摘要：真實世界的門診腫瘤科筆記包含專業術語、腫瘤分期表達、治療名稱、毒性描述，以及可能無法被一般生物醫學或相近臨床語言模型有效表達的機構特定去識別化標記。我們開發並評估了腫瘤科特定的BERT風格編碼器，使用了一個由290,026份來自21,564名接受肺癌和頭頸癌治療的患者的筆記組成的英國門診腫瘤科語料庫。我們將RadBERT和PathologyBERT與兩種本地策略進行比較：OncoNote-RadBERT，通過持續的掩碼語言模型預訓練生成，以及OncoNoteBERT，使用腫瘤科WordPiece分詞器從零開始訓練。模型的評估使用了掩碼語言建模損失和驗證集上的困惑度、分詞器碎片化度量、臨床術語分詞、掩碼標記探針和探索性表示分析。在零-shot評估中，兩個外部編碼器對腫瘤科語料庫的擬合效果較差（RadBERT的困惑度為113.04；PathologyBERT為2035.03），而持續預訓練產生了最強的擬合效果（OncoNote-RadBERT為2.10）。OncoNoteBERT達到了困惑度2.83，但產生了最有效的分詞，具有較低的子詞繁殖率和較短的標準化序列長度。與OncoNote-RadBERT的13個掩碼標記探針中的7個相比，它還為13個掩碼標記探針返回了臨床上可接受的預測。語料庫級擬合和掩碼標記性能之間的這種差異部分可歸因於分詞器的碎片化，而不僅僅是學習的語義。這兩個本地開發的模型將機構佔位符表示為一個可學習的單一標記。這些發現顯示，持續的適應和定制的分詞提供了互補的好處，並且在將相近領域的編碼器應用於腫瘤科NLP之前，表示層設計是重要的。

docs.title: Multimodal reasoning for broadly neutralizing antibody discovery from label-free human B cell repertoires across virus families
docs.text:
2610.03160v1 by Hantao Lou, Jianqing Zheng, Can Yue, Meihan Zhang, Yuanchao Bao, Yu Chen, Mengting Huang, Yupeng Yang, Qianyu Pan, Nana Fu, Yansong Shi, Hongli Li, Yangyang Chai, Ruyi Chen, Wansheng Li, Zhu Liang, Rongmei Yao, Yuanhan Mo, Lei Wang, Chunmei Wang, Yun Quan, Qiong Zhang, Xiangxi Wang, Xuetao Cao

Discovering broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) from human natural immune repertoires remains a fundamental challenge in immunology, hindered by: the extreme rarity of bnAb, incomplete understanding of their cellular origins across pathogens, and the inability of existing computational tools to generalize across emerging viral threats. Here we present ImmuneAgent, a closed-loop AI system that integrates multimodal reasoning with continual meta-learning and wet-lab feedback to overcome these barriers. Applied to screen the natural BCR repertoires from vaccinated or infected cohorts, the system achieves a ~55% neutralization antibody discovery rate (60 of 110 cloned candidates) and a ~11% bnAb yield (12 of 110), substantially outperforming a state-of-the-art sequence-based neutralization predictor or cofolding models evaluated at the same cloning budget. Five ImmuneAgent-discovered antibodies conferred 100% in vivo protection against lethal influenza challenge, comparable to the clinical-stage therapeutic MEDI8852. The system recovered the cellular and structural determinants of bnAb activity and identified FCRL5+CD27+ atypical memory B cells as a conserved bnAb reservoir and hydrophobic interface enrichment as a cross-viral structural signature, which generalized to unseen antigens, discovering human metapneumovirus (hMPV) cross-neutralizing and human papillomavirus (HPV)-neutralizing antibodies without antigen-specific sorting. These results validate that ImmuneAgent is a generalizable framework for rapid therapeutic antibody discovery against emerging viral threats.

摘要：發現來自人類自然免疫庫的廣泛中和抗體（bnAbs）仍然是免疫學中的一項基本挑戰，這受到以下因素的阻礙：bnAb的極端稀有性、對其在各種病原體中細胞來源的不完全理解，以及現有計算工具無法在新興病毒威脅中進行泛化。在此，我們提出了ImmuneAgent，一個封閉迴路的人工智慧系統，將多模態推理與持續的元學習及實驗室反饋相結合，以克服這些障礙。該系統應用於篩選來自接種或感染群體的自然BCR庫，實現了約55%的中和抗體發現率（110個克隆候選者中的60個）和約11%的bnAb產率（110個中的12個），顯著優於在相同克隆預算下評估的最先進序列基礎中和預測器或共折疊模型。五個由ImmuneAgent發現的抗體在致死性流感挑戰中提供了100%的體內保護，與臨床階段的治療藥物MEDI8852相當。該系統恢復了bnAb活性的細胞和結構決定因素，並確定FCRL5+CD27+非典型記憶B細胞作為保守的bnAb儲備，以及疏水界面富集作為跨病毒結構特徵，這一特徵可泛化至未見抗原，發現了人類副流感病毒（hMPV）交叉中和和人類乳突病毒（HPV）中和抗體，無需抗原特異性分選。這些結果驗證了ImmuneAgent是一個可泛化的框架，用於快速發現針對新興病毒威脅的治療抗體。

docs.title: The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer
docs.text:
2610.03827v2 by Saman Rahbar

Similarity scores are often offered as evidence that a model shares structure with the brain or across languages. We ask what such a score reads when that structure is removed, or when the instrument measuring it does not work, in two settings. Across seventeen languages, a grammaticality probe transfers worse between more distant languages (r = -0.66). But the probe's own accuracy falls along the same axis and is at chance in four languages, four of the five most distant. Dropping them halves the explained variance, and because it also narrows the range of distances, the design cannot say how much of the gradient is the instrument. Counting the 272 language pairs as independent gives p = 0.0006 for a steering effect that is null when the seventeen languages are the unit (p = 0.155). In brain alignment, a training objective raises a language model's similarity to fMRI responses from 0.10 to 0.34 (reliability ceiling 0.54), yet targets with the brain correspondence destroyed still reach 0.31. A shuffled target scores about k/n against the real one, for rank k and n sentences, a baseline that can be computed before any model is trained. Both interventions work, yet we detect no distance-graded steering effect and no syntactic benefit from alignment. Before reading a correspondence score, measure how much of it survives without the correspondence.

摘要：相似度分數通常被用作證據，表明模型與大腦或不同語言之間共享結構。我們詢問在該結構被移除或測量該結構的工具無法運作時，這樣的分數會顯示什麼，在兩種情境中。在十七種語言中，語法性探測器在更遙遠的語言之間轉移效果較差（r = -0.66）。但探測器自身的準確性沿著相同的軸線下降，在四種語言中達到隨機水平，這四種語言是五種最遙遠的語言之一。去掉這些語言後，解釋的變異數減半，並且因為這也縮小了距離範圍，這個設計無法說明梯度中有多少是工具的影響。將272對語言視為獨立的，對於一個在十七種語言為單位的引導效應，得到了p = 0.0006（當十七種語言為單位時，p = 0.155則為零）。在大腦對齊中，訓練目標將語言模型與fMRI反應的相似度從0.10提高到0.34（可靠性上限0.54），然而當大腦對應被破壞的目標仍然達到0.31。一個隨機排列的目標對真實目標的得分約為k/n，對於排名k和n句子，這是一個可以在任何模型訓練之前計算的基準。兩種干預都有效，但我們未檢測到距離分級的引導效應，也未從對齊中獲得任何句法好處。在閱讀對應分數之前，測量在沒有對應的情況下有多少分數能夠存活。

docs.title: Abstracts
Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
docs.text:
2610.12445v1 by Oskar J. Hollinsworth, Alex F. Spies, Tigist Diriba, Adam Gleave, Chris Cundy

Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.

摘要：最近的事件突顯了監控 LLM 代理的挑戰以及模型欺騙人類的危險。我們顯示通過探針的白盒欺騙檢測可以擴展到前沿監控設置，方法是收集迄今為止最大的欺騙數據集來訓練探針，並引入一種新穎的探針架構，可以在多層和多個標記之間聚合信息。我們的探針在 SHADE-Arena 中達到了 98.8% 的 AUC，超越了 Opus 5.5 的文本監控基準，並顯示出隨著基礎模型的擴展，效能有所改善。為了將我們的探針推向極限，我們在幾個情況下進行測試，在這些情況下，僅從上下文無法確定欺騙。在這些情況中，我們稱之為內省欺騙，真實情況只能通過仔細引導或對模型訓練數據的透徹了解來確定。在其中一次評估中，我們顯示探針可以區分包含模型真正隱藏目標的轉錄本與其他目標，AUC 高達 99.7%。我們的探針還能輕易檢測出在政治敏感話題上撒謊的顯著開放權重模型，以及在壓力下對其信念的表述。我們發布了名為 FIBS 的訓練數據集，以幫助推動有效探針的前沿部署，並鼓勵社群以更多的欺騙和破壞例子來擴展這一數據集。

docs.title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
docs.text:
2610.12337v1 by Jialei He, Enhe Liu, Sifan Song, Pengfei Jin, Jionglong Su, Hongbin Wang, Zhixiang Lu, Yanhao Huang, Anteng Cai, Zhengyong Jiang, Jiaman Ding, S. Kevin Zhou, Jinfeng Wang

Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.

摘要：解剖連續性為醫學影像重建提供了補充信息，但其使用需要考慮局部解剖結構和切片取樣的變異。我們介紹了ContiLNN，它通過雙向封閉形式的連續時間（Bi-CfC）模塊增強了二維重建骨幹，以進行切片間建模，同時保留平面內特徵提取。切片索引間隔調節由局部特徵和隱藏狀態決定的閘門，使得傳播能夠響應取樣變異，而無需數值ODE整合。參考引導的一致性將第一和第二階切片強度差異對齊，以保留解剖變異，同時從凍結的骨幹中進行蒸餾有助於保持平面內的真實性。在五個訓練種子中，ContiLNN在CT去噪、MRI超解析度和減少計數的PET重建方面，分別提高了平均PSNR 0.1907、1.0176和1.2482 dB，且在所有三個任務中RMSE均較低。CT結果對於一名保留的患者具有描述性。PET消融支持超出額外點狀容量的有序傳播。在連續訓練下，Bi-CfC在所有測試的取樣條件下實現了比擁有相似參數數量和算術成本的Bi-GRU更高的真實性。匹配的七切片分析顯示其延遲低52.8%和峰值GPU內存使用低57.0%相比Bi-GRU。混合間隙訓練改善了兩個運算元的稀疏和不規則上下文性能，但在指標和上下文中並未形成統一的排名。對於較少的訓練患者和第二個骨幹的實驗進一步支持了數據效率和骨幹兼容性。

docs.title: OA-MAP: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Multimodal Framework for Interpretable Knee Osteoarthritis Progression
docs.text:
2610.12134v1 by Sixu Chen, Mingrui Yang, Qiang Guan, Xiaojuan Li

Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) progression prediction can support patient monitoring, requiring the integration of multimodal data and multidomain expertise. Moreover, isolated risk estimates provide limited insight underlying a prediction. To automate the progression assessment workflow and reduce manual effort while providing interpretable findings and supporting evidence, we present OA-MAP, an autonomous multi-agent framework for evidence-grounded assessment of structural and pain progression in KOA. The system incorporates modality-specific agents including MRI, X-ray, and clinical agents, together with a coordinator agent. This framework can autonomously recruit specialist agents, select tools for prediction and analysis, and retrieve literature as external evidence based on user request and available patient information. An uncertainty-informed human-in-the-loop mechanism enables clinicians to review and correct intermediate findings, triggering recomputation of affected results. We evaluate the prediction models using 600 participants from the FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium cohort. On the test set of 100 participants, the fusion models achieve AUROCs of 0.80 for structural progression and 0.68 for pain progression. A case study illustrates how OA-MAP combines risk estimates with intermediate findings, cross-modal conflicts, literature support, and uncertainty indicators to support interactive review.

摘要：膝關節骨關節炎（KOA）進展預測可以支持患者監測，這需要整合多模態數據和多領域專業知識。此外，孤立的風險估計對於預測的基本洞察提供有限的幫助。為了自動化進展評估工作流程並減少手動工作，同時提供可解釋的發現和支持證據，我們提出了OA-MAP，這是一個自動化的多代理框架，用於基於證據的KOA結構和疼痛進展評估。該系統包含特定模態的代理，包括MRI、X光和臨床代理，以及一個協調代理。這個框架可以自主招募專家代理，選擇預測和分析工具，並根據用戶請求和可用的患者信息檢索文獻作為外部證據。一個不確定性知情的人工介入機制使臨床醫生能夠審查和修正中間發現，觸發受影響結果的重新計算。我們使用來自FNIH骨關節炎生物標誌物聯盟隊列的600名參與者來評估預測模型。在100名參與者的測試集上，融合模型在結構進展方面達到0.80的AUROC，在疼痛進展方面達到0.68的AUROC。一個案例研究說明了OA-MAP如何將風險估計與中間發現、跨模態衝突、文獻支持和不確定性指標結合，以支持互動審查。

docs.title: Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction for Effective Subgroup Reliability
docs.text:
2610.11957v1 by Meihui Zhong, Wenxin Tai, Ting Zhong, Fan Zhou

Conformal prediction offers a distribution-free coverage guarantee, making it especially attractive for clinical applications. Standard conformal prediction, however, provides such guarantees only at the population level, and its prediction sets can exhibit coverage disparities across clinically important subgroups. A natural remedy is to calibrate within predefined groups. However, this can require access to sensitive subgroup attributes and is prone to a worst-group bottleneck: protecting the most difficult subgroup can inflate prediction sets for all, increasing cognitive burden on decision makers. To this end, we propose Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction (SGCP), a conformal framework for subgroup-reliable uncertainty quantification. It learns a stochastic grouping map that allows each sample to draw calibration information from others with similar calibration behavior, yielding a local score law that boosts reliability across subpopulations. We prove that SGCP retains the standard coverage guarantee. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that it consistently reduces subgroup coverage gaps while achieving smaller or comparable prediction set sizes relative to existing baselines.

摘要：符合預測提供了一種無分佈的覆蓋保證，使其在臨床應用中特別具吸引力。然後，標準的符合預測僅在整體層面提供這樣的保證，其預測集可能在臨床上重要的子群體之間顯示出覆蓋差異。一個自然的解決方案是在預定義的群體內進行校準。然而，這可能需要訪問敏感的子群體屬性，並且容易出現最差群體的瓶頸：保護最困難的子群體可能會膨脹所有人的預測集，增加決策者的認知負擔。為此，我們提出了隨機分組符合預測（SGCP），這是一種針對子群體可靠的不確定性量化的符合框架。它學習一個隨機分組映射，允許每個樣本從具有相似校準行為的其他樣本中獲取校準信息，產生一種局部得分法則，增強子群體之間的可靠性。我們證明SGCP保留了標準的覆蓋保證。在合成和現實世界基準上的實驗顯示，它始終減少子群體覆蓋差距，同時相對於現有基準達到更小或可比較的預測集大小。

docs.title: Intervention anchors and scientific verification in synthetic vascular predictive representations
docs.text:
2610.11704v1 by Lingsen You, Yujun Guo, Xinyu Zhong, Zisu Peng, Wentong Wang, Li Shen, Junbo Ge

Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates do not by themselves bind a latent direction to a named intervention. We present a mathematical and synthetic audit motivated by vascular device-vessel suitcordance. Capacity-matched least-squares predictors were exactly equivalent under complete fixed output transforms, whereas an anchor-only observer recovered interpretations only within the span of known perturbation signatures. Six three-dimensional configurations across 64 seeds gave a maximum paired prediction discrepancy of 6.7e-15 but a median untransported edit error of 1.513. Coordinate transport removed that error. Noisy and weak anchors constrained calibration stability, and changing the representation basis required recalibration or verified transport. Across 256 additional fits in dimensions 3-24, prediction equivalence persisted within 4.0e-15. We then evaluated nine deliberate runnable fault classes across 64 seeds. All 576 faulty executions completed, but each violated at least one reconstruction, prediction, delivered-edit or scope contract; all 320 valid control records passed. Repeating a faulty implementation gave exact self-agreement despite error against the separately computed simulator expectation. For one omitted-direction defect, probe coverage followed its analytic law, and rank-aware abstention protected unsupported interpretations. Scalar-noise experiments exposed both missed weak faults and excessive rejection under narrow relative tolerances. These controls provide an executable separation of prediction, semantic support and scientific acceptance. They are synthetic numerical audits, not clinical validation, neural JEPA-Anything replication, agent learning or patient treatment-effect estimation.

摘要：完整的正交預測坐標本身並不將潛在方向與命名的干預綁定。我們提出了一個數學和合成的審計，這是由血管裝置與血管的適配性所驅動。容量匹配的最小二乘預測器在完全固定輸出變換下是完全等價的，而僅依賴錨點的觀察者僅在已知擾動特徵的範圍內恢復解釋。六個三維配置在64個種子中給出了最大配對預測差異為6.7e-15，但中位數未傳輸編輯錯誤為1.513。坐標傳輸消除了該錯誤。嘈雜和弱錨點限制了校準穩定性，並且改變表示基礎需要重新校準或驗證傳輸。在3-24維的256個額外擬合中，預測等價性在4.0e-15內持續存在。我們然後評估了九個故意可執行的故障類別，涵蓋64個種子。所有576個故障執行均已完成，但每個都違反了至少一個重建、預測、交付編輯或範圍合同；所有320個有效控制記錄均通過。重複故障實現給出了精確的自我一致性，即使與單獨計算的模擬器期望存在錯誤。對於一個省略方向的缺陷，探測覆蓋遵循其分析法則，而考慮排名的棄權保護了不支持的解釋。標量噪聲實驗暴露了錯過的弱故障和在狹窄相對容忍度下的過度拒絕。這些控制提供了預測、語義支持和科學接受之間的可執行分離。它們是合成的數值審計，而不是臨床驗證、神經JEPA-任何複製、代理學習或患者治療效果估計。

docs.title: Beyond Report Imitation: Clinically Aware Multi-Image Ultrasound Report Generation from Visible Evidence
docs.text:
2610.11610v1 by Yuchen Yang, Xin Wang, Lufan Wang, Yinghong Pan, Yujuan Feng, Yuqing Yang

Generating ultrasound reports from multiple images requires aggregating clinical evidence across views, yet archived key frames capture only part of the dynamic examination. Raw-report imitation is therefore misaligned with visual supervision: content that is clinically valid for the full examination may be unverifiable from the images available to a model. This gap creates a clinical behavior alignment problem. A model must preserve visible findings, avoid diagnostic reversals and unsupported completion, and not collapse into conservative templates. We propose CAMEO, a Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration framework for ultrasound report generation. Stage I learns ultrasound visual-language primitives; Stage II performs Cross-View Evidence Grounding by distilling trusted visible report points into multi-image QA and report-style supervision; and Stage III performs Clinically Aware Preference Alignment using clinical-error-oriented preference pairs. From USReport, we construct USReport-Distilled with 17,670 evidence-grounded paired-image training instances and USReport-Pref with 21,869 preference pairs; we additionally use 25,631 PubMedVision-US ultrasound instruction samples for domain adaptation and multi-image instruction tuning. On the primary USReport-Distilled benchmark, CAMEO improves over EchoVLM from 0.25 to 0.40 BLEU-1, 0.28 to 0.45 ROUGE-1, and 0.27 to 0.43 METEOR, while raising ClinicalScore from 55.02 to 74.20. These results underscore the value of evidence-grounded supervision, clinically aware alignment, and clinically structured evaluation for reliable ultrasound report generation.

摘要：生成超聲報告需要從多個影像中聚合臨床證據，然而存檔的關鍵幀僅捕捉到動態檢查的一部分。原始報告的模仿因此與視覺監督不一致：對於完整檢查而言，臨床有效的內容可能無法從模型可用的影像中驗證。這一差距造成了臨床行為對齊問題。模型必須保留可見的發現，避免診斷逆轉和不支持的完成，並且不能陷入保守的模板。我們提出了 CAMEO，一個臨床意識的多影像證據為基礎的協調框架，用於超聲報告生成。第一階段學習超聲視覺語言基本元素；第二階段通過將可信的可見報告點提煉為多影像 QA 和報告風格監督來執行跨視圖證據對接；第三階段使用以臨床錯誤為導向的偏好對進行臨床意識的偏好對齊。從 USReport，我們構建了 USReport-Distilled，擁有 17,670 個基於證據的配對影像訓練實例，以及 USReport-Pref，擁有 21,869 個偏好對；我們還使用了 25,631 個 PubMedVision-US 超聲指令樣本進行領域適應和多影像指令調整。在主要的 USReport-Distilled 基準上，CAMEO 將 EchoVLM 的 BLEU-1 從 0.25 提升至 0.40，ROUGE-1 從 0.28 提升至 0.45，METEOR 從 0.27 提升至 0.43，同時將 ClinicalScore 從 55.02 提升至 74.20。這些結果突顯了基於證據的監督、臨床意識對齊和臨床結構化評估在可靠的超聲報告生成中的價值。

docs.title: Sera: Semantic Representation Aggregation for Reliable and Interpretable Battery Health Forecasting
docs.text:
2610.11567v1 by Jiawei Li, Fang Liu, Wei Zhang, Zuming Liu, Man-Fai Ng, Zhi Wei Seh

Battery state of health (SoH) forecasting is important for battery management, but remains challenging due to nonlinear degradation and heterogeneity across batteries. Existing data-driven approaches primarily use temporal models to learn from numerical battery time series, and higher-level degradation characteristics are often not explicitly represented. These characteristics, however, can provide degradation guidance to support reliable forecasting and make the influence of degradation more interpretable. In this paper, we propose \textsc{Sera}, a \underline{se}mantic \underline{r}epresentation \underline{a}ggregation framework that complements temporal modelling with degradation semantics. Guided by battery domain expertise, \textsc{Sera} extracts degradation semantics from time series and constructs two complementary representations using rule-based knowledge and LLM-based interpretation. The representations are independently encoded and integrated with the representation learned by temporal models through gated aggregations. Experiments on the mainstream benchmark across multiple prediction horizons and different temporal models show that \textsc{Sera} consistently improves forecasting performance, achieving up to a 37.3\% reduction in prediction error over the temporal baseline and enhanced generalizability. Counterfactual analysis examines how forecasts respond to changes in degradation semantics to assess interpretability. The results show that prediction responses are consistent with the meanings of key degradation descriptors across tested horizons. Together, these findings demonstrate that structured degradation semantics and effective aggregation can improve forecasting accuracy and support reliable and interpretable battery health forecasting for advanced battery management.

摘要：電池健康狀態（SoH）預測對於電池管理非常重要，但由於電池之間的非線性劣化和異質性，這仍然是一個挑戰。現有的數據驅動方法主要使用時間模型從數值電池時間序列中學習，而較高層次的劣化特徵往往未被明確表示。然而，這些特徵可以提供劣化指導，以支持可靠的預測並使劣化的影響更具可解釋性。在本文中，我們提出了\textsc{Sera}，一個\underline{se}mantic \underline{r}epresentation \underline{a}ggregation框架，該框架通過劣化語義補充時間建模。受到電池領域專業知識的指導，\textsc{Sera}從時間序列中提取劣化語義，並使用基於規則的知識和基於LLM的解釋構建兩個互補的表示。這些表示獨立編碼，並通過門控聚合與時間模型學習的表示進行整合。在多個預測時間範圍和不同時間模型的主流基準上的實驗顯示，\textsc{Sera}持續改善預測性能，預測誤差相比時間基準最多減少37.3\%，並增強了泛化能力。反事實分析檢查預測如何對劣化語義的變化做出反應，以評估可解釋性。結果顯示，預測反應與測試範圍內關鍵劣化描述符的含義一致。總體而言，這些發現表明，結構化的劣化語義和有效的聚合可以提高預測準確性，並支持可靠且可解釋的電池健康預測，以促進先進的電池管理。

docs.title: Learning to Orchestrate Evolutionary Search: Progression-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic DE-CMA-ES Coordination in Optimization and Structural Model Updating
docs.text:
2610.11546v1 by Lechen Li, Rongye Shi, Wanhuan Zhou

Solving high-dimensional structural model updating problems requires an algorithm capable of navigating complex, non-convex landscapes with correlated parameters. Existing hybrid evolutionary algorithms typically rely on static architectures or fixed switching rules, resulting in disjointed search phases. To address this, this study proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning-governed dynamic DE-CMAES Orchestration (DRL-DCO) algorithm, in which a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)-based actor-critic agent continuously governs the evolutionary process as a single, unified system rather than a mechanical concatenation of algorithms.
